In addition it owns operates maintains and develops voice video and written data transmission telecommunication networks and infrastructure; offers voice video and data transmission telecommunication services to subscribers as well as value-added services content services marketing electronic signature and online money transfer; managing leasing selling purchasing possessing renting and dealing on any property and rights or benefit in any property including movable and immovable property; operates communication systems such as submarine cables satellites and circuits; and purchases sells and distributes fixed line sets computers and its peripherals and spare parts. The company was formerly known as Arab Republic of Egypt National Telecommunications Organization and changed its name to Telecom Egypt Company in March 1998. Telecom Egypt Company was founded in 1854 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A.
Description: Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A. operates as a regional development bank in Latin America. It operates through Own Portfolio and FNE segments. The company offers savings accounts cash and term deposits and custody of securities; specialized credit; credit for infrastructure and urban and rural microfinance; and collection services and credit cards. It is also involved in involved in structuring and distribution of bonds and local short and long-term securities such as debentures notes promissory notes real estate receivables certificates investment funds; third-party asset management consisting of the management of investment funds; exchange operations; portfolio management and credit analysis; and electronic transfers. It serves corporate large medium small and micro-enterprises; agribusinesses rural producers and family farming; urban and rural microfinance sectors; representative entities; individuals; and direct and indirect public administration institutions. The company operates through physical service points including agencies and microcredit units. Banco do Nordeste do Brasil S.A. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil.

Name: Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc
Description: Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc operates as a financial holding company for Guaranty Trust Bank Limited that provides commercial banking services in Nigeria Ghana Gambia Sierra Leone Liberia Cote D'Ivoire Kenya Uganda Rwanda Tanzania and the United Kingdom. It operates through six segments: Corporate Banking Commercial Banking Business Banking Retail Banking SME Banking and Public Sector. The company offers current accounts savings deposits and investment savings products; overdrafts loans and other credit facilities; and foreign currency and derivative products. It also provides private banking and custody services credit and debit cards and consumer loans and mortgages. The company serves corporate customers and blue chips; mid-size and fledgling corporate customers; mid-size commercial customers; small and medium-size enterprises and ventures; and government ministries departments and agencies. Guaranty Trust Holding Company Plc was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: AVI Limited
Description: AVI Limited manufactures processes markets and distributes branded consumer products in the food beverage footwear apparel and cosmetics sectors in South Africa other African countries Europe and internationally. It operates through Entyce Beverages Snackworks I&J Personal Care and Footwear and Apparel segments. The company provides hot beverages such as tea coffee and creamer; sweet and savoury biscuits; baked and fried potato and maize snacks; personal care products including body spray fragrance cosmetics and body lotion products; footwear and apparel; and catches processes markets and distributes seafood. It offers beverages under the Five Roses Freshpak TRINCO Ellis Brown HOUSE OF COFFEES Koffiehuis ciro LAVAZZA and frisco brands; biscuits and snacks under the BAKERS Willards Baker Street and PROVITA brands; frozen food under the I&J brand; and personal care products under the YARDLEY Exclamation and LENTHÉRIC brand names. The company also provides fashion products under the SPITZ KURT GEIGER LACOSTE CARVELA TOSONI GANT and Green Cross GX&Co brands. AVI Limited was incorporated in 1944 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Colombia Telecomunicaciones S. A. E.S.P. BIC
Description: Colombia Telecomunicaciones S. A. E.S.P. BIC together with its subsidiary provides telecommunication services in Colombia Europe and Latin America. The company offers mobile telephony and connectivity; broadband services; and fiber optics services to the home pay television fixed telephony and a range of digital solutions for small medium and large companies and corporations. It also provides fixed and mobile connectivity services as well as a range of digital services for individuals and companies. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Colombia Telecomunicaciones S. A. E.S.P. BIC operates as a subsidiary of Telefónica Hispanoamérica S.L.

Name: Aluar Aluminio Argentino S.A.I.C.
Description: Aluar Aluminio Argentino S.A.I.C. engages in the production and sale of aluminum products in Argentina and internationally. It operates in four segments: Primary Division; Processed Division; Energy Generation; and Engineering Construction and Industrial Assembly. The company offers ingots bars wire rods and plates; value-added products including profiles bars tubes thick laminates and foils; and zincalum. It also supplies energy; and markets energy from the wind farm. Aluar Aluminio Argentino S.A.I.C. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P.
Description: Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. engages in the generation transmission distribution marketing and commercialization of electricity in Colombia Panama Costa Rica and Honduras. The company operates hydroelectric thermal solar and wind power plants. It also offers internet charging stations and sewage and sanitation management services. Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. was formerly known as Empresa de Energia del Pacifico S.A. E.S.P and changed its name to Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P. was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Cali Colombia.

Name: The Housing Bank for Trade and Finance
Description: The Housing Bank for Trade and Finance provides various banking and financial products and services. The company offers savings POS current salaries basic bank time deposit current and other accounts; housing auto small business and personal loans; credit and debit cards and virtual prepaid cards as well as Iskan coin and gain products; money transfer online payments and bank drafts; safety deposit boxes; platform for spot trading in precious metals as well as spot and forward trading in foreign currencies; and e-services. It also provides direct facilities including overdraft discounted bills and contractors financing as well as real estate investment long-term syndicated and revolving loans; loans in foreign currency; indirect trade facility comprising inward and outward letters of credit bills of collection and letters of guarantee; mobile and online electronic services; and industrial start-ups business productive business vehicle and tourism loans. In addition the company offers brokerage services for trading in regional and international equity/debt capital markets; asset management services; investment services such as custody and issuance and investment trusteeships; financial advisory services including equity financing business valuation feasibility studies general financial advisory merger and acquisition and restructuring; treasury sales; and money market services. The Housing Bank for Trade and Finance was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: M. Dias Branco S.A. Indústria e Comércio de Alimentos
Description: M. Dias Branco S.A. Indústria e Comércio de Alimentos manufactures distributes and sells food products in Brazil. Its principal product categories are cookies and crackers pasta wheat flour and bran and margarine and vegetable shortening; cakes cake mixes snacks and nuts toasts peanut butter seasonings chocolates granola and grains breads and wraps sugar and sweeteners. The company offers its products under the Adria Aldente Basilar Bonsabor Estrela Fortaleza Finna Fit Food Frontera Isabela Jasmine Pelágio Pilar Piraquê Predilleto Richester Salsito Smart Taste&Co Treloso Vitarella Zabet and Las Acacias brands. The company also offers refined oils and wheat milling services. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1936 and is headquartered in Eusébio Brazil.

Name: Minera Valparaiso S.A.
Description: Minera Valparaiso S.A. an investment company engages in the generation and sale of electric power. It is also involved in the development of forestry; and management of the real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Sociedad Fábrica de Cemento El Melón S.A. and changed its name to Minera Valparaíso S.A. in 1969. Minera Valparaiso S.A. was incorporated in 1906 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Egypt Aluminum
Description: Egypt Aluminum produces manufactures markets and distributes aluminum products. The company’s products include billets wire rods foundry alloys ingots T. bars and slabs. It also offers hot rolled products including coils sheets and plates; cold rolled products consisting of coils strips and sheets; and disc tread plates and embossod sheet products. In addition the company provides standard construction and industrial extrusion profiles. Egypt Aluminum was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Nag Hammadi Egypt. Egypt Aluminum operates as a subsidiary of Metallurgical Industries Co.

Name: Qatar Insurance Company Q.S.P.C.
Description: Qatar Insurance Company Q.S.P.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the insurance reinsurance real estate asset management and information technology businesses. It operates in six segments: Marine & Aviation Insurance Property & Casualty Insurance Health & Life Insurance Real Estate Advisory and Investments. It offers personal insurance products including car motorcycle travel home boat and life and medical; and business insurance products such as property and commercial marine and aviation energy and motor fleet. The company is involved in real estate activities; issuance of tier 2 notes; and provision of IT and related advisory and investment management services. It operates Qatar the United Arab Emirates the Sultanate of Oman Kuwait the United Kingdom Switzerland Bermuda Singapore Cayman Islands Gibraltar Jersey and Malta. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Companhia de Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia - COELBA
Description: Companhia de Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia - COELBA engages in the distribution of electricity. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Salvador Brazil. Companhia de Eletricidade do Estado da Bahia - COELBA is a subsidiary of Iberdrola S.A.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc S.A.
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc S.A. operates petroleum products service stations in Morocco. The company operates maintains and renovates service stations. It also engages in the manufacture of lubricants bitumens additives fuels and specialty fluids; and distribution lubricants oil and cleaning products as well as engine oil. In addition the company provides logistics services. It serves the service station network industrial customers lubricants aviation gas logistics and renewable energies markets. The company was formerly known as Total Maroc S.A. The company was incorporated in 1927 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. TotalEnergies Marketing Maroc S.A. operates a subsidiary of TOTAL Outre-Mer S.A.

Name: Transcorp Power Plc
Description: Transcorp Power Plc engages in the generation and sale of electric power in Nigeria and internationally. It operates a gas-fired open cycle thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 972 MW. The company was formerly known as Transcorp Power Limited and changed its name to Transcorp Power Plc in January 2024. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Transcorp Power Plc is a subsidiary of Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc.

Name: PSG Financial Services Limited
Description: PSG Financial Services Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various financial services and products in South Africa and Namibia. It operates through three segments: PSG Wealth PSG Asset Management and PSG Insure. The PSG Wealth segment offers portfolio management stockbroking local and offshore investments estate planning financial planning local and offshore fiduciary multi-managed solutions and retirement products to individuals families and businesses. The PSG Asset Management segment provides various investment products including local and international unit trust funds. The PSG Insure segment offers personal short-term insurance products including home car and household insurance; and commercial insurance products such as business and agri-insurance. The company was formerly known as PSG Konsult Limited and changed its name to PSG Financial Services Limited in August 2023. PSG Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Grupo Bolívar S.A.
Description: Grupo Bolívar S.A. invests in administers and manages a portfolio of investments. It invests in shares corporate quotas and interest on national or foreign companies; equity or investment securities bonds issued by public or private entities and other securities with credit content or tradable shares in the market; bonds and other debentures; and trademarks and other forms of industrial properties. The company was founded in 1939 and is based in Bogotá Colombia.

Name: Corporación Financiera Colombiana S.A.
Description: Corporación Financiera Colombiana S.A. operates as a private financial institution in Columbia and Central America. The company offers investment banking services including mergers and acquisitions syndicated contracts capital markets project financing and consulting; and fundraising services. It also provides treasury products consisting of legal tender foreign currency and investment and money market products; and commercial banking services. In addition the company operates road concessions and hotels; produces and commercializes palm oil palm kernel oil palm kernel cake technically specified rubber certified rice seed and bio-inputs; and manufactures synthetic fabrics products specialized in providing shadow and enclosure solutions under the Polisombra brand as well as bonding and fastening media for agro-industrial and home use. Further the company distributes natural gas to users. Corporación Financiera Colombiana S.A. was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Bogotá Colombia.

Name: KCB Group PLC
Description: KCB Group PLC together with its subsidiaries provides corporate investment and retail banking services in Kenya Tanzania South Sudan Rwanda Uganda Burundi and the Democratic Republic of Congo. It operates through four segments: Corporate Banking Retail Banking Treasury and Mortgages. The company offers current accounts savings and fixed deposits consumer loans and mortgages-based lending products to individuals. It also provides overdrafts; residential and commercial buildings and other loans; credit facilities in local and foreign currencies for corporate customers; and investments in securities as well as engages in the funds management activities. In addition the company is involved in the trade finance and forex businesses; and participates in investments in treasury bills and bonds from the central banks. Further it engages in property ownership and management nominee corporate social responsibility asset management and insurance brokerage businesses. Additionally the company provides pay save and borrow solutions for individuals micro and small and medium sized enterprises; life and general insurance products including medical motor crop marine and others; wealth management advisory and brokerage services; distribution of collective investment schemes; and pension management services. KCB Group PLC was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Misr Fertilizer Production Company
Description: Misr Fertilizer Production Company engages in the production and sale of fertilizers ammonia and nitrogen in Egypt. It offers ammonia and urea; and ammonia water urea water industrial urea and scrape urea. The company also exports its products to Europe Latin America Asia Africa and North America. Misr Fertilizer Production Company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: NBS Bank Plc
Description: NBS Bank Plc provides retail and corporate banking services to individuals small and medium enterprises (SME) corporates and public institutions in Malawi. The company offers current savings sweep investment foreign currency-denominated and term deposit accounts. It also provides personal loans employer supported loans short term loans advances to salaried employees and mortgages; SME and corporate overdraft facility; SME loans business loans and order finance as well as loans to business women; and asset finance loans staff motor vehicle loan schemes insurance premium finance lease contracts credit and bancassurance products. In addition it offers international trade services; digital channels and internet banking services; issues debt securities; derivatives for risk management purposes; and invests in liquid assets such as short-term placement and corporate government debt securities. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Blantyre Malawi. NBS Bank Plc is a subsidiary of NICO Holdings Plc.

Name: Zenith Bank Plc
Description: Zenith Bank Plc provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria rest of Africa and internationally. The company accepts current savings salary domiciliary and children’s accounts; fixed and call deposits certificate of deposits and short-term investment funds; sole proprietorship and partnership accounts and trust funds; clubs societies and associations accounts; and limited liability company non-governmental organization embassies and high commission and church accounts. It also offers term loans and leasing services; overdrafts receivable/invoice discounting and LPO finance services; import and export finance facilities; MSME and scheme loans; education loans; and bonds and guarantees. In addition the company provides personal funds management and investment advisory home remittance and trust formation; import letters of credit import bills for collection non-valid for forex/advance payment export transactions invisible remittance and e-services; and collection payment and reporting solutions. Further it offers electronic banking services; virtual credit debit prepaid multi-purpose branded and loyalty and corporate cards; internet banking; and general and life insurance products and services. Additionally the company operates branches; cash centers; ATM terminals; and POS terminals. The company was formerly known as Zenith International Bank Limited and changed its name to Zenith Bank Plc in May 2004. Zenith Bank Plc was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Al Salam Bank B.S.C.
Description: Al Salam Bank B.S.C. provides banking products and services to retail private and corporate customers in Bahrain and Seychelles. It operates through Banking Treasury Investments and Takaful segments. The company provides various retail banking products including current savings call and youth accounts; saving products such as Wakala Danat savings scheme and life planning; property personal and auto financing products; credit prepaid multi-currency and discount cards; property motor home travel domestic helper pleasure craft personal accident and family medical insurance products as well as inventory and equipment coverage; cash deposit machines and ATM services; micro small and medium-sized enterprises packages; loyalty rewards programs; bank app; and self-service kiosks. The company also provides private banking products and services comprising wealth management services; Wakala deposit; multicurrency deposits; prepaid multi-currency cards; family trust and succession planning services; leveraged facilities and property financing services; treasury brokerage and IPO services; Sukuk services; asset management services; and private equity and real estate investments services. In addition it offers corporate banking services such as corporate online banking platform working capital financing term financing global and local trade financing escrow accounts set-up and managing and corporate cards services for large medium and small businesses. Further the company provides capital market and financial market services; interbank commodities Murabaha and Wakala tool Spot and Wa’ad based foreign exchange Sukuk REIT and equity securities products and hedging instruments; and Al Salam Invest trading and investing platform digital trading services and digital wealth management services. The company was formerly known as Al Salam Bank-Bahrain B.S.C. and changed its name to Al Salam Bank B.S.C. in November 2021. Al Salam Bank B.S.C. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Sanabis the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Douja Promotion Groupe Addoha S.A.
Description: Douja Promotion Groupe Addoha S.A. operates in the real estate sector in Morocco. The company offers various real estate properties including land plots projects to commercial and residential. Douja Promotion Groupe Addoha S.A. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Luz del Sur S.A.A.
Description: Luz del Sur S.A.A. engages in the generation transmission and distribution of electricity in Peru. The company has a concession area of approximately 3500 square kilometers which covers 30 municipalities of Metropolitan Lima and the Province of Cañete. It also involved in the purchase sale leasing development and construction of real estate properties. It serves approximately 5 million inhabitants. The company was formerly known as Edelsur. Luz del Sur S.A.A. was incorporated in 1994 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Luz del Sur S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of China Yangtze Power Co. Ltd.

Name: Dis-Chem Pharmacies Limited
Description: Dis-Chem Pharmacies Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the retail and wholesale of healthcare products and pharmaceuticals in South Africa. The company operates through two segments Retail and Wholesale. It owns and operates a chain of retail stores that offers various products including dispensary personal care and beauty healthcare and nutrition baby care and other products. The company also provides pharmaceutical health and front shop products in the wholesale market. In addition it offers customer loyalty programs. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Sociedad de Inversiones Pampa Calichera S.A.
Description: Sociedad de Inversiones Pampa Calichera S.A. invests in the shares of Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A in Chie. It also involved in investing of assets and securities such as shares bonds and debentures. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Las Condes Chile. Sociedad de Inversiones Pampa Calichera S.A. is a subsidiary of Sociedad de Inversiones Oro Blanco S.A.

Name: Direcional Engenharia S.A.
Description: Direcional Engenharia S.A. engages in the development and construction of real estate properties in Brazil. It primarily develops and constructs projects for low-income and middle-income families. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Fortress Real Estate Investments Limited
Description: Fortress is a real estate investment company with a focus on developing and letting premium-grade logistics real estate in SA and CEE as well as growing our convenience and commuter-oriented retail portfolio. Fortress also holds at the date of this report a 162% interest in NEPI Rockcastle the largest listed property company on the JSE with a EUR7 billion portfolio across nine CEE countries. This holding reduced from 242% at 31 December 2023 to 162% at the date of this report.

Name: MRS Logística S.A.
Description: MRS Logística S.A. is a logistics operator that manages a railway network in Brazil. The company manages a railway network of 1643 km in the states of Minas Gerais Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo. It transports containers; cement; bauxite; agricultural commodities such as corn sugar soybeans and soybean meal; and steel products including iron ore coal and coke. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Crédit Immobilier et Hôtelier Société Anonyme
Description: Crédit Immobilier et Hôtelier Société Anonyme provides banking products and services for individuals professionals MDMs and businesses in Morocco. The company offers checking current foreign currency and convertible dirham accounts; financing services for cars education small businesses and real estate projects; savings; classic capital market and money market investments; and bank cards. It provides bancassurance and assistance money transfers insurance brokerage and cash flow management services including cash collection and disbursement management as well as online and mobile banking services. In addition the company offers investment financing such as medium- and long-term credit administrative guarantees pre-financing of public contracts advance on pledged public contracts and other guarantees; operating financing which includes advance on foreign-born claims spot credit overdraft and cash facility commercial paper discount and foreign currency financing; leasing and LLD; and factoring services. Further it provides trade finance comprising import settlement and financing instruments exporter accounts export settlement and financing instruments international guarantees and customs bonds; spot and forward exchange; currency swap and options; commodity hedging; cash collection management; disbursement management; and treasury optimization; as well as issuers and account keeping services. The company was founded in 1920 is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Crédit Immobilier et Hôtelier Société Anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Massira Capital Management.

Name: NMB Bank Plc
Description: NMB Bank Plc provides various banking products and services in Tanzania. It operates through Treasury Retail Banking and Wholesale Banking segments. The company’s deposit products include personal wisdom current bonus business savings business fixed flexi call trust exclusive and executive accounts; fixed and term deposits; and Kilimo Fanikiwa Chap Chap instant Mtoto Akaunti Pamoja agribusiness personal Chipukizi and Mwanachuo accounts. It also provides salaried workers personal cash cover and other collateral secured pensioners outgrowers mortgage car investment and working capital and NMB Mshiko Fasta loan services. In addition the company offers emerging and commercial farmers and warehouse receipt financing; overdraft facilities; small and medium enterprise and micro and small entrepreneur loans; bank guarantees and export and import financing facilities; and supply chain financing services. Further it offers payment solutions for bills payment wage packaging and corporate bulk payment processing; collection solutions; treasury services including spot and forward foreign exchange contracts; foreign exchange swaps; interbank foreign exchange services; international payments; and money markets and investment solutions such as government securities fixed deposits interbank cash registry and custody services. Additionally the company provides credit and debit and prepaid cards; syndications; digital transaction and Chinese desk services; structured asset project and trade financing solutions; advisory services; and internet and mobile banking services as well as property development and leasing services. It offers its products and services to retail customers farmers industrialists small businesses corporations and institutions as well as government institutions. NMB Bank Plc was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos S.A.
Description: Bolsas y Mercados Argentinos S.A. operates as a stock exchange in Argentina. It offers investment access to organizations companies and the general public. The company provides primary placement secondary negotiation settlement and delivery and payment of the traded securities; and the register of shareholders safekeeping and debt payment and allocation activities. It also offers brokers ranking trading transaction clearing and settlement and safekeeping and related services as well as services for broker-dealer members. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Copperbelt Energy Corporation Plc
Description: Copperbelt Energy Corporation Plc engages in the generation distribution transmission sale and trade of electricity to mining customers in Zambia and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). It operates in two segments Sale of Electricity and Wheeling Services. The company operates 94MW photovoltaic solar plant; hydro power station with 40MW generation capacity; and 17 transformers. It is also involved in power trading business. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Kitwe Zambia.

Name: Inversiones La Construcción S.A.
Description: Inversiones La Construcción S.A. operates in the financial and health sectors in Chile Peru and Colombia. It operates through AFP (Pension Fund Administrator) Ispare (Health Insurance Provider) Insurance Healthcare Banking and Other segments. The company is involved in the management of products related to savings and retirement including mandatory individual retirement savings individual and group voluntary retirement savings voluntary individual savings and management and payment of pensions under scheduled or temporary withdrawal programs through a network of branches and digital platforms a website call center and mobile applications; and provision of health insurance solutions plans and supplementary products and collective credit life insurances for mortgage as well as educational and information technology services. It also offers products related to savings and retirement such as annuities individual life insurances consumer loans for pensioners and credit life insurances; and corporate and retail banking products comprising checking accounts lines of credit insurance financing state guarantees foreign trade leasing factoring investments cash management treasury mortgages investments and online time deposits. In addition it operates inpatient outpatient and dental networks; and manages financial and real estate assets. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Santiago Chile. Inversiones La Construcción S.A. is a subsidiary of Cámara Chilena de La Construcción A.G. Endowment Arm.

Name: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Cuprum S.A.
Description: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Cuprum S.A. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm manages mutual funds and equity for its clients. It invests in domestic and foreign stock and bonds. It was founded in December 29 2014 and is based in Santiago Chile. Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Cuprum S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Principal Chile Ltda.

Name: Kuwait Real Estate Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Kuwait Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. a real estate company owns develops and manages buildings in Kuwait and internationally. It operates in three segments: Real Estate Investment and Services. The company is involved in sale purchase renting out and leasing of lands and real estate properties; preparation and implementation of studies of the private and public real estate projects directly or through mediation; trade in materials related to real estate and other works; investment in companies’ shares or projects; contracting works; managing others' properties; and erect private and public buildings and projects including malls entertainment centers and touristic utilities. It also engages in the acquisition sale and purchase of shares and bonds; provision of maintenance works related to the buildings and properties such as civil mechanical and electrical works as well as elevators and air conditioning works; organization of real estate exhibitions; and holding of real estate auctions. In addition the company offers property management services comprising financing valuations market appraisals sales and acquisitions; search advisory sales and financial services property and facilities management project management and consultancy services; consultancy and transactional services such as leasing sales site search and feasibility space analysis and optimization price negotiation renewal and legal services etc.; and hospitality services including sourcing conception and implementation. Further it provides real estate services in the residential retail commercial and hospitality services sectors. Kuwait Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Sigdo Koppers S.A.
Description: Sigdo Koppers S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in services industrial and commercial and automotive businesses worldwide. The company is involved in the engineering construction electromechanical assembling national and international supply management local transport cargo logistics and port services as well as provides consulting services for networking telecommunications optimization of integrated processes automation and renewable energy. In addition the company provides equipment and machinery rental services for transportation agriculture construction mining forestry and industrial sectors; and explosive grade ammonium nitrate as well as distributes automobile products. Further it engages in rock fragmentation business; and production and commercialization of grinding balls and wear elements for mining and industry sectors. Sigdo Koppers S.A. was founded in 1920 and is based in Las Condes Chile.

Name: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Provida S.A.
Description: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Provida S.A. manages equity and fixed income pension funds. The firm was founded on June 1983.

Name: Alicorp S.A.A.
Description: Alicorp S.A.A. provides massive consumption and B2B products in Peru and internationally. It offers bars candies cereals cookies culinary aids flours oils folders margarines oats panetones premixes preserves bakers supplies fillings and toppings frozen breads and pastries butters chocolates noodles desserts soft drinks and gastronomic sauces; and frozen instant laundry semolina and other specialized products. The company also provides home care products and personal care products. In addition it offers nutritional solutions for aquaculture. The company was formerly known as Consorcio de Alimentos Fabril Pacífico S.A. and changed its name to Alicorp S.A.A. in 1997. Alicorp S.A.A. was founded in 1956 and is based in Callao Peru.

Name: Fleury S.A.
Description: Fleury S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides diagnostic imaging clinical analysis fertility and infusions services in Brazil. It operates in two segments Diagnostic Medicine and Integrated Medicine. The company also provides health management services such as telemedicine; orthopedic medicine services; laboratory support; toxicological exam; preventive integrated solutions and clinical research in oncology; integrated solutions research development of processes and services in genomics; and laboratory analysis services. In addition it operates a health platform immunobiological drug infusion center and ophthalmology service centers. Fleury S.A. was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Mapfre Perú Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros S.A.
Description: Mapfre Perú Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. provides various insurance products. It offers SOAT vehicle life home travel funeral personal accident health digital clinic international savings investment retirement burial and other insurance plans. The company provides insurance for workers including EPS SCTR vehicle and group life insurance; and business property and engineering risk credit and transport insurance products as well as letter of guarantee and surety bond. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Miraflores Peru. Mapfre Perú Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. operates as a subsidiary of MAPFRE Internacional SA.

Name: Bank Audi sal
Description: Bank Audi sal together with its subsidiaries engages in the retail commercial investment and private banking activities in Lebanon the Middle East North Africa Turkey and Europe. It operates through Corporate and Commercial Banking Retail and Personal Banking and Treasury and Capital Markets segments. The company offers cash LBP external payroll current deposit and wedding accounts. Its loan products include personal home car working capital term and syndicated loans; project and structured finance; and credit extension/short- and long-term financing. In addition it offers debit and credit cards; cash management services; treasury/financial advisory and trade-related services; capital market services; and investment banking services such as capital market mergers and acquisitions advisory asset management and brokerage services. Further the company provides online services such as ADSL bill domiciliation safe deposit boxes and 3D secure services as well as online banking and payment services. Bank Audi sal was founded in 1830 and is headquartered in Beirut Lebanon.

Name: The Foschini Group Limited
Description: The Foschini Group Limited together with its subsidiaries operates retail stores in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through TFG Africa TFG London and TFG Australia segments. It provides clothing jewellery cellphones accessories cosmetics sporting apparel and homeware and furniture. The company offers its products under the Home American Swiss Homelivingspace Archive BeautyBox Bash The Bed Store Connor Coricraft Dial-a-Bed Exact Fabiani The FIX Foschini Galaxy & Co. Granny Goose G-Star RAW Hi JD Hobbs Jet Jet Home Johnny Bigg Markham Phase Eight White Stuff Relay Jeans RFO Rockwear Sneaker Factory Sportscene Inside Story Sterns Tarocash Totalsports Volpes Whistles and YD brand names. It serves its products online. The company was formerly known as Foschini Limited and changed its name to The Foschini Group Limited in September 2010. The Foschini Group Limited was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Pacífico Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros
Description: Pacífico Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros engages in the insurance business in Peru. It offers life health oncology income personal accident travel funeral vehicle traffic accident and home and goods flex insurance products as well as insurance benefits and EPS health plans. The company provides life law group accident labor student accident and property insurance products as well as insurance for SMEs. In addition it engages in reinsurance business. The company was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Pacífico Compañía de Seguros y Reaseguros is a subsidiary of Credicorp Ltd.

Name: Qatar National Bank
Description: Qatar National Bank together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services in Egypt. It operates through Corporate Individuals and Other Businesses segments. The company offers current checking and savings accounts; certificates of deposit and demand and time deposits; electronic banking services comprising phone Internet mobile E-Wallet email WhatsApp and porta banking services; TransClick services and safe deposit boxes; professional’s programs; life insurance; cash express durable goods green home renovation education doctor cash bankers university professors women maternity break salary advance and smart facilities loans; cash loans against car license and rental proceeds; and mortgage finance auto and used car loans motor bike loans and car loans without sales prohibition. It also provides credit debit corporate deposit and prepaid cards as well as wristbands; banking packages; payroll services; SME and corporate banking services; corporate payment and TradeNet services; payment acceptance; payroll management; and investment banking services such as project and structured finance financial advisory services debt arrangements and syndicated facilities and agency services. In addition the company offers trade finance custody securities and clearing bank and personal investment advisory services. Further it provides supply chain finance treasury and dealing room and financial inclusion services. The company was formerly known as QNB Alahli S.A.E. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Qatar National Bank is a subsidiary of Qatar National Bank (Q.P.S.C.).

Name: Afriquia Gaz SA
Description: Afriquia Gaz SA engages in the distribution of liquefied petroleum gas in Morocco. The company offers liquefied petroleum gas butane and propane; and energy solutions. It provides its products under the under Afriquia Gaz Tissir Gaz Campingaz Ultragaz National Gaz and Butafric brands. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: BLOM Bank SAL
Description: BLOM Bank SAL together with its subsidiaries provides retail commercial investment private banking and insurance and brokerage services in Lebanon Europe the Middle East and North Africa. It operates in four segments: Treasury; Corporate Banking; Retail Banking; and Asset Management and Private Banking. The Treasury segment offers various treasury and investment products and services to investors and other institutional customers. The Corporate Banking segment provides deposits and current accounts loans and other credit facilities trade finance and foreign exchange services for corporate and institutional customers. The Retail Banking segment offers deposits housing loans consumer loans credit cards funds transfer and foreign exchange services as well as other branch related services to meet the personal banking and consumer finance needs of individuals. The Asset Management and Private Banking segment provides investment products and services to institutional investors and intermediaries. The company also offers life and personal accident healthcare motor marine property liabilities miscellaneous and Takaful insurance products and services as well as Islamic banking products and services. In addition it provides advisory and structured products; equity and debt capital markets advisory and brokerage services; economic and equity research; custody; and engages in sponsoring structuring and managing selected real estate projects across retail commercial and residential markets. The company was formerly known as Banque du Liban et d'Outre-Mer and changed its name to BLOM Bank SAL in December 2000. BLOM Bank SAL was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Beirut Lebanon.

Name: Wilson Sons S.A.
Description: Wilson Sons S.A. through its subsidiaries provides port and maritime logistics and supply chain solutions primarily in Brazil. The company manages two container terminals such as Rio Grande and Salvador container terminals. It provides general and bonded warehousing inventory management distribution transport management and foreign trade solutions. The company also operates 80 tugboats; and offers firefighting and others as well as offshore maritime support and ocean towage services. In addition it is involved in the construction conversion maintenance and repair of vessels marine and offshore structures as well as shipping agency activities. Further the company provides logistics services such as wharf for mooring cargo handling storage water storage/supply procurement material inventory management office fluid plant and road scale services; and environmental services waste management tank cleaning and containment barriers to prevent oil spills during docking. It serves shipping owners importers and exporters. The company was founded in 1837 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil. As of June 4 2025 Wilson Sons S.A. operates as a subsidiary of SAS Shipping Agencies Services SÀRL.

Name: National Bank of Oman SAOG
Description: National Bank of Oman SAOG provides various retail wholesale investment and Islamic banking services in the Sultanate of Oman the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. It operates through Retail Banking Wholesale Banking International Banking Islamic Banking and Funding Center segments. The company offers various deposits including savings accounts current accounts retiree accounts and long-term deposits; and home personal and car loans. It also provides life motor and health insurance products; and credit debit prepaid cards and easy payment plans. In addition the company offers trade finance working capital treasury project finance and syndication foreign exchange services money market brokerage services asset management fund management investment research and corporate finance and advisory services. Further the company provides internet banking phone banking transaction banking and call center banking services; and other banking solutions such as cashless cash withdrawals international transfers safe deposit boxes and systematic investment plans. It serves individual retail government corporate and institutional clients. National Bank of Oman SAOG was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: OQ Base Industries (SFZ) SAOG
Description: OQ Base Industries (SFZ) SAOG produces and sells base chemicals in the Sultanate of Oman and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Methanol integrated Plant and LPG Plant segments. The company offers LPG products such as propane butane condensate and cooking gas; and ammonia for use in fertilizers cleaning products fermentation refrigeration and fuels. It also provides methanol for use in production of chemicals; fuel cells biodiesel production and hydrogen generation; and manufacturing of plywood plastics and industrial solvents. OQ Base Industries (SFZ) SAOG was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Salalah Oman. OQ Base Industries (SFZ) SAOG is a subsidiary of OQ SAOC.

Name: Gulf International Services Q.P.S.C.
Description: Gulf International Services Q.P.S.C. through its subsidiaries provides insurance and reinsurance helicopter transportation and drilling and related services in Qatar Turkiye and internationally. It operates in three segments: Drilling Aviation and Insurance. The company owns and operates offshore and onshore drilling rigs that are used for drilling wells for oil and natural gas extraction as well as jack-up accommodation barges and lift boats. It also offers helicopter transportation services including offshore/onshore transporting; long and short-line load lifting; seismic support; VIP executive transport; ad-hoc short-term contracts; air-charter tourist flights aerial photo flights air ambulance and related services; flight training; maintenance and servicing of charters and helicopters; and supply of helicopter spare parts. In addition the company provides a range of insurance and reinsurance services in the construction operations marine and medical fields. Gulf International Services Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Gulf Cables and Electrical Industries Group Company - KPSC
Description: Gulf Cables and Electrical Industries Group Company - KPSC engages in the manufacture and sale of power cables control cables telecommunication cables and overhead conductors in Kuwait and the Middle East. It operates through three segments: Cable Manufacture Investment and Rendering Services. The company’s products include medium and low voltage cables; overhead lines cables; LSZH cables; lead sheathed cables; telephone and special application cables; L.T. cable joints; fire resistant cables; domestic wires; and solar PV cables. It is also involved in investment; general trading and contracting; and sale and purchase of land and properties as well as provision of cleaning and maintenance services. Gulf Cables and Electrical Industries Group Company - KPSC was founded in 1975 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Engie Energia Chile S.A.
Description: Engie Energia Chile S.A. engages in the generation transmission and supply of electricity primarily in Chile. The company transports natural gas and offers energy solutions to mining sectors and companies. It also operates solar wind thermal and hydroelectric power plants. The company was formerly known as E-CL S.A. and changed its name to Engie Energia Chile S.A. in June 2016. Engie Energia Chile S.A. was founded in 1981 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Engie Energia Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of ENGIE Austral S.A.

Name: East African Breweries PLC
Description: East African Breweries PLC engages in the brewery production importation marketing distribution and sale of beer spirits adult non-alcoholic drinks and malt and barley products in Kenya Uganda and Tanzania. The company offers beers under Allsops Lager Balozi Bell Guinness Guinness Smooth Pilsner Lager Serengeti senator Serengeti Lite Tusker Tusker Lite Tusker Malt Tusker NDIMU Tusker Cider WhiteCap Crisp and WhiteCap brand names; spirits under Baileys Baileys Delight Black and White Bullet Bourbon Captain Morgan Chrome Gilbey’s Gordon’s J&B Johnnie Walker Kane Extra Kenya Cane MC Dowells Origin Richot Smirnoff Snapp Tanqueray Uganda Waragi V&A and VAT 69 brand names; and nonalcoholic drinks under alvaro brand name. It also exports its products to South Sudan Rwanda Burundi and the Great Lakes Region. East African Breweries PLC was incorporated in 1922 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. East African Breweries PLC is a subsidiary of Diageo Kenya Limited.

Name: Norte Grande S.A.
Description: Norte Grande S.A. invests in shares and other financial instruments in Chile. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Santiago Chile. Norte Grande S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones SQYA S.A.

Name: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Habitat S.A.
Description: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Habitat S.A. is a publicly owned investment manager. Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Habitat S.A. was founded on June 161982 and is based in Santiago Chile with additional offices in Antofagasta Chile.

Name: Três Tentos Agroindustrial S/A
Description: Três Tentos Agroindustrial S/A together with its subsidiaries operates in the agribusiness sector in Brazil. It operates through three segments: Ag Inputs Grains and Industrial. It markets foliar fertilizers and plant-protection products as well as seeds for soybean corn and wheat. The company is also involved in the physical receipt standardization and trading of grain acquired from third parties as well as grain originating from operations involving rural producer certificates; and processing of soybean to produce meal and biodiesel. In addition it engages in sales promotion; insurance brokerage supplementary pension plans and health plans; credit services such as credit card and financing services to rural producers; and trading of agricultural commodities. The company operates in Africa South America North America Asia Europe and Oceania. Três Tentos Agroindustrial S/A was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Santa Bárbara do Sul Brazil.

Name: Empresa Nacional de Telecomunicaciones S.A.
Description: Empresa Nacional de Telecomunicaciones S.A. operates as a telecommunications company in Chile and Peru. The company provides mobile telecommunications services including voice value added data broadband mobile Internet and landline network services. It serves individuals companies corporations telecommunications companies correspondents distributors department stores or other distribution channels. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Santiago de Chile Chile. Empresa Nacional de Telecomunicaciones S.A. is a subsidiary of Almendral S.A.

Name: Alliances Developpement Immobilier S.A.
Description: Alliances Developpement Immobilier S.A. engages in the real estate business in Morocco. It is also involved in project management for its developed projects; and development of social housing mid-range and high-end residential housing golf resorts and projects for the tourism sectors. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Lafarge Africa Plc
Description: Lafarge Africa Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures markets and sells cement and other cementitious products in Nigeria. It offers aggregates ready-mix concrete and fly-ash products as well as mortar and waste management solutions through geocycle. The company also provides cement solutions under the RoadCem Unicem Ashaka Cem Watershield Cement Elephant Cement AshakaCem PowerMax and Elephant Supaset brands. In addition it offers building and construction services. The company was formerly known as Lafarge Cement WAPCO Nigeria Plc and changed its name to Lafarge Africa Plc in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Ikoyi Nigeria. Lafarge Africa Plc operates as a subsidiary of Caricement BV.

Name: Label Vie S.A.
Description: Label Vie S.A. operates supermarkets hypermarkets and hyper-cash stores in Morocco. It operates stores including Atacadao stores Supeco Carrefour Gourmet Carrefour Market and Carrefour Express and Carrefour stores; and Bringo an e-commerce platform. The company also engages in the construction or acquisition of property for rental purpose; consulting in IT and management applications; cattle feeder butcher livestock merchant and wholesale demo; advertising; construction and property management; import and export; mobile retail; financing; and real estate development business. The company was formerly known as Hyper SA and changed its name to Label Vie S.A. in 2001. Label Vie S.A. was founded in 1985 and is based in Skhirat Morocco.

Name: Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte Sociedad Anónima
Description: Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte Sociedad Anónima engages in the distribution and sale of electricity in Argentina. Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte Sociedad Anónima was formerly known as Empresa Distribuidora Norte Sociedad Anónima and changed its name to Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte Sociedad Anónima in January 1997. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte Sociedad Anónima operates as a subsidiary of Empresa de Energía del Cono Sur S.A.

Name: Serena Energia S.A.
Description: Serena Energia S.A. engages in the provision of renewable energy. It generates electricity through wind water and solar sources. The company was formerly known as Omega Energia S.A. and changed its name to Serena Energia S.A. in December 2023. Serena Energia S.A. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Corporación Favorita C.A.
Description: Corporación Favorita C.A. together with its subsidiaries offers consumer products through supermarkets in Ecuador and internationally. The company’s stores offer groceries meat legumes liquor pharmacy bakery and household products hardware cosmetics and school supplies. It operates its stores under the Supermaxi Megamaxi Akí Gran Akí Super Akí Aki Vecino Titan Super Saldos Jugueton Moblart Rey Romero Mr. Precio Salon De Navidad Sukasa todohogar Cemaco Kywi MegaKywi Ferrex Mr. Books Librimundi Tventas Bebemundo Maxitec Travel Stories Tatoo Metro Plus Zaz Servimax ctec Eureka and Nuà names. In addition the company engages in real estate business; sale of livestock products; sale of books and magazines; breeding dressing and sale of birds and chicken; marketing of clothing furniture and accessories for babies bakery products and articles for home; and trading activities as well as operating pharmacies warehouses and convenience stores. Further it provides laundry slaughtering and automotive services; and maintenance and repair services for electrical components. Corporación Favorita C.A. was founded in 1952 and is based in Quito Ecuador.

Name: Nigerian Breweries Plc
Description: Nigerian Breweries Plc engages in the brewing marketing and selling of lager stout non-alcoholic malt drinks and soft drinks in Nigeria. The company offers its products under the Star Heineken Gulder Star Radler More Desperados 33 Export Star Lite Goldberg Life Tiger Turbo King Legend Williams Legend Climax Amstel Malta Amstel Malta Ultra ZAGG Maltina Malta Goldberg lager Malta Gold malt drink Life Continental lager Hi-Malt and fayrouz brands. It also provides Climax herbal energy drink and spirits. The company sells its products through a network of distributors wholesalers bulk breakers and various retail stores. It also exports its products to the United Kingdom the Netherlands the United States Canada the Middle East rest of Asia and other African countries.  The company was formerly known as Nigerian Brewery Limited and changed its name to Nigerian Breweries Plc in 1990. Nigerian Breweries Plc was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Nigerian Breweries Plc operates as a subsidiary of Heineken N.V.

Name: Alexandria Container&Cargo Handling Company
Description: Alexandria Container&Cargo Handling Company provides container handling services in Egypt. It operates through two segments Alexandria Container Terminal + Head Office and Dekheila Container Terminal segments. The company offers handling transportation and storage of containers and cargoes at designated facilities inside and outside ports; management and operation of multipurpose terminals; shipping agency services; and customs clearance activities. It also provides berthing situation; tariff general handling and storage; and e-services such as container tracking and truck entrance request for companies and people. In addition the company operates the Alexandria and El-Dekheilla terminals; and invests in real estate properties. Further it provides terminal operating systems including CATOS and OCR; and gantry cranes yard gantry cranes and yard handling equipment. Alexandria Container&Cargo Handling Company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Kuwait International Bank K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait International Bank K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries provides Islamic banking products and services for individual and corporate customers in Kuwait. The company operates through Commercial and International Banking; Retail Banking; Treasury Fund Management and Institutional Banking; Investment Management; and Others segments. The company offers various personal banking products and services including youth current savings and salary accounts; Wakala flexible long term and KIB term deposits; vehicle construction material medical and goods Murabaha financing products; debit credit and prepaid cards; online and mobile banking safety deposit box and customs bills payment services; and travel insurance services. It also provides commercial banking products and services such as corporate services cards; call accounts; paycards; contracting and project financing; corporate financing products comprising various financing facilities; real estate financing; and real estate appraisal services. In addition the company offers property management services including marketing and managing properties collection of rent online rent payment preparing accounting reports maintenance services and legal services as well as ATM services. Further it provides liquidity management correspondent banking clearing Murabaha investments and exchange of deposits with banks and other financial institutions as well as commodity Murabaha finance Ijara and Wakala facilities. Additionally the company is involved in the purchase and sale of properties leasing and other trading activities. Kuwait International Bank K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Sociedad de Inversiones Oro Blanco S.A.
Description: Sociedad de Inversiones Oro Blanco S.A. through its subsidiaries invests in various types of goods and securities in Chile. The company’s investments include shares bonds and obligations. It also invests in the shares of a company that engages in the specialty fertilizers iodine lithium and industrial chemical markets; and other financial instruments. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Santiago Chile. Sociedad de Inversiones Oro Blanco S.A. is a subsidiary of Norte Grande S.A.

Name: Holcim (Liban) S.A.L.
Description: Holcim (Liban) S.A.L. a cement company engages in producing exporting and selling of cement and related products in Lebanon. It provides grey and white cement. The company was formerly known as Société des Ciments Libanais and changed its name to Holcim (Liban) S.A.L. The company was incorporated in 1929 and is based in Beirut Lebanon. Holcim (Liban) S.A.L. is a subsidiary of Holcibel S.A.

Name: International Breweries Plc
Description: International Breweries Plc engages in the brewing packaging and marketing of beer alcoholic flavored/non-alcoholic beverages and soft drinks in Nigeria. It provides its products under the Trophy Lager Trophy Stout Budweiser Hero Grand Malt Betamalt Eagle Lager Eagle Stout Castle Lite and Flying Fish brands. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. International Breweries Plc operates as a subsidiary of AB InBev Nigeria Holdings BV.

Name: Vivara Participações S.A.
Description: Vivara Participações S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of jewelry and other articles in Latin America. The company offers jewelry products including rings necklaces alliances toys solitaires earrings chains currents pendants and bracelets. It also provides watches; accessories such as sunglasses wallets and card holders passport and watch holders jewelry box perfumes cuff links keychains pens and knives; and gift products comprising giftable kits quiz graduation infantile mother/grandmother and customizable products. The company sells its products under the Vivara Tag Heuer Victorinox Movado Baume and Mercier Bulova Akium Lacoste Calvin Klein Hugo Boss Tommy Hilfiger Olivia Burton Festina Adidas Life By Vivara Guess. Nautica Porsche Design Montblanc and Festina brands. It offers its products through stores and kiosks as well as through e-commerce. Vivara Participações S.A. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Société de Therapeutique Marocaine S.A.
Description: Société de Therapeutique Marocaine S.A. a pharmaceutical company engages in the manufacturing of licensed medicines in Morocco. It offers products in various therapeutic areas such as allergology oncology cardiology dental dermatology endocrinology gastroenterology gynecology ophthalmology ENT pediatric pulmonology reanimation rheumatology central nervous system (CNS) and urology as well as antibiotics and generics. The company also provides its products in various forms including tablets capsules pouches syrups suspensions powders collyriums flexible pouches suppositories creams and pomades injectable solutions and self-injectable syringes. In addition it imports licensed medicines and dental products as well as biotechnology products; and involved in subcontracted production. The company exports its products to Europe Maghreb Sub-Saharan Africa and the Persian Gulf. Société de Therapeutique Marocaine S.A. was founded in 1976 and is based in Bouskoura Morocco.

Name: Aamal Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Aamal Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the industrial manufacturing trading and distribution managed services and property management and development businesses in Qatar and internationally. The company’s Industrial Manufacturing segment is involved in the manufacture wholesale and/or retail distribution of electric cables and tools aggregates ready-mix concrete cement blocks and pipes; and provision of services in relation to industrial investment repair and construction of power plants as well as management of industrial enterprises. Its Trading and Distribution segment engages in the wholesale and/or retail distribution of pharmaceutical and consumable items home appliances medical equipment tyres lubricants and industrial printing products. The company’s Managed Services segment offers housekeeping and cleaning entertainment and amusement and call center services as well as operates as a travel agent. Its Property segment engages in the retail outlet complex leasing real estate investment and property rental businesses. The company also engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of general consumable products; sale of footwear and baby care products and batteries; development and management of factories; and purchasing and leasing of ships; and clinical activities. In addition it offers curb stones interlock slabs and cement bricks; office supplies computer equipment and automobile products trading; printing and laminating; administration consultancy and electronic study program; indoor and outdoor cleaning; property management and historical and archaeological; oil and gas field maintenance; and IT consultancy and software services as well as glass reinforced pipes systems. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Doha Qatar. Aamal Company Q.P.S.C. is a subsidiary of Al Faisal Holding Company LLC.

Name: Mezzan Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Mezzan Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries manufactures sells and distributes food and non-food products in Kuwait the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates Qatar Jordan Afghanistan and Iraq. The company provides cakes biscuits potato chips snacks meats water canned foods and dairy products; contract catering services for short-term and long-term delivery of cooked food as well as on site operation of food facilities and catering for one off events; sales and delivery of foods; and ancillary storage logistics repairs and maintenance services and sale of non-food items. It distributes health and beauty products medicines medical devices manufacturing of medicine medical products and household products; and plastic materials lube oil and carton for packaging. In addition the company engages in the manufacturing and wholesale distribution of meat products and general trading in foodstuff; trading of household goods and cleaning materials; manufacturing of paper and nylon products; and recycling and trading of oil lubricants and related products. Further it offers storage services security services; distributes food and beverages; and manufactures and sells pastries and cakes. The company was founded in 1940 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Bradespar S.A.
Description: Bradespar S.A. through its interest in VALE operates as a mining company in the production of iron ore and pellets and nickel in Brazil. The company also produces copper thermal and metallurgical coal manganese platinum group metals gold and silver as well as raw materials for the steel industry with applications in the stainless-steel industry and metal alloys used in the production of various products. Bradespar S.A. was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Sociedad Matriz SAAM S.A.
Description: Sociedad Matriz SAAM S.A. through its subsidiaries provides tugboat services air cargo logistics and real estate rentals in South America Central America and North America. The company offers harbour towage services such as berthing and unberthing services for a range of vessels and cargos; stand-by maneuvers and other related activities for vessels transporting liquefied natural gas; and escort service for oil and gas tankers. It also provides assistance services in ship-to-shore and single point mooring operations; inland and marine terminals maritime services; and direct and indirect escort positioning and anchoring of oil and gas platforms. In addition it engages in acquiring selling marketing and constructing of real estate properties; warehouse management; equipment and machinery leasing; travel agency; and barge assistance coastal oil rigs towage assistance civil construction assistance and any salvage work. Further it provides services to aircraft freight and passengers at airports airport maintenance aircraft maintenance and repair cargo handling storage shipping and delivery and ground transportation of passengers and cargo; loading unloading storage port operator weighing and launch vessel ownership and agency port equipment and cargo and container transport and handling service; air land and sea freight and courier services; IT solutions storage and distribution and other related services; and management services. Additionally the company offers tourism trade accommodation transport exports and imports services; invests in shares bonds debentures company rights debts promissory notes bills of exchange certificates of deposit mutual fund shares savings plans marketable securities negotiable securities and various commercial paper; and imports machinery and equipment. The company operates a fleet of 210 tugboats. Sociedad Matriz SAAM S.A. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Las Condes Chile.

Name: CELSIA S.A. E.S.P.
Description: CELSIA S.A. E.S.P. engages in the generation transmission distribution and sale of electricity to residential commercial industrial and public sectors in Colombia and Central America. It operates hydroelectric solar wind and thermal power plants; and transmission and distribution substations. It also offers solar panels for homes; chargers for electric vehicles and solar farms; cooling districts and backup energy projects; and solutions to real estate developments such as energy internet and charging stations as well as sewage and sanitation management solutions. The company was formerly known as Compañia Colombiana de Inversiones S.A. E.S.P. CELSIA S.A. E.S.P. was founded in 1919 and is based in Medellín Colombia. CELSIA S.A. E.S.P. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo Argos S.A.

Name: Iguatemi S.A.
Description: Iguatemi S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the commercial exploration and planning of shopping centers in Brazil. The company is also involved in the purchase and sale of real estate. In addition it provides economic financial advisory and consultancy services. The company was formerly known as Jereissati Participações S.A. and changed its name to Iguatemi S.A. in November 2021. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Almacenes Éxito S.A.
Description: Almacenes Éxito S.A. operates as a retail commerce company in Columbia Argentina and Uruguay. It operates a chain of retail stores primarily under the Éxito Carulla Surtimax Super Inter Surti Mayorista Libertad Mini Libertad Devoto Disco and Géant brands. The company is involved in the online commerce activities. In addition it engages in the credit facilities insurance money transfers and remittances mobile phone services trade tourist package trips and tickets repair and maintain furnishings paperwork and energy trade activities; acquisition and building commercial premises for establishing stores malls or other locations; investing in property promoting and developing various kinds of real estate projects; and leasing of premises. Further the company invests in shares bonds trade papers and other securities; enters into firm factoring agreements; and distributes oil-based liquid fuels through service stations as well as alcohols biofuels and natural gas for vehicles and other fuels used in the automotive industrial fluvial maritime and air transport sectors. Almacenes Éxito S.A. was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Envigado Colombia. Almacenes Éxito S.A. is a subsidiary of Cama Commercial Group Corp.

Name: Telkom SA SOC Ltd
Description: Telkom SA SOC Ltd operates as an integrated communications and information technology (IT) services provider in South Africa the United States the United Kingdom rest of Europe and internationally. It operates through Openserve Telkom Consumer BCX Gyro and Other segments. The company offers mobile and fixed-line telecommunication services including broadband optical and carrier business-to-business connectivity interconnect-based services broadband data voice content and gaming solutions; and small and medium entity information communication and technology solutions as well as business mobility global telecommunication CPE-related services converged communication managed application-centric data networking managed local area networking unified collaboration as a service and internet and value-added services. It also provides IT advertising digital and social media advertising e-commerce and omni-channel services; and printed directory and international maritime services. In addition the company rents properties masts and towers; and offers insurance products and services. It serves residential business government wholesale and corporate customers. Telkom SA SOC Ltd was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Centurion South Africa.

Name: SLC Agrícola S.A.
Description: SLC Agrícola S.A. produces and sells agricultural products in Brazil and internationally. The company offers soybean corn cotton wheat millet crotalaria sorghum sesame seed corn popcorn mung bean and brachiaria crops. In addition it is involved in the cattle raising and livestock business. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil.

Name: Transportadora de Gas del Norte S.A.
Description: Transportadora de Gas del Norte S.A. engages in the natural gas transportation in the north and central west regions of Argentina. The company operates and maintains approximately 11222 km of both own and third party pipelines. It also provides operation maintenance integrity pipeline connection and hot taps engineering pipeline works management consulting training SCADA and communications community damage prevention and special projects services to third-party pipelines in Argentina Chile Mexico Peru and Uruguay. Transportadora de Gas del Norte S.A. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. The company operates as a subsidiary of Gasinvest S.A.

Name: Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P. through its subsidiaries operates in the financial services food petrochemicals and oil services media real estate and education sectors in Kuwait rest of the GCC rest of the Middle East rest of Asia rest of North Africa Europe and North America. It operates in six segments: Commercial Banking; Asset Management and Investment Banking; Media & Satellite Services; Energy; Industrial and Logistics; and Hospitality and Real Estate. The company offers commercial banking services including retail corporate and private banking; treasury products; and digital satellite services media pay TV services via satellite cable radio channels and music and video online streaming. It is also involved in asset management and investment banking activities such as corporate finance investment advisory and research and wealth management; manufacturing sale supply store export and distribution of various aromatics chemical and petrochemical materials and related derivatives; oil field maintenance and drilling services; setting up projects in the oil and gas and renewable energy sector; and consultancy activities. In addition the company engages in industrial project development food utilities transportation logistics and related supply chain services; hospitality and real estate sector; dairy production; leasing of equipment and vehicles; manufacture of rubber and plastic materials; stevedoring marine brokerage printing photography management management property management marketing facilities and hotel management research and development touristic development cosmetic agricultural medical construction educational live event and advertising services; broadcasting TV and IP streaming; managing and operating systems; and trading in electronic and satellite receiving equipment. Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Barloworld Limited
Description: Barloworld Limited operates as an industrial processing distribution and services company in Southern Africa the United Kingdom Australia Russia and Mongolia. The company operates through Equipment Southern Africa Ingrain Equipment Mongolia Equipment Russia and Other segments. The company offers industrial equipment and services comprising of earthmoving equipment industrial services and power systems that enable various mining construction and power solutions. It also manufactures various products which includes food and beverages paper pharmaceuticals building material and adhesives and others. In addition the company offers starch glucose and other products; and salvage management and disposal services. The company was founded in 1902 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Brava Energia S.A.
Description: Brava Energia S.A. engages in the exploration and production of oil and natural gas in Brazil. The company was formerly known as 3R Petroleum Óleo e Gás S.A. and changed its name to Brava Energia S.A. in September 2024. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries operates in the automotive business in Kuwait Iraq Egypt and the United Arab Emirates. The company imports distributes and sells vehicles and spare parts; and provides services related to vehicle inspection repair and maintenance. It also engages in dealership of heavy trucks; car rental and leasing; insurance brokerage; used vehicle sales; and real estate business. In addition the company operates showrooms and service centers; and offers after-sales services car valuation services technical inspection and vehicle registration renewal services. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Ali Al-Ghanim Sons Automotive Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Ali Alghanim Sons Holding Company K.S.C.C.

Name: CRDB Bank Plc
Description: CRDB Bank Plc together with its subsidiaries provides corporate and retail banking services for individuals small and medium enterprises (SME) corporates and high net worth individuals in the United Republic of Tanzania the Republic of Burundi and the Democratic Republic of Congo. It operates through Corporate Banking Retail Banking and Treasury segments.
