The company offers current malkia savings junior jumbo call fixed deposit salary bidii Hodari teen niamoja pension and scholar accounts; personal and salary advance loans; SME MSE malkia and komboa loans; debit cards; short- and long-term loans; and trade finance overdraft facilities contract financing for construction asset-based financing utility services general business and agricultural based project financing. It also provides foreign exchange financial custodial and registrar-ship services; government securities; securities brokerage services; internet and mobile banking services; and motor credit life assurance personal accident domestic package fire group life fidelity guarantee goods in transit marine money and all risk insurance products. The company operates through a network of multiple branches automated teller machines point of sales terminals and agents. CRDB Bank Plc was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Bank Dhofar SAOG
Description: Bank Dhofar SAOG provides corporate retail and investment banking products and services to individuals families and businesses in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in four segments: Retail Banking Corporate Banking Treasury and Investments and Islamic Banking. The company offers savings current ladies youth expatriate children minor escrow overdraft relationship banking and private banking accounts; recurring call fixed and flexi deposit accounts; education and retirement savings plans; housing auto personal and term loans as well as other credit facilities; debit and credit cards; consumer loans and mortgages; wealth management; and project finance services. It also provides accident illness home health travel and motor insurance products; and corporate internet banking and collections point of sale payment gateway remote cheque capture and deposit e-statement and SMS alert services. In addition the company offers trade finance services; bonds and guarantees; trade and transactional banking services; export and import letters of credit; letters of guarantee and documentary collections; commercial and treasury payments; Nostro and Vostro accounts; treasury products; cash management and risk participation services; and fund management investment in debt instruments and advisory services as well as engages in the trading of money markets foreign currencies and derivatives; and arranging/participating in syndicated/club/bilateral loans. Further it provides investment savings products; custody; financial planning and investment services; investment management and institutional finance services; and Islamic and online banking services. Additionally the company operates ATMs and CDMs. Bank Dhofar SAOG was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Jordan Islamic Bank
Description: Jordan Islamic Bank together with its subsidiaries provides financial banking and investment services in Jordan and internationally. The company offers current salary current demand saving call term notice investment by proxy and fund accounts; and house car and furniture financing services. It also provides Murabaha sale installment sale and musawama products; and investment services such as craftsmen financing Musharaka and Mudaraba as well as buys sells and rents real estate properties. In addition the company offers cards electronic and remittance services; online and mobile banking and SMS services; and education and brokerage services as well as safe deposit boxes. It operates through a network of various branches and banking offices. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Amman Jordan. Jordan Islamic Bank operates as a subsidiary of Al Baraka Group B.S.C.

Name: Cerveceria San Juan S.A.
Description: Cerveceria San Juan S.A. engages in the production packaging distribution and sale of beer in Peru. It offers malted beverages soft drinks liquors and waters as well as nutritional drinks. The company was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Pucallpa Peru. Cerveceria San Juan S.A. is a subsidiary of Anheuser-Bush InBev NV/SA.

Name: Transcorp Hotels Plc
Description: Transcorp Hotels Plc together with its subsidiaries provides hospitality services in Nigeria. The company’s hotel services include accommodation cuisines equipped meeting rooms and leisure facilities to business travelers and tourists. It operates the Transcorp Hilton hotel located in Abuja; and Aura by Transcorp Hotels. The company was formerly known as Transnational Hotels and Tourism Services Limited and changed its name to Transcorp Hotels Plc in 2014. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Abuja Nigeria. Transcorp Hotels Plc is a subsidiary of Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc.

Name: Abu Qir Fertilizers and Chemical Industries Co. (S.A.E.)
Description: Abu Qir Fertilizers and Chemical Industries Co. (S.A.E.) manufactures and sells nitrogenous fertilizers chemical and other related materials in Egypt and internationally. The company offers prilled urea prilled urea treated with zinc sulphate granular ammonium nitrate granular urea granular urea treated with magnesium and ammonium sulphate urea ammonium nitrate and liquid ammonia. It also provides maintenance for mechanical electrical instrumentation fire protection and detection and bulk material handling facilities; plant shutdowns/turnaround; turbomachinery vibration diagnosis and balancing; construction and piping; workshop; inspection; lifting; water treatment; electrical maintenance; instrumentation; and laboratory analysis services. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Fras-le S.A.
Description: Fras-le S.A. provides friction materials for braking systems and other products in Brazil England Argentina the United States China India Uruguay Holland Chile Colombia Germany South America and internationally. It operates through Automakers and Replacement segments. The company offers brake linings for commercial vehicles brake pads for commercial vehicles automobiles motorcycles and small aircraft brake linings for automobiles railway shoes brake shoes for commercial vehicles and automobiles clutch linings molded linings and universal plates and industrial products; brake disc drum master cylinder servos wheel cylinder wheel hubs repairs actuators and check valves. The company sells its products under the FRAS-LE Controil FREMAX and NAKATA brands. It also exports its products. Fras-le S.A. was founded in 1954 and is based in Caxias Do Sul Brazil. Fras-le S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Randon S.A. Implementos e Participações.

Name: Stanbic IBTC Holdings PLC
Description: Stanbic IBTC Holdings PLC a financial holding company provides banking and other financial services to individuals businesses institutions and corporations in Nigeria and internationally. The Business and Commercial Banking segment offers residential accommodation financing solutions and fleet management and related services to retail small and medium sized businesses and large commercial enterprises. The Corporate and Investment Banking segment provides transactional and lending products such as cash management international trade finance working capital and investor services solutions; and global markets including foreign exchange money markets interest rates equities credit and commodities. This segment also offers investment banking services including advisory and financing solutions for term lending to structured and specialized products across equity and debt capital markets. The Personal and Private Banking segment provides credit card facilities to individuals and businesses; merchant acquiring services; digital payment through various products and platforms; mobile money; and cross-border businesses. This segment offers retail lending; and transactional savings payment and liquidity management solutions. The Insurance and Asset Management segment provides investment portfolio and trust and fund management services as well as offers life insurance and trusteeship services. It undertakes venture capital projects; acts as an investor and portfolio manager an executor and trustee of wills and trusts and promoter of unit trust and funds; administrates and manages pension fund assets; general corporate finance and debt advisory services; and provides agency stockbroking and insurance brokerage services. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Stanbic IBTC Holdings PLC is a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: Odontoprev S.A.
Description: Odontoprev S.A. provides private dental care plans in Brazil. The company operates through Corporate Small and Medium-Sized Enterprise (SME) Individual and Other segments. The company manages and sells dental care plans to corporations and/or individuals. It is also involved in commercial advisory consulting and business management services; develops and licenses software programs; wholesale and retail trade of products and equipment sanitizers drugs medicines pharmaceutical inputs and related items; provision of storage loading deposit organization tidying custody of goods technical and administrative programming services as well as general management of assets and business. In addition the company engages in integrating technologies to develop dental solutions; and provide specialized services related to accidents and illnesses besides actuarial financial administrative and commercial and risk management services. Odontoprev S.A. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil. Odontoprev S.A. is a subsidiary of Bradesco Saúde S.A.

Name: Jazeera Airways K.S.C.P.
Description: Jazeera Airways K.S.C.P. engages in providing air transportation and commercial passenger services in Kuwait Middle East Central South Asia and Europe. It operates through Passenger Airline Service and Terminal Operations segments. The company operates a fleet of Airbus A320 and A320neo aircraft. It also owns and operates a terminal at Kuwait International Airport. In addition the company provides park and fly remote check-in services; and air cargo services including express courier unaccompanied bags human remains dangerous goods and general and perishable cargo services. It offers its services through its website and mobile app. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: The SPAR Group Ltd
Description: The SPAR Group Ltd engages in the wholesale and distribution of goods and services to grocery stores and other group retail outlets in South Africa and internationally. The company offers fresh produce in-store bakery butchery deli ready-to-eat meals home-meal replacements groceries general merchandise baked foods liquor products building and hardware products coffee dispensary and health-related products confectionery health and beauty frozen foods catering products wines and non-food items. The SPAR Group Ltd operates stores under the Bean Tree PHARMACY at SPAR Chikka Chicken SPAR Freshline & SPAR Bakery Good Living McCoy Pies SaveMor SPAR Products SPAR Signature Selection SPAR Butchery SPAR Express and The Food Stall brands. The company was founded in 1932 and is headquartered in Pinetown South Africa.

Name: Southern Peru Copper Corporation - Sucursal del Peru
Description: Southern Peru Copper Corporation - Sucursal del Peru engages in the mining milling and floatation of ore to produce copper concentrates. The company also smelts and refines copper concentrate to produce copper anodes and cathodes as well as molybdenum sulfuric acid gold silver and other by-product concentrates. It operates the Toquepala mining unit located in the region of Tacna; the Cuajone mining unit situated in the region of Moquegua; and a foundry and refinery property located in Ilo Peru; and holds interests in the Tia Maria project in Arequipa the Quebrada Honda dam in Tacna the Quaternary Crushing plant in Cuajone the Los Chancas project in Apurimac and the Michiquillay project in Cajamarca. The company also exports its copper products to the United States Europe Asia and South American countries. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Lima Peru. Southern Peru Copper Corporation - Sucursal del Peru operates as a subsidiary of Southern Copper Corporation.

Name: Crédit du Maroc S.A.
Description: Crédit du Maroc S.A. provides various banking and financial products and services in Morocco. The company offers bank accounts bank cards and online banking services; real estate and car loans and consumer credits; savings insurance and pension and education savings; and accident protection as well as death and disability multi-risk home and payment means insurance for individuals. The company also offers accounts and cards; funding for equipment credit and furniture leasing as well as real loans; financial investments; and life provident and account insurance to professionals. In addition it provides accounts and cards; funding for agricultural campaign material and development; financial investments; and life and account insurance products to farmers. Further the company provides payment methods international activities remote banking and flow management services; project financing such as investment financing funding of the operating cycle and financing of the corporate finance; and investment in UCITS term investments and negotiable debt securities for companies. Additionally it provides private banking products and services. The company formerly known as Credit Lyonnais Maroc and changed its name to Crédit du Maroc S.A. 1966. The company was founded in 1929 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Crédit du Maroc S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Groupe Holmarcom.

Name: Premier Group Limited
Description: Premier Group Limited operates as a consumer-packaged goods company in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Millbake and Groceries and International segments. The company manufactures distributes and sells bread flour maize meal sugar confectionary and nutritional beverages as well as biscuits pasta rice and wheat products. It also provides animal feeds feminine hygiene and other personal care products that include intimate care menstrual and cotton wool products. In addition the company engages in flour milling; food processing; investment holding; baking; sales and distribution; and management services. The company sells its products under the Fepro Iwisa Mageu Iwisa No.1 PowerUp Mandla Mahewu Nyala Amahewu Super Sun Mageu Cream and Smileez biscuits CIM Dry Biscuits BB Bakeries Blue Ribbon Blue Ribbon Square Mister Bread S.U.B. Star Bakeries Manhattan Champion Mister Sweet Rascals Super C Impala Invicta Ligugu Mega Star Nyala Premier Braaipap Super Sun Top Score Polana Sunblest Dove Cotton Lil-Lets Crown Select Dourado Bakers Pride Favorita Florbela and Snowflake brands. The company was founded in 1824 and is headquartered in Waterfall South Africa.

Name: Cogna Educação S.A.
Description: Cogna Educação S.A. operates as an educational organization in Brazil and internationally. It operates through three segments: Kroton Vasta and Saber. The company provides in-person and distance learning for higher education and postgraduate courses; and editing marketing and distribution of textbooks paradidactic books and handouts. It also offers basic education pre-university preparatory courses and language courses; and complementary activities such as education technology development for services to complement management and training. In addition the company advises on and/or facilitates direct and indirect financing for students; and develops software for adaptive teaching and academic management optimization. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Minerva S.A.
Description: Minerva S.A. produces and sells fresh beef livestock and by-products in South America and internationally. The company is also involved in slaughtering deboning and meat processing; selling chilled frozen and processed meat as well as beef pork and poultry products; exporting and selling live cattle; and breeding and selling live cattle lambs pigs and other live animals. In addition it trades in electricity; trades in proteins and food products; sells third parties’ brands primarily Swift products; and prepares products for animals which include meat/bone meal blood and tallow. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Barretos Brazil.

Name: IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC
Description: IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC engages in the development management and marketing of hotels and resorts in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates Africa and internationally. It operates through Property Development Hospitality Investments and Others segments. The company offers hotel management serviced homes and vacation rentals services under the Fairmont Hotels & Resorts Kempinski Hotels Mövenpick Hotels & Resorts and Sheraton Hotels & Resorts brands. It also purchases develops manages and sells real estate properties and land; and trades in private residential plots. In addition the company holds purchases and sells shares and bonds of real estate companies; provides studies and consultations on real estate issues. Further it prepares real estate auctions; provides buildings general contracting; holds and manages commercial and residential complexes; establishes building foundations for residential commercial maintenance touristic urban athletic buildings and projects; and operates beach clubs. Additionally the company offers travel and tourism services such as personal travel consultancy and air chartering services as well as provides events meetings corporate incentive arrangements; and offers assess to private jets yachts and tailor-creating travel experiences. The company was formerly known as Offset Consulting and Project Management Company – WLL – Najwa Ahmed Abdelaziz Al-Qatami and Partners and changed its name to IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC in May 2005. IFA Hotels and Resorts - KPSC was founded in 1995 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Pick n Pay Stores Limited
Description: Pick n Pay Stores Limited an investment holding company engages in the retail of food health and beauty products general merchandise clothing liquor and additional value-added-services in South Africa and Rest of Africa. The company owns and franchises hypermarkets supermarkets clothing stores liquor stores superstores build stores and express stores. It also offers its products online. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Commercial Real Estate Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Commercial Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. engages in the real estate business in the State of Kuwait Gulf countries and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate Hotel and Investment. Its property portfolio includes office towers malls/restaurant complexes residential properties and ballrooms. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Banco Patagonia S.A.
Description: Banco Patagonia S.A. provides various banking products and services in Argentina. It offers savings retired salary current agro and minor accounts; accounts for SMEs; and foreign trade services. The company also provides Patagonia leasing capital marketing and alternative financing services. In addition it offers loans; safe deposit boxes; credit and debit cards; and home car motorbike mobility ATM robbery protected belongings smartphone pets personal accidents life health burial and rental bond insurance products. Further the company provides financial agency services; mobile banking services; business cards; investments for fixed-term mutual funds and financial trusts; and collection payment inter-banking and AFIP services. It serves individuals businesses professionals SMEs agro-business clients the public sector and institutional clients. The company was incorporated in 1928 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Banco Patagonia S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco do Brasil S.A.

Name: Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.)
Description: Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) engages in real estate and project development and investment business in Egypt. The company involved in the planning and construction of urban districts and provision of utilities and services. Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) was founded in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt. Emaar Misr for Development Company (S.A.E.) is a subsidiary of Emaar Properties PJSC.

Name: Truworths International Limited
Description: Truworths International Limited an investment holding and management company engages in the retail of fashion apparel and accessories. It operates through Truworths Africa and Office UK segments. The company offers accessories bags bottoms jackets and coats jewellery and watches shoes sleepwear tops and Gifts for women men and kids. It also provides purses denim dresses lingerie maternity formals and co-ord sets for women; wallets suiting and underwears for men; kids multipacks for kids. In addition the company offers fragrances for men and women and kids; skincare such as cleansing moisturisers bath and body gifting special treatments mens grooming and suncare; and makups for eyes gifting lips face and nails. Further it provides homeware including blankets and throws; duvet covers and inners; sheeting; pillowcases; pillows for bedroom; bathmats; bathroom accessories; home fragrances; towels; and bathroom fragrance for bathroom; and curtains decor rugs scatter cushions dining the flower shop and kitchen accessories for living; and soft toys for kids. The company offers its products under various range of brands through a network of stores concession outlets wholesale partnerships and an ecommerce channel. Truworths International Limited was founded in 1917 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Cerveceria Nacional CN S.A.
Description: Cerveceria Nacional CN S.A. engages in the production and sale of beer and malt extracts. The company was founded in 1887 and is based in Guayaquil Ecuador. Cerveceria Nacional CN S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Ab Inbev Holdings Limited.

Name: United Bank for Africa Plc
Description: United Bank for Africa Plc together with its subsidiaries primarily provides corporate commercial and retail banking services in Nigeria rest of Africa and internationally. The company operates through Corporate Banking Retail/Commercial Banking and Treasury and Financial Markets segments. It offers savings current salary domiciliary diaspora and fixed deposit accounts. The company also provides corporate banking financial solutions to multinationals regional companies state-owned companies non-governmental organizations international and multinational organizations and financial institutions; retail/commercial banking products and services to middle and retail segments; and financing and risk management solutions and advisory services to corporate and institutional customers. In addition it offers energy banking services including treasury products current/dom. services credit facilities credit agency backed financing solutions note issuance facilities FCY lending and hedging products structured/project finance loan syndication E–banking services auto notification services card-based services government payment and collection services and in plant tellering services. Further the company provides mobile Internet and magic banking as well as notification services; SME loans and advances including working capital loans SME asset finance healthcare loans creative industry finance young entrepreneurs loans and school loans as well as SME accounts; business registration support services; international trade services; card solutions; merchant services; strategic advisory and research; and e-payment solutions. Additionally it offers trade remittance treasury management custody/investor and cash management services. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Banco Pichincha C.A.
Description: Banco Pichincha C.A. provides various banking services in Ecuador. It offers basic savings compatriot transactional flexible and young future savings accounts as well as current accounts. The company provides multipurpose and open line credit; used heavy lightweight vehicles and vehicle biocredit; educational credits; and mortgage credit including public and social interest housing consulting rooms office and premise biocredit for green housing construction housing for migrants and new or used housing credit as well as mortgage loan for construction expand and remodel. In addition it offers personal credit such as personal guarantee used vehicles educational open line and mortgage-secured credit; investment-backed credit; vehicle productive and builder biocredit; credit for woman; distributor-supplier business credit; constructor credit; and business credit. Further the company provides financial payment solutions; corporate prepaid and business card; credit card activation; forex trading trust payroll phone recharge online payment money receiving online purchase international transfer and shipments from abroad services; insurance products; cash management; agribusiness products; and web mobile and telephone banking. The company was formerly known as Banco del Pichincha C.A. and changed its name to Banco Pichincha C.A. in September 2006. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Quito Ecuador. Banco Pichincha C.A. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo Financiero Pichincha.

Name: Agility Public Warehousing Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Agility Public Warehousing Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries operates as an aviation services company under Agility brand name in the Middle East Europe Asia the United States and Africa. The company provides real estate fuel logistics airplane ground handling and cleaning services cargo and lounge management customs operations and management construction and remote site services customs consulting and waste recycling services. In addition it offers inventory management order fulfilment transportation and warehousing and rental services; and ground handling and airport services which includes ramp passengers into-plane fuelling and other aviation related services. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Motus Holdings Limited
Description: Motus Holdings Limited provides automotive mobility solutions in South Africa the United Kingdom Australia and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Import and Distribution; Retail and Rental; Mobility Solutions; Aftermarket Parts; and Head Office and Eliminations. It imports and distributes passenger and light commercial vehicles and parts to serve a network of dealerships vehicle rental companies fleets and government institutions; retails new and pre-owned passenger and commercial vehicles; sells parts and accessories; provides servicing and maintenance of vehicles; and provides treasury management fleet management telemetry and business process outsourcing services. The company also distributes wholesales and retails parts and accessories for out-of-warranty vehicles; and develops manages administers distributes vehicle related financial products and services. Motus Holdings Limited was founded in 1948 and is based in Bedfordview South Africa.

Name: Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC
Description: Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the wealth management credit and assets management debt collections and venture capital investment businesses in Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Instalment credit Investments Financial Brokerage and Real Estate. The company provides asset management and brokerage services such as margin trading non-discretionary and custody portfolios; advises on real estate private equity and development investments; and venture capital services. It provides working capital inventory replenishment and capital assets purchases to small and medium businesses; and debt collector services. In addition the company engages in financing services including financing management and brokerage; trading in real estate activities; general trading and contracting; project management; hospitality activities; credit facilities services; investment activities; financial advisory services; consulting services; fund management; and digital currency services. The company was formerly known as International Finance Company (K.P.S.C) and changed its name to Arzan Financial Group for Financing and Investment - KPSC in November 2013. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A.
Description: EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A. operates as an infrastructure company that operates highway concessions in Brazil. It operates Ecopátio Logística Cubatão an intermodal logistics platform which is the regulating site for trucks at the Port of Santos. The company is also involved in the port operations and handling and storage of import and export cargo at the Port of Santos. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. EcoRodovias Infraestrutura e Logística S.A. operates as a subsidiary of IGLI S.p.A.

Name: Zad Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Zad Holding Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture and distribution of fast-moving-consumer-goods in Qatar and internationally. It operates through Investment and Managed Services; Trading Manufacturing Distribution & Services; and Contracting Real Estate & Others segments. The company manufactures various flour and wheat based products under the QFM brand; and refines and packs various types of edible oils such as sunflower corn and canola oil. It also produces and markets bakery products including traditional Arabic breads pita breads slice bread buns and rolls cakes and muffins and pastries; and frozen meat products comprising chicken nuggets burgers and kofta under the Al Arabia and International brands. In addition the company provides property management; constructs roads water supply and sewerage projects industrial structures and buildings; sells and rents transport and heavy equipment; provides logistics solutions; and transports construction materials such as asphalt sand and aggregates. Further it manufactures and supplies ready mix concrete and asphalt; offers crushing services; and invests in commodities. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: ADvTECH Limited
Description: ADvTECH Limited provides education training and staff placement services in South Africa and other African countries. It operates through Schools Tertiary and Resourcing divisions. The Schools division offers pre-primary primary and secondary education services through face to face and online learning under the Crawford International Pinnacle Colleges Trinityhouse Abbotts College Junior Colleges the Bridge Assisted Learning School and Evolve Online School brands as well as Gaborone International School Flipper International School and Makini Schools brands. Its Tertiary division provides education services on diploma degree and postgraduate levels through face-to-face online and distance learning under the Independent Institute of Education (IIE) Vega School Varsity College Rosebank College IIE MSA IIE School of Hospitality & Service Management Capsicum Culinary Studio and the Oxbridge Academy brands. The Resourcing division offers placement solutions in the areas of information technology (IT) finance and engineering; and payroll and compliance solutions under the Network Recruitment Communicate Recruitment Network Contracting Solutions the Working Earth Africa HR Solutions and the CA Global Africa Recruitment brands. ADvTECH Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Coronation Fund Managers Limited
Description: Coronation Fund Managers Limited is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm provides its services to pension and provident funds medical schemes unit trusts banks insurers and other fund managers international retirement funds endowments and family offices. It launches and manages equity fixed income and balanced mutual funds. The firm invests in the public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. It employs fundamental analysis with bottom-up stock picking approach. Coronation Fund Managers Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Cape Town South Africa with additional office in London United Kingdom and Dublin Ireland.

Name: Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E.
Description: Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E. provides electronic -payments and digital finance solutions in Egypt. The company offers digital and bill payment investment and cash deposit and withdrawal services. It also offers rewards and loyalty programs; commerce enablement services such as online checkout point of sale and payment link services; e-ordering marketplace; payment and collection pay-out and ticketing services; micro finance and insurance brokerage services; and operates TicketsMall and Super app. In addition the company provides HR solutions; and payout portal payroll card employee insurance acceptance cash management cash-in and cash-out cash collection and remittance services; and acts as a banking agent that offers various banking and financial services. Further it offers business loans and daily interest accounts; digital platforms; consumer finance services; fast moving consumer goods (FMCG) platform solutions for consumer goods companies and merchants; and commercial technology solutions. Additionally the company provides systems and communication equipment management and maintenance and computer network services; advanced solutions and strategic software services that supports digital transformation in business organization; and operates free zone. It serves individuals enterprises small and medium size enterprises (SMEs) and financial institutions. Fawry for Banking Technology and Electronic Payments S.A.E. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Mineros S.A.
Description: Mineros S.A. engages in the exploration development and production of gold in Central and South America. It explores for gold and silver deposits. The company holds interest in the Nechí Alluvial Property covering an area of 473 square kilometers located in Lower Cauca Region of Antioquia in northwestern Colombia; Hemco Property that covers an area of 2270 hectares located in Bonanza Nicaragua; and La Pepa Project located in the Maricunga Gold Belt of the Atacama Region Chile. It also engages in the hydroelectric power generation activities. The company was formerly known as Mineros de Antioquia S.A. and changed its name to Mineros S.A. in May 2004. Mineros S.A. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Medellín Colombia. As of March 25 2025 Mineros S.A. is a subsidiary of Sun Valley Investments AG.

Name: CFG Bank SA
Description: CFG Bank SA provides various banking products and services to individual professional corporate and institutional clients in Morocco. The company offers various accounts; savings; term deposits and long-term savings products; certificates of deposits; bank cards; consumer Lombard and real estate credits; lease credits; overdraft and cash facilities; short-term loans; and insurance products. It also provides stock market and investment services and private and online banking services. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Naturgy Chile Gas Natural S.A.
Description: Naturgy Chile Gas Natural S.A. engages in the distribution supply and transportation of natural gas in Chile and Argentina. The company operates through Natural Gas Investment Distribution and Commercialization segments. It serves residential commercial industrial electric generators and gas distribution customers. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Santiago Chile. Naturgy Chile Gas Natural S.A. is a subsidiary of Naturgy Energy Group S.A.

Name: Capital Bank of Jordan
Description: Capital Bank of Jordan together with its subsidiaries provides various commercial and investment banking services to individuals and corporate clients in Jordan Iraq rest of the Middle East Europe Asia the United States and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Retail Banking Corporate Banking Corporate Finance and Treasury. It offers current and savings accounts fixed deposit accounts and certificates of deposit; personal car and home loans; corporate loans; trade finance; commercial loans; overdraft and revolving products letters of guarantee letters of credit bills for collection and discounted promissory notes; working capital loans; and structured finance services. The company also provides brokerage services; asset management services such as portfolio management investment advisory external asset manager model structured deposits investment funds and Sharia compliant products; treasury management and remittance and bill payment services; correspondent banking services for financial institutions; debit and credit cards; online and mobile banking services; and ATM facilities and SMS banking services. In addition it provides services relating to privatizations IPOs and mergers and acquisitions; foreign exchange operations; and money market and trading services. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Magazine Luiza S.A.
Description: Magazine Luiza S.A. engages in the retail sale of consumer goods. It operates through Retail Financial Operations Insurance Operations and Other Services segments. The company also grants credit and provides extended warranties for its products. In addition it is involved in the provision of consortium and management services; and e-commerce of perfumes cosmetics sports and fashion products as well as product delivery management and software development services. Further the company provides integration logistics and technological solutions as well as resale goods and provision of services in the stores electronic and food delivery management platform. It serves through physical stores e-commerce platform and SuperApp. Magazine Luiza S.A. was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Franca Brazil. Magazine Luiza S.A. operates as a subsidiary of LTD Administração e Participação S.A.

Name: Bank al Etihad
Description: Bank al Etihad provides various financial and banking products and services. It accepts various deposits such as current salary and savings accounts as well as term deposits and certificates of deposit. The company also offers SME transfer bundles startup loans business loans trade finance working capital financing fixed assets and expansion financing and overdraft plus services; and collateral-free auto mortgage and personal loans. In addition it provides debit credit and prepaid cards; bank Western Union and ACH transfer services; and digital banking services. Further the company engages in wealth management and trading; and offers supply chain finance mobile banking and online services. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Grupo Supervielle S.A.
Description: Grupo Supervielle S.A. a financial services holding company provides various banking products and services in Argentina. The company operates through Personal & Business Banking Corporate Banking Bank Treasury Insurance and Asset Management and Other Services segments. It offers savings accounts time and demand deposits and checking accounts; various loan products including personal consumer mortgage unsecured and car loans; overdrafts; loans with special facilities for project and working capital financing; and leasing bank guarantees for tenants salary advances domestic and international factoring international guarantees and letters of credit payroll payment plans credit and debit cards and senior citizens benefit payment services as well as financial services and investments such as mutual funds and guarantees. The company also provides foreign trade and cash management; advisory services; treasury services; insurance products comprising life home personal accidents technology ATMs protected bag protected content and integral insurance product for entrepreneurs and SME customers and other insurance policies; and asset management and other services as well as operates as a digital online broker. It operates through a network of bank branches ATMs and self-service terminals as well as cash dispensers with biometric identification systems. The company was formerly known as Inversiones y Participaciones S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Supervielle S.A. in November 2008. Grupo Supervielle S.A. was founded in 1887 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Azzas 2154 S.A.
Description: Azzas 2154 S.A. engages in the development and marketing of women's men's and children's footwear handbags accessories and clothing in Brazil and internationally. It offers its products through franchise stores company-operated store and web commerce channel under the Arezzo Schutz Anacapri Alexandre Birman Alme Vans Reserva Reserva Mini Reserva INK Reserva Go Oficina Reserva Brizza Troc Baw Carol Bassi ZZMALL Reversa Simples Reserva Paris Texas Vicenza Animale Farm Farm Global Fabula Foxton Cris Barros Off Premium Maria Filo NV Hering and Dzarm brands. The company was formerly known as Arezzo Indústria e Comércio S.A. and changed its name to Azzas 2154 S.A. in July 2024. Azzas 2154 S.A. was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Absa Bank Kenya PLC
Description: Absa Bank Kenya PLC together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services to private customers corporates financial institutions and government clients in Kenya. The company operates in two segments Consumer Banking and Corporate Banking. It offers current accounts savings foreign currency and commercial accounts as well as term deposits; credit debit and prepaid cards; personal home buying and construction re-mortgage equity release car and business loans; mortgages; and life and family car domestic package medical travel payment card business asset consequential loss marine employee benefit cover and liability cover insurance products. The company also provides investment banking risk management advisory transactional banking trade and asset finance forex market making liquid asset management asset management market and collection Internet and mobile banking and cash management as well as Islamic and Diaspora banking services. It operates through a network of branches and ATMs. The company was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya. Absa Bank Kenya PLC is a subsidiary of Absa Group Limited.

Name: NCBA Group PLC
Description: NCBA Group PLC together with its subsidiaries provides retail corporate and digital banking brokerage bancassurance and investment banking services in Kenya Tanzania Uganda Rwanda Cote d’Ivoire and Ghana. The company operates through Corporate and Institutional Banking Retail Banking Treasury Dealing Digital Bank and Investment Banking segments. It offers saving and current accounts; home plot personal car vehicle and equipment construction and term loans; overdrafts; insurance premium financing leasing and wealth management services; advisory services on corporate finance capital raising and project finance; and finance advisory services that include due diligence reviews business restructuring mergers and acquisitions spin-offs and business valuations and working capital reviews for optimization. The company also provides foreign currency services; property health money employee and liability insurance products; asset finance; and securities brokerage services. It operates through a network of multiple branches ATMs and cash deposit machines. The company was formerly known as Commercial Bank of Africa Limited and changed its name to NCBA Group PLC in September 2019. NCBA Group PLC is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima
Description: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima together with its subsidiaries engages in the diversified real estate activities in Argentina. It operates through five segments: Shopping Malls Offices Sales and Developments Hotels and Others. The company is involved in the acquisition development and operation of shopping malls office buildings and other non-shopping mall properties primarily for rental purposes; and lease and service related to rental of commercial space and other spaces. It also acquires and operates luxury hotels and resorts under the Intercontinental Libertador and Llao Llao names; develops constructs and sells residential properties including apartment tower complexes; and acquires undeveloped land reserves for future development or sale. In addition the company engages in the development and operation of stadium; and provision of ¡appa! a digital customer loyalty system platform for consumption in shopping malls use of parking spaces and redemption of corporate benefits. Further it is involved in development maintenance and sales of undeveloped parcels of land and/or trading properties; room catering and restaurant services. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina. IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones Sociedad Anónima operates as a subsidiary of Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A.

Name: Arab Banking Corporation (B.S.C.)
Description: Arab Banking Corporation (B.S.C.) provides wholesale banking services worldwide. It operates through MENA Subsidiaries International Wholesale Banking Group Treasury ABC Brasil and Other segments. The company provides consumer banking products such as term deposits current savings and call accounts; personal home and car loans; and credit and visa electron cards. It also offers transaction banking solution for trade and supply chain management and cash management; financing products and advisory services; structured financing solutions for real estate asset acquisition such as commercial investment and residential development; Shari’a compliant banking solutions; capital market products and services; financial markets and treasury products; and digital corporate onboarding services. In addition the company offers ila Bank a digital and mobile-only banking space. Arab Banking Corporation (B.S.C.) was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: e-finance for Digital and Financial Investments S.A.E.
Description: e-finance for Digital and Financial Investments S.A.E. provides digital payment solutions in Egypt. The company develops and operates financial networks; offers a suite of digital products to governments businesses and consumers; and provides technological infrastructure security for the support of e-payment systems. It also provides bill payment solutions for retail payments utilities education entertainment and government services; end-to-end services card management and third-party operation services for banks; eNovate such as white-label wallet applications digital onboarding and anti-money laundering e-cards and smart cards; and a digital market through a platform for browsing purchasing and executing orders. In addition the company establishes operates and manages platforms to digitize business processes; and provides telecom and contact center solutions as well as offers human resource and information technology outsourcing logistics and contact center and consultancy services. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries establishes and operates universities and colleges in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Higher Education and Others segments. The company offers computer programming; advertisement publication and distribution; and technology e-commerce and media services. It also provides diploma degrees in business administration information technology and engineering; content-based programs; learning solutions comprising IT business desktop and language e-learning content; professional certifications and learning management systems; and consultancy services for the implementation hosting and administration of e-learning solutions. In addition the company offers technical application and business skill courses; cyclical pedagogical syllabus learning system; career development and job placements; and management and training services to schools. Further it operates foster fledgling educational institutions. Humansoft Holding Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1994 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A.
Description: Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A. distributes electricity in Peru. The company holds a concession area of approximately 1602 square kilometers and provides energy to approximately 1600000 customers. It is also involved in the network movement works; sale of power blocks; and pole rental activities. The company was formerly known as Enel Distribución Perú S.A.A. and changed its name to Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A. in August 2024. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Lima Peru. Pluz Energía Perú S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of North Lima Power Grid Holding S.A.C.

Name: Guararapes Confecções S.A.
Description: Guararapes Confecções S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture distribution and sale of clothes articles for personal use and other related items in Brazil. It also offers financial services including interest-bearing products digital account cards loans insurance and assistance; and financial products. In addition it owns and operates Shopping Midway mall located in Natal as well as offers store leasing and parking management services. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited
Description: We Buy Cars Holdings Limited engages in buying distributing and retailing pre-owned motor vehicles in South Africa. It is involved in the sales of car finance insurance and other ancillary products such as tracking devices value added insurance products and comprehensive motor insurance. The company also engages in the operation of car supermarket; and owns and rents warehouses. It sells its products through physical supermarkets and our digital platforms. The company was formerly known as WBC Holdings Proprietary Limited and changed its name to We Buy Cars Holdings Limited in March 2024. We Buy Cars Holdings Limited is based in Centurion South Africa.

Name: Banco Provincial S.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco Provincial S.A. Banco Universal provides various banking products and services to individuals and businesses in Venezuela. The company offers current savings foreign currency and checking accounts; fixed deposits business corporate and SME credit cards; personal microcredit vehicle credit commercial noncurrent and agricultural loans as well as credit for entrepreneurs. It also provides debit payments electronic payments cash registry and trade deposits collections and payments payroll POS virtual and digital services. Banco Provincial S.A. Banco Universal was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P. manufactures and sells petrochemical products in Kuwait other MENA countries Asia South America and North America and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Energy Manufacturing and Petrochemical Sector; Education and Services; and Others. It is involved in manufacture and trades of packaging materials and plastic pipes; manufactures steel abrasive materials; produces chlorine salt and other petrochemical products; provision of educational and medical services; and undertakes industrial investments as well as investing directly and through portfolios into various sectors. The company also engages in incubators communications and technology business; general trading activities; provision of transportation services; blending of chemical products; and manufacture of chlor alkali products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: United Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: United Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in real estate operation and development in Kuwait Egypt Lebanon the United Arab Emirates Syria Oman Bahrain Jordan Europe and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Rental Operations Hospitality Operations Real Estate Development and Property Trading and Contracting and Services segments. The company engages in the development lease purchase and resale of real estate properties; ownership sale and acquisition of real estate properties and lands; and management of third-party properties. Its property portfolio includes hotels clubs motels entertainment houses rest places gardens parks exhibitions restaurants cafes residential compounds touristic and health spas entertainment and sports facilities and stores. The company also provides hospitality services through its owned hotels comprising Marina Hotel Hilton Hotel Bhamdoun Hotel Waldorf Astoria and Salalah Residence. In addition it offers agriculture general trading touristic development contracting beauty and medical care services; facilities management services such as maintenance cleaning and security services; real estate advisory services; and maintenance works of buildings and real estate properties such as civil mechanical and electrical works elevators and air conditioning works and other related maintenance works. Further the company engages in the organization of real estate exhibitions; holding of real estate bids; ownership sale and acquisition of stocks and bonds of real estate companies; ownership of commercial markets and residential compounds; food manufacturing; and investment in agriculture. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. United Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Name: NICO Holdings plc
Description: NICO Holdings plc together with its subsidiaries engages in general insurance life assurance pension administration banking corporate finance advisory asset management and information technology (IT) businesses in in Malawi Zambia Uganda and Mozambique. It operates through Life Insurance and Pension Business General Insurance Business Banking Business Asset Management and Information Technology segments. It provides general insurance products such as motor vehicle building road construction liability engineering professional indemnity marine hull cargo fire loss of profits agriculture burglary house-owners householders and personal accident products. The company also offers individual life insurance products including endowment assurance with profits cash generator endowment assurance with profits savings protection policy with profits child saver lien endowment assurance with profits and unit linked endowment with profits; and group business insurance products comprising deposit administration managed funds group life assurance group mortgage group credit and group funeral policies and annuities. In addition it provides deposit products credit facilities visa credit debit card services trade finance services foreign exchange products women business programs and other value-added services; pension solutions; and investment management services to institutional individual investors. Further the company offers corporate and project finance advisory services; IT services including IT managed services IT infrastructure services IT projects management and software solutions; property advisory management development and retail services; and hospitality services. NICO Holdings plc was founded in 1971 and is based in Blantyre Malawi.

Name: Empresas AquaChile S.A.
Description: Empresas AquaChile S.A. a food company produces processes distributes and markets salmon products in Chile and internationally. It offers Atlantic and Coho salmon products. The company operates under the Aqua and Verlasso brands. It also sells its products through retail stores. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Puerto Montt Chile. Empresas AquaChile S.A. is a subsidiary of AGROSUPER S.A.

Name: United Gulf Holding Company B.S.C.
Description: United Gulf Holding Company B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides asset management and investment banking and commercial banking products and services in Bahrain the Middle East North Africa Europe the Americas and internationally. It undertakes asset portfolio management corporate finance advisory investments in quoted and private equity/funds real estate capital markets international banking and treasury activities. The company also offers loans and other credit facilities; and accepts deposit and current accounts from corporate and institutional customers. In addition it offers property rental services. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Manama Bahrain. United Gulf Holding Company B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Name: Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A.
Description: Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the sanitation business in Chile. It operates through Water and Non-Water segments. The Water Utility segment produces and distributes potable water; and collects and treats sewage water. The Non-Water segment is involved in environmental analysis; treatment of liquid industrial waste; integral engineering services; and the sale of sanitary services energy projects and biogas. It provides sanitation services to residential commercial and industrial customers. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Inversiones Aguas Metropolitanas S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Suez Inversiones Aguas del Gran Santiago Limitada.

Name: Ahli Bank SAOG
Description: Ahli Bank SAOG provides commercial banking services in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through two segments Retail Banking; and Wholesale Banking Treasury and Investments. The company offers deposits and unrestricted investment accounts; consumer loans including home personal and auto loans; debit and credit cards; overdrafts Islamic financing and fund transfer facilities; and bancassurance products such as motor personal accident travel home and individual term insurance as well as group credit life coverage. It also provides current accounts term deposits loans and advances etc.; treasury trade finance and other investment services; and investment banking services comprising corporate finance advisory asset management and brokerage services. In addition the company offers internet mobile and SMS banking; ATM and CDM services; payment gateway and POS terminal services; and service centers and kiosk services. It serves the institutional corporate small and medium enterprise and retail sectors. Ahli Bank SAOG was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Banco Guayaquil S.A.
Description: Banco Guayaquil S.A. provides various banking products and services in Ecuador. The company offers current saving and business checking accounts. It also offers finance products such as microcredit home loan education loan working capital factoring agricultural credit and other financing products as well as fixed asset and immediate credit services. In addition the company provides credit cards; foreign trade products and services; and virtual banking and online services and consultations. Further it offers buying and selling currencies insurance services remittances visa application and payment related services as well as microfinance services. Banco Guayaquil S.A. was founded in 1923 and is based in Guayaquil Ecuador. Banco Guayaquil S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Corporacion Multibg S.A.

Name: The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Limited
Description: The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Limited together with its subsidiaries provides corporate and retail banking investment and asset management services in Kenya and South Sudan. It operates through two segments Retail Banking and Wholesale Banking. The company offers savings current salary children youth goldfish and fixed/call deposit accounts; forex products; payment solutions; fund transfer services; overdrafts; loans for micro small and medium enterprises; personal/consumer mobile home business mortgage and construction loans; term loans supply chain and distribution financing import duty finance working capital loans and asset finance services; mortgages; trade finance services; and insurance premium financing and mortgage finance solutions. It also provides investment services; bancassurance consultancy and capacity building stock brokerage and leasing services; debit credit business and prepaid cards; wealth fund and investment management solutions; insurance solutions custody and investor and treasury bond and bill services; share registry safe keeping and corporate trustee services; and fixed income and money market products. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya. The Co-operative Bank of Kenya Limited operates as a subsidiary of Co-opholdings Co-operative Society Limited.

Name: Orizon Valorização de Resíduos S.A.
Description: Orizon Valorização de Resíduos S.A. operates as a waste recovery process company. It engages in disposal of solid waste treatment business; bioenergy plants for capturing and treating gases from the decomposition of waste for sale or reutilization of methane gas. The company also produces energy from biogas-fueled power plant; and trades in carbon credit. The company’s Waste Processing and Industrialization business develops plants for processing materials from the industrial sector recycling solid urban waste and the direct burning of waste for energy generation. The company’s Environmental Engineering business offers services in the areas of recovery of degraded areas remediation of contaminated areas environmental diagnosis and monitoring waste management and the cleaning of oil industry tanks. The company was formerly known as Haztec Investimentos e Participações S.A. and changed its name to Orizon Valorização de Resíduos S.A. in August 2020. Orizon Valorização de Resíduos S.A. was founded in 1999 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. Orizon Valorização de Resíduos S.A. subsidiary of Inovatec Participações S.A.

Name: First National Bank of Botswana Limited
Description: First National Bank of Botswana Limited provides various banking and related products and services to individuals businesses corporates and private clients in Botswana. The company operates through four segments: FNB Retail FNB Commercial RMB Corporate and Treasury. It offers cheque transactional savings student youth corporate transact and business accounts; call accounts notice and fixed deposits treasury bills and bonds products; overdrafts; personal tertiary graduate home and business loans as well as vehicle and asset commercial property purchase order and corporate finance services; first funding employee loan schemes; and credit and debit cards. The company also provides foreign exchange solutions; Islamic finance and financial planning services; forex and trade services such as payment and import and export solutions; and accounting and custody services. In addition it offers agricultural solutions farming enterprise finance services business investment solutions and farm risk insurance finance services; and payment funding and cash management services to the public sector. Further the company provides corporate and investment banking services; private banking services comprising wealth and advisory and structured lending services; funeral debt protection car building and travel insurance services as well as business insurance services including fire business interruption electronic equipment business all risks glass goods in transit money theft public liability workers compensation and vehicle; and online and cellphone banking services. Additionally it offers InContact Pro an electronic platform for managing the money in business accounts. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana. First National Bank of Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of First National Bank Holdings (Botswana) Limited.

Name: Banvida S.A.
Description: Banvida S.A. provides financial services in Chile. The company provides financial services such as life and general insurance mortgage and consumer loans and investment services. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Santiago Chile. Banvida S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Teval S.A.

Name: Presco Plc
Description: Presco Plc engages in the oil palm plantations development palm oil milling palm kernel processing and vegetable oil refining businesses in Nigeria and Ghana. The company is involved in the extraction refining and fractioning of crude palm oil into finished products. It also provides special palm oil; refined bleached and deodorized palm oil; palm olein; palm stearin; palm fatty acid distillate; fresh fruit bunches; crude palm oil; and crude and refined palm kernel oil as well as palm kernel cakes. The company was formerly known as Presco Industries Limited. Presco Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Benin City Nigeria. Presco Plc is a subsidiary of NV Siat SA.

Name: SONASID S.A.
Description: SONASID S.A. produces and sells round bars concrete and wire rods for the construction and industrial applications in Morocco and internationally. It also offers billet and fiber and drawn wire products. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. SONASID S.A. is a subsidiary of Nouvelles Siderugies Industries.

Name: Netcare Limited
Description: Netcare Limited an investment holding company operates private hospitals in South Africa. It operates through Hospital and Emergency Services and Primary Care segments. The Hospital and Emergency Services segment engages in the hospital and pharmacy operations. Its operations covers its private acute hospital network and day clinics; and non-acute services including emergency medical services private mental health clinics operation diagnostics support services and cancer care services as well as sells healthcare products and vouchers. The Primary Care segment offers healthcare services and employee health and wellness services as well as administrative services to medical and dental practices. It also engages in the financing property owing and pharmaceutical services. It operates through a network of acute hospitals beds day clinics netcare 911 sites cancer care centres haematology centres renal dialysis facilities dialysis stations point of care devices mental health hospitals primary health care facilities and occupational health service contracts as well as insurance products and prepaid procedures and healthcare vouchers. Netcare Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Vulcabras S.A.
Description: Vulcabras S.A. through its subsidiaries operates as a footwear company in Brazil and internationally. The company offers sports-oriented clothing footwear and accessories; and safety boots for hospital workers mining companies steelmakers agribusiness civil construction and other sectors. It offers its products through e-commerce and brand-owned stores. The company markets its products under the Mizuno Olympikus UNDER ARMOUR and Botas Vulcabras brand names. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Jundiaí Brazil. Vulcabras S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Gianpega Negócios e Participações S.A.

Name: Hidrovias do Brasil S.A.
Description: Hidrovias do Brasil S.A. together with its subsidiaries an integrated logistics solutions company in Brazil and internationally. The company provides maritime transportation port terminals and storage services. It also offers cargo storage and lifting river transport service intermediation and agency maritime coastal transport movement and storage specialized cargo terminal Leasing of shipping assets port administration services as well as construction of highways and railways. The company operates four port terminals with 20.5 million tons total loading capacity; current waterway fleet which has 477 cargo barges 22 main pushers 6 auxiliary pushers and 2 cabotage vessels and a distributed fleet. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Scotia Group Jamaica Limited
Description: Scotia Group Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiaries provides financial products and services in Jamaica. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate and Commercial Banking Treasury Investment Management Services Insurance Services and Others segments. The Retail Banking segment offers personal banking services personal deposit accounts credit and debit cards consumer loans and mortgages. The Corporate and Commercial Banking segment provides non-personal direct debit facilities current accounts deposits overdrafts loans and other credit facilities. The Treasury segment is involved in the foreign currency trading activities. The Investment Management Services segment offers investments unit trusts and pension and other fund management services; brokerage and advisory services; and trust account administration services. The Insurance Services segment is involved in the provision of life and medical insurance products individual pension administration and annuities services as well as acts as a general insurance agency. It also offers investment banking services; and mortgage financing services. The company was founded in 1889 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica. Scotia Group Jamaica Limited operates as a subsidiary of Scotiabank Caribbean Holdings Ltd.

Name: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria Colombia S.A.
Description: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria Colombia S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the provision of loans to public and private sector companies and individuals. The company offers vehicle credits housing credits Colombians abroad online loans consumer credits and payroll credits; savings payroll digital savings pensioners meta and current accounts as well as briefcase and mobile money; debit credit cards and credit card portfolio purchase; traditional long term and variable CDT; leasing; offer for pensioners; life and general insurance such as personal accident health multi-risk vehicle card theft fire and earthquake and workers compensation insurance ; foreign exchange; personal banking; premiums; and private banking. It also provides SMEs; collection solutions mobile dataphone traditional phone payment link qr payments sales advances and ticket office; business debit and credit cards corporate credit cards agro credit cards and importer cards; business savings and current accounts current account for companies remunerated current accounts and business checking accounts; business loans working capital credifast credit severance pay credit payroll payment credit investment credit and mortgage credit. In addition the company offers machinery real estate vehicle import and sustainable leasing; letters of credit pre-financing of exports documentary collections transfers forfaiting and remittances; CDT structured trust real estate trust and investment trust; forwards options and swaps. Further it provides payroll and supplier payments national collection tax collection and banking correspondents; insurance for SMEs; as well as infrastructure investment and financing fixed income products equity products and syndicated credit. The company was founded in 1857 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria Colombia S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria S.A.

Name: CAP S.A.
Description: CAP S.A. engages in iron ore mining steel production steel processing and infrastructure businesses in Chile and internationally. The company explores evaluates and develops mineral ores; and produces iron ore and pellets in the Pacific coast. It also produces and sells corrosion-resistant rebars grinding rods concrete bars helical bars CAP-SOL bars wire rods limestone and quicklime. In addition the company offers pipes and conduit; corrugated steel products; instapanel covers and coating for warehouses and industrial and commercial warehouses; metalcon covers and coating; road defenses; photovoltaic structures; insulated panels open profiles laminated profiles metalcon construction systems collaborative plates steel sheets tubest and tubular profiles. Further it engages in desalinated water production business; electric transmission; and ports for ships. The company was formerly known as Compañía de Acero del Pacífico S.A. de Inversiones and changed its name to CAP S.A. in May 1991. CAP S.A. was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Las Condes Chile.

Name: Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A.
Description: Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. provides electricity distribution services in the state of Maranhão Brazil. It serves residential industrial commercial rural public power street lighting and public service customers. The company was formerly known as Companhia Energética do Maranhão – CEMAR and changed it to Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. in September 2019. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in São Luís Brazil. Equatorial Maranhão Distribuidora de Energia S.A. is a subsidiary of Equatorial Energia Distribuição S.A.

Name: Datatec Limited
Description: Datatec Limited together with its subsidiaries provides information and communication technology (ICT) solutions and services worldwide. It operates through Westcon International Logicalis International and Logicalis Latin America segments. The company distributes cyber security network infrastructure unified collaboration products data centre solutions and channel services; and offers financing/leasing solutions for ICT customers as well as digital service. Datatec Limited was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Sandown South Africa.

Name: AtlantaSanad Société Anonyme
Description: AtlantaSanad Société Anonyme provides various insurance products for individuals professionals and corporates primarily in Morocco. The company offers automotive car and motorcycle insurance housing multi-risk pension savings machine breakdown all IT risk multi-risk industrial multi-risk office multi-risk trader multi-risk cafés hotels and restaurants multi-risk building civil liability RC school RC sports fleet employees corporate fleet logistics transport health maritime and transport individual personal and professional accidents family ihtiate individual death premium international health pleasure multi-risk and RC hunting insurance products. The company was formerly known as Compagnie d'Assurances et de Réassurance ATLANTA. AtlantaSanad Société Anonyme was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. AtlantaSanad Société Anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Groupe Holmarcom.

Name: Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited
Description: Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited an investment holding company operates as a private healthcare company in Southern Africa the United Kingdom Europe the United States and internationally. The company operates acute hospitals. It also offers mental health acute rehabilitation renal dialysis oncology and imaging services. In addition the company provides long-term services for patients requiring frail care chronic mental healthcare and substance abuse support; wellness programs and occupational and primary healthcare to corporate and institutional clients; and contracted on-site occupational primary and emergency healthcare services to large private and public employees. Further the company develops and commercializes molecular imaging agents for use in positron emission computerized tomography diagnostics. The company was formerly known as Afrox Healthcare Limited and changed its name to Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited in January 2005. Life Healthcare Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Sagicor Group Jamaica Limited
Description: Sagicor Group Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various financial services in Jamaica the Cayman Islands Costa Rica Barbados and Panama. The company operates through Long Term Insurance Short Term Insurance Commercial Banking Investment Banking and Other segments. The Long Term Insurance segment provides annuities traditional life and universal life products. The Short Term Insurance segment offers group life group health and property and casualty offerings services. The Commercial Banking segment provides banking retail mortgages small business banking treasury management and corporate banking services. The Investment Banking segment offers wealth management products and services to retail and institutional clients including unit trusts mutual funds brokerage asset management and corporate trust. The Other segment provides property management captives management real estate investment remittance and cambio services. The company offers retirement products general insurance pension administration group insurance administration microfinance real estate development real estate sales and rental pension fund management insurance brokerage and investment services. It provides its services under Sagicor brand name. Sagicor Group Jamaica Limited was founded in 1840 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Ripley Corp S.A.
Description: Ripley Corp S.A. engages in the retail sale of apparel accessories and home products through department stores and e-commerce in Chile and Peru. The company product categories include beauty products techno products shoes and slippers accessories and complements automotive and decor products sport and adventure products bedroom and electro products hardware and pet products toy and children products health and wellness products men’s fashion women’s fashion children’s fashion furniture and other products as well as automotive spare parts. It is also involved in banking business through the management of Ripley Bank that primarily focuses on the consumer sector; and the real estate business including the ownership of shopping malls. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Compañía de Transporte de Energía Eléctrica en Alta Tensión Transener S.A.
Description: Compañía de Transporte de Energía Eléctrica en Alta Tensión Transener S.A. provides high-voltage electricity transmission services in Argentina. It operates and maintains transformer lines and stations as well as supervises the transmission works. The company also offers engineering and consulting services; expansion to the transportation systems; and testing and commissioning services. It operates a network of 12400 kilometers of transmission lines and 6228 kilometers of lines. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.
