Compañía de Transporte de Energía Eléctrica en Alta Tensión Transener S.A. is a subsidiary of Compañía Inversora en Transmisión Eléctrica Citelec S.A.

Name: Airtel Uganda Limited
Description: Airtel Uganda Limited a cellular telephone network operator provides telecommunication services in Uganda. It offers prepaid services comprising voice and SMS bundles Wi-Fi smart hybrid internet services devices roaming services and value added services; postpaid roaming and I-control services; and broadband services. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Kampala Uganda. Airtel Uganda Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Uganda Holdings B.V.

Name: Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc
Description: Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar from sugar cane in Malawi. The company produces raw brown and refined sugars as well as molasses. It also grows sugar cane. The company offers its products under BWANA SUKARI ILLOVO and WHITESPOON SUGAR brands. It exports its products to the regional African European Union and United States of America (USA). Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Blantyre Malawi. Illovo Sugar (Malawi) plc operates as a subsidiary of SUCOMA Holdings Limited.

Name: Nestlé Nigeria Plc
Description: Nestlé Nigeria Plc manufactures markets and distributes food products in Nigeria. It operates in two segments Food and Beverages. The company offers food products under the Maggi Cerelac SMA Nan Lactogen Golden Morn brands; beverage drinks under the Milo Milo energy cube Nescafe Milo ready-to-drink and Nestlé Pure Life brands; and snacking products. It also provides purified water. In addition the company offers its products under the Ideal Nido Carnation Gloria and Nestlé Professional brand names. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Nestlé Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Société des Produits Nestlé S.A.

Name: Sociedad Punta del Cobre S.A.
Description: Sociedad Punta del Cobre S.A. engages in the development and exploitation of mineral resources primarily in the Atacama Region. The company primarily explores for copper gold and silver concentrates. It holds interest in the Punta del Cobre mine the Manto de Cobre mine and the Granate mine San Jose and Biocobre mines located in the Atacama Region. The company also holds a 100% interest in the El Espino project located in Coquimbo region; and the Tovaku mining project located in Antofagasta region. Sociedad Punta del Cobre S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Copiapó Chile.

Name: Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited
Description: Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited provides various banking products and services in Uganda. It operates through Personal and Private Banking Business and Commercial Banking Corporate and Investment Banking and Treasury and Capital Management segments. The company also holds and manages the real estate portfolio; offers other services such as facilities management site acquisition property consultancy and execution of real estate projects; and engages in stock brokerage and asset management services. In addition it provides software development and financial technology solutions; wealth and investment solutions to private and personal banking markets; advisory networking and sustainability support to small- and medium-sized businesses and large commercial enterprises; advisory transactional trading and funding support to large companies governments parastatals and institutional clients; and insurance products and services. The company was formerly known as Stanbic Bank Holdings Limited and changed its name to Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited. The company was founded in 1906 and is based in Kampala Uganda. Stanbic Uganda Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: C&A Modas S.A.
Description: C&A Modas S.A. operates as a fashion retailer for women men and children in Brazil and internationally. It offers blouses pants dresses skirts coats beachwear underwear t-shirts shirts Bermuda jackets and coats bodies sets and shorts; beauty products including perfumes makeup skincare body and bath and accessories; and footwear such as boots shoes and moccasins flats sandals and tennis footwear. The company sells its products through stores as well as online. The company was founded in 1841 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil.

Name: Lighthouse Properties p.l.c.
Description: Lighthouse Properties p.l.c. engages in property investments and operation business in Spain Portugal and France. Its property portfolio includes retail assets. The company was formerly known as Lighthouse Capital Limited and changed its name to Lighthouse Properties p.l.c. in December 2021. Lighthouse Properties p.l.c. was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Sliema Malta.

Name: MetroGAS S.A.
Description: MetroGAS S.A. engages in the distribution of natural gas primarily in Argentina. The company was formerly known as Distribuidora de Gas Metropolitano SA. MetroGAS S.A. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. MetroGAS S.A. operates as a subsidiary of YPF Sociedad Anónima.

Name: Housing and Development Bank- Egypt (S.A.E)
Description: Housing and Development Bank- Egypt (S.A.E) together with its provides corporate and retail banking services in Egypt. It operates through Corporate Medium & Small Sized Enterprise; Investments; Retail; and Other Activities segments. The company offers current saving and deposit accounts; personal and real estate loans; loans and facilities; financial derivatives; credit cards; and other banking products. It also provides investment services that include financing merging and restructuring of companies and financial tools; asset management; and city tourist resort and real estate management services. In addition the company engages in financing and promotion of real estate; development of real estate; security and transportation activities; and provision of real estate mutual funds. Housing and Development Bank- Egypt (S.A.E) was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: SMU S.A.
Description: SMU S.A. operates as a food retailer in Chile and Peru. The company operates through Supermarket and Financial Services segments. It provides groceries fruits and vegetables and non-food and other products; and e-grocery solutions. The company also issues credit cards that grants credit to Unimarc supermarkets customers. It operates supermarkets under the Unimarc Mayorista 10 Super 10 Alvi Mayorsa and Maxi Ahorro brands. SMU S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Carozzi S.A.
Description: Carozzi S.A. produces and markets food products in Chile. It manufactures cookies chocolates candies cereal bars ice cream cereals oatmeal liquid and powdered beverages compotes pasta rice olive oil flours premixes desserts tomato sauce and paste jams coffee fruit and vegetable pulps preserves biscuits and panettone and snacks as well pet food products. The company markets its products under the Bresler Costa CACHORROS GATITOS ViVo and Ambrosoli brand names. It sells its products to supermarket chains; distributors; warehouses and small stores; and food service sector such as hotels restaurants and casinos. It exports its products in Peru Argentina and the United States. Carozzi S.A. was founded in 1898 and is based in San Bernardo Chile.

Name: Palestine Telecommunications Company P.L.C
Description: Palestine Telecommunications Company P.L.C. provides manages and sells telecommunication services in the Palestinian territories. It operates through Telecommunication Digital Services and Information Technology and Investing segments. The company provides wireline and wireless communication as well as leased lines internet and ADSL services; and operates telephone and cellular networks. It is also involved in investment activities. Palestine Telecommunications Company P.L.C. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Nablus Palestinian Authority.

Name: First HoldCo Plc
Description: First HoldCo Plc together with its subsidiaries provides commercial banking investment banking corporate banking and other financial services in Nigeria and internationally. The company operates through Commercial Banking Business Group; Investment Banking and Asset Management Business Group (IBAM); and Others segments. The Commercial Banking Business Group segment offers financial intermediation services to individual and corporate clients/customers. The IBAM segment provides advisory asset management markets and private equity services to corporations and governments; and merchant banking services. The Others segment offers insurance brokerage services. The company also provides funds management investment and general trading trusteeship real estate investment financial/ investment advisory and portfolio management services. In addition it is involved in the venture capital and private equity business. Further the company offers retail portfolio such as credit cards mortgages term loans and overdrafts facilities. The company was formerly known as FBN Holdings Plc and changed its name to First HoldCo Plc in February 2025. First HoldCo Plc was founded in 1894 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: United Development Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: United Development Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries contributes and invests in infrastructure and utilities in the State of Qatar. The company operates through four segments: Urban Development Hospitality and Leisure Infrastructure and Utilities and Other Operations. It engages in the real estate development and construction activities. The company is also involved in the investment and development of hotel and leisure facilities; selling of luxurious items; construction and management of district cooling systems and marina activities; provision of information technology solution and other services; environment related businesses; and business management activities. United Development Company Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Ferreycorp S.A.A.
Description: Ferreycorp S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of machinery engines equipment spare parts lubricants and other goods in Peru and Central and South America. The company is also involved in the purchase and sale of machinery automotive chemical equipment and agricultural equipment as well as related spare parts; and provision of maintenance and repair storage and workshop services; bulking agency; and equipment rental businesses as well as the delivery of related services. It engages in the marketing of technology-related software and equipment as well as operates as a representative and distributor of tires lubricants and safety equipment. The company was formerly known as Ferreyros S.A.A. and changed its name to Ferreycorp S.A.A. in March 2012. The company was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Lima Peru.

Name: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Limited
Description: Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services for individuals and businesses. It operates in two segments Corporate and Investment Banking and Wealth and Retail Banking. The company offers personal current and savings accounts; fixed deposits; personal loans; salary overdrafts; personal loans; home construction and non-resident mortgages; and investment solutions such as mutual funds fixed income securities foreign exchange and wealth lending; insurance products including home motor commercial car travel endowment personal accident insurance and life protection and farewell insurances as well as credit and debit cards. In addition the company provides cross border banking services; online and mobile banking services; and In-person services. Further it offers corporate and investment banking; wealth and retail banking; venture services; business account cash management services; forex hedging; global banking; business mortgages term loans and working capital services; term deposits/ margin account; and business channels/access. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya. Standard Chartered Bank Kenya Limited operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

Name: Mibanco Banco de la Microempresa S.A.
Description: Mibanco Banco de la Microempresa S.A. provides various banking products and services in Peru. The company offers business savings current accounts; business loans such as working capital machines and equipment commercial premises warehouse debt purchase cash credit line agricultural markets and shopping arcades campaigns and financing for SOAT; and business protection and multi-risk insurance products. It also provides fixed term deposits CTS easy savings flexible full savings online term deposit savings for a dream and woman savings; personal loans including personal and housing loans women and business vehicle credit and cash dependent; and personal insurance such as life financial protection individual accident family protected family plan flex home insurance microinsurance tax free return and tax relief return. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Surquillo Peru. Mibanco Banco de la Microempresa S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco de Crédito del Perú S.A.

Name: Leche Gloria S.A.
Description: Leche Gloria S.A. produces and sells milk and other dairy products in Peru Bolivia Ecuador. The company offers milk to dilute UHT milk powdered milk UHT and powdered milk mix as well as dairy mixes and drinks to dilute; dairy products comprising yogurt butter cheese condensed milk milk cream manjarblanco and ice cream base; drinks including daily drinks water fruit drinks soft drinks homemade drinks tea and vegetable drinks; and food products such as jams panettone canned fish and margarine. It sells its products under the Gloria Bonlé Pura Vida leche Griego Batti PRO Yofresh Bella Holandesa Chicolac Yomost Multilac Aruba and La Mesa brand names. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is based in Lima Peru. Leche Gloria S.A. is a subsidiary of Gloria Group.

Name: Zambia Sugar Plc
Description: Zambia Sugar Plc engages in growing of sugar cane in Zambia the Democratic Republic of Congo Kenya and South Africa. It operates through Cane Growing and Sugar Production segments. The company offers household brown refined white dark brown icing and castor sugars; treacle maple and golden syrup; and molasses. It sells its products under the Whitespoon brand. The company exports its products. Zambia Sugar Plc was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Mazabuka Zambia. Zambia Sugar Plc operates as a subsidiary of Illovo Sugar Limited.

Name: Patrimonio Autónomo Estrategias Inmobiliarias (3-2-4241)
Description: Patrimonio Autónomo Estrategias Inmobiliarias (3-2-4241) is the investment arm of Terranum Inversión. The firm operates as a real estate investment trust (REIT). The firm seeks to invest in large areas corporate office buildings stores warehouses shopping centers and first class tenants. Patrimonio Autónomo Estrategias Inmobiliarias (3-2-4241) is based in Colombia.

Name: Tanzania Breweries Public Limited Company
Description: Tanzania Breweries Public Limited Company produces distributes and sells malt beer non-alcoholic malt and alcoholic fruit beverages in Tanzania. The company operates in two segments: Beer and Wines and Spirits. It sells its products under the Safari Lager Kilimanjaro Premium Lager Castle Lite Balimi Extra Lager Castle Lager Bia Bingwa Eagle Lager Redds Flying Fish Kilimanjaro Light and Grand Malt as well as Konyagi Gin Valuer Brandy Zanzi Creamy Liqueur and Dodoma and Imagi wines brand names. The company also distributes beer under the Budweiser and Corona brands. Tanzania Breweries Public Limited was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Sanlam Maroc
Description: Sanlam Maroc provides insurance services Morocco. It offers various life and non-life insurances. The company was formerly known as SAHAM Assurance S.A. and changed its name to Sanlam Maroc in June 2022. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Sanlam Maroc is a subsidiary of Sanlam Pan Africa.

Name: Grendene S.A.
Description: Grendene S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development production distribution and sale of plastic footwear for women men and children in Brazil and internationally. The company sells its products through its stores franchised stores and web commerce channels as well as through commercial representatives and distributors under the Melissa Grendha Rider Cartago Ipanema Zaxy Pega Forte Grendene Kids and Zizou brand names; and operates Clube Melissa and Mini Melissa franchise stores. It also licenses the use of celebrity personalities and characters in the children’s media. The company also exports its products in North America Asia and Oceania Europe Central and South America the Middle East and Africa. Grendene S.A. was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Sobral Brazil.

Name: Lesieur Cristal S.A.
Description: Lesieur Cristal S.A. produces and distributes oils soaps and hygiene products in Morocco. The company is involved in agricultural upstream; pressing; crude oil refining; liquid and hard soap production; conditioning; margarine production; and marketing and distribution. It offers its products under the Lesieur HuilOr Cristal Oleor AL HORRA Mabrouka Magdor Familia Ledda Taous El Kef and El Menjel brands. The company also exports its products to approximately 42 countries. Lesieur Cristal S.A. was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Egyptian Iron and Steel Company
Description: Egyptian Iron and Steel Company produces and sells iron and steel products in Egypt. The company offers products including hot rolled equal angles duct beams round bars square strips and baklava; smooth and serrated rebar wicker rods flanges beams cold rolled strips and rolls slabs and square; iron limestone and barite ore abrasive blast furnaces and cast iron molds; oxygen argon and nitrogen; metal structural work; and manufacture spare parts. The company is based in Cairo Egypt. Egyptian Iron and Steel Company is a subsidiary of Metallurgical Industries Co.

Name: EFG Holding Company S.A.E
Description: EFG Holding Company S.A.E a financial services company provides investment banking products and services in Egypt rest of GCC countries and internationally. The company provides securities brokerage services for institutions high-net-worth investors and individual investors; investment banking services such as equity and debt capital markets mergers and acquisitions and merchant banking services to regional corporations multinationals and governments; and asset management products comprising mutual funds and financial investment solutions. It also offers private equity services for energy healthcare education and conventional funds; research; conference; commercial banking services; and non-bank finance products including financial technology leasing and factoring microfinance insurance mortgage securitization collection and Sukuk issuance. The company was formerly known as EFG-Hermes Holding S.A.E. and changed its name to EFG Holding Company S.A.E in July 2023. The company was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Sociedad Transmisora Metropolitana II S.A.
Description: Sociedad Transmisora Metropolitana II S.A. engages in the transmission of electrical energy on its own or on behalf of third parties. It operates 683 km of transmission lines and 57 substations; and owns and operates assets that are installed in 3 substations owned by third parties. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Osorno Chile. Sociedad Transmisora Metropolitana II S.A. is a subsidiary of Sociedad Transmisora Metropolitana SpA.

Name: Baladna Q.P.S.C.
Description: Baladna Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells dairy products in Qatar. The company offers fresh UHT long life hi-protein and evaporated milk; labneh dessert yoghurt and cheese; fresh and sterilized creams; Laban and Ayran milk drinks; chilled UHT and long-life juices; meat; and organic fertilizers. It is also involved in the slaughter of animals and sale of meat; trading of feed food materials plastic packaging and dairy products; retail of dairy products eggs olives and pickles in specialized stores; wholesale of soft drinks juices and mineral water; investment and management of agricultural projects; growing of cereals leguminous crops and oil seeds; and activities of export and import offices. In addition the company provides liquid and powder detergents; dishwashing liquids hand sanitizers and hand washing liquids; cleaning materials for tiles porcelain glasses and mirrors; and other detergent materials soaps and cosmetics. It sells its products under the Baladna and Awafi brands. Baladna Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2014 and is based in Al Khor Qatar.

Name: Banco de Occidente S.A.
Description: Banco de Occidente S.A. provides banking products and services for individuals and businesses in Colombia. The company offers savings payroll current and pension account; online remittances investment and asset management debit and credit card and used cars sales services. It also offers personal and commercial loans mortgage services digital products and various insurance services. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Cali Colombia. Banco de Occidente S.A. is a subsidiary of Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A.

Name: Viña Concha y Toro S.A.
Description: Viña Concha y Toro S.A. together with its subsidiaries produces distributes stores transports and sells wines in Chile Argentina and the United States. The company sells its wines under the Concha y Toro Don Melchor Marques de Casa Concha Casillero del Diablo Diablo Frontera Viña Maipo Carmín de Peumo Amelia Terrunyo Trio Tocornal Santa Emiliana Clos de Pirque Sunrise Palo Alto Sendero Reservado Concha y Toro SBX Descorcha Cono Sur Bicicleta Isla Negra Ocio 20 Barrels Trivento Eolo Fetzer Bonterra 1000 Stories Sanctuary and Jekel brands as well as Krossbar and Kross Cervecería Independiente brands. It is also involved in distribution of premium spirits and beers; provision of tourism services; and real estate business. Concha y Toro S.A. was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Las Condes Chile.

Name: JHSF Participações S.A.
Description: JHSF Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in Brazil and internationally. It operates through five segments: Recurring Income; Real Estate Business; Airport Hotels and Restaurants; and Holding Company. The company is involved in the construction and operation of shopping malls; purchase and sale of residential and commercial properties; retail of fashion goods; leasing of commercial real estate; and development and operation of hotels tourism activities and gastronomy including bars cafés and restaurants. It also engages in the operation and management of the airfield; provision of management services; and financing solutions services and real estate investment. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Jet Contractors
Description: Jet Contractors operates as a general contracting company in Africa. The company offers building envelopes and wood and metal frames for public infrastructure residential and industrial clients. It also provides architectural fibers concrete; and undertakes engineering procurement and construction of solar projects. The company was formerly known as Jet Alu Maroc SA and changed its name to Jet Contractors in March 2015. Jet Contractors was founded in 1992 and is based in Skhirat Morocco.

Name: Cablevisión Holding S.A.
Description: Cablevisión Holding S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development of infrastructure and the provision of convergent telecommunications services primarily in Argentina Uruguay and Paraguay. The company engages in the provision of fixed and mobile connectivity and voice and data services for individuals homes and companies. The company offers voice communications mobile internet content and download content access applications MMS SMS online streaming corporate email and social network access as well as sells mobile communication devices such as handsets and Wi-Fi modems under the Personal brand. The company also operates Flow a pay TV and entertainment platform that provides channels with various TV genres under Classic TV Flow Box and Flow Now brands as well as offers on-demand products premium subscriptions and Flow music and gaming services. In addition it provides connectivity cloud video and datacenter solutions; security solutions including network security firewall user protection and cybersecurity; Internet of Things solutions comprising fleet management and asset monitoring services; and cloud solutions such as IP video surveillance as well as cloud office collaboration platform for the management of office tools email accounts file repository and video calls under the Telecom brand. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: National Investments Company K.S.C.P.
Description: National Investments Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the investment treasury real estate asset management advisory and brokerage businesses in Kuwait GCC countries and internationally. It operates through four segments: Investment; Treasury; Real Estate; and Asset Management Advisory and Brokerage. The Investment segment trades in equities including investment in associates and other strategic investments. The Treasury segment is involved in liquidity management and trading of foreign currencies. The Real Estate segment engages in buying selling and investing in real estate. The Asset Management Advisory and Brokerage segment manages discretionary and non-discretionary investment portfolios and investment funds as well as provides brokerage advisory last mile delivery and other related financial services. The company is also involved in the property development information technology and trading and contracting activities. National Investments Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: MAS P.L.C.
Description: MAS P.L.C. is a property investor and operator listed on the main board of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange and with a secondary listing on A2X Limited. The group is internally managed combining investment acquisition leasing asset and property management marketing and finance skills. Capital previously invested in WE will be reinvested directly in income property in CEE and indirectly on a downside protected basis in developments via further preference shares in the DJV with co-investor developer and general contractor Prime Kapital.

Name: Holcim Ecuador S.A.
Description: Holcim Ecuador S.A. manufactures produces and sells clinker cement and concrete products to the construction industry in Ecuador. It also provides aggregate and pavement solutions; and solutions in waterproofing sealants and finishes. Holcim Ecuador S.A. was founded in 1921 and is based in Guayaquil Ecuador. Holcim Ecuador S.A. is a subsidiary of Holcim Investments (Spain) SL.

Name: International Financial Advisors Holding - KPSC
Description: International Financial Advisors Holding - KPSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the treasury and investments real estate and other businesses. The company is involved in the insurance and aviation businesses; yacht and travel and tourism; and wealth and fund management; and portfolio and strategic investment activities. It also provides turnkey Internet local and international data communication solutions and termination services for foreign carriers; mechanical electrical and plumbing (mep) infrastructure water and power civil contracting and engineering services; financing credit facilities; and consumer and mortgage finance investments and asset management. The company was formerly known as International Financial Advisors – KPSC. International Financial Advisors Holding - KPSC was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Molinos Agro S.A.
Description: Molinos Agro S.A. produces and sells grain soybean and cereal products. The company also provides animal feeding including both pet-food as well as poultry pork and dairy production; and constructs and operates a biodiesel plant. In addition it exports soy meal soy hull pellets crude soy oil soy lecithin biodiesel refined glycerin corn crude sunflower oil and wheat. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Victoria Argentina.

Name: Kuwait Cement Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Kuwait Cement Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries produces and sells cement and ready-mix concrete in Kuwait and internationally. It operates in two segments Manufacturing Sector and Investment Sector. The company offers ordinary portland cement OPC sulphate resistant cement SRC white ordinary Portland cement WOPC oil well cement OWC and ground granulated blast furnace slag material GGBS. It is also involved in the real estate and industrial businesses. In addition the company production of cement of all kinds; refractory bricks blocks and tiles; bulk hollow cement blocks and bricks; cement block; concrete or cement; asbestos cement or cellulosic fiber cement; and building materials. Additionally it is involved in aggregate crusher; chemical stores; wholesale of cement gypsum sand and aggregate retail sale of building materials and scrap and storage in warehouses; as well as sale and purchase of shares and bonds; owning the real estate; importing chemicals and aggregate; extract sand and refilling; transportation of solid and liquid waste; and collection of hazardous waste and non-hazardous waste. further the company engages in treating and disposing of hazardous waste and non-hazardous waste recycling used tires. Kuwait Cement Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Egypt Kuwait Holding Company (S.A.E.)
Description: Egypt Kuwait Holding Company (S.A.E.) is an investment holding company specializes in private equity and secondary investing. It invests in mature emerging growth industry consolidation buyout and growth capital investments. It seeks to invest in oil and gas production insurance infrastructure services fertilizer and agriculture chemicals electric power generation by fossil fuels petrochemicals natural gas distribution and transmission non-banking financial services and manufacturing MDF (Medium Density Fiberboard). The firm seeks to invest in Egypt Kuwait United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia. It invest from its balance sheet investments. Egypt Kuwait Holding Company (S.A.E.) was founded in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: FirstRand Namibia Limited
Description: FirstRand Namibia Limited offers banking insurance and investment products and services in Namibia. The company provides digital enablement solutions lending and transactional products for retail banking; transactional banking lending trade and working capital solutions advisory structured finance markets and structuring merchant services and purchase order financing and principle investing solutions and private equity for commercial banking; and investment banking solutions including lending and advisory global markets and custody and transactional banking. It also offers wealth and asset management services; estate planning; and short and long-term insurance products and advice affordable funeral cover and comprehensive insurance solutions for buildings motor vehicles portable possessions home contents and personal liability. In addition it provides home personal and mortgage loans; credit and debit cards card acquiring and credit facilities; vehicle and asset financing; unit trust investment and management; estate and trust services; insurance brokerage services; and eWallet DigiPlus CashTill and CashPlus solutions. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Windhoek Namibia. FirstRand Namibia Limited is a subsidiary of FirstRand EMA Holdings Ltd.

Name: Forestal Constructora y Comercial del Pacifico Sur SA
Description: Forestal Constructora y Comercial del Pacifico Sur SA engages in the purchase sell and distribute materials and construction products. It promotes construction activities; and acquire forest land. The company was formerly known as Inmobiliaria Colon SA and changed its name to Forestal Constructora y Comercial del Pacifico Sur SA in October 1974. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile.

Name: Al Meera Consumer Goods Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Al Meera Consumer Goods Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail trade of various types of consumer goods commodities in Qatar and the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in three segments: Retail Investment and Leasing. The Retail segment engages in the buying and selling of consumer goods. Its Investment segment includes equity and funds as financial assets. The Leasing segment rents out shops in various malls. The company also engages in the establishment and management of business enterprise; sale of food stuff household items garments stationery computer accessories books and toys; and construction operation and management of shopping centers and related facilities; and operation of supermarkets and hypermarkets. Al Meera Consumer Goods Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Airtel Malawi Plc
Description: Airtel Malawi Plc offers mobile telecommunication services in Malawi. The company provides GSM mobile cellular telephone leased line voice telephony messaging data international and national long-distance telecommunications and value-added services as well as high-speed fixed broadband internet roaming and mobile money services. It also sells simcards handsets accessories and other equipment. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Lilongwe Malawi. Airtel Malawi Plc is a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel Malawi Holdings BV.

Name: Banco da Amazônia S.A.
Description: Banco da Amazônia S.A. provides banking products and services in the Amazon region of Brazil. The company offers savings current simplified and salary accounts; credit cards; capitalization products; various personal and business loans; pension plans; investment funds bank deposit certificates and deposit receipts and agribusiness letter of credit; insurance products; and direct debit and online financial services. It also provides financing programs for family farming machines and equipment rural and biodiversity activities trucks green energy green business and infrastructure and rural and non-rural investments as well as science technology and innovation activities; development and merchant marine fund; working capital; foreign trade; and legal entity savings billing card advance business check automatic debit cellular messaging and banking domicile services. Banco da Amazônia S.A. was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Belém Brazil.

Name: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Capital S.A.
Description: Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Capital S.A. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm manages fixed Income mutual funds. The firm invests in fixed Income Instruments corporate Bonds mortgages adjustable notes bank bonds and term deposits. Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Capital S.A. is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Golden Pyramids Plaza S.A.E.
Description: Golden Pyramids Plaza S.A.E. develops an integrated tourism complex in Egypt. The company’s tourism complex includes hotels chalets hotel suits wedding and meeting venues bowling alleys and skate roller rinks cinema shopping mall housing units administrative offices and surgical and health centers. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: São Martinho S.A.
Description: São Martinho S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of sugar ethanol and other sugarcane byproducts in Brazil. The company operates through Sugar Ethanol Corm Ethanol Electric Power Real Estate Businesses Yeast and Other Products segment. It offers a range of raw sugar; hydrated ethanol which is used in tanks of cars powered by ethanol; anhydrous ethanol that is used as a gasoline additive in gasoline-powered vehicles; and industrial ethanol which is primarily used in the production of paints cosmetics and alcoholic beverages. The company also generates electricity from sugarcane bagasse; provides byproducts including yeast used in animal feed; offers fusel oil used as a solvent and pure amyl ethanol; and SMartLiO a substitute for soybean oil used in the production of biofuels paint and chemicals as well as Dried Distillers Grains with Solubles an animal nutrition for ruminants pigs horses birds fish and pets. In addition it is involved in the cultivation of sugarcane; development of real estate properties; import and export of goods products and raw materials; agricultural productions; and investment in other companies. The company was founded in 1914 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. São Martinho S.A. is a subsidiary of LJN Participações S.A.

Name: Dexco S.A.
Description: Dexco S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of wooden panels in Brazil and internationally. It operates through Wood Deca and Coatings segments. The company offers medium density particulate panels and medium and high-density fiberboard panels under the Duratex brand; laminated floors and semifinished components for furniture under the Durafloor brand name; and vitreous chinaware sanitary ware and metals under the Deca Hydra Belize Elizabeth and Hydra Corona brands. It also provides ceramic and cement flooring as well as coatings under the Ceusa Portinari and Castelatto brands. The company was formerly known as Duratex S.A. and changed its name to Dexco S.A. in August 2021. Dexco S.A. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Sociedad Portafolio S. A.
Description: Sociedad Portafolio S. A. an investment holding company invests in insurance savings and asset management banking infrastructure and other industries in Colombia and internationally. It also produces cement and concrete; manages airports; constructs roads and highways; and engages in the energy business. The company is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: Jordan Telecommunications Company
Description: Jordan Telecommunications Company provides telecommunication services in Jordan. It operates through Orange Fixed and Orange Internet Orange Mobile Renewable Energy Orange Money and E-Commerce segments. The company offers money transfer payment and financial services solution provided via an electronic account linked to a mobile number; wholesales electronic telecommunication equipment and device spare parts; constructs develops maintains fixed telecommunication network services; provides fiber to home services; and installs operates and manages a cellular network. It also engages in the retail trade of mobile phones and accessories; retail sale and wholesale of mobile phones lines; e-shopping and e-trading activities; GSM operation; internet service provider; and development of renewable energy projects. In addition the company furnishes installs maintains engineers and operates communication facilities for the provision of data network and internet access services as well as manage solar farms and renewable energy projects. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Jordan Telecommunications Company operates as a subsidiary of Joint Investment Telecommunications Co.

Name: Salhia Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Salhia Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in real estate development and leasing in Kuwait Gulf Cooperation Council and Europe. The company operates through Real Estate Operations and Hotel Operations. It develops and leases commercial retail and leisure and office properties. The company also provides hotel hospitality services through JW Marriott Hotel – Kuwait Courtyard Marriott Hotel-Kuwait and Arraya Ballroom – Kuwait and Marriot Executive Apartments. In addition the company is involved in the provision of project management services; and entertainment businesses. Salhia Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: ARGO Properties N.V.
Description: ARGO Properties N.V. operates as a real estate company in Germany. The company is involved in residential real estate; and conversion and development of office spaces. ARGO Properties N.V. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Amsterdam the Netherlands.

Name: MRV Engenharia e Participações S.A.
Description: MRV Engenharia e Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a real estate developer in Brazil and the United States. It operates in four segments: Real Estate Development Luggo Resia and Sundivisions. The company engages in the development construction and sale of owned and third-party real estate; development and rental of residential properties as well as provision of other services; and development and sale of residential and commercial urban lots. It also provides real estate consulting services; deals in service of goods and services supply in residential real estate segment; and holds shares. In addition the company offers housing solution platform for the apartments urbanized properties and rental units; and technical engineering services. MRV Engenharia e Participações S.A. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Access Holdings Plc
Description: Access Holdings Plc operates as the financial holding company of Access Bank Plc that provide various banking products and services in Nigeria rest of Africa and Europe. It operates in six segments: Corporate and Investment Banking Commercial Banking Retail Banking Access Pensions Management Hydrogen Payment Services Company Limited and Access Insurance Brokers Limited. The company offers deposit money banking wealth and investment management financial technology and ecosystem orchestration payment and consumer lending services. It also provides finance solutions for short medium and long-term financing needs as well as relationship banking services; manages and administers pension funds such as retirement savings accounts funds I-VI and transitional contributions funds; and administers retirement savings accounts voluntary savings schemes and approved existing schemes. In addition the company offers Instant Pay payment gateways POS card and switch services; and insurance brokerage services including insurance audits risk management evaluation specialized claims and uninsured loss recoveries research and market reviews and risk retention funds. It serves individuals multinationals corporates institutional and non-institutional clients organizations and the public sector. Access Holdings Plc was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P.
Description: Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services to individuals and businesses in Kuwait GCC countries and rest of Middle East countries. The company operates in two segments General Risk Insurance and Life and Medical Insurance. The General Risk Insurance segment provides general insurance products comprising marine and aviation motor vehicles property and engineering and general accidents insurance products. The Life and Medical Insurance segment offers savings protection products and other long-term contracts. This segment also provides whole life insurance term insurance unitized pensions pure endowment pensions group life and disability insurance and credit life insurance as well as group medical insurance products such as third-party administration preferred global health and FAY products. In addition the company offers takaful insurance and reinsurance products. Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Fairfax (Barbados) International Corp.

Name: Inversiones Portuarias Chancay S.A.A.
Description: Inversiones Portuarias Chancay S.A.A. invests in develops constructs maintains expands administers and operates Chancay port in Peru. It also provides advice on logistics and/or operations in maritime areas and specialized transportation services for import and export products. The company was founded in 2023 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Organización Terpel S.A.
Description: Organización Terpel S.A. operates fuel service stations in Colombia Panama Ecuador Peru and the Dominican Republic. The company engages in the purchase distribution and supply of hydrocarbons and their derivatives; and refining supply storage and transportation of natural or propane gas and other products. It also manufactures lubricants; and constructs improves conserves maintains and modernizes port and related activities. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Organización Terpel S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Empresas Copec S.A.

Name: Molibdenos y Metales S.A.
Description: Molibdenos y Metales S.A. engages in the processing of molybdenum concentrate worldwide. It provides molybdenum metal briquettes ferromolybdenum technical molybdic oxide briquettes and technical molybdic oxid powder for steel industry; high solubility technical molybdenum oxide pure molybdic oxide ammonium dimolybdate and ammonium heptamolybdate for the chemical industry; and metallic products such as molybdenum metal in form of powder and briquettes. The company also offers rhenium products including perrhenic acid ammonium perrhenate molybdenum rhenium alloy in form of powder and rhenium metal in form of powder and briquettes; and other by-products including copper cathodes copper cement and sulfuric acid. In addition it is involved in the provision of mining services; production marketing and distribution of electrical energy; commercial exploitation and real estate management; and production and marketing of value-added nuts. The company was founded in 1936 and is based in San Bernardo Chile.

Name: IRB-Brasil Resseguros S.A.
Description: IRB-Brasil Resseguros S.A. provides reinsurance solutions in Brazil and internationally. It offers reinsurance solutions for casualty cargo and marine agricultural risks property life and health oil and gas financial lines surety and mortgage. IRB-Brasil Resseguros S.A. was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Sappi Limited
Description: Sappi Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the provision of materials made from woodfiber-based renewable resources in Europe North America and South Africa. The company offers speciality paper; flexible packaging paper paperboard containerboard release liner label paper functional papers uncoated woodfree paper coated and uncoated woodfree paper coated mechanical paper thinprint inkjet paper and label paper. It also offers dissolving pulp graphic packaging and speciality casting and release papers; forestry and bio-energy materials. In addition the company provides biomaterials such as valida lignin and furfural as well as engages in insurance business. Sappi Limited company was founded in 1936 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: SIMPAR S.A.
Description: SIMPAR S.A. provides light vehicle rental and fleet management and outsourcing services in Brazil. The company provides road logistics; car rental and fleet management sector; rental of trucks machinery and equipment; Volkswagen/man truck and bus dealerships; and light and heavy vehicle fleets including complete service management customization maintenance and fleet operation with driver. It operates car and motorcycle retail business; manages and outsources fleets of light and heavy vehicle to the public sector municipal passenger transport and urban cleaning sectors; and offers financial solutions and services. SIMPAR S.A. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. SIMPAR S.A. is a subsidiary of JSP Holding S.A.

Name: Capex S.A.
Description: Capex S.A. an integrated energy company engages in the exploration and exploitation of hydrocarbons in Argentina. The company is involved in the exploration and exploitation of oil and gas; construction and development of a combined-cycle thermal power plant with an installed capacity of 672 MW and an LPG plant; production of hydrogen and oxygen; and production and sale of propane butane and gasoline as well as generation of energy from wind farms and hydrogen/oxygen. It also processes and separates liquid gases derived from gas. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Vicente López Argentina. Capex S.A. is a subsidiary of Companias Asociadas Petroleras S.A.

Name: Jordan Petroleum Refinery Co. Ltd.
Description: Jordan Petroleum Refinery Co. Ltd. engages in refining producing distributing and transporting petroleum products primarily in Jordan. The company provides asphalt products such as blown and liquid asphalt; and fuels including liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) gasoline kerosene aviation fuel diesel and fuel oils. It also provides lube oils; and white spirits and sulphur. In addition it is involved in sale of oil derivatives and gas cylinders; marketing of oils; maintaining and operating stations and warehouses of Aqaba; and loading various petroleum derivatives comprising LPG gasoline 90/95 normal/special diesel and avtur fuel oil white spirit and asphalt in tankers. Further the company repairs and requalifies gas cylinders. It primarily serves electricity transportation industry and construction sectors. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie
Description: Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie together with its subsidiaries provides banking and financial services individuals companies and institutions in Morocco. The company offers various accounts savings and investment products insurance brokerage and credit products. It also provides remote banking funding and private banking services including heritage project financial advice funding and everyday banking services; and international trade growth finance flow management operating cycle management currency hedging employee loyalty and business assistance services. In addition the company engages in the long-term rental of vehicles asset management foreign currency transactions stock exchange intermediation and equipment and real estate leasing activities. Further it provides customer relations center interactive voice server SMS and other services. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie operates as a subsidiary of BNPP IRB Participations.

Name: Empresas Lipigas S.A.
Description: Empresas Lipigas S.A. engages in the distribution and sale of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) natural gas (NG) and liquefied natural gas (LNG) in Chile Peru and Colombia. The company engages in the commercialization and distribution of LPG through cylinders and bulk for residential commercial industrial and transport sectors. It also provides compressed natural gas for vehicles and industrial clients; and natural gas based electric energy. Empresas Lipigas S.A. was founded in 1950 and is based in Las Condes Chile.

Name: MAHLE Metal Leve S.A.
Description: MAHLE Metal Leve S.A. an automotive parts company manufactures and sells components for internal combustion engines and automotive filters in South America Europe Central and North America Africa and internationally. It operates through Powertrain and Charging and Thermaland Fluid Systems segments. The company offers drive systems and power electronics for electric powertrains; piston systems cylinder components valve trains air conditioning engine cooling air management engine cooling oil management; and power electronics for traction drives for passenger cars as well as electric drive and mechatronic systems for industrial applications agricultural and construction machinery commercial vehicles industrial vehicles electric transport vehicles and the automotive industry. It provides climatic wind tunnels engine testing engineering module testing thermal management and transmission services. In addition the company offers pistons piston rings valves connecting rods bearings bushings thrust washers cylinder liners piston rings camshafts piston pins ring carriers and mechanical compressors products as well as fuelfilters airfilters oil filters air conditioning filters activated carbon filters oil separators caps diesel pre-filters and intake manifolds air conditioning and radiators and condensers. MAHLE Metal Leve S.A. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Mogi Guaçu Brazil.

Name: Oman Arab Bank SAOG
Description: Oman Arab Bank SAOG engages in the commercial and investment banking activities in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking Treasury Others and Islamic Banking segments. The company offers deposit products including current minor savings growth fixed deposit youth and upfront deposit interest accounts; and loan products such as home car and personal loans. It also provides credit debit prepaid corporate and reward cards as well as merchant services and card promotions; ATM and internet and mobile banking services; and bancassurance products comprising motor travel health home contents and comprehensive personal insurances. In addition the company offers treasury services that include foreign exchange and money market and hedging services; trade and project finance; and cash management services. Further it provides Sharia’ compliant Islamic banking products and services such as Ijarah Murabaha Mudarbah and Diminishing Musharakah. Oman Arab Bank SAOG was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Oman International Development and Investment Company SAOG
Description: Oman International Development and Investment Company SAOG is a private equity firm specializing in buyout investments. The firm also seeks to invest in global capital markets and marketable securities. It seeks to invest in banking Insurance finance leasing financial services commercial banking investment banking financial investments real estate tourism technology energy and industrial sectors. The firm also seeks to invest in steel household products aluminium plastics detergents chemicals tourism and food products. It prefers to invest both locally and internationally. The firm prefers to invest in United States and Canada Latin America and Caribbean Europe Asia/Pacific and Oman. The fund prefers to take majority stake in its portfolio companies. Oman International Development and Investment Company SAOG was founded in 1983 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: EZTEC Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: EZTEC Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. engages in engineering construction and real estate development activities in Brazil and internationally. The company develops and sells real estate properties; manages and leases properties; constructs condominiums; and subdivides land. It also engages in the provision of services related to construction supervision studies and projects; and execution of civil engineering works and services. EZTEC Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Besalco S.A.
Description: Besalco S.A. through its subsidiaries operates as a construction company in Chile. It designs constructs and sells houses and apartments; develops constructs maintains and operates hydroelectric plants; and manages concessions in public and private infrastructure ports airports and other sectors. The company also engages in the construction of roads reservoirs tunnels tailings dams bridges viaducts gas pipelines irrigation works hydroelectric plants sanitary works mining works hospitals stadiums residential and commercial buildings airports and seaports as well as works for the Santiago subway and State Railways; engineering and construction of industrial plants; and design and construction of electrical energy transmission systems including high medium and low voltage lines and substations. In addition it provides mining earthworks crushing sorting processing materials loading and transporting salt harvesting tailings dam operation equipment spot leasing harvesting forest debarking and ready-mixed concrete transportation services as well as chips chipping and transportation services. The company was formerly known as Sanz Bezanilla y Salinas Limitada and changed its name to Besalco S.A. in January 1995. Besalco S.A. was incorporated in 1944 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: UNACEM Corp S.A.A.
Description: UNACEM Corp S.A.A. produces markets and sells various types of cement clinker and concrete products in Peru the United States Ecuador Colombia and Chile. The company operates through three segments: Production and Marketing of Cement; Production and Marketing of Concrete; and Generation and Marketing of Electrical Energy Using Hydraulic Resources. It provides consulting and technology assistance storage and surveillance services. The company also engages in the real estate business; extraction of non-ferrous metal ores; thermal plant operation; production and sale prefabricated concrete; sale of energy and power; and manufacturing of quicklime and calcium carbonates. The company was formerly known as Unión Andina de Cementos S.A.A. and changed its name to UNACEM Corp S.A.A. UNACEM Corp S.A.A. was founded in 1967 and is based in La Victoria Peru.

Name: delta holding S.A.
Description: delta holding S.A. operates in the infrastructure metallurgy water and environmental and parachemistry activities worldwide. It manufactures road security advertising billboards and spots public area equipment bitumen/asphalt and its derivatives construction materials and signaling equipment; installs toll booths; and provides sports surfacing coating solutions and construction materials. The company also constructs and maintains roads highways city road networks port platforms and aeronautical runways; installs and maintains horizontal and vertical signages and safety equipment on traffic lanes; and develops social housings. In addition it offers metal and mechanical engineering boiler making hydro-mechanical equipment piping masts and public lighting columns; iron parts for the hydraulic industrial and public work sectors; and aluminum profiles and construction accessories. Further the company engages in machining of mechanical parts; hot-dip galvanizing and surface treatment business; foundry and extrusion of aluminum and stainless and special steels business; assembly and maintenance of electromechanical equipment; pumping plant set-up; port and hydraulic equipment installation; fabrication and erection of reconstituted welded profiles; and implementing industrial projects. Additionally it pipes and canals in centrifuged and pre-stressed reinforced concrete and special pipes. The company also offers paints thinners and horizontal signage related products; industrial medical and laboratory gases; mechanical construction materials; supplies ethanol and liquid carbon dioxide gas; and exploits for gem salt. delta holding S.A. was founded in 1974 and is based in Skhirat Morocco.

Name: The Okomu Oil Palm Company Plc
Description: The Okomu Oil Palm Company Plc engages in the cultivation and plantation of oil palm and rubber in Nigeria. The company operates Palm Plantation Rubber Plantation and Palm and Rubber Processing segments. It is also involved in the processing of fresh fruit bunches into crude palm oil and kernel for resale; and processing of rubber lumps to rubber cake. In addition the company offers palm oil products such as crude palm oil palm kernel palm kernel oil and palm kernel cake. Further it provides natural and synthetic rubber products. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Benin City Nigeria. The Okomu Oil Palm Company Plc operates as a subsidiary of Socfinaf S.A.

Name: Intelbras S.A. - Indústria de Telecomunicação Eletrônica Brasileira
Description: Intelbras S.A. - Indústria de Telecomunicação Eletrônica Brasileira engages in the manufacturing developing and sale of electronic security equipment and electronic surveillance and monitoring services in Brazil. The company operates through Security Communication and Energy segments. It offers electronic safety products and solutions including automation devices alarms storage cameras condominium communication corporate access control locks digital video recorders fire and intercom products vehicle monitoring sensors emergency signaling video walls software and application products and accessories; and networks products and solutions comprise racks routers 5G and corporate Wi-Fi products outdoor radios optical fiber and passive products switches PoE injectors signal repeaters USB adapters software and apps and cables. The company also provides communication related products and solutions such as webcams projectors wireless mouse and keyboards cloud solutions antennas and converters phone centrals appliance and conference products gateways headsets radio communicators smart boxes and controls smart speakers software and applications and phones; and energy related products and solutions that includes electric vehicle chargers fonts batteries UPS electronic protectors surge protectors USB accessories and illumination presence sensors. In addition it offers on grid solutions which includes attachment structures on grid generators and inverters solar panels and string box; and off grid solutions such as illumination products mounting structures outdoor cabinets solar drive and panels solar bomb and off grid generators and inverters. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in São José Brazil.

Name: Cresud Sociedad Anónima Comercial Inmobiliaria Financiera y Agropecuaria
Description: Cresud Sociedad Anónima Comercial Inmobiliaria Financiera y Agropecuaria an agricultural company engages in the production of agricultural commodities in Brazil and other Latin American countries. The company operates through Agricultural Business and Business Urban Properties and Investments segments. It is also involved in the management development and ownership of shopping malls office buildings and hotels; sale of grain derivatives such as flour and oil; production and sale of crops such as soybean sugarcane wheat corn oilseed and sunflower as well as sorghum and peanuts; and breeding purchasing and/or fattening of cattle for sale to slaughterhouses and supermarkets. In addition it leases its farms to third parties for agriculture cattle breeding and seed production; and offers agricultural services. The company was incorporated in 1936 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Bank of Jordan
Description: Bank of Jordan provides financial and banking services in Jordan Palestine Syria Bahrain Iraq and Saudi Arabia. It operates through the Retail Banking Corporate Banking Treasury and Financial Brokerage Services segments. The company offers current salary and savings accounts; time deposits and certificates of deposits; loans comprising personal housing and auto loans; safe deposit boxes; and credit debit and prepaid cards as well as digital payments. It also provides dealing and treasury services purchase services portfolio brokerage custody of investments financial consultations custody service and management services for initial public offerings. Bank of Jordan was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Noor Financial Investment Company - KPSC
Description: Noor Financial Investment Company – KPSC together with its subsidiaries provides investment and financial services in Kuwait the GCC and internationally. It operates through Investments Real Estate IT Services and Hotel Operations. The company offers mutual funds; public placement and private placement advisory services; wealth management services; and transaction based advisory services including business valuations portfolio valuation purchase price allocation and goodwill impairment as well as strategic financial advisory such as merger and acquisition transactions restructurings business modeling change of control going private management buyout and public private partnerships. It also provides banking; investment advisory and portfolio solutions; and invests in local and international equities public and private equity markets and real estate opportunities as well as listed equities and financial products. In addition the company operates Amman International Airport Hotel a 4-stars hotel as well as provides hospitality services and management of third-party hospitality businesses; owns and manages residential and commercial properties; provides maintenance for residential and commercial complex entertainment centers hotels and tourist facilities; develops leases and operates real estate properties; and provides information technology solutions and services including Oracle Cloud ERP and Kiosk solutions CMS/DMS and archiving software development and integration manpower outsourcing and recruitment printers and copiers consumables and maintenance and training services. Further it engages in general trading and contracting activities; leasing of submarine internet transmission cables; and media and advertisement services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Noor Financial Investment Company - KPSC is a subsidiary of National Industries Group Holding – KPSC.

Name: Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A.
Description: Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the leasing reselling and selling of trucks machinery equipment and parts in Brazil. The company leases tractors forklift trucks agricultural machinery and implements buses and other vehicles; sells automobile parts and accessories; sells new and used tractors machines tires air tubes implements motor vehicles and buses; and provides automobile maintenance and repair and technical assistance and related services as well as engages in the logistics and road transportation of cargos. It also offers civil construction parts lubricants provision of vehicle repair and maintenance services and the like road transportation of cargo in general wholesale trade of machinery apparatus and equipment for agricultural use parts and pieces and intermediation and agency activities for services and business in general except real estate; commercial representatives and agents for the trade of motor vehicles. In addition the company sells fertilizers herbicides and seeds; and provides engineering services related to customization of trucks and buses as well as provision of agricultural activities. Further the company manufactures and sells truck trailers truck bodies road implements cabins and industrial machinery and equipment; and provides installation renovation repair and maintenance of equipment and vehicles; provision of logistics and road freight transportation services; information technology services; technical analysis on motor vehicles; forklift operator services; and outsourcing and managing of human resources. Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A. is a subsidiary of SIMPAR S.A.

Name: Jordan Kuwait Bank
Description: Jordan Kuwait Bank together with its subsidiaries provides banking products and services to personal private and corporate customers. It offers various accounts such as savings current basic bank and fixed deposit accounts as well as certificates of deposit; loans including personal car housing army and office and clinic loans as well as personal loans against mortgage and for medical doctors; credit debit and prepaid cards; life and general insurance services; and other services such as dividend disbursement western union money transfer safe store auto safe deposit boxes remittance and direct debit services. The company also provides direct loans and lines of credit including working capital and fixed asset financing discounted loans L/C financing export financing real estate financing project financing and overdraft facilities; bills for collection letters of guarantee import and export letters of credit and finance leasing; POS; loan guarantee programs CBJ financing programs EIB programs women loans and other programs such as markabati tourism loan and startup loan; craftsmen and professionals services; and energy efficiency renewable energy project financing and medical product services. In addition it offers brokerage Sharia compliant products ETFs mutual funds equity fixed income portfolio and asset management and wealth planning. Further the company provides treasury services including foreign exchange margin trading financial derivatives money market and capital market investment and financial institutions and international banking services as well as digital services. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Jordan Kuwait Bank operates as a subsidiary of Al Rawabi United Holding Company K.S.C.C. (Holding).

Name: Southern Sun Limited
Description: Southern Sun Limited owns leases and manages hotels in South Africa Mozambique the Seychelles Tanzania the United Arab Emirates and Zambia. The company operates through five segments: Manco Investment Properties Sandton Consortium SA Portfolio and Offshore. It operates hotels and resorts under the Southern Sun Hotels Southern Sun Resorts StayEasy Garden Court SUN1 SunSquare and Sandton Convention Centre brands as well as Arabella Hotel Golf & Spa Mount Grace Hotel & Spa Sandton Sun and Towers Beverly Hills 54 on Bath and Paradise Sun brands. The company was formerly known as Tsogo Sun Hotels Limited. Southern Sun Limited was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A.
Description: Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A. engages in manufacturing and marketing beer in Morocco. The company produces and markets local wines and mineral water; and provides olive oil. Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A. offers its products under Casablanca Stork Gold Special Flag Original Special Flag Flag PILS Doppel Munich Lager Bonassia Comtesse de La Courtablaise Halana kasbah Larroque and Vigne d'azour brands. The company was founded in 1919 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Société des Boissons du Maroc S.A. is a subsidiary of Ste Marocaine d'Investissements & de Sces - MDI.

Name: Integratel Perú S.A.A.
Description: Integratel Perú S.A.A. operates as a telecommunications company in Peru. The company offers mobile telephony Internet and fixed telephony services; data transmission and information technology services; national and international long distance bearer services; and mobile satellite and pay television services. The company was formerly known as Telefónica del Perú S.A.A. and changed its name to Integratel Perú S.A.A. in June 2025. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Surquillo Peru. As of April 13 2025 Telefónica del Perú S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Integra Tec International Inc.

Name: Gulf Investment House - KPSC
Description: Gulf Investment House - KPSC together with its subsidiaries engages in the investment activities in Kuwait Gulf and the Middle East and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Investments Real Estate and Manufacturing. It provides financial and advisory services. The company also undertakes Islamic investments as well as engages in the real estate activities. Gulf Investment House - KPSC was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Gulf Investment House - KPSC operates as a subsidiary of GIH Financing Co.

Name: Compagnie Marocaine de Goutte à goutte et de Pompage S.A.
Description: Compagnie Marocaine de Goutte à goutte et de Pompage S.A. engages in the distribution of irrigation and agricultural equipment in Morocco and West Africa. The company engage in the distribution of irrigation systems pumping equipment for water supply; and solar equipment. It is also involved engages in the production PVC and HDPE pipes for drinking water supply; liquid sanitation; and construction projects in the construction and telecommunications sectors. The company provides desalination and pumping treatment services. It also engages in the distribution of plant protection and nutrition products seeds and plastic films; and mixing and processing of fertilizers. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Omnia Holdings Limited
Description: Omnia Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries research develops manufactures and supplies chemicals specialised services and solutions for the agriculture mining and chemicals application industries in South Africa rest of Africa and internationally. It operates through Agriculture RSA Agriculture Rest of Africa Agriculture International Mining RSA Mining International and Chemicals segments. The company manufactures and trades in granular liquid and specialty fertilizers; humates and other biostimulants; and fulvates kelp microbial products. It also offers trace elements and plant health products to enhance crop health yields and soil health; and value-added services and solutions as well as supplies raw materials and manufactured goods. In addition the company provides blasting agents bulk emulsion and blended bulk explosives; AXXIS electronic detonator system and software; mining chemicals; and manufactures and distributes specialty functional and effect chemicals and solutions as well as SHEQ-related services. It serves commercial and small-scale farmers co-operatives and other corporate clients; retail customers and government support programmes; and water agriculture industrial and life sciences sectors. Omnia Holdings Limited was founded in 1953 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Edita Food Industries Company (S.A.E)
Description: Edita Food Industries Company (S.A.E) engages in the production of snack food products in Egypt. The company operates through five segments: Cakes Croissants Rusks Wafer and Biscuits. It manufactures packs and sells food products such as juices jams readymade foods cakes pastry milk products meat vegetables fruits chocolate vegetarian products strudles brownies and packaged donut as well as candy jello cookies and frozen pastries. The company offers its products under the Molto HOHOs Twinkies TODO Bake Rolz Bake Stix Mimix Tiger Tail Oniro Molto Forni and Freska brands. It also distributes various brands of imported sweeteners olive oils and pasta. The company sells its products through distribution centers as well as wholesalers and retailers. The company also exports its products to approximately 17 markets across the Middle East and North Africa which include West Bank Iraq Libya and Morocco. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A.
Description: Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the exploration exploitation production and commercialization of metals in Peru the United States Europe and Asia. It primarily explores for zinc copper lead concentrates gold and silver metals. The company holds interest in the Cerro Lindo Mining Unit located in Peru; the El Porvenir unit situated in Peru; and the Atacocha Mine located in Peru. The company was formerly known as Compañía Minera Milpo S.A.A. and changed its name to Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A. in September 2018. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is based in Santiago De Surco Peru. Nexa Resources Perú S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Nexa Resources - Cajamarquilla S.A.

Name: Standard Bank PLC
Description: Standard Bank PLC provides banking and other related services in Malawi. It operates through Corporate and Investment Banking Treasury and Capital Management Personal and Private Banking and Business and Commercial Clients segments. It offers current fixed deposit call SME and contract save accounts; fixed term home pay day revolving term business revolving credit business term commercial property medium term and working capital loans; business overdraft; and trade and vehicle and asset financing services. The company also provides debit cards; bancassurance products; investment products and advisory services; offshore banking services; and ATM Internet telephone and electronic banking services. In addition it offers corporate and investment banking products and services comprising foreign exchange services commodities debt securities and equities trading services; transactional banking trade finance and investor services; and equity investment advisory project finance structured finance structured trade finance corporate lending primary market acquisition and finance property finance and asset and wealth management services to larger corporates financial institutions and international counterparties. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Lilongwe Malawi. Standard Bank PLC operates as a subsidiary of Stanbic Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: JSE Limited
Description: JSE Limited operates as a multi-asset class stock exchange in South Africa. It offers listing services for securities and debt instruments; trading colocation and client support services across its markets; post-trade services such as risk management as well as clearing and settlement assurance for the exchange’s equity bonds and derivatives markets; transfer secretarial services including share register maintenance issuer communication the handling of corporate actions and share scheme management to issuers; and central securities depository service. The company provides market data products comprising live data for JSE-listed equities derivatives and bonds as well as a selection of historical data products to market professionals and data distributors; and Issuer Services including results presentations and investor engagements annual general meeting facilitation and training through the JSE Training Academy. In addition it operates a private placements platform to address the needs of companies that seek to raise capital. The company was founded in 1887 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Capricorn Group Limited
Description: Capricorn Group Limited an investment holding company engages in the banking microlending and related businesses in Namibia Botswana and Zambia. The company’s products and services include savings investment loan credit and deposits. It also offers advisory asset management foreign exchange related finance and insurance products. In addition the company provides lending wealth management asset management and trust management services as well as offers property development and evaluation services and facilitates payments.
