Its Applied Electronics segment offers search and tracking radar systems and subsystems; radar sensor systems; ground and naval search and tracking radar systems; communication systems; cryptographic products and solutions; electronic components and printed circuit boards; remote controlled stabilized weapons platforms; and energy engineering and storage solutions. This segment also provides military and commercial products including technology solutions; and electronic manufacturing services. It serves municipalities parastatals utilities the mining and building industries corporate and retail customers small to medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) government and state-owned entities and defense forces. Reunert Limited was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Potasios de Chile S.A.
Description: Potasios de Chile S.A. engages in investing in shares and financial instruments in Chile. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile. Potasios de Chile S.A. is a subsidiary of Nitratos de Chile SA.

Name: Palestine Development & Investment Co.
Description: Palestine Development & Investment Co. is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in seed start-ups early stage and growth capital investments. The firm primarily invests in companies in industrial buildings and warehouses; commercial and institutional buildings; telecommunications and information technology communication equipments; tourism real estate development; energy and environment; electric utilities; security and commodity exchanges; mortgage services; manufacturing; infrastructure; hotel and motel construction; Recreation Clubs; Restaurants; Plastic Products; waste water treatment; agricultural machinery & consulting; processing; power generation hydroelectric power; solid waste recycling; finance financial services mortgage services capital markets and banking; and industry and agriculture. It seeks to invest in Palestinian authority Jordan and Iran. It seeks to invest a minimum of $1 million in firms with an enterprise value of minimum $5 million. The firm prefers to invest through major three categories Subsidiary Investments Affiliate Investments and Investments in Other Companies. For subsidiary investments it prefers to take more than 50% and controlling stake in investments. For Affiliate Investments it prefers to take owns 20% or more of the capital of the affiliate company granting an influence on both financial and operational policies. For Investments in Other Companies it prefers to own less than 20% of the capital and has limited influence in the decision-making process. The firm is active partner in its investee companies but does not seek control investments. It seeks to exit its investments between five years and seven years. The firm makes investments through personal capital and balance sheet. The firm is based in Rawabi Palestinian Authority.

Name: Bank of Beirut S.A.L.
Description: Bank of Beirut S.A.L. provides various banking products and services to individual and corporate customers. The company offers current and time deposits accounts; and housing auto personal and small business loans. It also provides debit credit business pay and internet cards; transfer domiciliation and bills payment BoB finance/Western Union payment and instacash services; and trade related services such as documentary letters of credit collections trade guarantees and trade finance arrangements. In addition the company provides asset management corporate treasury and capital market services; demand drafts; correspondent and commercial banking services; asset and cash management corporate treasury capital market services and mobile and personal online banking services; and payment solutions. It operates through branches and ATMs. The company was formerly known as Realty Business Bank s.a.l. and changed its name to Bank of Beirut S.A.L. in 1970. Bank of Beirut S.A.L. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Beirut Lebanon.

Name: Tamdeen Real Estate Company - KPSC
Description: Tamdeen Real Estate Company – KPSC together with its subsidiaries invests in real estate properties for the ownership resale leasing and renting in the State of Kuwait and internationally. The company is also involved in the development and sale of real estate projects and construction contracts of buildings; managing properties of others; establishing and managing real estate investment funds; and real estate studies and consultancy businesses. In addition it provides hotel services maintenance and advertising asset management investment banking custody consultancy and brokerage services as well as engages in media and entertainment and food and beverage. Tamdeen Real Estate Company - KPSC was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Corporacion Aceros Arequipa S.A.
Description: Corporacion Aceros Arequipa S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products in Peru and internationally. It offers corrugated bars or rebars corrugated stirrups mechanical connectors transfer voussoirs and baskets nails wires electro-welded meshes and panels wire rod merchant bars beams flat products calamines tubes mill ball bars rock support bolts and adapters welding and tools and hardware. The company also provides plates for vehicle suspension spring profiles and dowel basket and load transfer. It serves its products to self-construction construction heavy and light metalworking mining and agroindustrial sectors. Corporacion Aceros Arequipa S.A. was founded in 1964 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Banestes S.A - Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo
Description: Banestes S.A - Banco do Estado do Espírito Santo S.A. operates as a multiple-service bank in Brazil. The company operates through Financial and Insurance and Others segments. It operates in the areas of insurance and distribution intermediation and administration of third-party resources. The company also offers asset and fund management; administration and intermediation of securities insurance pension plans and capitalization; and current and savings accounts credit/debit cards investment fund management collections and agreement insurance brokerage custody services transfer of funds and resources credit operations and guarantees provision charges and other services. It operates through commercial rural industrial real estate foreign exchange investment and credit card management portfolios. The company was founded in 1935 and is based in Vitória Brazil.

Name: National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C.
Description: National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides real estate investment and development services in the Middle East and North Africa. The company involved in the ownership development trading leasing and management of real estate properties and other activities. It also sells and purchases land and real estate properties; manages third-party properties and public facilities; constructs residential buildings; real estate consulting; repair and maintains air conditioning refrigeration and air purification equipment; and trade fairs organization and management. In addition the company engages in the design construction operation maintenance and transfer of projects; auctions; operates and manages hotel and restaurant; and investing activities. National Real Estate Company - K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Cementos Bio Bio S.A.
Description: Cementos Bio Bio S.A. engages in the production and sale of cement lime and concrete products in Chile and internationally. The company operates through Cement and Lime segments. It offers ready-mixed concrete gypsum and limestone products. The company is also involved in the manufacture and sale of lime for use in the extraction of silver gold lithium and iodine applications as well as copper concentrators. Cementos Bio Bio S.A. was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Providencia Chile.

Name: Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A.
Description: Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A. engages in the retail sale of medicines perfumes personal hygiene and beauty products in Brazil. The company offers medicines and health care products in the areas of pediatrics oncology psychiatry urology orthopedics dermatology contraception pediatric endocrinology assisted reproduction geriatric gastrointestinal and hepatic pain fever and inflammation diabetes and endocrinology. It also provides personal care and beauty products including deodorant intimate care and oral hygiene as well as foot hair face and hand care products; dermo-cosmetics; and repellent diaper cloth and food products as well as other accessories for moms and babies. In addition the company offers clothing and accessories supplements first aid food and drink utilities and others; and cereals fibers vitamins and minerals first aid and herbal medicines and natural products. It sells its products through retail stores and online. Empreendimentos Pague Menos S.A. was incorporated in 1981 and is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil.

Name: CA Sales Holdings Limited
Description: CA Sales Holdings Limited operates fast-moving consumer good business. It provides warehousing in-store execution transport and logistics sale merchandising technology data services shopper marketing brand strategy development point-of-sale and retail training services as well as select debtor services. The company offers consumer products which includes food home care personal care consumer durables snack and confectionery paper products beverages pet care alcoholic beverages frozen foods and tobacco products and accessories. It operates in Botswana Eswatini Lesotho Mauritius Mozambique Namibia South Africa Zambia and Zimbabwe and internationally. CA Sales Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Centurion South Africa.

Name: Pan Jamaica Group Limited
Description: Pan Jamaica Group Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells food and drink products in Jamaica. It operates through Property and Infrastructure; Financial Services; Global Services; and Specialty Foods segments. The company engages in the processing distribution and retail of food and drink; agricultural services; property investment development rental and management; hotel operations and management; and capital infrastructure development. It also provides financial management; logistics transportation and port operations; business processing outsourcing and tourist attractions; captive insurance; cold storage; contract labour; and security services. Pan Jamaica Group Limited was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Qatari Investors Group Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatari Investors Group Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries operates as a diversified conglomerate company in Qatar. It operates through Real Estate Marine Services Industrial Contracting and Technology and Other segments. The company offers clinker ordinary Portland and oil well cements; and integrated security systems detection life safety and other digital systems.It also provides marine services such as container line air and sea freight customs and project cargo clearance heavy lift movement breakbulk and dry bulk cargo carriers freight forwarding project logistics warehousing and distribution; aviation services; and financial services such as remittance brokerage management and investment funds and shares and securities management and marketing services. In addition the company develops owns and manages commercial and residential real estate properties; and operates a car rental company. Further it trades in construction materials equipment and trucks; provides information technology and contracting services; undertakes building maintenance and industry equipment works; and offers mechanical and industrial engineering equipment. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Lusail Qatar.

Name: Oman Cables Industry SAOG
Description: Oman Cables Industry SAOG operates as a subsidiary of Draka Holding B.V.

Name: Palm Hills Developments S.A.E.
Description: Palm Hills Developments S.A.E. develops integrated residential and commercial real estate and resort projects primarily in Egypt. It constructs and operates villas apartments chalets beach houses cabins tessera town and twin houses and office malls. The company leases constructs and operates hotels motels resorts and residential compounds; generates electricity; desalinates water; provides sports field services; and operates and manages sport games. Further the company establishes private clubs academies health clubs and fitness centres; establishes manages and operates schools; operates five-star hotel; manages and operates centers for the preparation training and development of human resources; engages in the construction and building works and finishing works; offers decorations and general supplies; provides engineering consultancy services; engages in the construction and building activities related to residential commercial and hotel projects beach resorts recreational areas and projects; undertakes infrastructure works and facilities for projects; and offers tourism management and marketing services. Palm Hills Developments S.A.E. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal provides various banking products and services in Venezuela. It offers checking and savings accounts term deposit certificates and demand deposit accounts in foreign currency. The company also provides commercial credits auto financing invoice discounting and factoring discount financing alternatives and microcredits; bail bonds domestic letters of credit and letters of credit in foreign currency; and financing for agri-food manufacturing tourism health and mortgage sectors as well as for entrepreneurs. In addition it offers escrow services; cards; commerce/person collection services; ATMs; services for foreign and national currency; and points of sale and mobile and online banking services. The company was formerly known as Banco Tequendama C.A. and changed its name to Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal in December 2004. Banco Nacional de Crédito C.A. Banco Universal was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A.
Description: Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. engages in the industrialization and commercialization of food and alcoholic beverages in Argentina and internationally. It operates through Foods and Wineries segments. The company offers edible oils pasta dried frozen fractionated flour grass rice wines and sparkling wines. Molinos Rio de la Plata S.A. was incorporated in 1931 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: RCL Foods Limited
Description: RCL Foods Limited operates as a food manufacturer in South Africa. The company operates through the Groceries Baking and Sugar segments. It is involved in culinary products including mayonnaise peanut butter and rusks; milling specialty and bakery products; breads buns rolls and pies; as well as pet food products and beverages and sugar and molasses-based feed operations. The company sells its products primarily under the Ouma Nola Yum Yum Nutso Bobtail Catmor Dogmor Ultra Dog Canine Cuisine Optimizer Feline Cuisine Mageu Number 1 Monati Mnandi Supreme Tafelberg Safari A1 5 Star Sunbake Piemans Sunshine and Selati brands. In addition it engages in treasury international investments farming marketing and food innovation and research activities. The company was formerly known as Rainbow Chicken Limited and changed its name to RCL Foods Limited in August 2013. RCL Foods Limited was founded in 1960 and is based in Durban South Africa.

Name: Medicare Group Q.P.S.C.
Description: Medicare Group Q.P.S.C. provides healthcare and treatment services in Qatar. The company operates hospitals medical clinic centers and outpatient clinics. The company was formerly known as Al Ahli Specialized Hospital Company Q.S.C. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Caribbean Cement Company Limited
Description: Caribbean Cement Company Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement and clinker in Jamaica Caribbean countries and North America. The company is also involved in mining and sale of gypsum shale and pozzolan. It operates a spa facility. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Caribbean Cement Company Limited is a subsidiary of Trinidad Cement Limited.

Name: Résidences Dar Saada S.A
Description: Résidences Dar Saada S.A engages in the real estate development business in the Kingdom of Morocco. Its projects include apartments villas land shops and duplexes. Résidences Dar Saada S.A was founded in 2001 and is based in Casablanca the Kingdom of Morocco.

Name: Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited
Description: Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides financial solutions in Botswana. It operates through two segments Life Business and Asset Management. The company underwrites various classes of long-term insurances; administers deposit administration schemes and life and pension funds; and manages investments. It also provides life and short-term insurance; and microlending services. In addition the company is involved in the unit trust corporate social responsibility hospitality industry and corporate finance businesses. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Gaborone Botswana. Botswana Insurance Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Sanlam Allianz Africa (Pty) Ltd.

Name: Astral Foods Limited
Description: Astral Foods Limited operates as an integrated poultry producer in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through Poultry and Feed segments. It also engages in the marketing sale and distribution of fresh and frozen poultry products; and breeding and sale of day-old chicks and hatching eggs. The company also produces and sells feed products for farmed animal species; provides laboratory analytical services to the animal feed industry; and a range of value-added products comprising frozen reformed crumbed and ready-to-eat poultry products. It offers its products under the Goldi County Fair Festive Meadow Feeds National Chicks Ross CAL Tiger Chicks Tiger Animal Feeds Mountain Valley Earlybird and SupaStar brands. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Gauteng South Africa.

Name: Wisynco Group Limited
Description: Wisynco Group Limited engages in the bottling and distribution of water and beverages in Jamaica and internationally. The company offers bottled drinking water under the WATA brand; cranberry juice under the CranWATA brand; soft drinks under the BIGGA brand; and energy drinks under the BOOM brand. It also distributes and retails food products; and provides insurance services. In addition it imports grocery products under the General Mills Nestle and Kellogg’s brands; and distributes beverages juices and soft drinks under the Coca-Cola Tru-Juice Freshhh Juice Drinks Squeezz Drinks Wakefield Juices Calico Jack Rum Punch Fanta Sprite Schweppes Minute Maid and AdeS brands. Further it distributes green tea under the Ayataka brand; coffee and tea under the Costa Georgia Gold Peak and Honest Tea brands; water under the Dasani and smartwater brands; juices and nectars under the Del Valle and Simply brands; sports drinks under the Powerade brand; smoothies and juices; vitaminwater; and coconut water under the ZICO brand. Wisynco Group Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Spanish Town Jamaica. The company operates as a subsidiary of Wisynco Group (Caribbean) Limited.

Name: Guardian Holdings Limited
Description: Guardian Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries underwrites insurance products in Trinidad and Tobago Jamaica Barbados Dutch Caribbean Martinique Grenada curacao the Netherlands Aruba Cayman Islands Bermuda Bahamas and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Life health and pension; Property and casualty; Insurance brokerage; and Asset management. It offers short-term and long-term life and health insurance for both individuals and groups. In addition it provides critical illness property motor employers’ liability public marine accident engineering bonding fire commercial and crime insurance as well as short-term and long-term reinsurances. Further it offers traditional life and interest-sensitive without guarantee annuities-based and unit-linked life and interest-sensitive with guarantees insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in St Georges Grenada. Guardian Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of NCB Global Holdings Limited.

Name: Absa Bank Botswana Limited
Description: Absa Bank Botswana Limited provides various financial services in Botswana. It operates through three segments Corporate and Investment Banking; Retail Business Banking and Other; and Islamic Banking. The company offers current savings and call accounts; and term fixed interest and non-interest bearing and cheque account deposits. It also provides personal home life term foreign currency scheme and business loans; vehicle mortgage and production loans; commercial asset finance and overdraft services; trade finance products including letters of credit document collections performance bonds and bank guarantees and bills of exchange; and credit cards. In addition the company offers personal insurance products such as home owners household contents funeral motor and retrenchment insurance products; business insurance products covering buildings contents stock in trade motor vehicles electronic equipment workers compensation and other insurance products; treasury services comprising foreign exchange currency repo risk management and investment services; investment banking financing risk management and advisory solutions; customer loyalty programs and services; and cash management and merchant services. Further it provides Internet and ATM banking mobile app and e-statement services. The company offers its services to corporates financial institutions and government clients; and medium small businesses and retail customers. It operates through multiple branches ATMs and point-of-sale devices. The company was formerly known as Barclays Bank of Botswana Limited and changed its name to Absa Bank Botswana Limited in February 2020. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana. Absa Bank Botswana Limited is a subsidiary of Absa Group Limited.

Name: Export Development Bank of Egypt (S.A.E.)
Description: Export Development Bank of Egypt (S.A.E.) provides various banking products and services in Egypt. The company offers current savings export and time deposit accounts as well as certificates of deposit. It also provides loans for auto used car petroleum sector pharmacists university professors and scientific research centers doctors bankers loan-to-card buy out and financial institution employees; corporate and syndicated loans; and mortgage finance trade finance and export promotion services as well as financing for small and medium enterprises. In addition the company offers treasury services such as foreign exchange daily market report and money market services; and funded and unfunded risk participation bilateral loans and funding arrangements payments facilitation tailored/structured solutions and other products. Further it provides payroll financial inclusion transaction banking bancassurance online banking e-wallet and ATM services as well as debit prepaid and credit cards. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: Diagnósticos da América S.A.
Description: Diagnósticos da América S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides diagnostic and hospital services in Brazil and Argentina. It operates through Hospitals and Oncology; Diagnostics and Care Coordination; and International Diagnostics segments. The company offers outpatient doctors; medical and outpatient services; diagnostic support assistants for private patients or partner companies; care coordination remote monitoring population health management home medical and paramedical services; and medical consultations. It is also involved in the development and licensing of computer programs and predictive models using information technology and data science; and brokerage activities. The company was formerly known as Laboratório Clínico Delboni Auriemo S.A. and changed its name to Diagnósticos da América S.A. in August 2000. Diagnósticos da América S.A. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil.

Name: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P.
Description: National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. engages in the provision of various upstream oilfield services in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Oil field and Non-oil field services segments. The company offers upstream oil services that include cementing down hole tool completion directional drilling well logging services hydraulic fracturing coiled tubing and well stimulation services; environmental and sustainability services such as environmental and safety services; quality health safety and environmental services. It also provides drilling and maintenance of oil wells and chemical waste management; petrochemical activities; and support activities for petroleum & natural gas mining incidental to onshore and offshore oil & gas extraction. In addition the company offers support services for well drilling repairing and preparation for production well maintenance-related services; importing and owning machines tools and materials; owning lands and real estate necessary for establishing facilities and equipment; and importing and exporting chemicals. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Al Ahmadi Kuwait. National Petroleum Services Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Kuwait Projects Company Holding K.S.C.P.

Name: Sociedad Anónima Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia
Description: Sociedad Anónima Importadora y Exportadora de la Patagonia operates a chain of supermarket in Argentina. Its supermarkets offer food personal care and children other products. The company was founded in 1908 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc
Description: Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc produces and sells refined sugar to consumers and industrial markets in Nigeria. The company offers vitamin A fortified sugar for direct consumption baked foods sweetening of cereals and beverages applications; and non-fortified industrial sugar used by pharmaceuticals food and beverage other manufacturing companies. It sells its products under the Dangote Sugar brands. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Dangote Sugar Refinery Plc is a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.

Name: Banco Hipotecario S.A.
Description: Banco Hipotecario S.A. provides wholesale and retail banking services in Argentina. The company offers savings current and investor accounts; mortgage loans; personal loans comprising destination short term and salary plan loans; home life personal accident ATM theft movable goods pets sustainable mobility senior health protected purchase and comprehensive health insurance products. It also provides investment products such as fixed term deposits mutual funds titles and shares mortgage certificates safe deposit box and market data solutions as well as corporate financial advisory and office banking services. In addition the company offers treasury management financing accounts and payment and collection solutions to corporates institutions and small and medium enterprises. Banco Hipotecario S.A. was founded in 1886 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Wema Bank PLC
Description: Wema Bank PLC provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. The company offers current and saving accounts HNIs and term deposits; card services such as debit credit secure and prepaid cards; consumer and personal loans and revolving overdrafts; and collection services. It provides corporate banking services including overdraft term loan import and trade finance and financial lease facilities; and agricultural finance as well as export power oil and gas maritime and concessionary finance services. In addition the company offers small and medium scale enterprise financial advisory services; retail management and integrated revenue services; and cards and electronic and internet banking services. The company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG
Description: Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG develops owns and operates an electricity generation and seawater desalination plant in the Salalah region. The company operates Salalah independent water and power plant that comprises 5 gas turbines and 2 steam turbines with a contracted power capacity of 445 megawatts as well as contracted water production capacity of 15 million imperial gallons per day. It also supplies power and water to the Oman Power and Water Procurement Company. Sembcorp Salalah Power & Water Company SAOG was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Salalah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Moura Dubeux Engenharia S.A.
Description: Moura Dubeux Engenharia S.A. provides real estate development services in Brazil. The company develops flats hotels resorts and residential buildings as well as offers technical construction management and advisory services to the condominiums. It also engages in the purchase and sale of properties; rental and split of land allotment; real estate construction of properties; and management and administration of own- or third-party real properties as well as offers engineering services. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Recife Brazil.

Name: PPC Ltd
Description: PPC Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of cement aggregates ready mix concrete and fly ash in South Africa Botswana and Zimbabwe. It also provides premixes stone sand road layer materials and special aggregate-related products. The company was formerly known as Pretoria Portland Cement Company Limited and changed its name to PPC Ltd in October 2012. PPC Ltd was incorporated in 1892 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Suez Canal Company for Technology Settling (S.A.E)
Description: Suez Canal Company for Technology Settling (S.A.E) engages in the establishment and management of technological zones scientific incubators and training centers for the preparation of researchers and the transfer of technology and the provision of related services. It is also involved in designing software; entering data into computers; creating data and electronic information systems; and producing electronic content in various forms of audio image and data. In addition the company designs produces and operates computer programs systems and applications as well as provides training; and rents housing units. Further it engages in establishing integrated hospitals and the internal therapeutic or service activities; and establishing and managing universities institutes schools and educational institutions. Additionally the company invests in real estate properties. Suez Canal Company for Technology Settling (S.A.E) was founded in 1989 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal provides personal business and private banking products and services in Venezuela. It offers currency digital key global and paid global accounts; financing services; credit and debit cards; payment and collection services; foreign exchange services; and mobile banking services. The company was incorporated in 1890 and is based in Caracas Venezuela. Banco de Venezuela S.A. Banco Universal operates as a subsidiary of Banco de Desarrollo Económico y Social de Venezuela.

Name: Inverfal Perú S.A.A.
Description: Inverfal Perú S.A.A. engages in investing in fixed or variable income securities. The company operates through Retail Financial and Real Estate and Other Services segments. It is involved in the marketing of hardware construction home and interior decoration accessories as well as engaged in hypermarket and supermarket activities; and real estate activities. In addition the company acts as an insurance broker; and provision of computer; and call attention services. Inverfal Perú S.A.A. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in San Isidro Peru. The company operates as a subsidiary of Falabella S.A.

Name: A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P. engages in financial investments trading and investing in properties and leasing activities primarily in the State of Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Islamic Financing Leasing Sector Real Estate and Proprietary Investment and Assets Management. The company offers lease financing services; acts as financial intermediary and broker; grants credit facilities to consumers; and participates in the establishment of companies and deals in the shares of the companies on its behalf and on behalf of third parties. It also involved in the marketing of products and services; portfolio management on behalf of the customers; investment in real estate properties in industrial agricultural and other sectors; and development and rental of residential land and commercial properties. In addition the company conducts research and studies and related activities on behalf of customers; and establishes investment funds and manages funds. Further the company engages in the leasing and investment securities related activities as well as leases vehicle and equipment and provides logistic services. A'ayan Leasing and Investment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme
Description: Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme engages in the mining of silver deposits in Morocco. It holds interest in the Imiter mine covering an area of 375 ha located to the east of Ouarzazate in Morocco. The company was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter société anonyme operates as a subsidiary of Managem S.A.

Name: Companhia Energética do Ceará - COELCE
Description: Companhia Energética do Ceará – COELCE distributes electricity in Brazil. It operates in 184 municipalities in the state of Ceará in Brazil. Companhia Energética do Ceará is headquartered in Fortaleza Brazil. Companhia Energética do Ceará - COELCE is a subsidiary of Enel Brazil S.A.

Name: Seprod Limited
Description: Seprod Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes food products in Jamaica. The company offers sports drinks condensed milk sardines tuna salmon and other seafood carbonated soft drink biscuits and snacks spreads carbonated beverage for kids real fruit flavour drinks pure juice with no additives or added sugar flour sauces jams seasoning oil various beans cheese mayonnaise creamer and dressings. It also offers canned foods milk punches nuts breakfast cereals cornmeal instant porridge mix crackers nutritional supplements liquid meal supplement powdered beverages energy drinks. The company offers its products under Altitude Betty Brunswick Busta Butterkist Chiffon Chubby Cool Fruit Delite Eve Gold Seal Goya Kraft Miracle Planters Post Pronto Ritz Serge Seven Seas Supligen Supligen Max Swizzzle Tang Turbo and Uncle Sam's brand names. In addition it engages in agriculture; manufacture and sale of oils and fats consumer pharmaceutical biscuit milk products juices corn and wheat; investments; investments in real estate; property development; dairy farming; and logistics activities. Further it exports its products to various countries. Seprod Limited was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Curro Holdings Limited
Description: Curro Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries acquires develops and manages independent schools primarily in South Africa Namibia and Botswana. The company operates in Curro and Meridian segments. It offers independent education and ancillary services including Select schools Curro Academy Schools Curro Preschools Curro Assisted Learning Curro DigiEd Curro Private College and Curro Online for learners from the age of three months to Grade 12. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP
Description: Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP together with its subsidiaries engages in the acquisition establishment leasing operating and maintenance of petrol stations in Kuwait. It operates through two segments Fuel Marketing and Other Related Services; and Investments. The company also offers automobile services including oil change car wash maintenance workshop services and technical check-ups; prepaid fuel cards and related electronic services; various account cards for individual and corporate customers; and oulaE Tag a smart system for fuel payment and other services in the oula station. In addition it provides logistics marketing and consultancy services. Further the company is involved in the purchase renting owning and selling of lease lands and real estate; trade in petroleum products in bulk or retail; operation of central markets; and investment in financial and real estate portfolios. Oula Fuel Marketing Company - KSCP was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Telefónica Chile S.A.
Description: Telefónica Chile S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a telecommunication company in Chile. The company operates through Fixed Telephony Communications and Company Data Television Services and Others segments. It offers basic telephone services line connections and installations services dedicated lines international long-distance services marketing terminal equipment rental of circuit media of terminal equipment rental of means of circuits and others. The company also engages in the provision of business communication services; data transmission services; the sale and rental of communication equipment; telecommunications; and the sale and lease of networks. In addition it provides multimedia services such as the development installation maintenance marketing and operation of satellite television services; broadband; channel paid services; video on demand; and interactive or multimedia television services. Further the company offers logistics personnel and administration services. Additionally it provides broadcast live and play services as well as other related services in the fields of connectivity cloud security big data IoT and digital workplace. The company was formerly known as Compañía de Telecomunicaciones de Chile S.A. and changed its name to Telefónica Chile S.A. in April 2009. Telefónica Chile S.A. was founded in 1880 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile. Telefónica Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Telefonica Moviles Chile S.A.

Name: Tegma Gestão Logística S.A.
Description: Tegma Gestão Logística S.A. provides logistics management transportation and storage services in Brazil. The company operates in two divisions Automotive Logistics and Integrated Logistics. The Automotive Logistics division engages in the transfer and distribution of new and used vehicles port transfers inventory and yard management vehicle assembly and vehicle preparation services. The Integrated Logistics division provides road transport general and bonded storage logistics management returnable packaging management inventory management operations parts and components management stock management vehicle preparation services tropicalization accessorization and reverse logistics. It serves chemicals home appliances consumer goods automotive and petrochemicals sectors. Tegma Gestão Logística S.A. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Egyptian Chemical Industries
Description: Egyptian Chemical Industries produces and sells nitrogenous fertilizers and chemical materials in Egypt. Its products include high density ammonium nitrate urea fertilizers liquid ammonia pporous prilled ammonium nitrate ferro silicon ammonium nitrate novo kima fort and liquid ammonium nitrate fertilizers. The company also provides nitrogen gas liquid and aqua ammonia nitric acid and hydrochloric acid for industrial purposes as well as oxygen gas for medical and industrial purposes; and silica fume that is used in concrete. The company was founded in 1956 and is based in Aswan Egypt. Egyptian Chemical Industries is a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company S.A.E.

Name: Banco BMG S.A.
Description: Banco BMG S.A. provides commercial and credit financing and investment products and services primarily in Brazil. It operates in Retail Banking and Wholesale Banking segments. The company offers digital accounts; digital account credit card and consigned credit card; payroll and personal loan; insurance products including lender life family life and FGTS Protected insurance as well as Bmg Med and Bmg Consortium services. It also provides investment products such as bank deposit certificates agribusiness letter of credit and letters of real estate credit. In addition the company offers commercial banking; debentures; trade finance; and working capital; and derivatives such as non-deliverable forward SWAP options. The company was formerly known as BMG Financeira S.A.–Crédito Financiamento e Investimento and changed its name to Banco BMG S.A. in April 1989. Banco BMG S.A. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Holcim (Argentina) S.A.
Description: Holcim (Argentina) S.A. operates in the construction material industry in Argentina. It engages in the production of cement concrete stone aggregates liquid paints and membranes. The company also offers adhesives plasters additives repairers limes and hydraulic binders. It sells its products under the Dissents Geocycle Tector and Quimexur brand names. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Córdoba Argentina. Holcim (Argentina) S.A. is a subsidiary of Holcim Investments (Spain) SL.

Name: Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company
Description: Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company manufactures distributes markets and sells cigarettes in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company offers its products under Embassy Crescent & Star Portsman Sweet Menthol Safari Club Camel and Winston Aspen Monte Carlo and LD brand names. It also exports its products to the Democratic Republic of Congo Southern Africa and Namibia and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Dar es Salaam the United Republic of Tanzania. Tanzania Cigarette Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of JT International Holding B.V.

Name: Bank of Palestine Plc
Description: Bank of Palestine Plc provides banking and financial services in the Palestinian Authority. It operates through three segments: Retails; Corporate Institutions and Public Sector; and Treasury segments. The company offers current primary and saving account such as Baraem savings account; Labors program services; loan products including commercial mortgage loan programs personal personal housing student fishermen green and mortgage loans; overdrafts and microenterprise financing as well as loans for financing people with disabilities. It also provides card products and online banking services. In addition the company offers current accounts for corporate institutional customers and public sector; and trading and treasury services managing bank’s funds and investments. Bank of Palestine Plc was founded in 1960 and is based in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Integrated Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Integrated Holding Company K.S.C.P. operates a logistics company in Kuwait and internationally. The company offers equipment leasing and hiring services; heavy lifting services including specialized lifting and engineering and rigging services; heavy transport haulage services such as various trucks trailers and equipment; and alternative lift services comprising gantry system and jacking and skidding services. It also provides earth moving services including demolition and construction activities; industrial equipment services comprising air compressors welding machines tower lights man lifts and tele handlers; and rig move services such as drilling rig and super rig move work over casing and heavy haulage. In addition the company offers energy services for temporary project location including generators transformers fuel tanks load banks synchronizers and totals panels; shutdown management services; and tower cranes for residential and commercial civil construction high-rise building infrastructure bridges and flyovers and other construction projects. Further it provides port operations services such as handling of aggregates pet coke clinker gypsum rocks coal steel scrap direct reduced iron hot briquetted iron general cargo and jumbo bags; other services that include hopper system weigh bridge operation and port information management services; and general trading and contracting services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: RAGHSA Sociedad Anonima
Description: RAGHSA Sociedad Anonima engages in the real estate development business. It is involved in the construction leasing and sale of properties for offices and/or homes; and financing of properties. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Nitratos de Chile S.A.
Description: Nitratos de Chile S.A. through its subsidiary Potasios de Chile S.A. invests in shares of Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Santiago Chile. Nitratos de Chile S.A. is a subsidiary of Norte Grande S.A.

Name: Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P.
Description: Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P. together with its subsidiaries provides installment credit facilities to finance consumer products in Kuwait. The company offers cash auto housing educational marine furniture electrical commercial education and personal loans; guarantees; and short- medium- and long-term loans for the purchase of equipment home appliances land and properties. It also invests in real estate industrial agricultural and other economic sectors; and manages loans syndicated loans and investment portfolios. In addition the company is involved in the purchase and sale of financial securities such as shares and bonds; real estate activities; provision of collection services; and buying and selling of cars. Commercial Facilities Company S.A.K.P. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C)
Description: Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C) through its subsidiaries provides human resources and project lifecycle support services. It operates through Real Estate and Services segments. The company offers human capital and life support services such as HR and life support solutions; facilities management; engineering services; and KRH Academy a platform for training and professional growth. It also provides real estate services comprising real estate consulting property management solutions and development and project execution services as well as conducts feasibility studies and market research and analysis. In addition the company provides property leasing general trading housing entertainment human resources management logistic and support travel and tourism and contracting services. Beyout Holding Company (K.P.S.C) was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Hightech Payment Systems S.A.
Description: Hightech Payment Systems S.A. provides electronic payments and solutions in Morocco Europe the United States Africa Asia and the Middle East. The company is involved in the field of electronic banking software publishing consulting training auditing and electronic payment processing for third parties. It offers PowerCARD platform that covers the payment value chain and offers a range of solutions such as card issuing credit management merchant acquiring fraud monitoring retail payment payment analytics mobile payment and ATM and POS management. It also provides processing services for payment and switching activities; and testing services. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: GraceKennedy Limited
Description: GraceKennedy Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in food trading and financial services businesses in Jamaica the United Kingdom the United States Canada rest of Caribbean countries other European countries Africa and internationally. It operates through four segments: Food Banking and Investments Insurance and Money Services. The Food segment engages in the merchandising of general goods and food products; processing and distribution of food products; and operation of a chain of supermarkets. The Banking and Investments segment provides commercial banking stock brokerage corporate finance advisory and lease financing services. The Insurance segment offers general health group and creditors life insurance products as well as insurance brokerage services. The Money Services segment provides money transfer and bill payment services as well as is involved in the cambio operations. The company engages in the data analytics media rights holding property rental and investment management activities. GraceKennedy Limited was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited
Description: Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited operates as a construction company in South Africa rest of Africa and the United Kingdom. It undertakes construction of buildings including retail commercial offices residential healthcare hotels and entertainment warehousing and industrial and data centres; civil engineering and infrastructure for mining industrial and water and energy infrastructure; and roads and earthworks such as road and bridges bulk earthworks dams oil and gas and rail and pipeline infrastructure projects. The company also undertakes construction of airports toll roads renewable energy and serviced accommodation; and manufactures supplies and installs long-steel products. Wilson Bayly Holmes-Ovcon Limited was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of chlor alkali products in Kuwait other in the Middle East and North Africa Asia South America North America and internationally. It operates through Chlor Alkali Petrochemical Products Trading Logistics and Transport Industrial Projects and Investments segments. The company offers caustic soda chlorine ferric chloride sodium hypochlorite purified food grade salt hydrochloric acid and hydrogen. It also provides logistic and transportation services; construction of chlorine dioxide plant for groundwater reservoirs; distribution of industrial materials; production and sale of petrochemical products; and investment activities. In addition the company is involved in the import storage and distribution of cement and other bulk materials; establishing operating and managing storage silos; and production of steel drums and other petrochemical products. It serves potable and waste water treatment plant power plant oil refinery petrochemical oil drilling industrial food and pharmaceutical industries. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al Kout Industrial Projects Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries provides various investment and financial products and services in Kuwait Other GCC countries Other Middle East and North Africa Europe the United States and Asia. It operates through four segments: Asset Management Direct Investments and Corporate Finance Treasury and Other Operations. The company offers portfolio management services which include customized portfolio management; access to IPOs; and local regional and international fund management services. It also provides local/regional asset management services for asset classes including equity and fixed income institutions and individuals; fund management services that comprise a range of investment products for individuals and corporations; direct investment services that manage and monitor a diversified portfolio of mid to long-term direct investments; and online trading services through its platform KIC Trade. In addition the company offers treasury services that consist of foreign exchange trading and money market activities as well as manages strategic investments lending real estate and rental activities. Further the company engages in maritime medical and brokerage activities. Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Kuwait Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Kuwait Investment Authority.

Name: Jordan Electric Power Company
Description: Jordan Electric Power Company generates transmits and distributes of electric power in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1938 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.
Description: Holding Bursátil Regional S.A. a holding company operates capital markets infrastructures in Chile Colombia and Peru. The company offers clearing and settlement services for stock market transactions registration transfer administration and custody of securities; information services related to market information databases licensing and reports; negotiation products and services; services for issuers listed on the stock exchange; value-added services comprising office technological solutions; and other products such as fines office rental training and advertising area and website. Holding Bursátil Regional S.A. was formerly known as Holding Bursatil Chilena S.A. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Egyptian Financial and Industrial SAE
Description: Egyptian Financial and Industrial SAE engages in the manufacture and trading of chemical materials fertilizers and various agricultural fertilizers in Egypt. It operates through Acids Fertilizers Ammonium Sulfate and DCP segments. The company offers granulated single superphosphate and powder single superphosphate fertilizers; and concentrated and diluted sulfuric acid. It also manufactures and distributes acids ammonium sulfate and DCP products. The company also exports its products. Egyptian Financial and Industrial SAE was founded in 1929 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company
Description: Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company manufactures and sells cement in Tanzania and internationally. The company offers cement products under the Twiga Ordinary Twiga Plus Twiga Extra Twiga Jenga Twiga Super and Twiga Mega names. It serves constructions and government infrastructure projects; producers of ready-mixed concrete; and the general public through distributorship network. The company exports its products to various countries in the Central and East African Sub-Region. The company was founded in 1959 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania. Tanzania Portland Cement Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of Scancem International DA.

Name: Gulf Warehousing Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Gulf Warehousing Company Q.P.S.C. provides logistics and freight forwarding services in Qatar the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Logistics Operations Freight Forwarding Investment Properties and Others. It offers storage handling packaging and transportation; freight services through land air and sea; warehousing management; inventory management; retail distribution; promotional packing labelling and tagging; consulting projects event forwarding fine art relocations and equestrian solutions; and records management services including digitization of documents time-bound document retrieval document classification indexing and cataloguing comprehensive fixed asset tagging and inventorying electronic document management system implementation and storage management and secured destruction of physical records. The company also provides HAZMAT and pharmaceutical logistics solutions; and shipping agency services including yard operations liner representation port agency services cruise ship hosting and husbandry service. In addition it is involved in the trading of food chemicals plastic pipes and its accessories; container transportation; maintenance and repair services; rental income investment properties business; investment in shares bonds and funds; information technology services; record management and IT freight services; and preparation development and management of warehouses as well as courier services. It serves oil and gas government logistics retail FMGC healthcare shipping banking NGO sports and event management fine art aviation and small and medium enterprises. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Light S.A.
Description: Light S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the generation transmission distribution and sale of electric power in Brazil. The company distributes electricity in the state of Rio de Janeiro. It also engages in the research planning building operation and exploration of generation and transmission systems; purchase sale import and export of electric and thermal power and gas and industrial utilities; provision of consulting services in the energy sector; lease of real estate and personal properties; acquisition and sale of goods related to the studies and projects; implementation operation and maintenance of construction works and facilities; and hydropower generation activities. In addition the company provides services to low voltage clients including the assembly renovation and maintenance of facilities. Further it offers technology solutions and systems for the operating management of public service concessionaires including electricity gas water sewage and other utility companies; and builds installs operates and explores electric power plants. The company primarily serves residential commercial and industrial customers. Light S.A. was founded in 1899 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Blau Farmacêutica S.A.
Description: Blau Farmacêutica S.A. a pharmaceutical company provides drug products in Brazil Argentina Chile Colombia Uruguay Ecuador Peru and the United States. Its products cover various areas such as immunology hematology oncology nephrology infectology and anesthesiology. The company offers uterine stimulator antirheumatic anaesthetics antibiotics feminine health care biopharmaceuticals oncologicals hospital products antivirals and antiretrovirals biológicos acid pump inhibitor hemoderivatives antithrombotic and thrombolytics products. Blau Farmacêutica S.A. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Cotia Brazil.

Name: Raubex Group Limited
Description: Raubex Group Limited engages in the infrastructure development and construction materials business in South Africa Australia rest of Africa and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Materials Handling and Mining Construction Materials Roads and Earthworks and Infrastructure. The Materials Handling and Mining segment is involved in the contract mining; contract crushing; materials handling and processing services for the mining industry; and resource ownership activities. The Construction Materials segment produces and supplies materials to the construction market such as aggregates from commercial quarries asphalt and value-added bituminous products. The Roads and Earthworks segment is involved in the road construction and earthworks and road surfacing and rehabilitation activities including laying of asphalt chip and spray surface dressing enrichments and slurry seals. The Infrastructure segment undertakes infrastructure projects which includes renewable energy telecommunications facilities management housing infrastructure and commercial building refurbishment and construction projects. Raubex Group Limited was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Bloemfontein South Africa.

Name: Compañía Electro Metalúrgica S.A.
Description: Compañía Electro Metalúrgica S.A. operates as producers and vendors of integrated solutions for the mining market in Chile and internationally. The company provides crusher safety tooling mainframe liners primary mantles concaves rim liners cheek plates chock blocks bottom shell liners rim liners cheek plates chock blocks jaws spider caps and arm guards bowl liners and mantles products; ME polyFIT tower mill liners SAG/AG discharge system ball mill FE/DE head and shell liners and SAG/AG Discharge End feed end and shell Liners; and ME Grinding Rods ultra grind performa and super SAG products. It also offers simulations wear tracking application support scrap buyback program ME tracking and training ME grinding app and ME crushing training services; and field support and assistance development projects process and asset monitoring services. In addition the company involved in manufacturing and selling of glass containers for wine beer soft drink juice mineral water liquor and food market industries; produces and sells wines; generates electricity; and written and publishing business. Compañía Electro Metalúrgica S.A. was founded in 1917 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Oman Cement Company SAOG
Description: Oman Cement Company SAOG manufactures and sells cement and related products in the Sultanate of Oman and other GCC countries. It offers ordinary Portland sulphate resistant Portland limestone oil well and composite well cement as well as plaster cement. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman. Oman Cement Company SAOG operates as a subsidiary of Abra Holdings Limited.

Name: Kuwait Reinsurance Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Reinsurance Company K.S.C.P. provides reinsurance services in Kuwait the Middle East North Africa and internationally. It operates through two segments Non-Life Reinsurance and Life Reinsurance. The company offers treaty property engineering casualty downstream and upstream energy renewable energy marine life reassurance and Retakaful reinsurance products and services. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Kuwait Reinsurance Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of Al Ahleia Insurance Company S.A.K.P.

Name: Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A.
Description: Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A. provides health services in Chile. It offers patient information and indication exams and online services; specialties services; and outpatient services including urgency laboratory imaging vaccination blood bank outpatient procedures and reproductive medicine unit. The company also provides hospitalization services such as maternity adult and pediatric hospitalization adult critical patient unit pavilion and surgical procedures neonatology and robotic surgery; and telemedicine services comprising online consultation and rehabilitation. In addition it operates health centers which includes metabolic surgery and nutrition thyroid and parathyroid physical medicine and rehabilitation endometriosis hemodynamics service and dialysis centers. Further the company offers research and training services as well as newborn school and accident agreements. Instituto de Diagnóstico S.A. was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Providencia Chile.

Name: Oando PLC
Description: Oando PLC through its subsidiaries provides integrated energy solutions in Nigeria and internationally. The company operates through Exploration and Production and Supply and Trading segments. It explores and produces oil and gas; and trades in crude refined and unrefined petroleum products. Oando PLC was formerly known as Unipetrol Nigeria Plc and changed its name to Oando PLC in December 2003. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Oando PLC is a subsidiary of Ocean and Oil Development Partners Limited.

Name: Tsogo Sun Limited
Description: Tsogo Sun Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the gaming entertainment and hospitality business in South Africa. The company operates through Casinos Limited Payout Machines (LPMs) and Other Gaming and Betting segments. It offers casinos and gaming comprising VSlots division with limited payout machines and the Galaxy Bingo division with electronic bingo terminals. The company’s gaming and entertainment options include movies bird gardens theme parks restaurants bars shows and events and others. It also operates hotels; and online betting division through playTSOGO and bet.co.za. The company was formerly known as Tsogo Sun Gaming Limited and changed its name to Tsogo Sun Limited in June 2023. Tsogo Sun Limited is headquartered in Four Ways South Africa. Tsogo Sun Limited is a subsidiary of Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited.

Name: Cairo Amman Bank
Description: Cairo Amman Bank provides various banking and financial services for corporate and institutional customers in Jordan and internationally. The company offers current deposit savings and notice accounts; and debit credit and prepaid cards. It also provides a range of loan products including retail corporate and renewable energy loans as well as venture and micro and small and medium enterprise financing. In addition the company offers investments services such as foreign exchange derivatives hedging and custody; money transfer safety deposit box mobile ATM online bill payment interest rates and commissions and fees services; brokerage and investment management finance leasing and Islamic banking services; and SMS mobile and online banking services. It operates through a network of multiple branches in Jordan Palestine and Bahrain. Cairo Amman Bank was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Grupo Casas Bahia S.A.
Description: Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. together with its subsidiaries retails electronics home appliances and furniture in Brazil. It also offers financial services and solutions such as buy now pay later and credit card services; and logistics solutions and services comprising fulfillment and full commerce services as well as manufactures and sells wooden furniture. The company provides extended warranty and equipment installation services. In addition it serves consumers through brick and-mortar stores and e-commerce platforms under the Casas Bahia Pontofrio Extra.com Bartira banQi Rede Celer ASAPLog and CNT brands; and distribution centers. The company was formerly known as Via S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. in September 2023. Grupo Casas Bahia S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A.
Description: LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A. develops constructs and rents residential and commercial properties in Brazil. It offers logistics warehouses shopping centers and strip malls as well as industrial warehouses; and engineering and construction services for real estate properties. The company was formerly known as MRV Logística E Participações S.A. LOG Commercial Properties e Participações S.A. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Belo Horizonte Brazil.

Name: Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG
Description: Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG develops operates and maintains mobile and fixed telecommunications services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates global system for mobile communication for prepaid and post-paid services; and sells telecommunication equipment and other associated services. It also provides international and national fixed line voice and data services from fixed line. In addition it offers data collection services; wired telecommunications services; and manages and operates data preparation of other agencies as well as maintains networks and rents communication equipment. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman. Omani Qatari Telecommunications Company SAOG operates as a subsidiary of Seyoula International Investment W.L.L.

Name: Altron Limited
Description: Altron Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in information communication and technology business in South Africa rest of Africa Europe and internationally. The company operates in three segments: Platforms IT Services and Distribution. Its platforms include Altron Netstar offers vehicle tracking and recovery systems fleet management services and usage-based telematics; Altron FinTech offers debit order processing payment and switching card personalization and issuance credit management software and debit and credit card payment solutions as well as person-to-person payments and value-added services to the consumer market; and Altron HealthTech offers practice management solutions in the healthcare industry and medical transaction switching. The company also provides networking hardware DevOps and modernization data management IT infrastructure solutions security IT as a service cloud artificial intelligence data storage data center infrastructure and other solutions. In addition it design develop and implement managed identity profile and cryptographic solutions for their clients across devices platforms and locations; distributes industrial electronic components such as batteries and solar lighting and optics software and compilers and semiconductors and aerospace products; and provides hardware and consumables to manage outsource print services such as installation and training paper and toner supplies maintenance and services of equipment and service contracts as well as provides technology services software and supplies for production and office environments. The company was formerly known as Allied Electronics Corporation Limited and changed its name to Altron Limited in August 2021. Altron Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Multiexport Foods S.A.
Description: Multiexport Foods S.A. provides seafood products in Chile and internationally. It offers Atlantic salmons coho salmon and trout as well as fresh frozen and smoked products. The company was formerly known as Aquafarms SA and changed its name to Multiexport Foods S.A. in May 2007. Multiexport Foods S.A. was founded in 1983 and is based in Puerto Montt Chile. Multiexport Foods S.A. is a subsidiary of Multiexport Dos S.A.

Name: Locaweb Serviços de Internet S.A.
Description: Locaweb Serviços de Internet S.A. offers hosting software licensing and technical support services in Brazil. It operates through two segments Be Online and Software as a Service & Solutions (Be Online & SaaS) and Commerce. The Be Online and Software as a Service & Solutions (Be Online & SaaS) segment provides hosting and cloud services; and SaaS solutions including email and marketing intelligence software and site builder under the Locaweb Allin Nextios Kinghost Delivery Diretso Etus Social Mine and Connectplug brands. Its Commerce segment offers e-commerce solutions platform marketplace integration and sub-acquiring business services under the Tray Tray Corp Yapay Melhor Envio Ideris Samurai Credisfera Vindi Bagy Sul Bling PagCerto Bagy Octadesk Squid and Sintese names. The company provides data center telecommunications software licensing and intermediation and collection services. Locaweb Serviços de Internet S.A. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Mobile Telecommunications Limited
Description: Mobile Telecommunications Limited operates as a mobile telecommunications company in Namibia. It provides voice and data services and solutions to postpaid and prepaid individual and business customers through its telecommunications transmission and distribution network which is serviced by mobile homes dealerships comprising airtime sellers and distributors 24-hour customer contact center digital channels and a network management and technical quality center. The company also offers mobile; fixed connectivity; Internet of Things; digitally enabled value-added services; fiber to the office and home; secure cloud and private branch exchange hosted solutions; digital payment gateway services; and credit life insurance services The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Windhoek Namibia. Mobile Telecommunications Limited is a subsidiary of Namibia Post and Telecommunications Holdings Limited.

Name: Zambia National Commercial Bank Plc
Description: Zambia National Commercial Bank Plc provides banking and financial services in Zambia. It operates through five segments: Retail Banking Digital Banking Corporate Banking Business Banking and Treasury Management. The Retail Banking segment offers private banking services deposit and investment savings products safe custody debit cards consumer loans and mortgages. The Digital Banking segment provides internet banking mobile banking merchant services and Zanaco Xpress. It offers various transactional services. The Corporate Banking segment offers corporate and investment banking solutions which incorporate direct debit facilities deposits products overdrafts loans and other credit facilities and foreign currency solutions. The Business Banking segment provides specialist advice to high growth start-ups and small and medium enterprises. The Treasury Management segment offers treasury transactions such as investments in government securities placements open market operations and other transactions related to dealing in foreign currencies. The company also offers personal auto term and working capital loans; trade project syndicate and supply chain financing services; and bancassurance. In addition it provides credit cards as well as cash management services. The company serves personal corporate government and agriculture sectors. It operates multiple branches agencies automated teller machines POS machines and Zanaco Xpress agents. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Lusaka Zambia.

Name: Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C)
Description: Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C) together with its subsidiaries establishes and operates cinemas in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Cinema and Buffets Investment and Investments Properties segments. The company establishes operates and leases shops restaurants ready-made meals coffee shops and fun games halls in cinema and theatre buildings; owns movable assets; and manages and operates visual and audio media as well as retail sales of gifts and accessories. It also engages in the publishing and film production and distribution activities. In addition the company invests in equity and investment funds; and invests in and rents real estate properties. Kuwait National Cinema Company (K.P.S.C) was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S.A.
Description: Cruzeiro do Sul Educacional S.A. provides education services in Brazil. It offers academic and professional education services including elementary school undergraduate graduate and extension courses in on-site and distance learning modalities; kindergartens; and medical courses. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Sidi Kerir Petrochemicals Co.
Description: Sidi Kerir Petrochemicals Co. engages in the production and sale of polyethylene in Egypt and internationally. Its products are used in applications including film blow moulding injection and roto moulding. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Blumar S.A.
Description: Blumar S.A. engages in the fishing and aquaculture businesses. The company produces and sells fresh or frozen salmon products in the United States Brazil and the rest of Latin America Europe and Asia. It provides fishmeal and fish oil products used in the production of animal feed; and frozen mackerel. In addition the company produces and sells mussels; and other products such as fillets. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in Santiago de Chile Chile.

Name: U Consumer Finance S.A.E.
Description: U Consumer Finance S.A.E. a financial technology company provides various financial solutions for customers and businesses. The company offers investment products an instant cash redemption program savings solutions and a financing solution as well as the U* application which provides buy now pay later solutions. It also provides business solutions comprising payroll system payroll card and employee benefits. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Sheikh Zayed City Egypt.

Name: Enel Generacion Piura S.A.
Description: Enel Generacion Piura S.A. an energy company generates and markets electricity in Peru. The company generates electricity from thermal hydro solar and wind resources. It is also involved in the natural gas business. The company was formerly known as Empresa Electrica de Piura S.A. and changed its name to Enel Generacion Piura S.A. in October 2016. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Lima Peru. Enel Generacion Piura S.A. is a subsidiary of Enel Perú S.A.C.

Name: Irani Papel e Embalagem S.A.
Description: Irani Papel e Embalagem S.A. manufactures and sells corrugated cardboard and packaging papers in Brazil and internationally. It operates through three segments: Sustainable Packaging; Paper Segment for Sustainable Packaging; and Sustainable Resins. The company offers light corrugated and heavy cardboard boxes and sheets; and low and heavy weight kraft papers and recycled papers. It also provides forestry and reforestation services; and sells wood and extracts pine resin used as raw material for production of pitch and turpentine. The company was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil.

Name: Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A.
Description: Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A. a technology company provides solutions and mobile platforms for digital payments customer engagement microfinance and digital services in Brazil and internationally. It provides Bemobi Pay which includes smart checkouts which offers white-label and customizable solution payment method orchestration and multiple payment methods; Smart POS that accepts payments; Payment Orchestration which optimizes payments and connects business to multiple providers increase approval rates and reduce fraud; and simplify payment management. The company also offers Grace an AI-first conversational payments platform; digital engagement solutions for telecom ISPs and telco MNOS; and Agenda Edu SuperApp a tool for communication engagement and school finances.
