In addition it provides microfinance and digital subscriptions solutions for telco MNOS; and Wave a digital native platform for telecommunications; and mobile scoring solutions for telcos and finances. The company serves telecom MNOs and ISPs utilities education health and finance industries. Bemobi Mobile Tech S.A. was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Oceana Group Limited
Description: Oceana Group Limited operates as a fishing and food processing company in South Africa Namibia rest of Africa North America Europe the Far East and internationally. It engages in catching processing and procuring various marine species including pilchard anchovy redeye herring Gulf menhaden lobster squid horse mackerel and hake as well as processing of meat chicken and vegetable products. The company also markets and sells canned fish fishmeal and fish oil. Oceana Group Limited was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: BrasilAgro - Companhia Brasileira de Propriedades Agrícolas
Description: BrasilAgro - Companhia Brasileira de Propriedades Agrícolas engages in the acquisition development exploration and sale of agricultural properties in Brazil Paraguay and Bolivia. It operates through six segments: Real Estate Grains Sugarcane Cattle Raising Cotton and Other. The company is involved in the cultivation of soybean corn sugarcane sesame sorghum bean and cotton lint and seed as well as pasture; and production and sale of beef calves after weaning. It also engages in exploration import and export of agricultural activities and inputs cattle raising livestock investment properties; and forestry activities; purchases sells and rents real estate in rural and/or urban properties; and sale of the raw products. In addition the company provides real estate brokerage services; manages third-party assets; and operates farms through own and leased lands. BrasilAgro - Companhia Brasileira de Propriedades Agrícolas was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Tharisa plc
Description: Tharisa plc an investment holding company engages in the mining processing beneficiation marketing sale and logistics of platinum group metals (PGMs) and chrome concentrates in South Africa China Singapore Hong Kong the United Arab Emirates an internationally. It operates through four segments: PGM Chrome Agency and Trading and Manufacturing. The company sells PGM concentrates including platinum palladium rhodium gold ruthenium iridium nickel and copper. It also produces metallurgical chrome concentrate and specialty chrome concentrates; operates a third party chrome plant as well as markets and sells the chrome concentrate produced at this plant; and manufactures and sells mining and mineral processing equipment. In addition the company holds 100% interest in the Tharisa mine an open pit PGM and chrome mine located on the south-western limb of the Bushveld Complex South Africa. Tharisa plc was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Paphos Cyprus.

Name: Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E)
Description: Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement and cement products. The company also produces packing bags. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Sinai Cement Co. (S.A.E) is a subsidiary of Vicat Cement Egypt.

Name: Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. provides a range of insurance products and services in Qatar. It operates through three segments: Underwriting Investments and Real Estate. The company offers personal insurance products comprising motor medical travel maid home life and yacht and boat insurance. It also provides corporate insurance products such as energy engineering general accident corporate liability fire and property marine cargo marine hull motor fleet group medical and group life insurance; and takaful insurance products. In addition the company invests in capital and other resources in related activities. It serves private and public sectors including government offices banking institutions hotels and other organizations as well as infrastructure projects. Qatar Islamic Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. was formerly known as Qatar Islamic Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Jordan Ahli Bank
Description: Jordan Ahli Bank provides various banking and financial services in Jordan and internationally. It offers current salary transfer savings and deposit accounts; personal profession real estate and car loans; debit credit and pre-paid cards; bancassurance covering health fire car transportation risk travel and engineering insurance products as well as life and personal accidents retirement and academic insurance programs. The company also provides overdraft facilities syndicated and commercial loans commercial discounted bills letters of guarantee and credit and documentary bills. In addition it offers small and medium enterprises (SME) current and savings accounts and fixed deposits; SME credit cards; financing solution programs; green business packages; trade financial solutions; Anty women in business program which includes current accounts for businesses owned or managed by women; and support and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Jordan National Bank. Jordan Ahli Bank was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: TAQA Arabia S.A.E.
Description: TAQA Arabia S.A.E. and its subsidiaries operates as an energy and utility provider in Egypt. The company operates through Gas Power Fuel and lubricants Water and other segments. It constructs manages operates and maintains natural gas transmission and distribution lines; power plants electricity transformers and distribution networks; and water desalination stations refineries water purification transmission lines pumping stations and sewage and industrial drainage grids. The company also distributes electricity natural gas and water; provides consulting services; and is involved in conventional and renewable power generation and distribution. In addition it undertakes engineering procurement and construction works; manages and operates natural gas filling stations under the Master Gas name; and provides compressed natural gas mobile services. Further the company provides wastewater and chemical treatment filtration smart water metering and a smart water management platform; operates a solar power plant fuel stations under the TAQA brand name and fuel storage terminals; and distributes lubricants. It serves residential commercial and industrial clients; and oil and gas petrochemicals tourism agricultural and real estate development sectors. TAQA Arabia S.A.E. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Al Soor Fuel Marketing Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Soor Fuel Marketing Company K.S.C.P. engages in the sale of fuel and other related services in the State of Kuwait. It operates through Fuel Marketing and Other Related Services and Investment Operations segments. The company engages in the acquisition establishment leasing operation and maintenance of petrol stations. It also provides gasoline diesel fuel and kerosene as well as oil and lube products. In addition the company offers automobile services related to cars and vehicles such as oil changing car washing maintenance workshop and technical check-up services; ships and trades in petroleum products in bulk or retail; and prepaid and postpaid petro cards for public private and government sectors as well as operates soft drinks vending machines at fuel stations. Further the company purchases leases acquires and sells land and real estate properties; and invests in managed portfolio and short-term money market placements. Al Soor Fuel Marketing Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. The company operates as a subsidiary of Alfa Energy Company K.S.C.

Name: Independent Petroleum Group K.S.C.P.
Description: Independent Petroleum Group K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the trading and marketing of crude oil and petroleum products. The company is involved in logistics activities; and owns and operates petroleum products tankers. It operates in Africa the Middle East Europe Asia and the Far East. Independent Petroleum Group K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Essbio S.A.
Description: Essbio S.A. primarily engages in the catchment decantation filtration disinfection purification storage and distribution of water. It also provides sewage collection and treatment sludge treatment and liquid industrial waste treatment services; sewers maintenance services; and project management advisory and technical assistance for rural health services. The company serves agro-industrial forestry port and mining sectors as well as commercial and residential customers primarily in the regions of O'Higgins and Biobío in Chile. Essbio S.A. was founded in 1990 and is based in Concepción Chile.

Name: Arabian Cement Company S.A.E.
Description: Arabian Cement Company S.A.E. manufactures and sells cement and other related products in Egypt. The company offers cements under the AL MOSALAH and AL NASR names; clinker under the OPC and SRC names; and ready mix concrete including standard and high strength mixes and high density light weight self-compacting screed and fibers concrete. It also provides construction materials; and constructs and operates factories for recycling. In addition the company offers managerial restructuring and general trading services transportation of goods project management and preparation of feasibility study. Further the company involved in environmental services clean energy production and development and establishes and operates factory for recycling wastes and other services. It also exports its products. Arabian Cement Company S.A.E. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt. Arabian Cement Company S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Aridos Jativa S.L.U.

Name: Qatar General Insurance & Reinsurance Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatar General Insurance & Reinsurance Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides general insurance and reinsurance products in Qatar. The company offers individual insurance products including travel medical housemaid private motor personal accident jewelry home and marine hull products; and corporate insurance products such as property marine and aviation engineering energy corporate motors liability and miscellaneous group medical and specialty lines insurance products. It is also involved in the investment development and management of real estate properties; hospitality exhibition and events management; contracting and construction; manufacturing of rebar and insulation materials; automobiles repair; and trading of water bottling and beverages. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Clientèle Limited
Description: Clientèle Limited through its subsidiaries engages in the provision of financial services in South Africa. It operates through Clientèle Life Insurance; 1Life Insurance; Emerald Life Insurance; Non-Life Insurance; and CBC Rewards Mobile and Direct Rewards segments. The company markets distributes and underwrites insurance and investment products as well as invests funds; operates a micro-insurance license and markets and distributes specialized funeral products; and offers personal and business lines legal insurance policies. It also provides rewards benefits to its clients from retailers and service providers; and airtime and data products. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Morningside South Africa. Clientèle Limited is a subsidiary of Friedshelf 1577 Proprietary Limited.

Name: Afrimat Limited
Description: Afrimat Limited operates as a mining and materials company primarily in the southern African region. The company operates through five segments: Construction Materials Industrial Minerals Bulk Commodities Future Materials and Metals and Services. The Construction Materials segment provides aggregates products including sand gravel and crushed stone; and concrete-based products comprising concrete made from rock sand water and readymix cement. The Industrial Minerals segment offers limestone dolomite and industrial sand. The Bulk Commodities segment provides iron ore and anthracite. The Future Materials and Metals segment produces phosphate an organic fertilizer; and vermiculite rare earths and green construction materials. The Services segment offers IT consulting and external logistical and mining services as well as mobile crushing screening drilling and blasting loading and hauling services. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Bellville South Africa.

Name: Bank of Africa - Benin SA
Description: Bank of Africa - Benin SA provides various banking products and services for individuals and businesses in Benin. It offers checking accounts; debit and credit cards; savings accounts and investment product including time deposit. The company also provides loans such as real estate school consumer equipment vehicle travel group personal vitamin and advance loans as well as over drafting services. In addition it offers insurance products; and money transfer services as well as provides mobile banking services. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cotonou Benin. Bank of Africa - Benin SA is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Unifique Telecomunicações S.A.
Description: Unifique Telecomunicações S.A. provides telecommunications services in Brazil. The company offers data storage data hosting and internet services. It also provides SCM multimedia communications services; access to communication networks portals content providers and information services; satellite cable and microwave pay-TV; and internet hosting and switched fixed-line telephone services. In addition the company retail trades computer and mobile phone equipment and supplies; monitors electronic security systems; provides supplementary pension and health plans; and publishes books and retail trades books. Unifique Telecomunicações S.A. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Timbó Brazil.

Name: Camil Alimentos S.A.
Description: Camil Alimentos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in processing production packaging and marketing of food products. The company offers sugar sweets canned sardines and tuna fish pasta coffee biscuits health products and other products as well as grains such as rice and beans. It provides its products under various brands such as Camil Coqueiro União and Santa Amália in Brazil; Saman and La Abundancia in Uruguay; Tucapel in Chile; Costeño in Peru; and Rico Arroz in Ecuador. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Camil Alimentos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Camil Investimentos S.A.

Name: Chilanga Cement PLC
Description: Chilanga Cement PLC engages in the manufacture and sale of cement products in Zambia. The company offers Mphamvu 325N a general-purpose bagged cement for building and construction projects; SupaSet 425R a rapid-setting cement for block making and concrete projects; Powerplus 425N an ordinary Portland cement for heavy construction projects including bridges railways stadiums and airports; Powerbuild 425N for mass concrete applications in the foundations of large buildings; Supablock 42.5N used in bricks and blockmaking; and Pawalime quicklime acts as a flux for removing impurities. It also exports its products to Zimbabwe Malawi and Burundi. The company was formerly known as Lafarge Zambia Plc and changed its name to Chilanga Cement PLC. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Lusaka Zambia. Chilanga Cement PLC is a subsidiary of Huaxin (Hainan) Investment Co. Ltd.

Name: SBN Holdings Limited
Description: SBN Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides banking and financial services to individual customers and small to medium-sized enterprises in Namibia. It operates through Personal and Private Banking; Business & Commercial Banking; and Corporate & Investment Banking segments. It offers personal transactional call current fixed and notice deposits and savings accounts. The company also provides home revolving student and medium-term loans; mortgage loans; trade property vehicle asset and contract finance; instalment sale and finance leases; overdraft; and letters of credit invoice discounting bank guarantees and business revolving credit plans. In addition it offers credit and debit cards; asset management and unit trust services; insurance broking services; safe custodianship services; property investment and construction; and cellphone and internet banking services. The company was founded in 1915 and is headquartered in Windhoek Namibia. SBN Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Standard Bank Group Limited.

Name: Administradora Americana de Inversiones S.A.
Description: Administradora Americana de Inversiones S.A. operates independently of Administradora de Fondos de Pensiones Capital S.A. as of December 1 2021.

Name: Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C.
Description: Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in insurance and reinsurance businesses in Qatar the United Arab Emirates Lebanon Luxembourg and Jordan. It operates through five segments: Motor Marine and Aviation; Fire; General and Accident; Group Life and Health; and investments. The company offers personal insurance products such as car insurance travel insurance yacht insurance products and individual medical insurance products. It also offers corporate insurance products such as motor fleet aviation engineering fire health and marine insurance products. In addition the company provides insurance intermediation and management services; Islamic insurance and reinsurance; information technology solutions; real estate holding and leasing operations; and trades in computer network devices and computer software. The company was formerly known as Doha Insurance Company Q.S.C. and changed its name to Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. in March 2017. Doha Insurance Group Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: British American Tobacco Kenya plc
Description: British American Tobacco Kenya plc engages in the manufacture and sale of tobacco and tobacco free oral nicotine pouches in Kenya and internationally. It is involved in farming and processing manufacturing selling of cigarettes and other tobacco and nicotine products. The company was formerly known as BAT Kenya Limited and changed its name to British American Tobacco Kenya plc in 1998. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya. British American Tobacco Kenya plc operates as a subsidiary of British American Tobacco p.l.c.

Name: ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public) provides building materials and construction and engineering services in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Qatar and internationally. It operates through Industrial Operations Real Estate Operations and Contracting Operations segments. The company manufactures autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) products including AAC slabs construction blocks panels lintels reinforced slabs dry mortar and other AAC reinforced structural components; ground granulated blast furnace slag ordinary Portland resistant micro silica white cement and sulfate resistant cement; and ready-mix concrete products as well as interlock products. It also provides project management construction and management contracting and subcontracting infrastructure project engineering procurement and construction services as well as civil works electrical plumbing heating ventilation and air conditioning services. In addition the company owns develops and manages real estate properties in the Gulf region. Further it engages in the transportation and delivery of various products through a fleet of vehicles and trucks as well as offers integrated construction services with turnkey building solutions for citizens looking to build homes. ACICO Industries Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Activo Inmobiliario Peruano S.A.A.
Description: Activo Inmobiliario Peruano S.A.A. engages in real estate activities in Peru. The company leases shopping centers. It also invests in fixed or variable income securities movable and immovable properties and other activities. In addition the company develops purchases and sells real estate properties; and provides shopping center management services for the distribution and sale of goods. The company was formerly known as Falabella Perú S.A.A. and changed its name to Activo Inmobiliario Peruano S.A.A. in 2025. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Activo Inmobiliario Peruano S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Desarrollos Perú SpA.

Name: Namibia Breweries Limited
Description: Namibia Breweries Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in brewing and distribution of alcoholic beverages and manufacture of soft drinks in Namibia and South Africa. It offers alcoholic beers under the Windhoek Lager Windhoek Draught Windhoek Non-Alcoholic Tafel Lager Tafel Lite Tafel Radler Hansa Draught Camelthorn King Lager and Heineken brand names; non-alcoholic beer under Horizon brand name; ciders under the Strongbow Savanna Premium and Hunter’s brand names; sparkling and still bottled water under the Aqua Splash brand name; mixers under the McKane brand name; and nectars and juices with flavors including Mediterranean guava strawberry/banana tropical punch apple red grape orange peach/orange peach/pear mango pine and peach/apricot under the Fruitree brand name. The company also provides wines under Tassenberg Capenheimer Perlé Castelo Ginger Fizz Nederburg and Durbanville Hills brand names as well as offers Count Pushkin and Cruz vodka Old Buck gin Klipdrift and Richelieu brandy Bain’s whisky and Amarula cream liqueur. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as South West Breweries Ltd and changed its name to Namibia Breweries Limited in 1990. Namibia Breweries Limited was incorporated in 1920 and is based in Windhoek Namibia. The company operates as a subsidiary of NBL Investment Holdings (Proprietary) Limited.

Name: Empresa Siderúrgica del Perú S.A.A.
Description: Empresa Siderúrgica del Perú S.A.A. produces and sells steel products in Peru and internationally. The company offers strength structural steel abrasion resistant steel sewers angles structural square bars structural smooth round bars mining bars mining balls U channels steel nails corrugated iron construction iron enabled iron electro welded mesh plates reservoirs galvanized mechanical pipes LAC pipes and mechanical tubes and LAF mechanical tubes. It serves construction road infrastructure energy mining agriculture and industrial companies. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Empresa Siderúrgica del Perú S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Gerdau S.A.

Name: Desktop S.A.
Description: Desktop S.A. provides fixed telephony broadband internet and pay television services in Brazil. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Sumaré Brazil.

Name: Sociedad Minera Corona SA
Description: Sociedad Minera Corona SA engages in the exploration extraction production and sale of copper silver gold lead zinc and oxides concentrates. It holds interest in the Yauricocha mine located in the Yauyos province and the Carolina mine located in Hualgayoc province. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Lima Peru. Sociedad Minera Corona SA operates as a subsidiary of Dia Bras Perú S.A.C.

Name: Société Libanaise des Ciments Blancs S.A.L.
Description: Société Libanaise des Ciments Blancs S.A.L. produces sells and exports white cement and related products. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Chekka Lebanon. Société Libanaise des Ciments Blancs S.A.L. is a subsidiary of Holcim (Liban) S.A.L.

Name: Oriental Weavers Carpets Company (S.A.E)
Description: Oriental Weavers Carpets Company (S.A.E) manufactures and sells carpets jet-printed rugs and related raw materials worldwide. It offers machine woven and non-woven carpets; door and kitchen rugs rubber-backed bathroom mats multilevel textured mats for outdoor applications car mats children’s rugs and mats scatter rugs and club rugs; and three-dimensional advertising floor panels and runners and artificial turf for indoor and outdoor applications. The company provides wall-to-wall carpets; indoor/outdoor rugs; patterned printed engraved and embossed mats; underlay rolls and rug pads; car mats; and bathroom mats as well as handmade rugs. It serves retailers home fashion brands luxury hotels resorts and other lifestyle centers. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: Cleopatra Hospitals Group S.A.E.
Description: Cleopatra Hospitals Group S.A.E. operates hospitals in Egypt. It provides various medical services including surgeries medical supervision analysis examinations and xrays as well as inpatient day patient and outpatient medical services. The company also operates polyclinics; and inpatient and outpatient pharmacies. Cleopatra Hospitals Group S.A.E. was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao
Description: Companhia Brasileira De Distribuicao operates supermarkets specialized stores and department stores in Brazil. The company sells food products including non-perishables beverages fruits vegetables meat bread cold cuts and dairy products; and non-food products such as cleaning supplies disposable products personal care products and pet supplies under its private label and third-party brands. It is also involved in providing ready-to-eat meals; rental of commercial spaces; and e-commerce sales. The company operates its supermarkets under Pão de Açúcar Mercado Extra and Compre Bem banners; proximity and specialized stores through Mini Extra Minuto Pão de Açúcar Pão de Açúcar Adega and Aliados Minimercado banners; and gas stations through the Pão de Açúcar Mercado Extra and Compre Bem banners as well as sells its products through its websites. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Bank Of Africa Senegal
Description: Bank Of Africa Senegal provides various banking products and services in Senegal. The company offers current savings investment and currency accounts; term deposits; education marketplace home car consumer equipment and overdraft loans; cards; and money transfer insurance and digital banking services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Dakar Senegal. Bank Of Africa Senegal is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Kuwait Insurance Company S.A.K.P.
Description: Kuwait Insurance Company S.A.K.P. provides various insurance products and services in Kuwait. It operates through Marine and Aviation Fire General Accident Motors and Life Insurance segments. The Marine and Aviation segment provides insurance against risks related to goods transportation and marine and aviation vessels. The Fire segment offers insurance against fire for various types of buildings and stores; industrial risks; and oil and gas industry. The General Accident segment offers insurance against risks of contractors machinery and computer damages and cessation of work; and cash bonds fidelity professional risks work accidents and civil responsibility. The Motors segment provides insurance against motor vehicles. The Life Insurance segment provides life insurance cover for individuals and groups as well as medical insurance products. In addition the company provides takaful insurance. Further it offers travel home boat and yacht and jet ski insurance. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Compagnie Minière de Touissit S.A.
Description: Compagnie Minière de Touissit S.A. engages in the exploration extraction and processing of base metals precious metals and industrial minerals in Morocco. The company produces silver-bearing lead and zinc concentrates as well as silver. It also manages a portfolio of 34 mining permits in Morocco. Compagnie Minière de Touissit S.A. was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Pet Center Comércio e Participações S.A.
Description: Pet Center Comércio e Participações S.A. operates physical and digital stores that sells products and services for pets in Brazil. The company offers pet food products such as prescription pet food super premium premium and standard pet food wet food snacks and others; and accessories hygiene cleaning products drugs and others under the Petz brand. It also operates veterinary centers under the Seres brand. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: The United Bank
Description: The United Bank provides commercial and Islamic banking services in Egypt. The company offers current savings and investment accounts; time and fixed time deposit; EGP and USD certificates; debit prepaid and credit cards. It also provides loans including educational car mortgage personal and Intalaka microfinance as well as syndication loans. In addition the company offers microfinance and pharmacist program finance; trade services and finance; cash management and treasury services; treasury bills and bonds; project finance; export financing program; and financing and lending programs. Further it offers safe deposit boxes; remittances services; electronic payment services; internet online and mobile banking services; small and medium enterprises products; and digital wallet e-payroll foreign currency exchange ATM and international payments services. The United Bank was formerly known as United Bank of Egypt and changed its name to The United Bank in June 2006. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C
Description: Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C engages in the oil and fuel import and export and food trading businesses. It also provides fuel storage and marketing services. The company was formerly known as Al Ameer for Development and Multiprojects and changed its name to Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C in March 2009. Afaq For Energy Co. P.L.C was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: United Projects Company For Aviation Services K.S.C.P.
Description: United Projects Company For Aviation Services K.S.C.P. operates as a commercial real estate development and facilities management company in Kuwait. It operates in two segments Investments and Service Operations. The company provides airplane ground and cleaning services. It offers real estate management and project management and consultancy services; and real estate development services such as property management sales and leasing site development and renovation and space design and planning. In addition the company provides property and facilities management services including parking lot management automated facilities platform security and cleaning check-in counters management and engineering and custodial services; facility and equipment maintenance service comprising air conditioning plumbing electric and conveyor belt services; utilities and communications infrastructure; and exterior landscaping services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. United Projects Company For Aviation Services K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Agility Public Warehousing Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Valid Soluções S.A.
Description: Valid Soluções S.A. provides digital payment solutions in Brazil. It operates through three segments: Payments Method Identification and Mobile. The Payments Method segment offers integrated products and solutions such as chip and magnetic stripe cards gift cards check printing invoices and bank statements as well as solutions in radio frequency identification contactless cards and mobile payments. The Identification segment provides data capture storage and administration security forms recognition and fingerprints. Its solutions are used in the generation of computerized systems for managing databases collection of biometric data printing and customization of official identification documents solutions for smart cities stamps traceable and digital certification services. The Mobile segment offers services of issuing statements and technologies for use in cell phones and digital mobility such as NFC TSM and HCE solutions for mobile service providers. It also develops technologies for use in cell phones such as recharge and payment and production of cards intended for telecommunications. It serves state governments and government agencies large financial institutions telecommunications companies retailers agriculture cooperatives and independent professionals. The company was formerly known as Valid Soluções e Serviços de Segurança em Meios de Pagamento e Identificação S.A. and changed its name to Valid Soluções S.A. in August 2018. Valid Soluções S.A. was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Sorocaba Brazil.

Name: Super Group Limited
Description: Super Group Limited engages in the supply chain management mobility dealership and fleet management activities in South Africa sub-Saharan Africa Europe and the United Kingdom. It operates through seven segments: Supply Chain Africa Supply Chain Europe Fleet Africa SG Fleet Dealerships SA Dealerships UK and Services. The company provides supply chain services comprising primary and secondary distribution multi-temperature-controlled product distribution integrated distribution to the national convenience market bonded cross-border transport warehousing supply chain optimisation and consulting brand management sales and merchandising courier services and procurement. It also offers fleet management solutions for specific transport and vehicle management needs of various customers; and various value-added services such as driver fuel and tyre management; accident and insurance administration; fleet optimization and route planning; vehicle tracking and recovery; call center; and repair services. In addition it provides end-to-end logistics warehousing and customs clearance; and transportation and logistics solutions. Further the company offers passenger and commercial vehicles. Super Group Limited was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: RFG Holdings Limited
Description: RFG Holdings Limited manufactures and markets convenience meal solutions in South Africa the Kingdom of Eswatini and internationally. It offers canned fruit and jam fruit purees and fruit concentrates canned vegetables canned meat bottled salads and pickles fresh pasta and sauces baked and unbaked pies pasties sausage rolls and pie-slices tomato products fruit juice dry packaged foods and infant meals ready meals dairy and bakery products. In addition it provides dry and frozen tubeset muffin batters croissants cinnamon scrolls frozen preformed cookies frozen pizzas dry bakery mixes and ready-to-eat muffins; milk cream and cheese; and corn baked beans spaghetti and chakalaka and other products. The company provides its products under the Rhodes Quality Bull Brand Bisto Hinds Pakco Zing Trout Hall Ma Baker Mama’s Hazeldene Magpie Big Jack Today Man’s Meal Trotters Southern Coating and Squish brands. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Rhodes Food Group Holdings Limited and changed its name to RFG Holdings Limited in April 2020. RFG Holdings Limited was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Dhofar International Development & Investment SAOG
Description: Dhofar International Development and Investment Holding Company S.A.O.G is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides portfolio and fund management services to its clients. It also invests in real estate markets. Dhofar International Development and Investment Holding Company S.A.O.G was founded on December 9 1987 and is based in Salalah Oman.

Name: Transjamaican Highway Limited
Description: Transjamaican Highway Limited engages in the development operation and maintenance of TransJam Highways tolled road network in Jamaica. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Kepler Weber S.A.
Description: Kepler Weber S.A. provides grain storage equipment and post-harvest grain solutions in Brazil the Americas Africa Europe and Asia. The company operates through five segments: Farms Agroindustry Ports and Terminals Replacement and Services and International Business. The company offers grain storage and preservation systems such as silos dryers cleaning machines and related components; belt semi-enclosed belt enclosed belt and chain conveyors; sweep augers screw conveyors elevators dispatch hoppers heat generators catwalks and structures and metallic structures; industrial equipment; and port terminals. It also provides spare parts and technical assistance services; technical engineering and data processing services; engineering risk insurance services; and grain temperature and moisture monitoring services in the processing and storage process. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Arkan Al-Kuwait Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Arkan Al-Kuwait Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiary provides real estate services primarily in Kuwait. It operates through three segments: Real Estate Investments and Services. The company offers real estate investment and development management of real estate funds as well as real estate evaluation services. It also owns manages operates invests rents and leases hotels clubs health clubs motels entertainment houses rest houses parks fairs restaurants cafeterias compounds tourist facilities health resorts sports and entertainment projects as well as shops. In addition the company involved in development purchase sale and management of properties and land; execution and maintenance of civil mechanical and electrical contracting activities; and owns commercial markets and residential compounds as well as general trading and contracting and air conditioning and refrigeration business. Further it offers development of infrastructure projects for residential commercial and industrial areas under the BOT system; and imports sells and installs various safety and firefighting equipment; and organizes real estate exhibitions. Arkan Al-Kuwait Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Invest Bank
Description: Invest Bank provides various banking and related financial services in Jordan. It provides personal banking services comprising current and saving accounts and time deposits; personal mortgage/housing under construction land financing equity release auto and cash-to-cash loans; and credit cards. The company also offers corporate banking services such as overdraft accounts decreasing loans accounts discounted promissory notes bonded services bridging and amortized loans syndicated loans and other services; treasury services; letters of credit; guarantees; and revolving loans discounted promissory notes structured trade finance solutions and liquidity and cash management products and solutions. In addition it provides factoring brokerage supply chain finance and financial leasing services; and mobile and internet banking services as well as engages in the management and operation of bonded warehouses. The company was formerly known as Jordan Investment & Finance Bank and changed its name to Invest Bank in April 2009. Invest Bank was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Al Suwadi Power Company SAOG
Description: Al Suwadi Power Company SAOG develops finances designs constructs operates maintains insures and owns power-generating facilities in Oman. The company owns and operates the Barka 3 power plant with a power capacity of approximately 750 MW; gas interconnection facilities; and other related infrastructure to produce power. It sells electrical energy to Nama Power and Water Procurement Company SAOC under power purchase agreement. Al Suwadi Power Company SAOG was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Al Khuwayrah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Invercap S.A.
Description: Invercap S.A. is involved in the mining and steel businesses in Chile Argentina and Peru. The company produces processes and sells steel products as well as iron mining. Invercap S.A. was founded in 1994 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Arab Palestinian Investment Company
Description: Arab Palestinian Investment Company an investment holding company operates in the manufacture trade distribution and service sectors in Palestine Jordan the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates Iraq and Turkey. The company manufactures cold cuts luncheon canned meat and frozen meats under the Siniora Al-Quds and Unium brands; manufactures aluminum and profiles; distributes fast-moving consumer goods; and distributes human and veterinary pharmaceuticals medical and laboratory equipment and surgical and disposable items to pharmacies private hospitals non-governmental organizations the ministry of health and retail outlets. It also provides after sales services; a range of advertising promotion communication public relations and event management services as well as storage and cooling services; engages in the financial leasing of equipment and machines; distributes passenger cars trucks and vans; and leases vehicles. Arab Palestinian Investment Company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Oxiquim S.A.
Description: Oxiquim S.A. produces and sells resins for the wood board industry in Chile. It offers liquid petroleum gas clean fuels wood board animal feed and nutrition human food food flexible packaging films thermoplastic and compostable resins paints coating and adhesives; industrial water desalination purification and treatment; pharmaceutical mining detergents and cleaning cellulose and paper HPLC solvents and ACS reagents and others. The company also provides reception storage and dispatch services for liquid bulk serving mining companies LPG and fuel distributors pulp mills paint and coating manufacturers and resins and adhesive producers. In addition it is involved in the distribution and marketing of a range of chemicals raw materials and specialties for the productive industry; and marketing sales and technical support product development supply chain and logistics sourcing and procurement mixing and formulation packaging and drumming and private labeling services. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Advanced Technology Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Advanced Technology Company K.S.C.P. provides healthcare and environmental solutions in Kuwait. It offers diagnostic imaging and radiotherapy products; medical technologies and dialysis and health facility infrastructure; laboratory and environmental solutions; automated pharmacy systems and modular furniture for inpatient outpatient and emergency pharmacies; and OR integrated solutions consumable supplies and disposable solutions. The company also provides disinfection and sterilization equipment; patient care and rehabilitation and medical furniture; and specialized equipment instruments materials and consumables for dental clinics and labs. In addition it offers pharmaceuticals aesthetic products medical devices hospital consumables and disinfectants; animal health veterinary agriculture crop protection and irrigation products; and wellness and healthcare apparel products. Further the company provides information solutions such as hospital management systems electronic medical records clinical decision support systems IT strategic consulting process mapping clinical workflows education training and other related services; and structured cabling converged and wireless networking IP telephony video conferencing enterprise datacenters enterprise storage disaster recovery and business continuity security and cloud and virtualization environment building solutions. Additionally it offers kitchen and laundry equipment including cooking equipment dishwashers meal delivery and ventilation systems laundry equipment and insulated trays for hospitals hotels catering services and restaurants; and security surveillance and access control solutions as well as home care nursing and physiotherapy services. It serves government and private hospitals dental practitioners laboratories and physicians. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Salmiya Kuwait.

Name: Sonda S.A.
Description: Sonda S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides information technology (IT) solutions in the United States Canada Chile Brazil Mexico Argentina Colombia Costa Rica Ecuador Panama Peru Guatemala and Uruguay. It operates through Digital Business Digital Services and Transactional Business segments. The company offers digital software factory digital architecture data and advance analytics and digital channels and tech. consulting; as well as network and edge DaaS and IaaS cloud and datacenter cybersecurity workplace services and technology infrastructure and services. It also provides high availability IT and OT networks collaborative hybrid work network transformation service and comprehensive communications outsourcing. In addition the company offers ERP FIN700 SAP and Autodesk.; as well as sales of computing infrastructure including servers workstations tablets PCs printers storage and backup equipment communications equipment databases operating systems and others. Further the company involved in implementation maintenance and guarantee management of the assets. Sonda S.A. was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatar Industrial Manufacturing Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in industrial manufacturing in Qatar and internationally. The company produces treated sand for construction and agricultural uses; paving stones and kerb stones; sulphuric acid for local and export markets; and non-colored and colored aluminum profiles as well as converts facial tissues toilet rolls kitchen rolls and M Tork rolls. It is also involved in various types of industrial investments. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc
Description: Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc together with the subsidiaries engages in the power oil and gas and hospitality businesses in Nigeria. It operates through five operating segments: Hospitality Agro-allied Power Oil & Gas and Corporate Centre. The company owns and operates Transcorp Hilton Abuja and Transcorp Centre as well as Aura a digital hospitality platform and provides hospitality services. It is also involved in the exploration refining and marketing of petroleum products and oil and gas; general maritime marketing; growing of agricultural products; processing of food and cash crops activities; and generation and sale of electric power. In addition the company provides communication services. Transnational Corporation of Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Arab Jordan Investment Bank
Description: Arab Jordan Investment Bank provides commercial banking services to individuals SMEs or corporations in Jordan and internationally. It operates through Individual Accounts Institutions and Corporate Treasury and Institutional Financing segments. The company offers current demand savings and time deposit accounts. It also provides personal trade and housing loans; and overdrafts revolving commercial loans term loans asset-backed facilities syndicated loans forwards options futures trade finance facilities/transactional banking and online banking services. In addition the company provides safe deposit box postdated cheque cheque book certified cheque sweeping and cash pooling wealth management transfer and trade finance services; treasury VIP banking and financial planning services; letters of credit letters of guarantee and bills for collection; bancassurance services; and debit and credit cards. Further the company offers investment banking services such as mergers acquisitions and leverage buyouts; insurance; financial advisory private banking IPOs and fundraising escrow accounts and project and specialized finance. The company operates through a network of multiple branches and offices in Jordan and Cyprus. Arab Jordan Investment Bank was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: FCMB Group Plc
Description: FCMB Group Plc provides various banking and financial services to the wholesale and retail customers in Nigeria and Europe. The company’s Investment Banking segment offers banking services to structured large corporate organizations. This segment is also involved in capital-raising activities for organizations in money and capital markets as well as offers financial advisory services to organizations in raising funds. Its Investment Management segment administers and manages the pension fund assets and other investment portfolios for structured retiree savings account holders and other equity fund account holders. The company’s SME Banking segment provides banking services to small and medium enterprises (SME) and commercial registered businesses. Its Commercial Banking segment offers banking services to SME and commercial registered businesses. The company’s Corporate Banking segment provides direct debit facilities current accounts deposits overdrafts loan and other credit facilities foreign currency and derivative products for companies and financial institutions. Its Personal Banking segment offers private banking services and private customer current accounts; savings deposits and investment savings products; and custody services credit and debit cards consumer loans and mortgages to individuals. The company’s Institutional Banking segment provides government financing as well as services to financial institutions and multilateral agencies. Its Treasury and Financial Markets segment offers funding support to various business segments. This segment is also involved in currency trading including financial instruments trading and structured financing. The company also offers stockbroking trusteeship micro-lending cash management trade loans and advances corporate finance investment banking securities brokerage money market and foreign exchange services. FCMB Group Plc was founded in 1977 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Tupy S.A.
Description: Tupy S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development manufacture and sale of cast and compacted graphite iron structural components in North America South and Central Americas Europe Asia Africa Oceania and internationally. The company operates through two segments Freight Transportation Infrastructure Agriculture and Power Generation; and Distribution segments. It offers engine blocks cylinder heads and cast and machined products for the manufacturers of engines used in passenger vehicles commercial vehicles construction machines tractors agricultural machinery power generators capital goods in general and engine assembly for third parties. The company also provides spare parts; malleable iron connections for the construction industry; and cast iron profiles for various use. Tupy S.A. was founded in 1938 and is headquartered in Joinville Brazil.

Name: BK Group PLC
Description: BK Group PLC provides retail and corporate banking insurance brokerage internet and digital services in Rwanda. The company operates a commercial bank that offers a range of financial products including loans mortgages and vehicle financing as well as operates branches ATMS and POS terminals. It serves individuals SMEs corporations non-profits and other financial entities. The company also provides asset management and investment banking; investment and advisory services comprising wealth management and corporate finance; a range of non-life insurance products such as motor transport engineering and personal accident insurance; and smart solutions consisting of home security cashless payments and enterprise security. In addition it invests in education innovation and climate. The company was formerly known as Bank of Kigali Limited and changed its name to BK Group PLC in December 2017. BK Group PLC was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Kigali Rwanda.

Name: Hudaco Industries Limited
Description: Hudaco Industries Limited imports and distributes automotive industrial and electrical consumable products in South Africa and internationally. The company operates in two segments Consumer-Related Products and Engineering Consumables. The Consumer-Related Products segment distributes clutch kits automotive ignition leads oil and hydraulic seals wheels brake and clutch hydraulics mountings bushes hydraulic repair kits cylinders hoses CV joints wheel hubs suspension components and vehicle components to the automotive and industrial after-market; batteries chargers and related battery management equipment as well as battery bays; power tools marine engines survey instruments and fasteners; and wireless networking VoIP and physical security solutions. It also distributes intrusion detection surveillance access control and fire detection equipment; two-way radios and satellite communications wireless networking mobile and VoIP services; end to end security and ICT solutions; and cooking heating and outdoor products. The Engineering Consumables segment distributes diesel engines and spares and support services; bearings chains belting industrial hose seals electric motors geared motors and transmission products; filtration solutions kits and accessories to mining process and manufacturing markets; thermoplastic pipes and fittings and equipment; and variable speed drives electric motors electrical cabling plugs sockets and related products. This segment also manufactures and distributes hydraulic and pneumatic products; drivetrains; dragline hoses; conveyor drive pulleys and idlers; and ferrous and non-ferrous castings as well as designs services and repairs systems. It serves the wholesale and retail automotive manufacturing mining exports security alternative energy construction and agriculture markets. Hudaco Industries Limited was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Edenvale South Africa.

Name: Sechaba Brewery Holdings Limited
Description: Sechaba Brewery Holdings Limited an investment holding company manufactures imports markets and distributes alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages in Botswana. The company offers beer alcoholic fruit beverages soft drinks purified water and other non-alcoholic beverages. Sechaba Brewery Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Saga Falabella S.A.
Description: Saga Falabella S.A. operates chain of department stores in Peru. The company’s stores sell products in various categories including electrohome technology furniture and organization shoes bedroom sports accessories footwear gifts kitchen and kitchenware decoration and lighting pets automotive tool and machinery construction hardware products and beauty and health as well as woman men and children fashion. The company also sells its products through Falabella.com platform. It is also involved in insurance businesses; and rental of spaces to third parties. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Saga Falabella S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inverfal Perú S.A.A.

Name: Sygnia Limited
Description: Sygnia Limited a financial services group provides investment management and administration services to institutional and retail clients primarily in South Africa. It offers multi-manager and index-tracking investment funds customized multi-management investment administration and foreign exchange transacting services transition management stockbroking and securities lending and trading services. The company also provides asset management; investment funds such as unitised life funds unit trusts ETFs and management of segregated portfolios; various savings products including retirement annuities tax-free savings accounts investment policies living annuities and preservation funds; and institutional investment administration employee benefits and retirement fund services. Sygnia Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Empresas Tricot S.A.
Description: Empresas Tricot S.A. engages in the sale of clothing and fashion accessories in Chile. The company offers women’s men’s and children’s t-shirts blouses sweaters and vests sweatshirts pants jeans jackets skirts shorts rompers sports and maternal products pajamas nightshirts slippers robes swimwear jackets formal suits divers and underwear products. It also provides accessories such as hair beauty and personal care caps and hats scarves and handkerchiefs pareos glasses belts wallets backpacks and bags jewelry ties and footwear products. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Macul Chile. Empresas Tricot S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Retail Chile S.A.

Name: Unilever Nigeria Plc
Description:
Unilever Nigeria Plc manufactures and markets food home care and beauty and personal care products primarily in Nigeria and internationally. It operates through 
Food Products; and Home and Personal Care segments. The company offers products under the Close-Up Pepsodent Rexona Knorr Annarpurna and Royco brand names. The company was formerly known as Lever Brothers (West Africa) Ltd and changed its name to Unilever Nigeria Plc in 2001. Unilever Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1923 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Unilever Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of Unilever Overseas Holdings BV.

Name: Iochpe-Maxion S.A.
Description: Iochpe-Maxion S.A. produces and sells automotive wheels and structural components for commercial and light vehicles in North America South America Europe Asia and internationally. The company operates in two divisions Maxion Wheels and Maxion Structural Components. It offers steel and aluminum wheels; wheels side rails and chassis for commercial vehicles; and railway freight cars wheels and castings as well as industrial castings. It also provides structural components such as frames sidebars crossbars metal stampings hand brake levers pedal and welded assemblies structural pieces and other automotive components. The company was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Cruzeiro Brazil.

Name: Banco de Valores S.A.
Description: Banco de Valores S.A. provides various financial products and services in Argentina. The company offers financial and non-financial trusts; shares and debt issuance; open and closed end mutual funds; integral settlement and clearing agents; investment API and corporate banking; and rating services. It is also involved in financing operations. The was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Al Batinah Power Company SAOG
Description: Al Batinah Power Company SAOG designs develops finances constructs operates maintains insures and owns a power generating associated gas interconnection and other infrastructure facilities in the Sultanate of Oman. It owns the Sohar 2 power plant with a power capacity of approximately 750 MW located in the Al Batinah region of the Sultanate of Oman. The company also sells the generated electrical energy to Nama Power and Water Procurement Company SAOC. Al Batinah Power Company SAOG was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Al Khuwayrah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Famous Brands Limited
Description: Famous Brands Limited through its subsidiaries operates as a quick service and casual dining restaurant franchisor in the United Kingdom South Africa South African Development Community the Middle East and Rest of Africa. It operates through Brands and Supply Chain segments. The company operates franchised and company-owned restaurants under the Leading and Signature brands. It is also involved in the manufacture of meat serviette sauces and spices ice cream potato products coffee grounds and beans cheese and juices; and operation of retail outlets. In addition it provides logistics services; and retail products such as dressings and spice condiments frozen meat products frozen chips and other value-added products. The company was formerly known as Steers Holdings Limited and changed its name to Famous Brands Limited in 2004. Famous Brands Limited was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Vitru Brasil Empreendimentos Participações e Comércio S.A.
Description: Vitru Brasil Empreendimentos Participações e Comércio S.A. provides educational services in Brazil. It offers distance in person undergraduate postgraduate technical and professional courses as well as continuing education and preparatory courses. The company operates campuses and via digital education system centers. In addition it operates a platform that provides free content through an ecosystem that includes blogs free preparatory courses and social networking profiles. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Florianópolis Brazil.

Name: ONATEL-SA
Description: ONATEL-SA provides telecommunications services for mobile landline and internet activities. It also sells terminals and other telecommunication equipment. ONATEL-SA is based in Ouagadougou Burkina Faso. ONATEL-SA operates as a subsidiary of Itissalat Al-Maghrib (IAM) S.A.

Name: Sefalana Holding Company Limited
Description: Sefalana Holding Company Limited through its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of fast-moving consumer goods in Botswana Zambia Lesotho and Namibia. The company operates through four segments: Trading - Consumer Goods Trading - Others Manufacturing and Property. It operates retail supermarkets under the Sefalana Shopper name; convenience stores under the Sefalana Quick name; cash and carry outlets under the Sefalana Cash & Carry name; hyper stores under the Sefalana Hyper name; liquor stores under the Sefalana Liquor name; retail hybrid store under the The BIG One name; cigarette distribution outlet under the Capital Tobacco name; and fuel station under the Puma and Caltex franchise as well as catering business under the Sefalana Catering name. The company also produces and sells sarona samp; sechaba mabele; soya sorghum weaning food for infants; soya sorghum enriched foods; tholo malt; tsabotlhe a soya sorghum extruded product; maatla an enriched maize meal product; and ultra-high temperature milk under the Delta Fresh and A Star brands. In addition it sells agricultural and construction equipment automotive products and after-sale service; and operates as a franchised local representative for MAN Honda Daewoo and Tata vehicles including light and heavy commercial vehicles passenger vehicles trucks special-purpose vehicles and buses. Further the company leases office blocks workshops factories and warehouses; and manufactures laundry and bath soaps under the Marang Olga and Fusion brand names. Sefalana Holding Company Limited was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: QALA For Financial Investments
Description: QALA For Financial Investments is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in growth capital turnarounds leveraged buyouts consolidations industry roll-ups greenfields and distressed investments. The firm typically invests in energy cement and construction specialty real estate mining consumer foods food agrifoods agribusiness foundry and ceramics glass manufacturing transportation logistics solid waste energy management metallurgy infrastructure and resources oil and gas minerals financial services including microfinance agriculture alternative energy resources water utilities food products alcohol beverage and tobacco distribution textiles recycling facilities containers and packaging  and other non-core companies and resource-extraction plays. It primarily invests in companies based in Middle East and Africa with a particular emphasis on opportunities in North Africa and East Africa with a focus on Algeria Egypt Sudan Libya Kenya Uganda and Tanzania. The firm seeks to invest 10-20% of the equity component in its portfolio companies. It It seeks majority ownership in its portfolio companies and seeks to co-invest with other investors. The firm also makes socially responsible investments. QALA For Financial Investments was founded in 2004 and is based in Cairo Egypt with an additional office in Algiers Algeria.

Name: JSL S.A.
Description: JSL S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides logistics services in Brazil. It also offers charge transport internal logistics storage urban distribution commodity logistics and other charter services. In addition the company provides logistics services comprising intercity interstate and international road freight transport services; charter passenger transport; logistical cargo transport; and storage related services. Further it manufactures plants and related equipment. JSL S.A. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. The company is a subsidiary of Simpar S.A.

Name: Supreme Ventures Limited
Description: Supreme Ventures Limited engages in betting gaming and lottery operations in Jamaica. The company operates through Lottery Sports Betting Pin Codes and Other segments. It provides video lottery terminal games at gaming lounges and food and beverage operations. In addition the company is also involved in numeric lottery games horseracing activities sports betting micro-financing and selling of PIN codes. Further it provides management and technology services; and micro-financing services. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Ledesma Sociedad Anónima Agrícola Industrial
Description: Ledesma Sociedad Anónima Agrícola Industrial operates as an agro-industrial company in Argentina. The company offers sugar alcohol and bioethanol fruits and citric juices and meat and grains as well as paper copybooks school spares and stationary from sugarcane fiber waste. It also produces energy from renewable sources. Ledesma Sociedad Anónima Agrícola Industrial was incorporated in 1914 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Liva Group SAOG
Description: Liva Group SAOG engages in the insurance business in the Sultanate of Oman the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. It operates through Health & Life; Personal Lines; and Commercial Lines segments. The company offers general health insurance products. It also provides car motor fleet travel and home contents insurance products; life insurance including personal accident insurance for individuals and embassies; comprehensive personal plan domestic helper products; and individual credit life products. Liva Group SAOG was formerly known as National Life and General Insurance Company SAOG and changed its name to Liva Group SAOG in October 2023. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Muscat Oman.

Name: Sociedad Comercial del Plata S.A.
Description: Sociedad Comercial del Plata S.A. operates in construction energy agribusiness transport and infrastructure and real estate sectors in Argentina and internationally. It operates through Construction; Oil; and Agribusiness segments. The company provides construction materials such as hollow ceramic bricks floor and wall coverings ceramics porcelain tiles and processed glasses under the CERRO NEGRO LOSA CORMELA and SUPERGLASS brand names. It also explores exploits refines markets distributes and stores hydrocarbons and its derivatives; produces markets distributes and stores fuel lubricants and other petroleum derivatives; provides downstream services; and develops explores and produces liquified petroleum gas and oil. In addition the company offers rail freight services for transporting grains and its by-products from the humid pampas to the port; invests in own securities; and is involved in forestry activities. Further it develops and operates real estate; and produces wheat flour breadcrumbs and batters premixes for sponge cakes mashed potatoes polenta olive oil sunflower oil balsamic vinegar canned olives precooked white corn flour oats dried pasta biscuits and legumes under the Morixe brand name as well as frozen pre-fried potatoes under the Rapipap brand name. Sociedad Comercial del Plata S.A. was incorporated in 1927 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: MM Group for Industry and International Trade S.A.E.
Description: MM Group for Industry and International Trade S.A.E. engages in the distribution business in Egypt. It operates through four segments: Consumer Electronics Activity Telecommunication Activity Automotive Activity and Tractors activity. The company distributes consumer electronics such as mobile phones tablets air-conditioners refrigerators and household appliances; and luxury vehicles. It also engages in the franchises and distribution of mobile services and accessories including pre-paid and post-paid and e-top-up terminals/credit recharge as well as mobile and broadband devices and accessories. In addition the company assembles and distributes agricultural tractors and farm equipment. The company was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Salmones Camanchaca S.A.
Description: Salmones Camanchaca S.A. engages in the salmon farming business in Chile. The company offers Atlantic and Coho salmon products in various formats such as whole fillet portion and other products including bits and pieces harasu and scrape meat. It also exports its products. Salmones Camanchaca S.A. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Puerto Montt Chile. Salmones Camanchaca S.A. (SNSE:SALMOCAM) operates as a subsidiary of Camanchaca S.A. (SNSE:CAMANCHACA).

Name: OceanPact Serviços Marítimos S.A.
Description: OceanPact Serviços Marítimos S.A. provides services related to the study protection monitoring and sustainable use of the sea coastline and marine resources in Brazil and internationally. It operates through two segments Vessels and Services. The company provides environmental services such as environmental protection oceanographic surveys environmental licensing and studies operational safety and environmental remediation; subsea services including geophysics geotechnics inspection repair and maintenance services as well as support services for construction and decommissioning activities; and logistics and engineering services comprising maritime logistics offshore support base and port and coastal engineering. It primarily serves the oil and gas sector as well as other sectors such as ports shipping mining energy and telecommunications. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited
Description: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited publishes and prints newspapers and magazines in South Africa. The company operates through Publishing Printing and Distribution; and Packaging and Stationery segments. It engages in publishing and printing of newspapers and magazines digital assets web and gravure printing and book printing as well as manufacturing and distribution of labels packaging and stationery products. In addition the company is involved in digital and telecommunication solutions; and owns properties. Further it engages in television channel development business. Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Oman Education & Training Investment Company SAOG
Description: Oman Education & Training Investment Company SAOG provides higher education and training services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company provides cleaning and maintenance vocational training and investment in funds and securities services. It also engages in the operation of Sohar University. Oman Education & Training Investment Company SAOG was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Sohar the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development
Description: Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development engages in the real estate development business in Egypt. The company develops residential and commercial properties. Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Heliopolis Egypt. Heliopolis Co. for Housing & Development is a subsidiary of Holding Company for Construction and Development.

Name: Wataniya Palestine Mobile Telecommunication - Public Shareholding Company
Description: Wataniya Palestine Mobile Telecommunication - Public Shareholding Company offers manages and sells wireless telecommunication services for business and personal needs in Palestine. It provides 3G mobile services; and installs and operates communications stations and telephone networks. The company offers its products and services through a network of distributors agents and points of sale. Wataniya Palestine Mobile Telecommunication Public Shareholding Company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestine.

Name: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company
Description: Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company manufactures and sells pharmaceutical ampoules in Egypt and internationally. The company offers analgesics and antipyretic; analgesics and anti-inflammatory; anti-infective; antihistamine; cardiovascular and metabolic; corticosteroids; gastrointestinal tract; nervous system; ophthalmic; respiratory; topical ointment and cream; vitamins; and miscellaneous products. It also exports its products. Egyptian International Pharmaceutical Industries Company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: Even Construtora e Incorporadora S.A.
Description: Even Construtora e Incorporadora S.A. operates as a real estate developer and builder in Brazil. The company develops and sells residential and commercial projects under the Open and Even brands. It is also involved in land prospecting; real estate development and sale; broker portal operation; and project construction activities. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Clínica Las Condes S.A.
Description: Clínica Las Condes S.A. operates hospital centers in Chile. It provides services in the areas of anesthesia and pain adult bronchopulmonary cardiology adult surgery cardiovascular and endovascular surgery pediatric surgery plastic and reconstructive surgery dermatology gastroenterology gynecology and obstetrics maxillofacial physical medicine and rehabilitation internal medicine neurosurgery neurology adults child neurology nutrition dentistry ophthalmology otorhinolaryngology pediatrics adult psychiatry child and adolescent psychiatry traumatology CLC urgency urology. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Clínica Las Condes S.A. is a subsidiary of Lucec Tres S.A.

Name: Distribuidora de Gas Cuyana S.A.
Description: Distribuidora de Gas Cuyana S.A. engages in the distribution of natural gas in Argentina. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Real-Estate Trade Centers Company K.P.S.C
Description: Real-Estate Trade Centers Company K.P.S.C operates in the real estate business in Kuwait and Syrian Arab Republic. The company buys owns and sells real estate properties and lands; manages leases and markets third-party properties; owns and manages resorts hotels health and sports clubs private hospitals and tourist premises; and buys sells leases and rents land and buildings. It also conducts real estate studies and provides various kinds of related consultations; owns sells and purchases securities and debentures; constructs private and public buildings and projects; offers buildings and real estate maintenance works; organizes real estate exhibitions and auctions; and owns and manages commercial markets and residential complexes. In addition the company develops and manages real estate lands. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E.
Description: Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E. operates as an integrated poultry company in Egypt. It operates through Food Poultry and Other segments. The company produces breeds and fattens chicks. It also involved in production of animal feed and fertilized eggs. In addition the company operates feed plants and poultry slaughterhouse. Further the company offers grandparents parents hatcheries broilers and processing poultry products. It sells its products primarily under the Koki and Koki Gold names. The company serves restaurants and five-star hotels as well as other users of feed live chicken chicken meat and other value-added chicken products. It also exports its products. Cairo Poultry Company S.A.E. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Mutandis SCA
Description: Mutandis SCA engages in the provision of various consumer goods in Morocco and Africa. It provides seafood and fruit juice products; detergents including powdered detergent multi-use detergent paste bleach surface cleaning liquids and dishwasher soap; and PET bottles and plastic bottle-caps for carbonated drinks mineral and table water table oil and fruit juice. The company also exports its products to Europe and the Middle East. Mutandis SCA was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Consorcio Cementero del Sur S.A.
Description: Consorcio Cementero del Sur S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the production and sale of cement in Peru. It operates through four segments: Dairy Cement Paper and Cardboard and Agribusiness. It is involved in the processing and pasteurization of milk and production of dairy products. The company is also involved in the extraction and processing of metallic and non-metallic minerals; production and marketing of ready-mixe concrete precast concrete and other aggregates; production collection and commercialization of lime and calcium oxide; and exploitation and production of stone aggregates. In addition it engages in the manufacture industrialization and commercialization of other construction materials; exploration exploitation transformation and commercialization of goods derived from the cement lime and limestone industry; provision of concrete-processing and handling services; leasing of machinery; and paper and cardboard and agri businesses. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Lima Peru. Consorcio Cementero del Sur S.A. is a subsidiary of Holding Cementero Del Peru Sociedad Anonima.

Name: Camanchaca S.A.
Description: Camanchaca S.A. engages in the industrial fishing business in Chile the United States Mexico Japan Europe and China. The company produces fishmeal frozen and canned jack mackerel langostino lobster and fish oil in northern and southern Chile; and engages in the salmon farming activities.
