It is also involved in the farming mussels abalones and shellfish as well as logistics operations. In addition the company export fishes and shellfish to approximately 50 countries. The company was formerly known as Compañía Pesquera Camanchaca S.A. Camanchaca S.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Al Safat Investment Company K.S.C.
Description: Al Safat Investment Company K.S.C. is a Shariah-compliant privately owned investment manager. The firm also provides financial and consulting services to its clients. The firm is specializing in acquisition SMEs buyouts and growth capital investments. It is also a venture capital capital firm specializing in startup. It primarily provides its services to institutional and individual investors. The firm manages client focused portfolios and investment funds for its clients. It invests in the public equity fixed income and alternative investment markets across the globe. The firm’s alternative investments include investments in private equity and real estate markets. It conducts in-house research to make its investments. The firm invests in various sectors such as services medical sector energy financial investments real estate healthcare Takaful insurance information and technology travel and tourism food/beverages and consumer goods/agriculture education and industrial sectors. It prefers to invest in Islamic funds market Kuwait GCC or MENA region. It prefers to take majority stake in companies. Al Safat Investment Company K.S.C. was founded on September 15 1983 and is based in Hawally Kuwait with an additional office in Safat Kuwait.

Name: Echeverría Izquierdo S.A.
Description: Echeverría Izquierdo S.A. engages in the engineering and construction activities in Chile. The company offers civil works electromechanical installation electrical installation and instrumentation installation of heavy structures piping prefabrication and installation and pre commissioning and industrial maintenance. It engages in construction of building and special foundations; and real estate development. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Las Condes Chile.

Name: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc
Description: Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc provides various commercial banking products and services primarily to multinational companies financial institutions individuals small businesses partnerships and commercial entities in Nigeria. It operates through Retail Banking Commercial Banking Institutional Banking Corporate & Investment Banking Non-Interest Banking and Special Purpose Vehicle segments. The company offers savings and current accounts; investment products; personal loans; cards; e-channels; business accounts loan products business advisory and business digital solutions for SMEs; credit services to large scale enterprises; recurring discounted certificate fixed and call deposits; and importers financing invoice discount facility letter of credit and overdraft services. The company offers retail and consumer banking and trade services; corporate investment and non-interest banking services; and wholesale banking services comprising the granting of loans and advances letter of credit transactions money market operations electronic and mobile banking products and other banking activities as well as issues debt securities to borrow funds and solutions and guided by Islamic economics. It operates a network of branches and cash centers. Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A.
Description: Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A. an investment company engages in the maritime logistics and port businesses. The company provides maritime carriage services which include 9000 and 3100 TEUs full container vessels; tanker vessels for clean products; ferries for people vehicles and cargo; pilot launches; wellboats to support the salmon industry; and tugboats. It also operates port terminals and airports; provides agency services for coordinating pilotage services passengers service and tourism bunkering back office and other services; and logistics services. Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Empresa Regional de Servicio Público de Electricidad Electro Norte Medio S.A.
Description: Empresa Regional de Servicio Público de Electricidad Electro Norte Medio S.A. distributes and markets electric energy in Peru. It also carries out sub-transmission and electricity generation activities; provides electrical meter contrast consulting services; and designs executes study or work related to electrical activities. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Trujillo Peru. Empresa Regional de Servicio Público de Electricidad Electro Norte Medio S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Fondo Nacional de Financiamiento de la Actividad Empresarial del Estado.

Name: Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC
Description: Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC together with its subsidiaries provides asset management and investment banking services in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through three segments: Asset Management Investment Banking and Others. The company offers portfolio management services including discretionary non-discretionary and advisory services as well as equity real estate and fixed income portfolios; and market making services. It also provides wealth management services such as tailored portfolio across all asset classes investments advisory mandates private equity and venture capital private credit portfolio and iMarkaz; capital market and m&a advisory services; and industry capital markets regulatory economic policy infrastructure and periodic research services as well as consulting services comprising industry market assessment company valuation business plans white label reports due diligence/business evaluation c-suite support at CXO level databases access feasibility studies and directors intelligence support. In addition the company offers real estate services including fund management tailored portfolio management full property management RE development and advisory services. Further it is involved in funding import and export operation; undertake the job of brokers; dealing and trading in foreign currencies and precious metal markets; offering personal commercial and consumer loans; finance operation related to pledging investment portfolios and securities and finance brokerage; investment in industrial real estate agricultural services and other sectors; placement agent; and custodian services. Kuwait Financial Centre - KPSC was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Guinness Nigeria Plc
Description: Guinness Nigeria Plc engages in brewing packaging marketing and selling whisky vodka liqueur gin spirits beers non-alcoholic drinks and ready-to-drink products primarily in Nigeria. The company offers its products under Guinness Foreign Extra Stout Guinness Extra Smooth Malta Guinness Malta Guinness Herbs Lite Harp Lager Smirnoff Ice Satzenbrau Lager Dubic Malt Snapp Master’s Choice Orijin Spirit Mixed Drink Orijin Bitters Smirnoff Ice Double Black with Guarana Guinness Africa Special Orijin Zero Tappers and Royal Kingdom Lager brands. Guinness Nigeria Plc exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. As of September 30 2024 Guinness Nigeria Plc operates as a subsidiary of Tolaram Corporation Pte Ltd.

Name: Sabvest Capital Limited
Description: Sabvest Capital Limited is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in early venture mid venture late venture emerging growth growth capital special situation and management buyouts. It seeks to invest equity interests in listed and unlisted companies. It usually invests in companies where key management has meaningful interests or in family managed businesses. The firm does not invest in stage one start-up or greenfield investments and turnarounds and is also unlikely to make new investments that exceed 15% of its portfolio or 25% of shareholders’ equity. It seeks to invest in companies operating in the information technology industrial media retail trading services financial and distribution industries. The firm seeks to invest in businesses in South Africa the United Kingdom and Europe. The firm invests in portfolio companies with equity stakes between 10% and 40%. It usually invests in companies where key management has meaningful interests or in family managed businesses. The firm may hold majority or joint controlling interests but without direct management responsibility. The firm does not acquire a board seat in case of majority investments and favors large minority stakes in unlisted companies. It may hold equity instruments that are small in percentage terms but where the group is able to exercise influence through board representation or shareholder agreements. The firm also has a secondary investment focus which includes holding cash bonds short-term investments fund participation shares and other investments and debt instruments. It seeks to hold a meaningful level of investments in international currencies. Sabvest Limited is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Mirgor Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera Inmobiliaria y Agropecuaria
Description: Mirgor Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera Inmobiliaria y Agropecuaria manufactures and sells air conditioning equipment for automotive and agricultural businesses. The company operates through Automotive Consumer Electronics and Telephony Retail Services Agricultural Steel Marketing and Other segments. It offers air conditioning equipment and car radios; televisions and cell phones; and other electronic products. The company is also involved in the metallurgy business; markets cereals and oilseeds to export destinations; production of agriculture breeding and farming activities; manufactures and markets steel; retails cellphone television and other electronic products; and provision of storage tire repair logistics technical service for repairing telephones and other services. It operates in the Argentine Republic the Eastern Republic of Uruguay the Republic of Chile Republic of Paraguay the Dominican Republic the Republic of Honduras the Republic of Colombia the Republic of Panama the Republic of Ecuador the Plurinational State of Bolivia and the United States of America. Mirgor Sociedad Anónima Comercial Industrial Financiera Inmobiliaria y Agropecuaria was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Empresas Gasco S.A.
Description: Empresas Gasco S.A. provides energy solutions based primarily based on gas in Chile and internationally. It operates through Chile Energy Solutions International Business Energy Solutions and Supply segments. The company distributes and commercializes liquefied gas and liquefied natural gas to residential commercial industrial and real estate customers; distributes natural gas under the concession regime; and develops and maintains photovoltaic solar energy and gas-fired power generation projects. Empresas Gasco S.A. was founded in 1856 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos
Description: Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos sells medicines perfumes personal hygiene and beauty products cosmetics and dermo-cosmetics in Brazil. It sells its products through stores under Panvel brand. The company is also involved in purchasing selling brokering subdividing leasing renting managing and administering its owned and third-party properties. Dimed S.A. Distribuidora de Medicamentos was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Eldorado do Sul Brazil.

Name: Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso
Description: Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso provides commercial bank services for retail corporate and financial markets in Burkina Faso. The company offers savings checking current and currency accounts; term deposits; cards; and digital and online banking services as well as various loans such as house equipment collective car and motorcycle personal consumer vitamin holiday and payday advance loans. It also provides cash and overdraft facilities; discounted commercial papers; bridge spot and campaign credits; advances; cash vouchers; insurance advisory and money transfer services; foreign currency endorsements documentary discounts documentary credits and checks or foreign currency items; guarantee letters; and trade express and currency transfer services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Ouagadougou Burkina Faso. Bank of Africa - Burkina Faso operates is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Boa Safra Sementes S.A.
Description: Boa Safra Sementes S.A. produces and sells soybean seeds in Brazil. It also offers corn and bean seeds. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Formosa Brazil.

Name: APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C. owns and operates Khalifa Bin Salman Port in Bahrain. The company offers container terminal services; general cargo services that handles various vessel types comprising dhows five-star cruise vessels various bulk and break-bulk vessels RORO and livestock; and engages in landside operations including less-than container loads (LCL)/ full container loads (FCL) stations containerization of cargo vehicle storage and long/short term storage solutions. It also provides break bulk and project cargo services; operates roll-on roll-off (RoRo) terminal that handles tractors buses trucks oversized cargo loaded on special flatbed mafi and lowboy trailers as well as new or used vehicle import and export and related services; and provides cruise terminal services. In addition the company offers marine services such as activities relating to pilotage and towage FCL LCL livestock domestic export/import transshipment and mooring. Further it provides container repair reefer documentation gate/yard and data and application programming interface store services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Muharraq Bahrain. APM Terminals Bahrain B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of APM Terminals B.V.

Name: Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E)
Description: Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E) operates in information technology data center outsourcing contact center smart buildings consumer electronics food and beverage land transport E-payments and non-banking financial services fields in Egypt and internationally. The company offers business process and HR outsourcing contact center CX management digital solutions and call center seat leasing services; ATM and self-service data center site preparations low current enterprise network infrastructure and telecom solutions as well as voice and multimedia Internet of Things smart cities security enterprise management Oracle apps and tech and Microsoft solutions; and financial inclusion mobile wallets omni channel blockchain analytics and big data cyber security and customer experience (CX) solutions. It also provides mobile phones and accessories air conditioners desktops notebooks servers tablets computer accessories monitors printers printing consumables scanners software UPS cameras flat panel TVs white goods home appliances and IT products; frozen fruits and vegetables; and pasta tomato paste and fava beans. In addition the company offers auto; supply chain management; and sales and distribution merchandising export vessel discharging consumer finance microloans financing card recharging and donation payment services. Further it engages in the delivery of raw materials; trucking logistics and distribution activities; port and storage services; operates a fleet of trucks; operating and franchising of restaurants; developing commercial and office complexes; and assembling of light transport vehicles. The company was formerly known as Raya Holding Company for Technology and Communication (S.A.E) and changed its name to Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E) in October 2016. Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E) was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: National Industries Company - KPSC
Description: National Industries Company - KPSC engages in the manufacturing and marketing of building and constructing materials and infrastructure products in Kuwait the GCC and the Middle East. It operates through four segments: Building Materials and Contracting Services Oil Sector Real Estate and Investments. The company offers interlock yard tiles kerbstone garden benches and flower pots; cement cladding and limestone bricks; cladding bricks and materials; and mansory blocks. It also provides PPR fittings cPVC and uPVC pressure fittings uPVC sewerage and drainage systems uPVC conduit pipes and accessories and uPVC cable ducts. National Industries Company - KPSC was founded in 1960 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Distribuidora de Gas del Centro S.A.
Description: Distribuidora de Gas del Centro S.A. distributes natural gas in the provinces of Córdoba Catamarca and La Rioja Argentina. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Distribuidora de Gas del Centro S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversora de Gas del Centro S.A.

Name: Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C
Description: Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C engages in the real estate development and investment activities in Palestine. The company develops and sells real estate properties such as housing tourism commercial and mixed-use lands. It also involved in the financial investment activities. The company was formerly known as Asas Al-Ard Company for Investments and Real Estate Development and changed its name to Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C in May 2022. Arkaan Real Estate P.L.C was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Rawabi Palestinian Authority.

Name: Hospital Mater Dei S.A.
Description: Hospital Mater Dei S.A. operates hospitals in Brazil. The company provides healthcare services such as hospitalizations surgeries oncology medical consultations exams and other services. It also engages in data and artificial intelligence business. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Belo Horizonte Brazil. Hospital Mater Dei S.A. is a subsidiary of JSS Empreendimentos e Administração LTDA.

Name: Al-Deera Holding Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Al-Deera Holding Company K.P.S.C. is a private equity firm specializing in direct and fund investments. The firm seeks to make buyout investments in the public equity markets. It seeks to invest in financial services aviation industrial oil and gas media and technology real estate retail and services sectors in its own capacity or through its subsidiaries. The firm prefers to invest both locally and globally through its subsidiaries. The firm prefers to take majority stakes. It seeks to invest in both public and private companies. Al-Deera Holding Company K.P.S.C. was founded on February 18 1998 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Kingston Wharves Limited
Description: Kingston Wharves Limited provides multi-purpose port terminal and logistics services in Jamaica. It operates through Terminal Operations and Logistics Services segments. The company operates public wharves and stevedoring of vessels as well as warehousing and logistics facilities. It also involved in the provision of port security services; rents of ambient warehouses and cold storage facilities; and rents properties. In addition the company offers verified gross mass services for full container load shipment; logistics services including inventory management order fulfilment product assembling and labelling order picking and packaging customized freight transportation and distribution services warehousing and returns immediate short-term and long-term lease and postponement services; and contract labor services. Kingston Wharves Limited was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Misr National Steel - Ataqa
Description: Misr National Steel - Ataqa manufactures and sells steel rebars in Egypt. The company serves its products to government projects real estate developers national infrastructure engineering projects tunnels and other projects. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Misr National Steel - Ataqa is a subsidiary of Al Wehda Industrial Development.

Name: Marítima de Inversiones S.A.
Description: Maritima de Inversiones SA is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm manages equity and mutual funds. It invests in term deposits mutual Funds and stocks. The company was founded on March 19 1982 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A.
Description: Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. engages distribution of electricity in Peru. The company was formerly known as Electroperú S.A. and changed its name to Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. Sociedad Eléctrica del Sur Oeste S.A. was incorporated in 1905 and is based in Arequipa Peru.

Name: Trisul S.A.
Description: Trisul S.A. engages in the construction and development of real estate properties in Brazil. The company is involved in the subdivision of plots of land; and purchase and sale of properties. It also develops real estate projects with ownership interest of third parties. Trisul S.A. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Ser Educacional S.A.
Description: Ser Educacional S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates on-campus and distance-learning undergraduate graduate and professional training courses and other education-related areas in Brazil. It offers undergraduate post graduate on-campus and digital learning and vocational courses. The company operates under the UNINASSAU – Centro Universitário Maurício de Nassau UNINABUCO – Centro Universitário Nabuco UNG – Universidade Guarulhos UNAMA – Universidade da Amazônia UNIVERITAS – Centro Universitário Universus Veritas UNINORTE - Centro Universitário do Norte Centro Universitário de Ciências Biomédicas de Cacoal – UNIFACIMED UNIJUAZEIRO - Centro Universitário de Juazeiro do Norte Sociedade Educacional de Rondônia – UNESC Centro Universitário São Francisco de Barreiras – UNIFASB Centro Universitário FAEL CDMV – Centro de Desenvolvimento da Medicina Veterinária Faculdades UNINASSAU Faculdades UNINABUCO e Escolas Técnicas Joaquim Nabuco e Maurício de Nassau Centro Universitário 7 de Setembro – UNI7 GOKURSOS BEDUKA DELÍNEA PROVA FÁCIL and Peixe 30 CDO CDM DOK and PLANTÃO VETERINÁRIO brands. It also involved in the investment business. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Recife Brazil.

Name: Banco Popular S.A.
Description: Banco Popular S.A. provides banking products and services in Colombia. The company offers debit and credit cards; savings and current accounts; CDT term deposits; investment and voluntary pension funds; housing and investment credits; protection and insurance; tax payment; and customer service and payment channels; cash management; working capital; development credits; commercial consumer mortgage and microcredit loans; financial leasing; and money table products and services as well as digital wallet. It also provides overdraft real estate and machinery and equipment leasing; collection with barcode PSE payment to suppliers payment of payroll and tax and national referenced collection; and foreign trade services including import and export credit portfolio guarantees and warranties and import and export financing. Banco Popular S.A. was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Banco Popular S.A. is a subsidiary of Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A.

Name: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A.
Description: Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. captures produces bottles and markets still and carbonated natural mineral waters in Morocco. It is involved in the manufacture and sale of preforms as well as bottling and marketing of table water. The company offers its products under the Sidi Ali Oulmès Aïn Atlas Vitalya Bahia Purifya Glass' Orangina Fifa of Sainte Luce and DIAM brands. Les Eaux Minérales d'Oulmès S.A. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Navarino S.A.
Description: Navarino S.A. through its subsidiaries manufactures and sells steel parts for mining and grinding balls in Chile and internationally. It is also involved in the glass packaging business. Navarino S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Zamp S.A.
Description: Zamp S.A. engages in the restaurant business in Brazil. It operates and franchises restaurants under the Burger King and Popeyes brands. The company was formerly known as BK Brasil Operação e Assessoria a Restaurantes S.A. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A.
Description: Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. provides broadband internet services in Brazil. It offers fiber optic internet pay TV music streaming and fixed and mobile telephony services. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Pereiro Brazil. Brisanet Serviços de Telecomunicações S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Brisanet Participações S.A.

Name: Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E.
Description: Taaleem Management Services Company provides private higher education and skills-based learning services in Egypt. It operates Nahda University Badya University and Memphis University. The company was formerly known as Bisco Investment Company and changed its name to Taaleem Management Services Company S.A.E. in July 2016. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat
Description: The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat provides direct-to-home (DTH) broadcasting satellite broadband and other communication services in Egypt the Middle East and North Africa. It operates fleet of satellites including Nilesat 201 and Nilesat 301; and geostationary satellites that delivers a range of television channels radio stations and data and internet connectivity solutions to households businesses and governmental organizations. The company also offers satellite services including KA-BAND broadband services and KU-BAND and EXT. KU-BAND broadcasting services. In addition it provides teleport services such as OTT and video streaming satellite uplink and downlink services DTH playout and backhauling solutions and occasional TV solutions. Further the company offers gateway operations and consultancy services; broadcasting services including free-to-air and encrypted television channels radio stations and interactive services; satellite-based broadband and data services to support internet connectivity in underserved areas; and serves as a primary distribution platform for various Arabic-language broadcasters which includes content in various genres such as news sports entertainment and educational programming. The Egyptian Satellite Company Nilesat was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A.
Description: Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. operates as an insurance broker in Brazil. The company offers financial and insurance products including individual and corporate insurance consortia capitalization and private pension plans. It is involved in prospecting activation support insurance and financial products through car dealership networks and training for the sale of credit and credit-related insurance products. The company was formerly known as Wiz Soluções e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. Wiz Co Participações e Corretagem de Seguros S.A. was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Brasília Brazil.

Name: Munshaat Real Estate Projects Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Munshaat Real Estate Projects Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the ownership development sale and purchase of real estate properties in Kuwait and internationally. The company also owns operates manages rents and invests in hotels clubs motels entertainment houses rest places gardens parks exhibitions restaurants cafes commercial complex residential compounds touristic and health spas entertainment and sports facilities stores and appended facilities as well as offers real estate consultancy services. In addition it is involved in the maintenance works for buildings and real estate properties such as civil mechanical and electrical and elevator and air conditioning works; and organizing exhibitions related to the real estate projects and auctions as well as develops and manages real estate investment funds. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited
Description: Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited together with its subsidiaries provides banking and other related services in Kenya Tanzania Uganda and Burundi. The company offers current savings salary accounts and fixed deposits; mortgage and term loans; and overdrafts hire purchase credit guarantee scheme insurance premium financing leasing and trade finance as well as debit and credit cards. It also provides Diaspora banking money transfer POS acquiring agency banking Agri Biz Loans mobile banking internet banking treasury automated teller machines and payment solutions; and bancassurance general insurance and medical insurance products. The company was formerly known as Diamond Trust of Kenya and changed its name to Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited in 1997. Diamond Trust Bank Kenya Limited was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Metalfrio Solutions S.A.
Description: Metalfrio Solutions S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures imports and sells domestic and commercial refrigerators and freezers in Brazil Turkey Mexico the United States and internationally. The company offers horizontal and vertical freezers and refrigerators conservators inverters storage units ice cream freezers beverage displays coolers breweries display and glass doors beer max and all black equipment under the Metalfrio Klimasan Derby and Caravell brands. It also provides maintenance and technical assistance; sells spare parts; offers logistic services; leases related goods and services; and refurbishment services. The company exports its products. Metalfrio Solutions S.A. was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Compañía Industrial El Volcán S.A.
Description: Compañía Industrial El Volcán S.A. produces and sells construction materials in Chile and internationally. The company offers thermal insulation and acoustic absorptions; asphalt shingles accessories and fixing and moisture barriers; vapor barrier manhole covers valcanoboarding and volcanoes; volcoglasses; invisible seam cornerbacks septum repair partition plasters putties volcastic and façade installation tools; and passive fire protection products as well as pastes compounds and joint treatment tapes. It offers its products to housing health hospitality education industrial commercial and work space sectors. The company was founded in 1916 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Zona Franca de Iquique S.A.
Description: Zona Franca de Iquique S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates premises for wholesale and retail business centers in the duty-free zones of South America. It operates distribution center for domestic and international goods; logistics center; and mall commercial area and industrial parks. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Iquique Chile.

Name: Paz Corp S.A.
Description: Paz Corp S.A. a real estate company engages in housing projects development business in Chile and Peru. The company develops apartments and houses as well as office and other real estate projects like offices shops strip centers malls etc. Paz Corp S.A. was founded in 1982 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Armac Locação Logística e Serviços S.A.
Description: Armac Locação Logística e Serviços S.A. engages in leasing machines equipment and services in Brazil. The company offers trucks forklifts excavators telescopic handlers skid steer loader mini excavators motor graders wheel loaders backhoes road rollers crawler tractors wheel tractors and pavers. Armac Locação Logística e Serviços S.A. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil.

Name: Casa Grande S.A.A.
Description: Casa Grande S.A.A. engages in the cultivation industrialization and marketing of sugar cane in Peru. It operates through Sugar and Derivatives; and Grape and Blueberry segments. The company offers products derived from cane such as brown sugar refined white sugar ethyl alcohol molasses and sugarcane bagasse. It is also involved in the cultivation packaging conservation transformation and industrialization of grapes blueberries and other agricultural products. The company was formerly known as Empresa Agroindustrial Casa Grande and changed its name to Casa Grande S.A.A. in April 2008. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Chocope Peru. Casa Grande S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Corporación Azucarera del Perú S.A.

Name: Ibnsina Pharma
Description: Ibnsina Pharma operates as a pharmaceutical distributor in Egypt. The company offers pharmaceutical and cosmetics products to private and public-sector customers including retail chains independent pharmacies wholesalers hospitals and healthcare institutions. It also provides warehousing and logistic services for its suppliers; marketing solutions; importation and packaging services; and market research and analysis services as well as value added services. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Cartavio S.A.A.
Description: Cartavio S.A.A. engages in the cultivation processing and industrialization of sugarcane in Peru. It produces refined white and brown sugar; rectified and industrial ethyl alcohol; and other products such as molasses and bagasse. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Cartavio Peru. Cartavio S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Corporación Azucarera del Perú S.A.

Name: Gulf Hotels Group B.S.C.
Description: Gulf Hotels Group B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries owns operates and manages hotels and restaurants. The company operates in three segments: Hotel Room Operations Food and Beverages and Investments and Other Activities. It owns and operates the Gulf Hotel Gulf Hotel Bahrain Convention and Spa Gulf Executive Offices Gulf Executive Residence Gulf Brands International Gulf Hotel Laundry Services Gulf Executive Residence Juffair Asdal Gulf Inn Boutique Hotel Novotel Bahrain Al Dana Resort Gulf Convention Centre Ocean Paradise Resort Zanzibar Gulf Court Hotel Business Bay Crowne Plaza Bahrain GHG Colombo and Bahrain Airport Hotel. The company also provides management services to Asdal Gulf-inn Seef in the Kingdom of Bahrain; laundry services; group support services; imports and sells alcohol beverages; interior and building design of catering facilities and landscape and recreational design services; computer and telephone system selection and layout; marketing advertising and promotion; supervision of building repair and maintenance; staff recruitment orientation and training services; and energy saving and security systems. In addition it engages in the construction supervision and liaison; production of brochures folders and menus; materials purchasing; marketing surveys; development of operating plan and budget as well as collateral materials; recruitment management; set-up of financial accounting and control systems; negotiation of leases licenses and concessions with third parties; provision of family entertainment; and coordination and execution of hotel opening. Further the company is involved in the rental and management of executive apartments and offices; retail sale of food and beverages; and executive apartments. Gulf Hotels Group B.S.C. was incorporated in 1967 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P. operates as an investment and finance company in Kuwait. It operates in four segments: Financing Investment Real Estate and Education. The company grants real estate industrial all other types of loans and short medium and long term loans to individuals and corporate to finance the purchase of land and properties and to companies and institutions to finance their activities against securities; and manages a range of investment portfolio and collective investment schemes as well as involved in investment of surplus funds and securities leasing service gifts and accessories mediation in lending and borrowing operations financing and mediation in trade operations and health care services. It is also involved in general trading activities; organization of public auctions; provision of educational services; and trades develops and manages real estate projects as well as operates and manages schools. The company was formerly known as Housing Finance Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P. in December 2016. Unicap Investment and Finance Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A.
Description: Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development production and sale of veterinary drugs vaccines and other products for production and companion animals primarily in Brazil. The company operates through three segments: Production Animals; Companion Animals; and International Operations. It manufactures and trades in medicines including anti-inflammatories antibiotics anticoccidials antimastitics ectoparasiticides endectocides endoparasiticides hemoparasiticides inoculants therapeutics products for animal reproduction and vaccines; and performance-enhancing additives probiotics and other veterinary products for cattle swine poultry sheep horses and goats as well as manufacturing services. The company also manufactures veterinary solutions for dogs and cats such as anesthetics sedatives anti-inflammatory antibiotic antimicrobial dermatological ectoparasiticide endoparasiticide dermocosmetic and otological products. In addition it offers vaccines and other veterinary products for production and companion animals. The company was formerly known as A.H.N.S.P.E. Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. Ouro Fino Saúde Animal Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Cravinhos Brazil.

Name: Nampak Limited
Description: Nampak Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of packaging products in South Africa and rest of Africa. The company offers beverage food and aerosol cans; and other metal packaging products. It also provides date/batch small character ink jet and large character ink jet coding; laser coding technologies; thermal transfer overprinting; thermal inkjet printing; marking addressing barcoding and labelling solutions; metal detection; X-ray inspection; package integrity inspection/pressure or vacuum loss detection; and fume extraction systems. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Stokvis Nord Afrique S.A.
Description: Stokvis Nord Afrique S.A. engages in the import and distribution of technical equipment in Morocco. The company is involved in the importation and distribution of new construction equipment such as compact or hydraulic excavators loaders backhoe loaders compactors graders and crawler bulldozers as well as spare parts; and distributes equipment for other sectors such as dumpers used in mines and quarries forklifts and crushers. It engages in the rental of industrial equipment. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Bouskoura Morocco.

Name: CGE Transmisión S.A.
Description: CGE Transmisión S.A. operates in the electric power transmission sector primarily in the zonal transmission and dedicated transmission segments. The company has 3639 kilometers of zonal transmission lines and transformer substations totaling 8932 MVA of installed power. It also designs builds and operates dedicated transmission solution to meet the needs of its customers. The company is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Salam International Investment Limited Q.P.S.C.
Description: Salam International Investment Limited Q.P.S.C. establishes incorporates acquires and owns enterprises in contracting energy and industry consumer and luxury products technology real estate and development sectors in Qatar and internationally. The company offers information technology (IT) IT consulting electronic system installation and maintenance and mechanical services; and building and facilities management investment and oil and gas services. It also engages in civil contracting and furniture trading activities; trading and maintenance of refrigerators water coolers and air conditioners; consulting and managerial studies; and manufacturing of switchgears. In addition the company involved in trading of chemical materials water equipment IT equipment and computer networks; maintenance of oil equipment; steel and aluminum works; aluminum and powder coating services; managing of restaurants and bakeries; real estate; interior design; and furniture and interior manufacturing businesses. Further the company engages in the retail and wholesale of luxury consumer products; marketing and offices facility; construction and supply of landscaping related materials; manufacture of bowls and boxes of cardboards; installation operation and maintenance of cameras and security surveillance systems; and investment in securities. Salam International Investment Limited Q.P.S.C. was founded in 1952 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Ânima Holding S.A.
Description: Ânima Holding S.A. operates as an education organization in Brazil. It operates in two segments Inspirali Medical Education and Ânima Core. The company provides undergraduate courses in medicine; educational services in higher education and professional training courses; and professional development services in postgraduate courses. It also offers consultancy services in technological innovation technical support and maintenance; and develops computer programs. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. engages in the real estate investment and development activities in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates and Egypt. The company operates through Real Estate Hotels and Investment segments. It is involved in commercial real estate activities such as purchase and sale of lands and properties. The company also involved in the establishment acquisition and management of hotels; and tourism activities. In addition it invests in shares and share capital of the companies. Al-Arabiya Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Damaan Islamic Insurance Company "Beema" (Q.P.S.C.)
Description: Damaan Islamic Insurance Company Beema" (Q.P.S.C.) provides a range of insurance products and services in Qatar. It operates through five business segments: Marine and Aviation; Motor Insurance; Fire & General Accidents; Takaful and Medical insurance; and Investments. The company offers retail insurance products such as motor travel home domestic help accident individual life marine and caravan insurance. It also provides corporate insurance products including group health group life aviation marine hull miscellaneous engineering liability workmen’s compensation and property insurance. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Lusail Qatar."

Name: Bell Equipment Limited
Description: Bell Equipment Limited designs manufactures exports distributes and supports a range of heavy equipment for the mining and quarrying construction forestry agriculture and industry sectors in South Africa Rest of Africa and Europe. It operates through Manufacturing Assembly Logistics and Dealer Sales Operations – South Africa; Manufacturing Assembly Logistics and Dealer Sales Operations – Europe; Direct Sales Operations – South Africa; and Direct Sales Operations – Rest of Africa segments. The company offers articulated dump trucks (ADT) water tankers motor graders tracked carriers and articulated haulers; backhoe skid steer and wheel loaders; compaction; excavators telehandlers and rough terrain forklifts; and crushers screeners and conveyors for the mining and construction industries. It also provides forklifts and versalifts haulage tractors loggers and cane loaders logpro and canepro skoggers slew loaders and timber trucks; telecopic wheel loaders and loadalls; and attachments comprising cross-cut grapples felling and harvesting heads pickaroons and stem and timber grapples for the forestry and agriculture industries. In addition the company offers aftermarket products and services; spare parts lubricants and service kits; apprentice operator and technical training services; care packages and extended cover; product support services; and Fleetm@tic a fleet management tool. It sells its products under the BELL JCB KOBELCO and FINLAY brands through a network of customer service centers and independent dealers. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Richards Bay South Africa. Bell Equipment Limited is a subsidiary of I A Bell and Company (Pty) Limited.

Name: Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C.
Description: Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiary National Company for Aggregate Import & Sale W.L.L trades in construction materials in Kuwait. It operates through Cement Steel Aggregate and Ready Mix; and Investments segments. The company is involved in the import and sale of aggregates; transportation of liquids liquid gases chemicals and solid and liquid waste; extraction reprocessing and packaging of sand; processing of construction waste; processing and disposal of non-hazardous wastes; warehousing and storage; chemical storage; retail sale of construction materials and scraps; and gravel crusher activities. It also distributes ready-mixed concrete cement gypsum bricks tiles ceramics marbles building materials metallic construction materials plumbing and heating supplies sand gravel steel blacksmithing supplies and related materials and equipment; and holds properties and movable assets. In addition the company manufactures and sells prefabricated and ready-mix concrete and cement bricks; invests in financial surpluses in financial portfolios managed by specialized companies or entities; buys and sells shares bonds and motor vehicles; operates car repair garages auto bodywork workshops and car painting and coating workshops; and imports gravel and chemicals. Kuwait Portland Cement Co. K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Rainbow Chicken Limited
Description: Rainbow Chicken Limited operates as an integrated chicken/broiler producer in the Republic of South Africa. It processes distributes and markets a range of frozen fresh and further-processed added-value chicken products under the Rainbow Rainbow Ready2Go Rainbow Simply Chicken Rainbow FlavourBurst and Farmer Brown brand names. The company also produces a range of grain-based animal feed products under the Epol and Driehoek Feeds brands. In addition it processes wastewater from chicken processing plants and poultry manure from chicken farms to generate electricity heat and recycled water as well as converts wastewater from the chicken processing plant into biogas. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Irene the Republic of South Africa.

Name: QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. operates as a life and medical insurance company in Qatar. It operates through two segments: Medical and Life. The company offers group and individual and group medical insurance; retirement and child insurance plans; and senior citizens and visitors mandatory health insurance. It also underwrites reinsurance products in the GCC region and internationally. QLM Life & Medical Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2011 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A
Description: Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A provides financing solutions in Morocco. It offers financing solutions for personal automobile journey and life events. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Societe d'Equipement Domestique et Menager (EQDOM) S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Société Générale Marocaine de Banques.

Name: Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education
Description: Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education together with its subsidiaries operates as an integrated provider of educational services in Egypt. It operates through School and Higher Education segments. The company offers K-12 and higher education services. It owns and operates K-12 schools under the Mavericks BCCIS Saxony International School Regent International School Futures Futures Language Schools and Rising Stars brands; and nurseries under the KidzGround STEAMulation and Discovery Campus brands. The company also provides transport services to students. Cairo For Investment And Real Estate Developments-CIRA Education was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides various banking products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates in three segments: Corporate Retail and Investment. The company offers current salary cheque savings call vevo RERA escrow and investment accounts; investment deposits; financing products such as personal property Ministry of Housing programs auto working capital capital expenditure enterprise export Bahrain special project and short and long-term financing as well as specialized trade financing instruments. It also provides debit and credit cards; remittances and foreign exchange transactions drafts and managerial cheques cash management and trade finance services; interbank tools and investment and hedging instruments; and payroll wealth management investment banking and custody services. In addition the company offers online and mobile banking automated and interactive teller machine services and bulk cash deposit machines; and money market trading and treasury services as well as handles debt and equity investments; and invests in real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Islamic Bank B.S.C. is a subsidiary of The National Bank of Bahrain B.S.C.

Name: Industrias del Cobre Sociedad Anónima
Description: Industrias del Cobre Sociedad Anónima engages in the manufacture and sale of wires and electrical and telecommunication cables and conductors in Peru and internationally. The company offers low voltage conductors cords fire safety cables and bare copper conductors; and low voltage aerial distribution cables medium voltage low fire hazard sheathed cables medium voltage PVC sheathed cables medium voltage PE sheathed cables and bare conductors. It also provides mining cables such as medium voltage cables for fixed installations and low voltage infrastructure cables; and cables for solar farms and rooftops. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Lima Peru. Industrias del Cobre Sociedad Anónima operates as a subsidiary of Invercable S.A.

Name: United Capital Plc
Description: United Capital Plc together with its subsidiaries provides investment banking portfolio management securities trading and trusteeship services in Nigeria. It operates through Investment Banking Asset Management Wealth Management Trustees Securities Trading Consumer Finance and UCEE MFB segments. The company offers issuing house corporate investment advisory project finance debt restructuring mergers and acquisitions asset management wealth management and debt capital market services. It also provides trust services such as debenture trust; bond trusteeship to corporate and sub-sovereign issuers of public debt instruments; trustees to collective investment schemes; and private and security trusts. In addition the company offers pay day loans and consumer lending; stockbroking; and securities trading services including receiving agents to new issues stockbrokers to primary issues and advisers to SMEs as well as equity portfolio management and securities dealing services. It serves governments; micro small and medium scale enterprises; institutions; high net worth individuals; and other individuals. The company was formerly known as UBA Capital PLC and changed its name to United Capital Plc in December 2014. United Capital Plc was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: First Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: First Investment Company K.S.C.C. is a Shariah compliant privately owned investment manager. The firm also provides treasury services to its clients. It primarily provides its services to institutional investors and high net worth individuals. The firm manages client focused portfolios for its clients. It also launches and manages mutual funds. The firm offers a range of Islamic financial products such as Murabaha and Ijara. It also invests in public equity. First Investment Company K.S.C.C. was formed on July 26 1997 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Canal Shipping Agencies Company
Description: Canal Shipping Agencies Company provides various shipping services to the international commercial fleet in Egypt. It offers shipping services on Suez Canal transit Port Said Ports Red Sea Al-Arish and Damietta. The company also provides services including canal tourism freight forwarding sailors and parcel cargo handling and spare parts as well as legal services comprising marine insurance settlement of marine general average and collision and other related legal services. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Port Said Egypt. Canal Shipping Agencies Company is a subsidiary of The Holding Company for Maritime and Land Transport.

Name: Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public) an investment holding company manages a portfolio of investments across various sectors in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Financial Services (Real Estate) Pharma Education Food and Beverage IT Solutions and Oil and Construction segments. The company invests in real estate industrial agriculture and other sectors; buys and sells in shares sukuk and other securities; develops the infrastructure of residential commercial and industrial areas; and manages real estate facilities by built operate and transfer system. It also invests in financial real estate and investment portfolios; and provides lending and guarantee services. In addition the company deals and trades in the foreign exchange and precious metals market. Further it owns property rights patents trademarks or industrial models franchising rights and other intangible rights. Additionally the company engages in real estate media general trading investment and educational catering services; and provision of IT professional audio visual and enterprise software solutions to public and private sectors as well as specialized graduate studies. It also offers grinding and packaging of spices grains and herbs; provides oil and construction services; and branded generic pharmaceuticals. The company was formerly known as Al Imtiaz Investment Company - K.S.C. (Public). Al Imtiaz Investment Group Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Khaleeji Bank B.S.C.
Description: Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. provides various banking products and services to retail customers corporate clients high net worth individuals and financial institutions in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through two segments Banking and Investments. The company offers various corporate and retail banking products and services that include Mudharaba deposits savings current term deposits and salary accounts; and fund transfer and bill payment services as well as money market and treasury services. It also provides personal home auto real estate and consumer finance products; letters of credit; wealth management services; structured investment products; project financing; debit and credit cards; doctors financing scheme; SIO finance; insurance products; SME financing; and online and mobile banking services. In addition the company offers investment banking products and services such as deals structuring raising of funds through private placement and fund administration services; and carries out strategic investments in the form of equity contribution as well as engages in the construction and selling of properties and issuing additional tier 1 certificates. It provides its products and services through branches located in Bahrain Financial Harbor Hidd Sanad and Riffa. The company was formerly known as Khaleeji Commercial Bank BSC and changed its name to Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. in June 2023. Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Khaleeji Bank B.S.C. is a subsidiary of GFH Financial Group BSC.

Name: Voltamp Energy SAOG
Description: Voltamp Energy SAOG together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and sells transformers medium and low voltage switchgears and panels in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers power transformers; corrugated type special duty hermetically sealed type solar inverter duty and earthing transformers; motor duty booster isolation and furnace transformers; solar power green energy and wind transformers as well as solar skid solutions; and dry type distribution transformers. The company also provides package sub-station solutions; reactors; and MV and LV switchgears as well as repair overhauling and maintenance services of transformers and switchgears for utilities oil and gas companies power plants industrial and government sectors etc. It offers its products for various applications including power generation and distribution power transmission infrastructure renewable offshore and railway. The company also exports its products. Voltamp Energy SAOG was founded in 1987 and is based in Rusayl the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: KAP Limited
Description: KAP Limited engages in industrial chemical and logistics businesses in South Africa rest of Africa the Americas Europe the Middle East and Australasia. It operates through six segments: PG Bison Safripol Unitrans Feltex Sleep Group and Optix. It manufactures and sells polyethylene terephthalate high-density polyethylene and polypropylene products. In addition the company offers foam sprung fabric and industrial foams and mattresses as well as provides technology-enabled driver behaviour management solutions. The company also operates timber plantations a sawmill a pole plant and production facilities for wood-based decorative panel products. It serves automotive components consumer agriculture petrochemical mining and passenger transport sectors. KAP Limited was formerly known as KAP Industrial Holdings Limited and changed its name to KAP Limited in April 2023. KAP Limited is headquartered in Stellenbosch South Africa.

Name: Irbid District Electricity Co. Ltd.
Description: Irbid District Electricity Co. Ltd. engages in the distribution of electric power in Jordan. It serves retail consumers. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Irbid Jordan. Irbid District Electricity Co. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Electricity Distribution Company.

Name: Siniora Food Industries Company
Description: Siniora Food Industries Company engages in the canning packaging distribution and trading of chilled meat in Jordan. The company is involved in the retail of cold cuts frozen products canned products and plant-based products as well as Horeca cold cuts and frozen products; peppers spices olives pistachios and vegetables; chicken and turkey; and luncheon meat salami and sausages under the Siniora UNIUM Polanez Almasa and BADEEL brand names. It exports its products to Palestine Syria Lebanon Saudi Arabia the United Arab Emirates Kuwait Qatar Oman Yemen and Bahrain. The company was founded in 1920 and is based in Sahab Jordan. Siniora Food Industries Company is a subsidiary of Arab Palestinian Investment Company.

Name: Companhia CELG de Participações S/A
Description: Companhia CELG de Participações S/A engages in the generation of electricity. It generates electricity from hydro power plants. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Goiânia Brazil.

Name: Watt's S.A.
Description: Watt's S.A. manufactures and sells food products in Chile Argentina Peru and Internationally. It operates in Food Business and Wine Business segments. The company offers liquid and powdered milk dairy beverages oils jams preserves creams manjar juices and nectars yogurt cheese butter fruit pulp tomato sauce frozen vegetables and fruits fruit-based beverages and dairy-based beverages. It also owns and operates wine-producing valleys. The company sells its products under the Calo Sureña Loncoleche Danone Activia Danone Light & Free Oikos San Rafael Las Parcelas de Valdivia Calan Crucina Astra and Watt's Frugo Yogu Yogu Shake a Shake Danone Griego FRUTOS DEL MAIPO La Reina SANTA CAROLINA Dampezzo Frito Master Plus Gastonomico Pamperita Mazola Los Lagos Regimel Chef Belmont Cristal and Wasil brands. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in San Bernardo Chile. Watt's S.A. is a subsidiary of Chacabuco S.A.

Name: National Finance Company SAOG
Description: National Finance Company SAOG offers financial products and services to individuals small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and corporate entities in the Sultanate of Oman. The company provides corporate deposits; and new and used vehicles used vehicles consumer durables equipment and warehouse financing services as well as working capital debt factoring guarantee and sale and lease back services as well as green finance service. It operates through its branches in the Sultanate of Oman. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E.
Description: alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E. provides corporate and retail banking and investments services in Egypt and internationally. The company offers savings and current accounts certificate of deposits and time deposits; debit and credit cards; and personal mortgage auto education and other financing products. It also provides corporate banking products such as financing channels structured finance and syndication investment and securities custody and clearing corporate service desk global transactional banking; financing of small medium enterprise; and commercial activities medical program and Izdehar. In addition the company offers banking services such as payroll exchange rates investment funds investment trustees custodian services financial inclusion international limit Tharaa and schedule of charge. Further it provides internet banking mobile banking and ATMs network services. The company was formerly known as Egyptian Saudi Finance Bank and changed its name to alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E. in April 2009. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in New Cairo Egypt. alBaraka Bank Egypt S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Al Baraka Group B.S.C.

Name: Al Eid Food Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al Eid Food Company K.S.C. (Public) engages in the import distribution and trade of food products in Kuwait. It supplies bee honey; and offers food stuff real-made meals and vegetable products. The company was formerly known as ALEid Company for General Trading and Contracting WLL. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al Eid Food Company K.S.C. (Public) is a subsidiary of Dalqan Holding Company K.S.C. (Holding).

Name: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P.
Description: JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. provides ports management warehousing contract logistics equipment leasing and power rental services in Kuwait and rest of GCC. The company offers container handling RORO heavy lift break bulk vessels and aggregate cargo handling; handling of container terminal and general cargo; transportation; reefer plugging facility; and value added services including weighbridge general transportation and project logistics and advanced ERP management system. It also provides bulk transportation and customs clearance support services and turnkey solutions; temperature controlled warehouses client warehouse management system and inventory management; equipment leasing services including cranes heavy lift material handling equipment portable welding machines screw compressors tower lights man lifts excavators and wheel loaders; and power rental services such as diesel generators transformers fuel tanks power accessories as well as value added services comprising engineering design and consulting installation and commissioning project management and maintenance and support services. In addition the company is involved in buys sells rents hires and imports trucks vehicles and equipment and machinery; clearance shipping and stevedoring operations for imported and issued goods and packaging goods; and ground support services for passengers as well as airport management services for aircraft and aviation-related goods. The company was formerly known as Jassim Transport & Stevedoring Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to JTC Logistics Transportation & Stevedoring Co. K.S.C.P. in November 2024. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. operates as a real estate investment and management company in Brazil. The company is involved in management of own or third-party real estate developments including shopping malls centers; purchase and sale of ready-made or under-construction residential and commercial properties; leasing of real estate; and operation of rotating parking. Its portfolio includes office buildings and convenience centers. São Carlos Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Lewis Group Limited
Description: Lewis Group Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the retail of household furniture home appliances electronic goods and homewares in South Africa Botswana Lesotho Eswatini and Namibia. It operates through Traditional and Speciality segments. The company retails electrical appliances; sound and vision equipment; beds and mattresses; and various furniture products through its stores under the Lewis Best Home and Electric Bedzone United Furniture Outlets and Beares brands. It also provides microinsurance to customers purchasing merchandise on credit under the Monarch Insurance brand. Lewis Group Limited was founded in 1934 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC markets and sells of petroleum products and energy solutions in Kenya and internationally. The company offers excellium fuels and kerosene; and petrol diesel lubricants and car care products. It also provides liquefied petroleum gas and solar lanterns through service stations and authorized distributor outlets. In addition the company offers logistics and facilities services; and car wash and care services. Further it operates a convenience shop under the Bonjour brand name that provides various products and services including banks ATMs chemists dry cleaners barber shops florists and restaurants in collaboration with other third-party partners; and coffee shops under the café bonjour Java on the go Java Express Art Caffe’ to Go and Mugg & Bean names as well as service bay stations with trained mechanics under the Quartz Auto service name and TotalEnergies Card a fleet management solution for fleet managers. It also exports its products. TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC was formerly known as Total Kenya Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC in July 2021. The company was founded in 1955 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. TotalEnergies Marketing Kenya PLC operates as a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing Afrique SAS.

Name: Central Costanera S.A.
Description: Central Costanera S.A. generates transports trades and distributes electrical energy in Argentina. It owns and operates four conventional turbo steam units with an installed capacity of 661 MW; two cycles energy plant with an installed capacity of 851 MW; a gas turbine; and a BTH steam turbine with an installed capacity of 277 MW. The company provides engineering consultancy and management services for operation of electrical power plants. The company was formerly known as Enel Generación Costanera S.A. and changed its name to Central Costanera S.A. in March 2023. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. The company operates as a subsidiary of Enel Argentina S.A.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Collins Property Group Limited
Description: Collins Property Group Limited an investment holding company owns develops manages and leases real estate properties. Its portfolio includes retail office industrial residential and leisure properties. The company is also involved in the ownership and development of commercial properties as well as provision of rental and treasury services. It operates in South Africa Mozambique Namibia Zambia Austria Switzerland Luxembourg Malta and Mauritius. The company was formerly known as Tradehold Limited and changed its name to Collins Property Group Limited in June 2023. Collins Property Group Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Umhlanga South Africa.

Name: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc
Description: The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc engages in the transmission distribution and retail of electricity in Kenya. It purchases electricity generated from geothermal hydro thermal solar cogeneration and wind sources. The company was formerly known as East Africa Power & Lighting Limited and changed its name to The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc in October 1983. The Kenya Power and Lighting Company Plc was incorporated in 1922 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Misr Hotels Company
Description: Misr Hotels Company engages in the tourism and hotel business in Egypt. The company constructs buys and sells hotels resorts casinos and restaurants. It operates the Nile Ritz Carlton Hotel in Cairo; and the Safir Dahab Resort Hotel in Dahab. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A.
Description: Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides oncology hematology radiotherapy and genomics healthcare services in Latin America. The company offers treatment services including radiotherapy hormone therapy immunotherapy port-a-cath palliative care target therapy breast cancer hormone therapy bone marrow transplant non-oncological infusions chemotherapy oral chemotherapy and prostate cancer hormone therapy; and surgery procedures such as breast head and neck lung prostate cancer stomach bladder cancer oncological kidney cancer gynecological and testicular cancer. It also provides diagnostics services comprising pathological analysis genetic testing molecular journey personalized medicine and individualized treatment myelogram-bone marrow biopsy and ONCO test-PDO. In addition the company offers treatment support services which include veinviewer cryotherapy integrative medicine and DeLife as well as hilotherapy laser therapy OC care line OC precision medicine OncoACCESS survivorship and telemedicine services. Oncoclínicas do Brasil Serviços Médicos S.A. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Autopistas Del Sol SA
Description: Autopistas Del Sol SA is involved in the construction expansion remodeling preservation improvement operation and administration of highways. It operates the North Access a 95-kilometer highway that connects the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires with the suburbs in the north and nearby coastal areas; and the General Paz Beltway highway a 24-kilometer toll-free section of the primary ring road that surrounds the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: JMMB Group Limited
Description: JMMB Group Limited provides a range of financial services for individual business corporate and institutional clients in Jamaica North America Trinidad and Tobago Barbados the Dominican Republic and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Financial and Related Services Banking and Related Services and Other. The Financial and Related Services segment offers securities brokering stock brokering portfolio planning funds management and investment advisory services. The Banking and Related Services segment is involved in accepting deposits; granting of loans and other credit facilities; foreign currency trading; and provision of remittance and related services. The Other segment provides insurance brokering investment and real estate holding services. The company also offers savings and loans commercial and merchant banking; consumer financing; mutual fund administration; and pension funds administration services. JMMB Group Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Hermes Transportes Blindados S.A.
Description: Hermes Transportes Blindados S.A. provides money and securities transfer custody and processing and document transfer services in Peru. The company offers sending and collecting banknotes coins precious metals jewelry and other high-value items to and/or from the requested destination; prepare and transfer the banknotes to supply the indicated ATM; administration of premises and agencies; vault management; and specialized services for mining sector. It also provides Hermeticase a device that allows receiving validating accounting for deposits made viewing movements online and generating reports for accounting closings. In addition the company offers corporate messaging services including transport of documents and national packages local distribution internal messaging and custody of documents and back ups; business processing services such as digitization and digitalization of documents verification and validation attention to commercial requirements accounting registration and analysis of invoices and card insertion services. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Chorrillos Peru. Hermes Transportes Blindados S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Maiz Jersey Limited.

Name: Telekom Networks Malawi plc
Description: Telekom Networks Malawi plc provides telecommunication services to enterprises and individual customers in Malawi. It operates in two segments Telecommunications and Mobile Money. The company provides a range of communication products and services including voice internet access bundles international dialing and roaming and value-added services as well as prepaid tariff plans. It also offers prepaid data international incoming messaging enterprise business postpaid and roaming services. In addition the company provides internet and virtual private network; session initiation protocol and PBX; home broadband; hosting; managed cloud; mobile phone contracts; mobile advertising; and 5G solutions as well as communications solutions to small and medium enterprises. Further it offers a range of mobile money services including money transfers cash withdrawals bill payments cash deposits and merchant payments. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Blantyre Malawi.

Name: Kuwait Business Town Real Estate Company - KPSC
Description: Kuwait Business Town Real Estate Company - KPSC engages in real estate business in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates the United States and Europe. The company operates through Investment and Real Estate segments. It develops owns purchase and sale real estate and lands; and shares and bonds of real estate entities. The company also offers maintenance works execution of civil mechanical electrical elevators and air conditioning works to ensure protection and safety of buildings as well as consultancy services. In addition it manages operates invests in rents and leases hotels clubs motels guest houses parks gardens showrooms restaurants cafeterias housing complexes touristic and health resorts recreational and athletic projects and stores with auxiliary services accompanying facilities and other services; and commercial malls and residential complexes. In addition the company establishes and manages real estate funds; invests surplus fund available with company by investing in financial and real estate portfolios; contributes to the development of infrastructure of areas and residential commercial and industrial projects using build-operate-transfer system and manages through it; and holds real estate auctions. Kuwait Business Town Real Estate Company - KPSC was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: British American Tobacco Uganda Limited
Description: British American Tobacco Uganda Limited engages in the importation distribution and sale of cigarettes in Uganda. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. British American Tobacco Uganda Limited operates as a subsidiary of British American Tobacco p.l.c.

Name: Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A.
Description: Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A. operates in the fishery sector in Peru and internationally. The company offers frozen giant squid jack mackerel mackerel and anchovy for direct human consumption. It also provides indirect human consumption products such as fishmeal that is used for animal breeding in livestock sheep and porcine industry as well as in aquaculture; and fish oil which is used in the aquaculture industry as well as for human consumption as health supplement capsules. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Lima Peru. Pesquera Exalmar S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Caleta de Oro Holding del Perú S.A.C.

Name: Jordan Commercial Bank
Description: Jordan Commercial Bank provides banking and financial products and services to corporate retail and investment clients in Jordan and internationally. The company offers deposit products such as fixed deposit certificate of deposit and current accounts; personal housing and auto loans; debit credit and pre-paid cards; electronic payment services; and safe deposit boxes fast cash salary advance Tejari express and autosave services. It also provides financing for restaurants; fixed assets and working capital; renewable energy educational industrial IT architectural and entrepreneurs start-up projects; and point of sale financing as well as business loans. In addition the company offers overdraft revolving loans discounted bills term loans letters of credit letter of guarantee bills for collection and export loans; and liabilities and cash management services.
