Further it offers investment services such as cash dealing margin trading custody services investment management financial consultancy issue management trust services and safekeeping services; and spot and forward foreign currency trading services. The company operates through its branches and ATMs. Jordan Commercial Bank was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A.
Description: Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. provides stock over the counter markets services for equity fixed income derivative and foreign exchange services in Colombia. The company offers listing services to issuer and issues; trading services through electronic trading and recording platforms; post trading services which consist of settlement clearing collateral management custody and securities management services; market information and price procurement services; and core banking and securities market system implementation services as well as digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Servicios Integrados Bursátiles S.A. and changed its name to Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. in June 2001. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Bogota Colombia. Bolsa de Valores de Colombia S.A. is a subsidiary of Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.

Name: Jordanian Duty Free Shops
Description: Jordanian Duty Free Shops invests in operates and manages duty-free shops. Its shops provide a range of products which include fragrances cosmetics accessories confectionary liquors cigarettes and tobacco products for diplomats non-residential foreigners tourists businessmen and pilgrims. Jordanian Duty Free Shops was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a real estate company in Kuwait. The company operates through three segments: Real Estate Activities Entertainment Activities and Equities and Other Investing Activities. The Real Estate Activities segment invests and trades in real estate; constructs or develops real estate properties; and offers other related real estate services. The Entertainment Activities segment owns and operates cinemas; and leases cinemas to governmental and private entities. The Equities and Other Investing Activities segment participates in financial and real estate funds. The company also buys rents leases and sells real estate properties inside and outside of Kuwait; establishes and maintains buildings and real estate projects including residential complexes; establishes commercial markets entertainment centers touristic facilities and building accommodations; engages in contracting works; and trades in building materials. Ajial Real Estate Entertainment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Cemento Polpaico S.A.
Description: Cemento Polpaico S.A. produces and sells cement in Chile. It also offers concrete; and aggregates including sand and gravel. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is based in Santiago Chile. Cemento Polpaico S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Caburga Limitada.

Name: Banco del Caribe C.A. Banco Universal
Description: Banco del Caribe C.A. Banco Universal provides various banking products and financial services. Its deposit products include savings and checking accounts saving accounts for kids foreign currency accounts workers' compensation and demand yield deposits. The company also offers loans for wholesale and retail trade restaurants and hotels communal and social services manufacturing industry agriculture fishing and forestry transport storage communications exploitation of mines and hydrocarbons and construction industry; mortgage loans; auto line finance; and commercial microcredit and CrediMujer. In addition it provides biometric services digital banking mobile payment services foreign exchange operations payment system for services and recharges and credit cards; and cash services including payment to suppliers collection service payment at the box office concentrator accounts collection of values roster and electronic data interchange. Further the company engages in trust operations. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Invicta Holdings Limited
Description: Invicta Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the distribution of engineering components and consumables in South Africa the Rest of Africa Europe and Asia. It operates in Replacement Parts for Industrial Equipment; Replacement Parts for Auto and Agri; Capital Equipment and Related Services; and Replacement Parts for Earthmoving Equipment. The company offers technical services including on-site installation maintenance work breakdown repair condition monitoring failure analysis design engineering and manufacturing services; engineering consumables such as bearings seals and gaskets power transmissions light and heavy materials handling fasteners geared and electric drives and motors; and fluid technology products and solutions comprising hydraulic pneumatic valves pumps filtration hose fittings and lubrication. It also supplies tools and equipment cutting welding lifting personal protective equipment locks and machine tools; imported and local vibrator motors tensioning and suspension systems; and vibrating equipment and material handling solutions. In addition the company manufactures and supplies heavy-duty belting components and imported conveyer belting to the industry. Further it supplies automotive and agricultural after-market replacement parts and kits; forklifts off-road dump trucks and related spare parts; earthmoving and materials-handling equipment; after-market replacement spare parts ground engaging tools and undercarriage parts for earthmoving equipment; aftermarket heavy-duty diesel engine parts for industrial and agricultural machinery; and heavy machinery parts and diesel engine components used for excavators bulldozers wheel loaders motor graders trucks trailers power generation sets and marine engines. Additionally it provides technical support and value-added assembly services. Invicta Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Financiera Oh! S.A.
Description: Financiera Oh! S.A. a finance company provides financial products and services in Peru. The company offers fixed term deposit CTS and savings accounts; cash credit and other loans; credit cards; and insurance against card protection cancer cell phone and others. The company was formerly known as Financiera Uno S.A. and changed its name to Financiera Oh! S.A. on July 15 2016. Financiera Oh! S.A. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Lima Peru. Financiera Oh! S.A. is a subsidiary of IFH Retail Corporation.

Name: Socovesa S.A.
Description: Socovesa S.A. engages in the real estate development and construction businesses under the Almagro Socovesa Pilares and Desarrollos Comerciales brands in Chile. The company constructs various projects such as houses buildings bridges roads dams irrigation works tunnels ports airports and earthworks. It also develops high-rise housing projects. Socovesa S.A. was founded in 1965 and is based in Providencia Chile.

Name: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG
Description: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in milling wheat and other cereals in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in four segments: Flour Mill Feed Mill Bakery and Others. The company offers bread baking health special grain and premix products under the Dahabi and Atyab brands; and cattle and poultry feed products including general ruminant calf rearer sheep cubes camel and horse feed and breeder and pigeon feed under the Barakat brand. It also manufactures sells and distributes fresh and frozen bakery products; sells and distributes confectionery items and other flour related products; and manufactures imports and exports wheat and flour. In addition the company provides laboratory services for testing of materials and chemicals; and consultancy services. Further it engages in investment activities. Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG was founded in 1976 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Hayat Communications Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Hayat Communications Company K.S.C.P. provides construction and communication services. The company engages in the trading and installation of telecommunications and related equipment; electrical communication tools and contracting; maintenance of telecommunication tools; trading of telecommunication materials and systems; information transfer infrastructure and contracting; trade installation management operation and maintenance of telephones and communication devices and tools; trading of communication lines and cards; marketing and leasing of electronic communication devices and internal communication networks; establishment and contracting of information centers and infrastructure; trade installation management operation and maintenance of communication devices and networks security and safety and monitoring devices; preparation of various studies and provision of technical consultation in the field of communications information systems and security services; owning establishing leasing and renting telecommunications networks; and investment business. It also offers mobile phone services paging systems and other telecommunications services as well as computer consultancy services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Inversora Juramento S.A.
Description: Inversora Juramento S.A. operates as an agricultural and livestock company in the northwestern region of Argentina. The company engages in the production industrialization marketing and sale of meat and agricultural products. Its agricultural products include soybeans sorghum alfalfa pastures and corn. The company has approximately 89504 hectares of land located in the province of Salta. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Salta Argentina.

Name: International Company for Agricultural Crops
Description: International Company for Agricultural Crops engages in the agricultural activities in Egypt. The company is also involved in trading and import of agricultural pesticides and fertilizers; and mixing and filling of liquid fertilizers; production of agricultural crops seeds; and trading ginning and export of cotton. It also engages in trading and import of fertilizers and agricultural fertilizers; trading of agricultural crops and seeds; and seed screening. In addition the company offers rice wheat maize legumes beans etc. as well as NPK mixture fertilizers. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Mansoura Egypt.

Name: Injazzat Real Estate Development Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Injazzat Real Estate Development Company is a real estate investment firm. The firm targets real estate opportunities including direct investments in opportunistic lands income generating assets and commercial residential and land developments indirect investments in funds and shares in real estate companies and build-operate-transfer (BOT) projects. Its investment activities involves land trading which includes buying parcels of land for direct resale or to be split into sub-plots and sold to one or more buyers. The firm co-invests with partners who bring added value or specific experience in a particular type of project. Injazzat Real Estate Development Company was founded in 1998 and is based in Safat Kuwait.

Name: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E.
Description: Obour Land for Food Industries S.A.E. manufactures and distributes dairy products in Egypt. The company engages in the packing and pasteurization of liquid dairies cream and natural butter as well as white dry and cooked cheese; and yogurt ice creams biscuits and natural fruit juices. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in El Obour City Egypt.

Name: Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited
Description: Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited provides commercial banking services in Uganda. It offers various deposit products including savings accounts current accounts festival flexible recurring deposits monthly and quarterly income plan for fixed deposit and fixed/short-term deposit accounts. The company also provides loans/advances such as salary multi-purpose housing loans against bank's deposits education traders business and short-term loans; financing against warehouse/storage receipts sales invoice financing suppliers bill discounting and asset finance products as well as loans against future rent receivables and bank deposits. In addition it offers non-fund based services/products comprising letter of credit and bank guarantee services; funds transfer services; foreign exchange services; and lockers Internet banking ATM cards and tax collection services as well as invests in government securities such as treasury bills and treasury bonds. Further the company provides equity brokering services; and investment advisory securities trading securities exchanges listing sponsoring services and remittance services as well as other digital channels comprising mobile banking cash recyclers agent banking SMS alerts automated account statement website and call center services. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. Bank of Baroda (Uganda) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Bank of Baroda Limited.

Name: Electro Cable Egypt
Description: Electro Cable Egypt manufactures and sells power and telecommunication cables in Egypt. It offers enameled copper wires; low medium and high voltage wires and cables; overhead transmission conductors; building wires; and telephone cables. The company also exports its products to Africa Europe and the Arab countries. Electro Cable Egypt was founded in 1954 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Unimer SA
Description: Unimer SA operates in the seafood industry in Morocco. It offers canned sardines and mackerel and semi canned anchovies; and provides fish meal and oil. The company is also involved in deep sea fishing fish farming and freezing businesses. It offers its products primarily under the Princesse Madrigal Walima Conserveries Provençales Belmonte Gourmet La Monegasque Vanelli and Titus brands. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Unimer SA is a subsidiary of Sanam Agro.

Name: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E
Description: Misr Beni Suef Cement Co. S.A.E produces and sells cement products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers clinker and Portland pozzolana cement products. It also exports its products as bulk or bagged cement. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Madinet Masr For Housing and Development
Description: Madinet Masr For Housing and Development engages in development of real estate properties in Egypt. The company develops large scale urban communities. It also provides civil construction and brokerage services. Madinet Masr For Housing and Development was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Madinet Masr For Housing and Development operates as a subsidiary of BIG Investment Group Limited.

Name: Salafin S.A.
Description: Salafin S.A. provides consumer credit to individuals and professionals in Morocco and Africa. The company offers personal loans and revolving loans with or without credit card; mortgage and car loans; and insurance and customer service solutions. It is also involved in offering advisory; and credit scoring and distribution to collection businesses through collection platforms for third parties. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Salafin S.A. is a subsidiary of Bank of Africa.

Name: Egyptian Resorts Company (S.A.E)
Description: Egyptian Resorts Company (S.A.E) develops communities in Egypt. Its flagship project is Sahl Hasheesh a resort located in Red Sea coast. The company acquires land holdings; sells pre-designated land plots to sub-developers for various purposes such as residential communities hotels and entertainment venues office parks schools hospitals and others; and offers infrastructure development and community and property management services. It also provides electricity water and irrigation communication network services and roads and lighting; and develops and operates its own projects including Old Town Jamaran Tawaya and Sawari marina. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Oman Refreshment Company SAOG
Description: Oman Refreshment Company SAOG engages in the filling and distribution of soft drinks water and juices in the Sultanate of Oman. The company holds the franchise rights to produce fill and distribute PepsiCo range of soft drinks and Aquafina Water. It also trades in consumer-packaged goods such as new edge beverages; Lays range of snacks; Quaker range of oat products; Eurocake and EDITA bakery products; Froneri range of ice cream products consisting of Nestle and Mondelez brand name; Dairy and Chilled products including Balade and Barada names; and frozen food products. In addition the company sells vending machines; provides related vending products; and produces and distributes juices under its Topfruit brand name. Further it engages in the buying selling and sub-dividing of real estate into plots; renting and operating of self-owned or leased residential and non-residential real estate; real estate appraisal; export and import business; business agencies activities; and renting of commercial equipment and professional machinery. Oman Refreshment Company SAOG was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A.
Description: Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A. provides products and services related to the financial markets in Peru and internationally. It offers mutual funds investment funds local and foreign stock exchanges and team deposits. It also provides divicambio and private fixed income related services. The company was formerly known as NCF Inversiones SA and changed its name to Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A. in November 2013. Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited
Description: Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited provides banking products and services in Botswana. It operates in two segments Corporate Commercial and Institutional Banking; and Consumer Private & Business Banking. The company offers personal banking products and services such as current call and savings accounts; fixed deposits; personal auto and home loans; credit cards; foreign exchange mutual funds and fixed income securities; and insurance products. It provides business banking products and services including business current savings and call accounts; loans and working capital solutions such as loan against property business mortgages term loans business overdraft and trade solutions; foreign exchange forwards; yield enhancement solutions including fixed and term and fixed income deposit accounts; and cross border services. In addition the company offers corporate and institutional banking products and services comprising cash management trade services syndications and lending treasury services foreign exchange currency options government bonds high yield deposits and other liquidity management products. Further it provides corporate finance advisory hedging and transactional services online and mobile banking as well as ATM services. It serves individuals corporations governments banks and investors. The company was founded in 1897 and is based in Gaborone Botswana. Standard Chartered Bank Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

Name: Mpact Limited
Description: Mpact Limited engages in the paper and plastic packaging and recycling business in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Paper and Plastics segments. The company offers recycled-based packaging and industrial paper such as containerboard and carton board and other materials; corrugated packaging products; bags; and sacks as well as plastic packaging solutions. It serves packaging converters fruit producers FMCG companies and quick restaurant sectors as well as food beverage personal care home care pharmaceutical agricultural and retail markets. The company is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: A'ayan Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: A'ayan Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate development and investment activities in Kuwait and rest of GCC countries. The company operates through Project Management Investments Property Management and Others segments. It owns trades in leases and rents real estate properties; buys develops owns and sells land; and develops establishes and manages commercial residential tourist infrastructure and industrial projects. The company also engages in contracting business related to real estate; trading of construction materials and building supplies; and the provision of building maintenance services. In addition it invests in owns operates manages rents and leases hotels health clubs tourist facilities restaurants and cafeterias residential complexes shops and sports projects. Further the company is involved in the exploitation of investing surplus funds in portfolios. Additionally it invests in and establishes engineering laboratories associated with real estate investment; and provides real estate consultancy services. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Telecomunicações Brasileiras S.A. - Telebras
Description: Telecomunicações Brasileiras S.A. - Telebras provides multimedia communication services. It provides support services for public broadband internet connection for universities research centers schools hospitals service stations telecenters community and others; infrastructure and support networks for telecommunications services; and broadband internet connection services for end users as well as implements private communication network. The company is also involved in the leasing of satellite capacity; and rental of optical cables routers and infrastructure for satellite. Telecomunicações Brasileiras S.A. - Telebras was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Brasília Brazil.

Name: Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E)
Description: Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E) produces and sells cement products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers Portland sulphate resistant and blended pozzolanic cement. It also exports its products to Sudan. Misr Cement (Qena) Company (S.A.E) was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Americanas S.A.
Description: Americanas S.A. operates in the e-commerce business in Brazil. It offers e-commerce digital platform for various digital solutions. The company operates Americanas.com an online store with various products; Ame a platform for financial and non-financial products and services; and Puket an online clothing platform; MinD an online design and home decoration platform. In addition it provides imaginarium a multi-brand e-commerce channels; Lovebrands an online platform that offers various products and services; Skoob a virtual library platform as well as operates a retail chain of fruits and vegetables under Hortifruti Natural da Terra brand. Americanas S.A. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Mayagüez S.A.
Description: Mayagüez S.A. engages as an agro-industrial business in Colombia. The company offers white and raw sugar and Bio-fertilizer; generates energy through fossil fuels; and bioethanol products. Mayagüez S.A. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Candelaria Colombia.

Name: Purple Group Limited
Description: Purple Group Limited a financial services and technology company engages in trading platforms fractional property and crypto asset investing retirement fund administration and asset management businesses in South Africa. The company operates through EasyTrader and EasyAssetManagement (EAM); and Easy Group segments. The EasyTrader and EasyAssetManagement (EAM) segment is involved in the derivatives trading and asset management operations. The Easy Group segment includes EasyEquities EasyProperties EasyCrypto and RISE EasyRetire. It also offers EasyBonds EasyTrader EasyPartnerships EasyCredit and EasyProtect solutions. The company was formerly known as Purple Capital Limited and changed its name to Purple Group Limited in December 2013. Purple Group Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc
Description: Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc provides various banking products and services in Zambia. It operates through Corporate & Investment Banking and Wealth & Retail Banking segments. The company offers current and savings accounts foreign currency and fixed deposit accounts and time and term deposits; personal instalment loans mortgages loans corporate and trade finance personal loans overdrafts credit and debit cards working capital solutions and business loans; investment services including mutual funds fixed income securities wealth lending foreign exchange and international banking; cash management and other transaction services; and bancassurance services. It also sells third-party insurance products such as group life assurance and motor and houseowner/householder insurance; operates client contact centers; and provides mobile online and agent banking. The company serves corporate personal priority and business clients. Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Lusaka Zambia. Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc operates as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered Holdings (Africa) BV.

Name: Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. provides insurance products in Bahrain. It operates through Non-motor Motor Medical Group Life and Family Takaful segments. The company develops and provides protection coverages for property engineering general accident liability marine cargo marine hull aviation medical group life motor level term assurance and decreasing term assurance. It also manages general takaful and family takaful funds. In addition the company offers travel expat medical visa smart device domestic helper and personal cyber insurance products; life planning services; and savings and protection plans. It offers its services through its online platform. The company was formerly known as Al Ahlia Insurance Company B.S.C. and changed its name to Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. in January 2018. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Manama Bahrain. Solidarity Bahrain B.S.C. is a subsidiary of Solidarity Group Holding B.S.C (c).

Name: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company
Description: Alexandria Mineral Oils Company engages in the production and sale of oil products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers fuel and transformer oils paraffin wax and derivatives gasoline and diesel neutral and special mineral oils liquefied petroleum gas naphtha and wax distillates as well as engages in the maximization of gas oil with low sulphur and pour point oil loading and blending and crude oil refining activities. It is also involved in importing exporting marketing selling and trading its products other petroleum products and supplies as well as engages in the warehouse leasing business. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Rasiyat Holding Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Rasiyat Holding Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries develops promotes acquires and invests in education real estate financial and industrial projects in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Academic and Investments segments. The company owns Kuwait Technical College as well as engages in a range of activities including curriculum development course delivery and academic research comprising creating organizing and delivering educational programs to students. It also develops residential commercial and mixed-use properties. In addition the company owns and holds shares of institutions; invests in income generating assets and service sector as well as Islamic bonds and bank notes; and owns stocks of local and foreign companies. The company was formerly known as Gulf North Africa Holding Company – KPSC. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: KAL Group Limited
Description: KAL Group Limited operates as a diversified trader and retailer in the agricultural manufacturing retail and fuel and convenience markets in South Africa and Namibia. It operates through Agrimark The Fuel Company Agrimark Grain and Manufacturing segments. The company engages in the grain handling and storage; marketing of agricultural commodities; seed and animal feed sales; provision of agricultural management advisory services; marketing of small grains and oilseeds; trading of potatoes; marketing of mechanical equipment; and sale of farming machinery and equipment as well as offers after-sales services. It also distributes packaging materials such as cartons carton inner packaging plastic bags labels pallet strapping and pallets for fruits and vegetables; and offers local wines and beers pet products and financing products. In addition the company manufactures and sells plastic products such as bulk bins; and irrigation equipment such as micro sprinklers inline valves and automation products. Further it operates tyre and fitment stores that provides wheels tyres and batteries as well as services for assisting with tyre fitment and balancing; Forge Agri store that offers agri-supplies such as feed fertiliser seed fencing irrigation animal handling services protective clothing and others; Forge Build which provides building hardware and bulk materials including cement piping and build sand power tools paint forge oils and plumbing or electrical equipment; and Farmsave that supplies agricultural input services and building materials. It also provides retail fuel including convenience stores under the Expressmark brand as well as quick service restaurant outlets. The company was formerly known as Kaap Agri Limited and changed its name to KAL Group Limited in March 2023. KAL Group Limited was founded in 1912 and is based in Paarl South Africa.

Name: Nascon Allied Industries Plc
Description: Nascon Allied Industries Plc manufactures and sells refined edible and grade salt in Nigeria. The company operates through Salt and Seasoning segments. It offers table pure dried and vacuum tannery butter and edible and non-edible industrial salt; and spices comprising stew mix and curry powder as well as seasoning cubes tomato paste and vegetable oil. The company sells its products directly to distributors who redistribute to wholesalers confectioners supermarkets and retailers under the Dangote and Dan Q brand names. Nascon Allied Industries Plc was formerly known as NASCON Industries Plc and changed its name to Nascon Allied Industries Plc in July 2015. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Ikeja Nigeria. Nascon Allied Industries Plc operates as a subsidiary of Dangote Industries Limited.

Name: C.A. Ron Santa Teresa
Description: C.A. Ron Santa Teresa operates a distillery in Venezuela. It produces rums from sugarcane as well as cocktails. The company was founded in 1796 and is based in El Consejo Venezuela.

Name: Arab Insurance Group (B.S.C.)
Description: Arab Insurance Group (B.S.C.) together with its subsidiaries provides life and non-life reinsurance products and related services in the Afro Asia region. The company offers property marine engineering accident whole account and other non-life policies as well as short term group life policies and long term life policies. Arab Insurance Group (B.S.C.) was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Disway S.A.
Description: Disway S.A. distributes IT and telecom equipment products in Morocco Tunisia the Middle East and Africa. The company offers desktop PC and laptops; printer scanner point of sale terminal tracer copier fax and consumables; tablet smartphone connected object and headphones and earphones; PC screen TV game console video projector projection screen videoconferencing interactive screen and photo and video; and accessories including cable drive hard drive flash memory luggage storage keyboard and mouse memory stick gaming audio webcam power bank and strip inverter and others and miscellaneous. It also provides solutions for server network data center storage backup software and video surveillance; and solar panels on and off grid solution solar pumping protections and solar accessories. In addition the company offers logistics services; manages stocks; processes orders; and engages in packing and co-packing drop shipping assembly inventory and reporting services. Disway S.A. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides wealth management forward trading access to IPOs and advisory services to its clients. It provides its services to individual institutional clients ultra-high net worth individuals high net worth clients family offices sovereigns endowments foundations and corporate. The firm manages customized portfolios and mutual funds for its clients. It invests in the public equity fixed income and alternative investments markets across the globe with a focus on the MENA region. The firm employs quantitative analysis to make its investments. It makes its investments in the securities of companies operating across diversified sectors. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. was formerly known as Kipco Asset Management Company K.S.C.C. till December 07 2014. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. was founded in September 28 1998 and is based in Sharq Kuwait. KAMCO Investment Company K.S.C.P. operates as a subsidiary of United Gulf Bank B.S.C. (E.C.).

Name: Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A.
Description: Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the distribution of pharmaceutical products in Brazil. It provides pharmaceutical personal hygiene and beauty products. The company operates retail stores under the Drogasmil Farmalife Drogarias Tamoio and Drogaria Rosário brands. Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A. was incorporated in 1961 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Bank of Africa Mali SA
Description: Bank of Africa Mali SA provides various banking products and services to individuals business customers and SMEs in Mali. It offers checking current foreign currency and savings accounts and term deposits; house consumer personal and various other loans; cards; financing of activities; investment products; insurance products; and money transfer and digital banking services. The company also provides foreign currency endorsements letter of credit transfers and documentary discounts and credits. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Bamako Mali. Bank of Africa Mali SA is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG
Description: Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells steel products in the Sultanate of Oman the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia and internationally. It offers black and galvanized pipes hollow sections merchant bar mill products and rebars. The company also operates tube mill and merchant bar mill facilities. Its products are used in construction scaffolding irrigation agriculture engineering public health fencing steam and gas facilities firefighting and water and sanitation pipes. The company was formerly known as Al Jazeera Tube Mills Company S.A.O.G. Al Jazeera Steel Products Company SAOG was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Sohar the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Jubilee Holdings Limited
Description: Jubilee Holdings Limited an investment holding company underwrites life and non-life insurance risks associated with death disability health property and liability. It operates through two segments: Health Business and Life Business. The company offers life insurance; health insurance; property and casualty insurance; retirement products; medical insurance; and individual life group life and investments products. It also provides life and investment products which includes retail life products personal pension individual annuity income drawdown last expense corporate life group pension and credit life; and health products comprising individual health plans SME plan corporate health third party administration critical illness and international health. In addition the company offers financial investment products including money market fund and fixed income fund; and leases commercial space. Further it issues a portfolio of investment contracts liabilities to provide asset management solutions for savings and retirement needs. Additionally the company provides financial advisory services; invests in properties; generates electricity; sells fresh and processed meat products; and other financial related services. It operates in Kenya Uganda Tanzania Burundi and Mauritius. Jubilee Holdings Limited was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Grupo Clarín S.A.
Description: Grupo Clarín S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates in the media industry in Argentina an Internationally. It operates through Digital and Printed Publications; and Production and Distribution of Content segments. The Digital and Printed Publications segment includes newspapers with national and regional circulation sports newspapers the edition and publication and distribution of magazines as well as commercial printing; publishes newspapers a sports daily; magazine publishing and editing and distribution. This segment also offers Diario Clarín a national newspaper for the Spanish-speaking world; Olé a sports newspaper for the Argentine market; and Genios a children’s magazine. The Production and Distribution of Content segment offers Canal 13 channels amplitude modulation/frequency modulation radio broadcast stations and Radio Mitre and La 100 as well as produces content for television films and radio and cable television signals; and organizes and broadcasts sporting events. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Grupo Clarín S.A. is a subsidiary of GC Dominio S.A.

Name: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A.
Description: CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides tourism services in Brazil and internationally. It offers intermediation services land transportation hotel reservations air tickets and chartered sea cruises cultural and professional exchange marketing of sea cruises and other services. The company operates under Trend Travel and in the United States of America; Almundo.com Avantrip Biblos CVC and Ola brands in Argentina. It provides its tourism services directly to customers through independent service providers. CVC Brasil Operadora e Agência de Viagens S.A. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Santo André Brazil.

Name: Allied Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Allied Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes technology products in Brazil and Latin America. It engages in the wholesale and retail trade of telephone computer electronic devices accessories and peripherals. The company also provides logistics services; delivery and storage services; program development and licensing; image processing and services related to enabling data voice and recharge plans; and payment services deposit transfer and/or withdrawal of funds management of payment accounts issuance of payment instruments and others. It sells its products through digital retail including marketplaces e-commerce platforms and digital operations solutions; physical retail such as brand shops; and distribution channels. The company was formerly known as Dstar Participações S.A. and changed its name to Allied Tecnologia S.A. in November 2015. Allied Tecnologia S.A. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Havanna Holding S.A.
Description: Havanna Holding S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the operation and franchise of coffee shops in Brazil Peru Paraguay Chile Spain and Bolivia. The company offers caramel cookies havannets cookies mini line chocolates caramel sauce haired lattes and frappes. It also operates bars and cafés. The company is involved in the distribution activities in the United States Colombia Costa Rica El Nicaragua Europe Israel and Australia. Havanna Holding S.A. was founded in 1947 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: BLC BANK S.A.L.
Description: BLC BANK S.A.L. provides investment corporate and retail banking services in Lebanon. The company offers current savings and term deposit accounts; life accidental term life education retirement home and investment insurance; credit debit internet fresh and prepaid cards; banker’s draft and transfer services; ATM BLC pass ATM cardless withdrawal internet point of sale and mobile banking services; and mother and child account and safe deposit boxes. It also provides letter of credit documentary collection and bank guarantees; and advisory asset management and brokerage products and services. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Beirut Lebanon. BLC BANK S.A.L. operates as a subsidiary of Fransabank S.A.L.

Name: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG engages in marketing and distributing of petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. The company is also involved in blending of lubricants. In addition it operates Shell service stations; Shell Select shops which offers beverages fresh food and localized offers; Shell Café; and Shell GO+ for digital promotions. Further the company offers shell fuel cards engine oils and lubricants for motorists; and industrial lubricants for industries including auto and truck dealers aviation construction fleet manufacturing marine metals mining and power. The company was formerly known as Shell Marketing (Oman) Ltd. and changed its name to Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG in June 1997. Shell Oman Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1958 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A.
Description: La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. provides insurance and reinsurance products and services to individuals and business customers in Peru. The company offers vehicle home card and credit health oncology accident family life life funeral life and savings and travel insurance products. It also provides property equipment and machinery and agricultural insurance products as well as insurance products for negotiations and guarantees. La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. was incorporated in 1937 and is headquartered in San Isidro Peru. La Positiva Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. is a subsidiary of Fidelidade - Companhia de Seguros S.A.

Name: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG engages in the marketing and distribution of petroleum products in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through Retail Commercial Aviation Lubricants and Non-Fuel Services segments. The company offers gasoline diesel jet fuel and kerosene; retail commercial aviation and marine fuels; lubricants comprising engine gear and hydraulic oils as well as specialty lubricants brake fluids engine coolants and greases; fuel cards; autofill RFID; Fuely a fuel delivery service; bunkering services for vessels; and non-fuel related services. It also provides smart tags; Al Maha PLUS app; car wash services; and oil and lube change services for cars as well as operates fuel stations convenience stores and service centers. Al Maha Petroleum Products Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Puerto Ventanas S.A.
Description: Puerto Ventanas S.A. operates a port in Chile. The company offers warehousing services; and services to the ships including docking and undocking tug and berthing and unberthing. It also provides land transportation services by road or rail; and loading and unloading services. Puerto Ventanas S.A. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Riopaila Castilla S.A.
Description: Riopaila Castilla S.A. operates as an agro-industrial company in Colombia. The company offers sugars honeys inverted syrup mixtures and palm oil as well as fertilizers under the FertiRio Conditioner name. It also engages in cattle raising activities; cogeneration of energy from sugarcane bagasse; and production of renewable energy including alcohol and palm oil. In addition the company provides agricultural services and consulting services such as adaptation preparation and planting; crop lifting; fertilizer application; variable-rate fertilization; and precision agriculture. Riopaila Castilla S.A. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Santiago de Cali Colombia.

Name: Cristalerías de Chile S.A.
Description: Cristalerías de Chile S.A. manufactures and sells glass containers for wine beer non-alcoholic beverages liquors and food markets in Chile and internationally. The company operates through Glass Packaging Wine Communications Electric Generation and Investment segments. It is involved in the production import export and sale of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages such as wines and spirits; generation of electricity; and written digital and editorial press activities. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Padre Hurtado Chile. Cristalerías de Chile S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Compañía Electro Metalúrgica S.A.

Name: Grupo Multi S.A.
Description: Grupo Multi S.A. develops manufactures distributes and sells electronic products in Brazil. The company offers blenders fryers pans ovens mixer coffee makers kettles sandwich makers food warmer scales omelette maker hood food processors parts and accessories for mixers. It also offers vacuum cleaners circulators heaters fans iron vaporizer drinking fountain popcorn maker wineries and ice machines; and electric toothbrush refill oral irrigator compressor inhaler mesh inhaler air humidifier aroma diffuser oximeter medication spacer essential oils scented candles electric toothbrush irrigator nozzles and accessories. Further it offers digital thermometer infrared thermometer baby thermometer arm blood pressure monitor wrist blood pressure monitor blood glucose monitor lancet blood glucose strips electric racket and electric insect killer; digital scales bioimpedance scales gel and thermal bags knee brace elastic knee pad and elbow pad wristband elastic thigh and ankle strap. Additionally It provides smartphones cell phones tablets computers and notebooks security UPS batteries and accessories; access control automation lighting and security monitoring related products; steering wheel monitor cabinet webcam controls headset keyboard mouse mouse pad microphone VR glasses cables memories and SSD and sound box; and printing supplies sticky-notes-pad staplers punchers organizers digitizing tablets electronic waste bins glues and books and office supplies. It offers household utensils hardware tools sports automotive beauty and skin care products as well as provides toys for pets and infants and health care products. The company provides audio video screen and projectors. Grupo Multi S.A. was formerly known as Multilaser Industrial S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Multi S.A. in April 2024. Grupo Multi S.A. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Biomm S.A.
Description: Biomm S.A. operates as a biotechnology company in Brazil. The company offers insulin products for the treatment of diabetes including AFREZZA a Human insulin powder for inhalation; GLARGILIN a glargine insulin; WOSULIN N and WOSULIN R; and Lifepen G a reusable insulin injection pen. It also provides Bevyx for the treatment of metastatic colorectal cancer; HERZUMA for the treatment of early-stage and metastatic breast cancer and metastatic gastric cancer with HER2-positive tumors; GHEMAXAN an anticoagulant for the prophylaxis and treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism unstable angina and in cases of acute myocardial infarction; and RANIVISIO for the treatment of vision problems related to abnormal blood vessel growth or fluid buildup in the retina. Biomm S.A. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Nova Lima Brazil.

Name: Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E.
Description: Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E. together with its subsidiaries provides offshore marine and oil support services in Egypt. The company manages and operates AHTS PSV multi purpose vessel diving support vessel mooring boats and offshore support vessels as well as utility vessels; and under water activities and diving scope of services. It also provides marine work services including oil spill recovery; firefighting capabilities; dynamic positioning; 4-point mooring; and supply installation and maintenance of marine navigation aids such as buoys and navigation light services. In addition the company offers track record EPCI contracts installation engineering laying of sub sea pipelines sub sea coiled tubing submarine power cables mooring systems protective coating and construction work services; and survey services comprising rig positioning ROV inspection pre-engineering survey and construction support services. Maridive and Oil Services S.A.E. was founded in 1977 and is based in Port Said Egypt.

Name: Britam Holdings Plc
Description: Britam Holdings Plc an investment holding company provides financial solutions in Kenya Uganda Tanzania Rwanda South Sudan Mozambique and Malawi. The company operates in five segments: Life Insurance Business; Non-Life Insurance Business; Asset Management; Property; and Corporate and Other segments. The Life Insurance Business segment provides unit linked products education plans whole life plans and other conventional products; and group life and critical illness products disability products individual pension plans umbrella pension plans and corporate pension plans. Its Non-Life Insurance Business segment offers protection to customers’ assets particularly for personal and commercial business; and aviation engineering fire-domestic risks fire-industrial and commercial risks liability marine motor personal accident theft workmen’s compensation and employer’s liability and miscellaneous insurance. The Asset Management segment offers discretionary/segregated portfolio management and wealth management services as well as unit trust funds. Its Property segment is involved in the purchase and sale of properties as well as buying developing selling and leasing land to third parties. The Corporate and Other segment offers debt-financed investment portfolios. It serves individual and corporate customers through financial advisors partners and digital channels. Britam Holdings Plc was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Spur Corporation Ltd
Description: Spur Corporation Ltd together with its subsidiaries operates as a restaurant franchisor in South Africa and internationally. It operates and franchises restaurants under the Spur Steak Ranches Panarottis Pizza Pasta John Dory’s Fish Grill Sushi The Hussar Grill RocoMamas Casa Bella Nikos Doppio Zero Modern Tailor and Piza e Vino brands fast casual brand RocoMamas and three bespoke speciality dining brands The Hussar Grill Casa Bella Nikos Coalgrill Greek Doppio Zero Modern Tailors; Virtual Kitchen brands includes Just Wingz (Spur Steak Ranches) Pizza Pug Bento Reel Sushi Rib Shack RocoFellas and CharGrill Chicken. It is also involved in sauce manufacturing warehousing product distribution training export décor manufacturing and call center businesses. In addition it operates retail company stores as well as provides marketing services. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: The National Bank
Description: The National Bank provides various banking and financial services to retail corporate institutional and public sector customers in the Palestinian Authority. It operates through Retail Accounts; Corporate and Institution Accounts; Public Sector Accounts; and Treasury segments. The company offers current demand savings and time deposits; consumer loans; overdrafts; credit cards and other services. It also provides trading and treasury services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Palestine Electric Company P.L.C
Description: Palestine Electric Company P.L.C through its subsidiary Gaza Power Generating Company engages in the generation and sale of electricity in the Gaza Strip Palestine. It operates a power plants to produce natural gas. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Gaza Palestine. Palestine Electric Company P.L.C is a subsidiary of Palestine Power Company.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Engen Botswana Limited
Description: Engen Botswana Limited engages in the petrochemical investments and property operations businesses in Botswana. It operates through two segments Petrochemical Activities and Property Letting. The company is involved in the selling and distributing fuel; and letting of properties. It also markets petroleum products. The company was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana. Engen Botswana Limited is a subsidiary of Petroleum Investment Holdings Limited.

Name: Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A.
Description: Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A. produces and exports wines in Chile Argentina and internationally. It sells its products under the Altair Cabo de Hornos Sideral Tierras Moradas Kankana del Elqui 1865 Tayu 1865 GatoNegro 9 Lives Epica Castillo de Molina Gran Reserva Tarapaca Leyda Misiones de Rango Santa Helena Alpaca Viñamar La Celia Graffigna and B-LIV brands. The company was founded in 1865 and is based in Santiago Chile. Viña San Pedro Tarapacá S.A. operates as a subsidiary of CCU Inversiones S.A.

Name: Dexxos Participações S.A.
Description: Dexxos Participações S.A. engages in the production and sale of thermosetting resins to the reconstituted wood panels industry in Brazil. The company operates through the Chemicals and Steel Tubes segments. It is also involved in the production of formaldehyde and hexamine; resale of methanol and other chemical products; and manufacture of steel tubes for the civil construction infrastructure automobile petroleum and gas markets. The company was formerly known as GPC Participações S.A. and changed its name to Dexxos Participações S.A. in June 2021. Dexxos Participações S.A. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public) provides drilling and workover services for oil companies in Kuwait and internationally. The company provides integrated maintenance services; transportation support through a fleet of heavy-duty trucks low beds Kenworth forklifts and cranes; workshop; supply chain; and catering services. The company was formerly known as Hamad Al-Hamad and Partners for well drilling trading and maintenance Company and changed its name to Burgan Company for Well Drilling Trading and Maintenance K.S.C. (Public) in February 2005. The Company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Fahaheel Kuwait.

Name: Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C.
Description: Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C. buys builds operates and sells residential and commercial real estate projects. The company develops and manages residential compounds; invests in real estate projects; develops land for resale; engages in the construction project management and real estate marketing activities; and provides property management maintenance and brokerage services. Mazaya Real Estate Development Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Zambian Breweries Plc
Description: Zambian Breweries Plc engages in the manufacture and distribution of alcoholic beverages in Zambia. The company offers beers under the Mosi Premium Lager Mosi Light Castle Castle Lite Carling Black Label Eagle Lagers Budweiser Stella Artois Corona Flying Fish and Brutal Fruit. It distributes its products through retailers bar owners and wholesalers. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. Zambian Breweries Plc operates as a subsidiary of AB InBev Africa BV.

Name: Lasco Manufacturing Limited
Description: Lasco Manufacturing Limited manufactures and sells soy-based products primarily Jamaica. The company offers juice drinks water and packaged milk products. It offers its products under LASCO brand name. The company was formerly known as LASCO Foods (Successors) Limited and changed its name to Lasco Manufacturing Limited in May 2010. Lasco Manufacturing Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Acsion Limited
Description: Acsion Limited engages in property holding and development activities in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through South African Property Operations South African Hospitality Operations and International Property Operations segments. Its investment portfolio includes retail properties including regional shopping centers light industrial property and a mixed-used property as well as an international retail property. In addition the company develops community shopping centers convenience shopping centers as well as industrial residential and hospitality properties; operates hotels; and provides property and asset management services. Further it engages in conferencing business and sale of food and beverage. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Centurion South Africa. Acsion Limited is a subsidiary of Fortutrax Proprietary Limited.

Name: Privatization Holding Company - K.P.S.C.
Description: Privatization Holding Company - K.P.S.C. invests in utilities and infrastructure sectors in Kuwait and internationally. It operates in two segments Investment and Other. The company engages in investment; electric power generation; manufacturing; and real estate businesses as well as the provision of IT general trading and contracting educational and medical services. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Kenya Airways Plc
Description: Kenya Airways Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the international regional and domestic carriage of passengers and cargo by air in Kenya and internationally. The company operates through Passenger; Freight and Mail; Handling; and Others segments. It also provides ground handling services to other airlines and handling services to import and export of cargo as well as engineering and training services. The company operates domestic and international flights and flies to 43 destinations in Africa the Middle East Asia Europe and North America. As of December 31 2024 it operated 43 aircraft which included nine Boeing 787 wide body jets eight Boeing 737 narrow body jets thirteen Embraer regional jets one Airbus four Boeing 737 freighters and eight Bombardier Dash 8-400. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the insurance reinsurance and takaful insurance businesses for individuals and corporates in Qatar. It operates through Takaful Investment and Real Estate segments. The company offers comprehensive and third-party insurance products; and property insurance products such as fire and special perils property all risks business interruption terrorism and jewelers block insurance. It also provides engineering insurance products including contractor’s all risk erection all risk equipment machinery breakdown deterioration of stock in cold storage and electronic equipment insurance; and workmen's compensation personal accident fidelity guarantee and money insurance products. In addition the company offers individual/family health household travel and yacht/jetski marine insurance; and public and third-party liability insurance products. Further it provides marine cargo freight forwarders liability marine hull and aviation insurance; inpatient and daycare outpatient credit life and group life and personal accident insurance as well as individual medical insurance plans; and motor fleet and group health and medical insurance products. Additionally the company is involved in the investment and real estate businesses. Al Khaleej Takaful Insurance Company Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E)
Description: CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) provides diversified financial services in Egypt and internationally. It offers leasing solutions including finance and operating leases and sale and leaseback for a range of corporate clients and SMEs; microfinance lending; and investment banking platform to provide market leading capital raising mergers and acquisitions (M&A) advisory asset management securities brokerage custody fixed income brokerage and research services. The company also provides ECM advisory services such as advisory on capital structuring and capital market activity through public offerings private placements rights issues and pre-IPO transactions; debt raising debt structuring and restructuring services; asset management products comprising fixed income money market equity balanced indexed and Sharia-compliant funds as well as range of mutual funds and saving plans; institutional and individual clients bookkeeping services; and mortgage finance. It offers its services to a client base that include global and regional institutions and family offices large corporates SMEs and high net worth and individual investors. CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Sheikh Zayed City Egypt. CI Capital Holding For Financial Investments (S.A.E) operates as a subsidiary of Banque Misr S.A.E.

Name: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. engages in managing real estate projects in Kuwait. It operates in Hotel Operations Real Estate and Investment segments. The company invest develop and trades real estate properties as well as manages real estate investment commercial projects investment funds and portfolios. Sokouk Holding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Sociedad Anónima Viña Santa Rita
Description: Sociedad Anónima Viña Santa Rita produces and sells wines in Chile America Europe Asia Africa and Oceania. The company offers wine products under the Casa Real Reserva Especial Bougainville Pewën de Apalta Triple C Floresta Medalla Real Gran Researva Medalla Real Gold Medal SR Secret Reserve 120 Reserva Especial 120 Early Harvest and 3 Medallas brands. It exports its products to Ireland Brazil the United States of America Canada Mexico the United Kingdom China Japan Denmark Colombia Scandinavia Korea and the Netherlands. The company was founded in 1880 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Sociedad Anónima Viña Santa Rita is a subsidiary of Cristalerías de Chile S.A.

Name: Beta Glass Plc
Description: Beta Glass Plc manufactures distributes and sells glass bottles and containers in Nigeria and internationally. The company also offers crowns and crates. Its products are used by soft drinks breweries wine and spirits pharmaceutical food and cosmetics companies. The company also exports its products to Ghana Burkina Faso Benin Republic Cameroon Gabon Republic of Congo Angola Mauritius South Africa Côte d’Ivoire Sierra Leone Guinea and Liberia. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Beta Glass Plc is a subsidiary of Frigoglass Industries Nigeria Limited.

Name: Aenza S.A.A.
Description: Aenza S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries provides specialized management consulting services and leasing of corporation in Peru Chile and Colombia. It operates through Infrastructure Energy Engineering and Construction and Real Estate segments. The company’s Infrastructure segment offers long-term concessions or similar contractual arrangements in Peru for toll roads transportation and water treatment as well as operation and maintenance services for infrastructure assets. Its Engineering and Construction segment provides traditional engineering services such as architectural planning structural civil and design engineering for advanced specialties comprising process design simulation and environmental services. This segment also provides services related to civil works which include construction of hydroelectric power stations and other large infrastructure facilities; electromechanic construction such as power plant concentrator plants oil and natural gas pipelines and transmission lines; and office and residential buildings hotels accessible housing projects shopping centers and industrial facilities. Its Energy segment engages in exploration production treatment marketing services of natural gas and its derivatives in the gas processing plant and gas processing as well as the construction and assembly of oil facilities and the storage and dispatch of fuel and oil by products. Its Real Estate segment develops and sells house  offices and commercial spaces. The company was formerly known as Graña y Montero S.A.A. and changed its name to Aenza S.A.A. in November 2020. Aenza S.A.A. was founded in 1933 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Renaissance Services SAOG
Description: Renaissance Services SAOG together with its subsidiaries operates as an accommodation services solutions and integrated facilities management company in the Sultanate of Oman and rest of the Middle East. The company offers turnkey and other contract services including accommodation solutions facilities management and establishment contract catering operations and maintenance training cleaning and waste management services. It is also involved in the ownership building and operation of permanent accommodation for contractors; and investment in companies and properties as well as general trading and related activities. The company serves healthcare energy defense education utilities and other sectors. Renaissance Services SAOG was founded in 1996 and is based in Muttrah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Allpark Empreendimentos Participações e Serviços S.A.
Description: Allpark Empreendimentos Participações e Serviços S.A. engages in the provision of parking services in Brazil. It operates through Leased and Managed Locations Owned Locations Public concessions (Otf-Stíeet) Public concessions (On-Street) Long-term Private Contracts Digital and Other segments. The company operates parking lots in commercial buildings shopping malls hospitals educational institutions banks and land; and outside public roads including airports and underground garages. It is also involved in the investments in parking meters infrastructure signage and initial concessions in the municipalities; and provision of AppZul+ services as well as technical administration advisory and planning services related to vehicle parking. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Merafe Resources Limited
Description: Merafe Resources Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the mining and beneficiation of chrome ore into ferrochrome and associated minerals. The company operates ferrochrome smelters ferrochrome furnaces chrome ore mines UG2 plants and PGM processing plants located in the Northwest Limpopo and Mpumalanga provinces of South Africa. It operates in South Africa Brazil the United States China India Japan South Korea Taiwan Singapore Australia England Finland Italy Luxembourg the Netherlands Slovenia and Spain. Merafe Resources Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Bryanston South Africa.

Name: Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG
Description: Galfar Engineering & Contracting SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in engineering contracting and construction businesses in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through four segments: Construction Manufacturing Hiring of Equipment and Training of Personnel. The company constructs a range of projects including palaces commercial establishments housing complexes educational institutions hospitals monuments religious structures stadiums showrooms telephone exchanges and residences. It also offers design civil mechanical electrical and instrumentation services for oil and gas pipelines and flow lines; construction of oil storage tanks gathering stations and compressor stations; and design and construction of power transmission systems. In addition the company constructs railway roads bridges dams seaports airports and water and wastewater transmissions; and provides operation and maintenance of water transmission networks infrastructure works of industrial parks and refineries and large- scale earthmoving projects. Further it is involved in hiring equipment; training services; engineering procurement and construction consultancy services; production and sale of ready-mix concrete products; electrical and HVAC services; and plumbing and maintenance contracts. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C. provides general insurance takaful and related products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain and internationally. It operates through Marine and General Motor Medical and Life segments. The company offers fire general accident engineering group life marine cargo marine hull and aviation special contingency motor third party motor comprehensive and extended warranty medical education protection and savings insurance products. It also provides travel home and life insurance products. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C. is a subsidiary of Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P.

Name: Monteiro Aranha S.A.
Description: Monteiro Aranha S.A. through its subsidiaries operates in the telecommunications the pulp and paper sector petrochemicals and real estate sectors in Brazil. The company distributes timber pulp packaging paper paper bags and corrugated cardboard boxes; liquefied petroleum gas and fuel; and fuel and LPG as well as produces ethylene oxide and its derivatives. It is also involved in producing ethylene oxide and its derivatives; and developing and investment in residential and commercial real estate projects as well as offers storage services for liquid bulk. Monteiro Aranha S.A. was founded in 1921 and is based in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited
Description: Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited provides banking and other financial services to residents in Namibia. It offers banking services including account management; overdraft facilities and services; and micro-lending services. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Windhoek Namibia. Letshego Holdings (Namibia) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Letshego Holdings Limited.

Name: B Investments Holding S.A.E.
Description: B Investments Holding S.A.E. is a private equity firm specializing in growth capital investments. The firm seeks to invest in diverse range of sector including food and beverages non-banking financial services education real estate development healthcare renewable energy and manufacturing. The firm seeks to invest in companies located in Egypt. It prefers to invests between $15 million to $50 million. B Investments Holding S.A.E. was founded in 2006 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Eléctrica Puntilla S.A.
Description: Eléctrica Puntilla S.A. generates and sells of electrical energy and power in Chile. It operates various hydroelectric plants. The company was founded in 1906 and is based in Santiago Chile. Eléctrica Puntilla S.A. is a subsidiary of Sociedad del Canal del Maipo S.A.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: HF Group Plc
Description: HF Group Plc through its subsidiaries engages in the mortgage lending banking property development and bancassurance businesses in Kenya. The company operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking Property Development Bancassurance and Others segments. It accepts deposits from retail customers; and provides micro and personal loans as well as sources residential mortgages for individual owner occupiers. The company also accepts deposits from corporate organizations; and provides loans to property developers for construction of residential houses office blocks schools hospitals and other related infrastructure. In addition it engages in the development and sale of housing projects; and provision of insurance agency services. It serves individual and corporate customers. The company was formerly known as HF Group Limited and changed its name to HF Group Plc in July 2017. HF Group Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Proagro C.A.
Description: Proagro C.A. produces and markets animal feed products. The company provides chickens and whole chickens; sausages cooked breasts hams bolognese and mortadella; and frozen nuggets milanese tenders chicken wings and burger products. It offers animal feed products for ruminants equine pigs broilers fish and rabbit; and breeding and production of poultry. It offers its products under Corral and Protinal brand names. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Valencia Venezuela.

Name: Sea Harvest Group Limited
Description: Sea Harvest Group Limited engages in the fishing and fast-moving consumer goods business in South Africa Europe Australia Asia and internationally. It operates through four segments: South African Fishing Sea Harvest Australia Sea Harvest Aquaculture and Cape Harvest Foods. The company is involved catching processing and marketing cape hake horse mackerel pelagic fish anchovy pilchard Spanish mackerel fish trawl prawns scallops crabs and abalone. It also engages in the production distribution marketing and sale of cheese butter powder and convenience food products in retail and bulk forms to the South African retail foodservice co-packing and food product development markets; and manufacture and distribution of chilled and frozen food products. The company was formerly known as Sea Harvest Holdings Proprietary Limited and changed its name to Sea Harvest Group Limited in February 2017. Sea Harvest Group Limited was founded in 1964 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Custodian Investment Plc
Description: Custodian Investment Plc through its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services in Nigeria. It operates through Non-Life Business Life Business Pension Administration Property Development and Management and Trustees and Others segments. The Non-Life Business segment offers engineering aviation marine and motor liability oil and energy fire and property insurance for individual and corporate customers. The Life Business segment provides a range of life insurance products for individual and group including annuity endowment and investment-oriented products and insurance products with discretionary participatory features (DPF). The Pension Administration segment is involved in the administration and management of the retirement benefits of members. The Property Development and Management segment engages in the acquisition development sale and management of various commercial residential hospitality and retail property assets. The Trustees and Others segment includes trustee management corporate services investment and property management. The company offers general insurance products such as auto travel home event personal accident and other insurance products; and life insurance products including savings and investment endowment protection annuity and other products as well as group life and group credit life insurance products. The company was formerly known as Custodian and Allied Insurance Limited. Custodian Investment Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Sudatel Telecom Group Limited
Description: Sudatel Telecom Group Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the provision of installation maintenance and infrastructure development services and operation of telecommunication services in the Republic of Sudan Senegal Mauritania and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through Voice Data and Wholesale segments. The company offers voice services; data services comprising leased data transmission circuits DSL and internet; and transmission services to other operators and corporate organizations as well as wire and wireless telecommunication services. It also manages its international operations. The company was formerly known as Sudan Telecommunication Company Limited. Sudatel Telecom Group Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Khartoum Sudan.

Name: Bahrain National Holding Company B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain National Holding Company B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides insurance and investment products in the Kingdom of Bahrain other GCC countries and internationally. It operates through Motor Insurance Property & General Insurance Medical Insurance and Life Insurance segments. The Motor Insurance segment offers motor comprehensive insurance third party insurance and other services related to motor insurance. The Property & General segment provides property general accident engineering marine and aviation insurance products. The Medical Insurance segment offers medical insurance products. The Life Assurance segment provides group life insurance group credit life insurance term assurance and saving scheme plans. The company also offers automobile smash repairs roadside assistance and automobile services. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Birzeit Pharmaceuticals Company
Description: Birzeit Pharmaceuticals Company manufactures and trades in various medicines in the Palestinian Authority. The company offers its products in various therapeutic fields comprising alimentary system cardio-vascular system muscolo-skeletal system endocrines central nervous system genito-urinary system obstetrics and gynecology infections dermatological preparations ophthalmic drugs respiratory system and nutrition and metabolism as well as ear nose and oropharynx. It also provides OTC products such as multivitamins and minerals and supplements; and skin/topical care allergy and cold eye care mouth and nose care pain and fever and digestion and gastrointestinal products.
