In addition the company offers its products in various dosage forms including ampoules capsules tablets and caplets syrups suspensions and granules ophthalmic semi-solids powder vials suppositories and powders. Further it manufactures and trades in cosmetics products; and provides printing and publishing services. The company serves the Ministry of Health as well as health care organizations and programs; and end users through pharmacies and physicians. It also exports its products primarily to Algeria and East Europe. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Corporación Grupo Químico C.A.
Description: Corporación Grupo Químico C.A. engages in the production and sale of chemical products and preparations in Venezuela. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Valencia Venezuela.

Name: Alexandria New Medical Center
Description: Alexandria New Medical Center engages in the operation of a hospital in Egypt. The company’s hospital provides range of medical specialization services including gynecology general surgery pediatrics and other as well as medical diagnostic and treatment services in various medical fields. It also operates children’s neurology sugar liver chest cardiology internal oncology dental nose and ear women’s ophthalmology nutrition dermatology blood disease and rheumatology clinics; specialized units and centers; and dormitories. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Combined Motor Holdings Limited
Description: Combined Motor Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the motor retail and distribution business in South Africa. It offers new and used vehicles including parts and accessories; and fleet solutions. The company also provides car rental services. In addition it offers insurance products that includes death disability dread disease and retrenchment of customers and vehicle and component warranties as well as vehicle financing. Further the company is involved in supply and installation of workshop lifting lubrication and diagnostic equipment waterless car wash systems and office consumables services. Combined Motor Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Durban South Africa.

Name: BMMI B.S.C.
Description: BMMI B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and retail of food beverages and other consumable items. It operates through five segments: Retail Operations; Wholesale Operations; Contract Services and Supply; Hospitality; and Investments Shipping and Other Activities. The company is involved in the distribution wholesale and retail of beverages through its BMMI shops to hotels restaurants clubs and other licensed outlets; and production of ready-made food products including sandwiches packaged fruits baked goods sushi and sashimi fully cooked meals and European and Arabic and fusion style salads. It also operates Downtown Rotana a five-star hotel; and provides remote site and facilities management services camps and temporary structures rations supply technical sourcing and supply and contract logistics and services. In addition the company offers supply chain warehousing and distribution services; provides shipping services such as marine cargo relocation liner surveying and government services; and owns and operates Alosra supermarket as well as operates restaurants and cafes. Further it provides catering and housekeeping services. It operates in the Kingdom of Bahrain the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Iraq the United States Djibouti South Sudan Sudan and Kenya. The company was founded in 1883 and is headquartered in Seef the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Julius Berger Nigeria Plc
Description: Julius Berger Nigeria Plc a construction company engages in the planning and construction of various civil engineering works in Nigeria and Europe. The company operates through Civil Works Building Works Services and Diversification segments. The Civil Works segment provides professional services in the areas of engineering construction and maintenance of various infrastructures including construction of traffic networks turnkey harbors wharfs jetties loading installations and warehouses; refurbishment and construction of airports; design and construction of auxiliary buildings for factories oil and gas installations and power plants in the oil gas and energy sectors. The Building Works segment designs and constructs buildings hotels hospitals sports facilities and residential districts as well as administration commercial and industrial buildings. The Services segment produces and supplies furniture and interior fittings; and offers stevedoring port management and medical as well as design engineering and procurement services. The Diversification segment engages in the purchase and processing of raw cashew nuts; and sale of cashew kernels and other cashew products. The company also manufacturers and deals in aluminum steel iron or other structural products; provides logistical and technical support services; and port management and warehousing services. In addition it operates medical service institutions; and offers medical and health care services as well as acts as a cargo superintendents and proprietors of warehouses. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Abuja Nigeria.

Name: Northern Cement Company
Description: Northern Cement Company produces and sells cement in Jordan. The company offers ordinary Portland Pozzolanic Portland Pozzolanic sulphate resistant Portland low alkali Portland oil well and white Portland cements. It engages in the carbon gypsum and pozzolan griding; investment in other companies; importing white clinker and all kinds; manufacturing and griding of clinker; and importing grinding and crushing of all types of materials for cement and concrete industry. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Northern Cement Company operates as a subsidiary of Northern Region Cement Company.

Name: The Kuwait Company for Process Plant Construction and Contracting K.S.C.P.
Description: The Kuwait Company for Process Plant Construction and Contracting K.S.C.P. executes turnkey projects for building civil engineering and infrastructure projects in Kuwait. The company provides civil engineering services including project and construction management design engineering construction and commissioning services for residential buildings commercial and industrial buildings shopping centers and hotel projects; and flooring systems water/fire proofing and roofing systems rehabilitation and concrete repair structures electro chemical treatments of structures and corrosion services and solutions to various specialized industries. It offers road and infrastructure services such as road and highway construction projects as well as related services comprising storm water drainage sewer systems water networks telephone networks and road marking and signs; drainage pipeline maintenance services; and electrical related products and supporting services. In addition the company provides engineering products including asphalt polymer based bitumen and ready mix concrete as well as scaffolding services and equipment rental; and constructs installs and maintains water facilities such as treatment plants for drinking water for homes and large buildings swimming pools water features and spa facilities. Further it supplies and installs passenger and freight elevators escalators moving walks dumbwaiters and elevators for the physically challenged; and distributes marble and natural stone products and services. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Bahrain Duty Free Shop Complex BSC
Description: Bahrain Duty Free Shop Complex BSC operates the duty-free business in the new Bahrain international airport in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Muharraq the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Arab International Company for Education and Investment
Description: Arab International Company for Education and Investment engages in the establishment of private universities in Jordan. The company is involved in the preparation of students as specialists in the technological fields. Arab International Company for Education and Investment operates its educational activities through the Applied Science University. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Colorado S.A.
Description: Colorado S.A. manufactures and distributes various paints in Morocco and internationally. It offers building and automotive refinish paints; and industrial ecological and functional paints. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Colorado S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Colbert Finances Sa.

Name: Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A.
Description: Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. provides diagnostic imaging and medicine services in Brazil. The company offers diagnostic imaging clinical analysis nuclear medicine genetic testing and vaccination services as well as corporate remote and in-person solutions for hospitals and diagnostic centers in the private and public sectors. It provides clinical analysis services such as blood count cholesterol triglycerides urinalysis 1 stool test detection of sexually transmitted diseases and anatomical pathology; and diagnostic imaging services such as magnetic resonance computed tomography ultrasound x-rays bone densitometry mammography scintigraphy and PET-CT (positron emission tomography – computed tomography). It also offers graphic methods examinations including electrocardiogram cardiotocography Holter ergometric tests and cardiopulmonary tests. Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. was formerly known as Centro de Imagem Diagnósticos S.A. and changed its name to Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. in April 2023. Alliança Saúde e Participações S.A. was founded in 1992 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Letshego Africa Holdings Limited
Description: Letshego Africa Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides retail financial services in Botswana Namibia Mozambique Lesotho Eswatini Kenya Rwanda Uganda Tanzania Nigeria and Ghana. The company is also involved in banking and microfinance activities; unsecured consumer lending; deposit licensed; group and MSE lending; property; and support services. In addition it accepts demand accounts savings accounts and call and term deposits; and provides insurance arrangements. The company was formerly known as Letshego Holdings Limited and changed its name to Letshego Africa Holdings Limited in December 2023. Letshego Africa Holdings Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Bamburi Cement Plc
Description: Bamburi Cement Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells cement and related products in Kenya and Uganda. The company also provides pre-cast mould concrete products for various applications including block drainage hollow blocks road kerbs edge restraints fencing products and others; and ready mix concrete products. In addition it engages in the rehabilitation of quarries; and owns and maintains nature and environmental park developed from rehabilitated quarries. The company was founded in 1951 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. Bamburi Cement Plc operates as a subsidiary of Amsons Industries (T) Limited.

Name: Allshores Limited
Description: Allshores Limited provides insurance and investment solutions to individuals and businesses in Bermuda Bahamas Caribbean region and Cayman Islands. It operates through Health Life Annuity and Pension; Property and Casualty; Real Estate; and Cayman Islands and Other Caribbean Operations segments. The company provides group and individual health and accident life and disability insurance as well as annuity and pension products. It also offers personal and commercial fire windstorm burglary public liability marine special types personal automobile personal auto-cycle workmen’s compensation and commercial vehicles insurance as well as property casualty and motor insurance. In addition it is involved in the rental of office space in buildings. The company was formerly known as BF&M Limited and changed its name to Allshores Limited in May 2025. The company was founded in 1903 and is headquartered in Pembroke Bermuda.

Name: Cashbuild Limited
Description: Cashbuild Limited engages in the retailing of building materials and associated products in South Africa Botswana Eswatini Lesotho Namibia Zambia and Malawi. It operates through Cashbuild P&L Hardware Cashbuild Common Monetary Operations and Cashbuild Non-Common Monetary Operations segments. The company offers builder hand and garden tools; safety equipment and workwear tanks field toilets drain covers and wheel barrows; and aggregates plastic sheeting and steel products. It also provides brickwork; concrete; cement; electrical and bathroom and kitchen products; doors putty and windows; roofing and ceiling products; tools and hardware; inverters petrol generators lighting and gas solutions; soft drinks and snacks; and outdoor and decorative products. It serves contractors homebuilders and improvers farmers traders and other customers. The company operates through the Cashbuild model and P&L Hardware stores. Cashbuild Limited was founded in 1978 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc markets and distributes refined petroleum products in Nigeria. It operates through Network General Trade and Aviation segments. The company offers premium motor spirit (PMS) automotive gasoline oil (AGO) and aviation turbine kerosene (ATK) as well as kerosene for use in lamps cooking stoves etc. It also provides range of lubricants such as automotive lubricants and industrial lubricants; engine oils for cars motorcycles tricycles and heavy-duty engines; transmission oils and brake fluids; marine oils and greases; and automotive and industrial greases under the TotalEnergies and ELF brand names. In addition the company jet fuels and aviation gasolines for the aviation industry; bitumen; and solar lamps and solar home and industrial solutions. Further it operates service stations and lubricants blending plants; provides food snacks and coffee products through Café Bonjour; and offers TotalEnergies Card for individuals and professionals as well as offers TouchPoint services to facilitate the management of mobile money services and other digital services. The company was formerly known as Total Nigeria Plc and changed its name to TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc in September 2021. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. TotalEnergies Marketing Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies Marketing & Services.

Name: SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C
Description: SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C engages in the real estate business in Kuwait and internationally. It engages in the purchase sale investment management leasing and renting of real estate properties; and purchase and sale of shares bonds and securities of real estate companies. The company also provides consulting services for real estate; organizes exhibitions for real estate projects; and develops infrastructure projects in the areas of residential commercial and industrial construction as well as projects under the build operation and transfer system. The company was formerly known as Sanam Real Estate Company K.S.C.(Public) and changed its name to SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C in May 2025. SANAM Group Holding Company K.P.S.C was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: A'Saffa Foods SAOG
Description: A'Saffa Foods SAOG manufactures and distributes poultry meat in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers fresh frozen and processed chicken. The company was formerly known as ASaffa Poultry Farms SAOG and changed its name to A'Saffa Foods SAOG in April 2010. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Jalles Machado S/A
Description: Jalles Machado S/A produces markets and exports sugar ethanol and other by-products from sugarcane. The company offers crystal and organic sugar; hydrated anhydrous industrial and organic ethanol; sanitizing products; and yeast. It also produces clean and renewable energy from cane bagasse and straw. In addition the company engages in industrial automation 4G project agro-industrial control tower and research and development activiries. Jalles Machado S/A was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Goianésia Brazil.

Name: Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A.
Description: Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A. operates as a rural real estate company in Brazil. The company engages in leasing of farms for agricultural production located in various municipalities in Mato Grosso. Terra Santa Propriedades Agrícolas S.A. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Norstar Holdings Inc
Description: Norstar Holdings Inc together with its subsidiaries develops rents and manages real estate properties in Northern Europe Central and Eastern Europe Israel Brazil and the United States. It develops commerce residential and office properties. The company was formerly known as Gazit Inc. and changed its name to Norstar Holdings Inc in May 2011. Norstar Holdings Inc was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Panama City Panama.

Name: Societe de Promotion Pharmaceutique du Maghreb S.A.
Description: Societe de Promotion Pharmaceutique du Maghreb S.A. produces commercializes imports and exports medicines derma-pharmaceuticals and cosmetic products in Africa. It subcontracts medicines for national and international laboratories. The company was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Had Soualem Morocco. Societe de Promotion Pharmaceutique du Maghreb S.A. is a subsidiary of Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC.

Name: Asiya Capital Investments Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Asiya Capital Investments Company K.S.C.P. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm invests in the public equity and alternative investment markets of Asia. It also makes buyout investments in Asia with a focus on Emerging Asian economies. Asiya Capital Investments Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 2005 and is based in Sharq Kuwait with an additional office in Safat Kuwait.

Name: Inversancarlos S.A.
Description: Inversancarlos S.A. engages in the paper cardboard electronic recycling ethyl anhydrous raw alcohol and other related businesses in Ecuador. It is also involved in handling shipping logistics and recycled raw materials distribution. The company was based in Guayaquil Ecuador.

Name: iOCO Limited
Description: iOCO Limited provides information and communications technology services in Africa the United Kingdom Europe and the Middle East. It offers advisory; agile; artificial intelligence; automation; cloud and cyber security; data; enterprise resource planning; financial performance management; managed services; software testing; security and building management; and software and development services. The company also provides ExposeIT app that helps for root out corruption and wrongdoing in the organizations. It serves mining financial manufacturing public sector and telecommunication industries. The company was formerly known as EOH Holdings Limited and changed its name to iOCO Limited in December 2024. iOCO Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Palestine Islamic Bank
Description: Palestine Islamic Bank provides various banking products and services to personal and business customers in Palestinian and internationally. The company offers current current salary savings financial inclusions corporate and fixed deposit accounts; term and investment deposits; education healthcare auto cars insurance commodity property and pensioners financing services; and Istisna’a’ services. It also provides direct financing products; and indirect financing products such as letters of credit and bills of collection and guarantees. In addition the company offers transfer safe deposit box money exchange and international bank account number services; personal and corporate cards; and electronic banking services that include online mobile SMS ATM electronic top-up and payment and cash deposit services. Palestine Islamic Bank was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: Melon S.A.
Description: Melon S.A. through its subsidiaries produces markets and supplies cement ready-mix concrete and aggregates in Chile. It operates through two segments Cement and Aggregates. The company’s products are used in high-rise buildings civil and industrial works mining and port works and household. It serves construction material distributors; construction companies; and the real estate infrastructure civil works and mining sectors. The company was formerly known as Lafarge Chile SA and changed its name to Melon S.A. in October 2009. Melon S.A. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile. Melon S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversiones Cordillera del Sur II Spa.

Name: Delta Sugar Company
Description: Delta Sugar Company engages in the manufacture and sale of sugar beets in Egypt. It offers white and sugar cubes; beetroot pulp; and molasses for use in animal feed industry and to produce alcohol carbon dioxide converted honey vinasse and various types of baker's yeast. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Delta Sugar Company is a subsidiary of Egyptian Sugar and Integrated Industries Company SAE.

Name: Libstar Holdings Limited
Description: Libstar Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and markets branded and private label consumer packaged goods in South Africa and internationally. It operates through three segments: Perishable Products Ambient Products and Household and Personal Care Products. The company offers refrigerated or frozen products including dairy convenience meals value-added meats and fresh mushrooms; wet and dry condiments meal ingredients baking and snacking and spreads; and household cleaning products as well as personal care products. It also provides baby food products; and beverages. The company sells its products under the Lancewood Millennium Foods Finlar Fine Foods Denny Mushrooms Umatie Rialto Cape Herb & Spice Khoisan Gourmet Cape Foods Montagu Foods Cecil Vinegar Dickon Hall Foods Cape Coastal Honey Chamonix Amaro Foods Cani Ambassador Foods Contactim and retailer brands to retail and wholesale food service industrial contract manufacturing and export channels. Libstar Holdings Limited was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Plattekloof South Africa.

Name: Jamaica Broilers Group Limited
Description: Jamaica Broilers Group Limited together with its subsidiaries produces and distributes poultry products animal feeds and agricultural items in Jamaica the United States and other Caribbean regions. The company engages in the poultry and pullet production; milling and sale of feed; processing and sale of salted/pickle products; supply of farming equipment and supplies; production of fertile eggs; cattle rearing for sale; hatching and distribution of baby chicks; production and sale of broilers layer pullets and table eggs; and production and distribution of agricultural and industrial supplies. It also engages in the electricity generation; captive insurance; aircraft ownership; ocean freight consolidator; and property rental activities as well as packaging and transportation services. Jamaica Broilers Group Limited was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Spanish Town Jamaica.

Name: Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A.
Description: Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. operates as a real estate development company in Brazil. The company undertakes development of residential commercial condominium land and hotel projects; and provides reversible leasing programs. Melnick Desenvolvimento Imobiliário S.A. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil.

Name: Inversiones Centenario S.A.A.
Description: Inversiones Centenario S.A.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as a real estate company in Peru. The company operates through Urban Development and Real Estate Rental segments. It owns a portfolio of urban development industrial development and offices. The company also develops and markets residential and industrial lots. In addition it operates hotels; and invests in housing. Inversiones Centenario S.A.A. was founded in 1929 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc
Description: British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc engages in the manufacturing sales and distribution of cigarettes and nicotine products in Zambia. The company offers vapour tobacco heating products modern and traditional oral and combustible tobacco products. It sells its products under the Vuse Glo Velo Grizzly Dunhill Kent Lucky Strike Pall Mall Rothmans Camel Natural American Spirit Newport Vogue Viceroy Kool Peter Stuyvesant Craven A and State Express 555 brand names. British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc was founded in 1963 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. British American Tobacco (Zambia) Plc is a subsidiary of British American Tobacco p.l.c.

Name: Jamaica Producers Group Limited
Description: Jamaica Producers Group Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the property management businesses in Europe the Caribbean and North America. It operates through four segments: property and infrastructure; specialty foods global services; and financial services segments. The company is involved in the agriculture processing distribution and/or retail of food and drinks. It also engages in logistics transportation port terminal operations shipping land management and investment activities. Its products include fruit juices smoothies and flavored waters natural juices purified ice and water tropical snacks and rum cakes under the Hoogesteger St Mary’s Tortuga CoBeverage Lab Monte Cristi JP Tropical Snacks and Grupo Empresarial Alaska brands. The company also provides land and property management and treasury investments services. The company was formerly known as Jamaica Banana Producers Association Ltd. and changed its name to Jamaica Producers Group Limited in 1992. Jamaica Producers Group Limited was founded in 1925 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Colombina S.A.
Description: Colombina S.A. produces and sells food products in Colombia and internationally. The company operates through Sweets Chocolate Cookies Preserves Ice Cream and Represented segments. It offers sweets chewing gum gums marshmallows chocolates snacks sweet cookies cakes sauces and preserves ice cream cream for cones popsicles ice cream cookies canned fish tuna and sardines coffee drinks olive oil alcohol and other imported products. The company was founded in 1918 and is based in Cali Colombia.

Name: AFMA S.A.
Description: AFMA S.A. provides insurance brokerage services for private and corporate clients in Morocco and internationally. The company offers insurance products for businesses such as civil liabilities operating loss business motor automobile transport damage and credit insurance as well as insurance related to construction; and personal and cyber risk insurance products. It also provides individual insurance solutions comprising car multi-risk home death retirement capitalization individual accident and health insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Ingevec S.A.
Description: Ingevec S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the engineering and construction business in Chile. The company operates through Engineering and Construction; Real Estate; and Investment and Income segments. It is involved in the study promotion administration and execution of real estate projects and developments which includes homes buildings civil and other related works as well as offers architecture and engineering services; and provision of professional and consultancy services. The company also invests in hotel and office projects located in Chile and Peru. Ingevec S.A. was founded in 1983 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.)
Description: Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) provides life and non-life insurance products and services for individuals and companies in Kuwait. The company operates through General Risk Insurance Life and Medical Insurance and Investment segments. It offers insurance against the risks related to goods transportation and various marine and aviation vessels; insurance against risks of contractors machine and computer damages and cessation of works; insurance for cash fidelity bonds professional risks work accidents civil responsibility and cars; insurance against fire for buildings stores industrial risks and oil and gas industries; and insurance against accidents for motor vehicles. The company also provides life and health insurance products; and reinsurance services. Warba Insurance and Reinsurance Company (K.S.C.P.) was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc
Description: Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc provides aircraft and cargo handling passenger handling passenger profiling and crew transportation services in Nigeria. It operates through Ground Handling Cargo Handling and Other segments. The company engages in ramp services and baggage handling. It also provides cargo documentation services for airlines import and export facilitation through customs bonded warehouses across the network. In addition the company involved in energy and power distribution and leasing of ground handling equipment. Further the company offers aircraft handling disinfection cleaning and aircraft movement control load control baggage/cargo off and onloading GSE supply and utilization unit load device management and baggage reconciliation services. Additionally it provides cargo handling services including warehousing import cargo bulk breaking cargo delivery and customs control-services; and crew transportation as well as aviation training services. Nigerian Aviation Handling Company Plc was incorporated in 1979 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Seef Properties B.S.C.
Description: Seef Properties B.S.C. primarily engages in real estate activities in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through four segments: Malls and Properties Serviced Apartments Leisure and Entertainment and Other. The Malls and Properties segment manages real estate properties including the Seef Mall Isa Town Mall and Muharraq Seef Mall as well as other properties in Hamad Town Isa Town Saar and Um-Al Hassam. The Serviced Apartments segment leases Fraser Suites Seef furnished serviced apartments and tourist restaurants. The Leisure and Entertainment segment owns and operates leisure and recreational games facilities in various commercial malls under the Magic Island brand name. The company also manages hotels and amusement parks and theme parks. Seef Properties B.S.C. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Agma SA
Description: Agma SA engages in the insurance and reinsurance advisory and brokerage business in Morocco. The company offers automobile multi-risk home death accident travel/assistance pension savings insurance products for individuals. It also provides automotive insurance that covers public liability defense and appeal vehicle damage flight fire broken glass collision damage and passenger protection; industrial multi-risk fire/explosions breakage of machinery water damage flight and glass breakage and signs insurance products; construction assembly all risks and civil liability insurance products; and operating losses transported goods credit and cyber security insurance products. The company was formerly known as Agma Lahlou-Tazi S.A. and changed its name to Agma SA in May 2018. Agma SA was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Salalah Port Services Company SAOG
Description: Salalah Port Services Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in the leasing equipping operating and managing of container terminal and general cargo terminal facilities in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in two segments Container Terminal and General Cargo Terminal. The company provides marine services; value-added services such as trucking real estate leasing CFS roro customs clearance bulk dhow operations warehousing sea air cargo cruise flex hubs oasis villas and clubs and break-bulk services; and property-related activities within the Port of Salalah premises. In addition it operates a liquid bulk terminal at the port of Salalah. Salalah Port Services Company SAOG was founded in 1998 and is based in Salalah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Quds Bank Ltd.
Description: Quds Bank Ltd. provides banking and investment services and commercial solutions to corporate and individual customers. It offers current accounts; personal loans auto financing and real estate financing; credit cards and ATM cards; and e-services money transfer and safe boxes services. The company also provides banking services including treasury and FX services and remittances; financing services such as loans overdraft fixed assets financing project financing purchase and receivable financing discounting bills/cheques and customs financing; international trade services comprising bills for collection letters of credit and letters of guarantees; and mobile and online banking services. It operates through a network of multiple branches and offices in the Palestinian Authority as well as representative office in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: TotalEnergies Marketing Sénégal SA
Description: TotalEnergies Marketing Sénégal SA engages in the distribution of fuels in Senegal. It offers fuel butane gas jet fuel heating oils and solar lamps as well as fuel cards. The company also sells car care products lubricants and car washing through their gas stations shops; and operates restaurants under the La Croissanterie and Tweat names. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Dakar Senegal. TotalEnergies Marketing Sénégal SA is a subsidiary of TotalEnergies SE.

Name: Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E
Description: Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E together with its subsidiary El Tatweer Food Industries Company (S.A.E.) manufactures markets and distributes dairy cheese juice and bakery products in Egypt. It operates in three segments: Dairy Products Juice Products and Bakery Products. The company offers white and processed cheeses; mozzarella; juices; bakery products comprising sandwiches bread and croissants; and full and half cream and skimmed milk products. It sells its products under the Domty Bravo and Slim brands. The company also exports its products to approximately 35 countries with presence in the Middle East Europe North America and Africa. The company was formerly known as Domty Company for Food Industries S.A.E and changed its name to Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E in August 2006. Arabian Food Industries Company (DOMTY) - S.A.E was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Romi S.A.
Description: Romi S.A. develops manufactures and sells machine tools plastic processing machines and cast parts. The company provides machine tools such as machining and turning centers vertical turning centers CNC lathes and vertical CNC lathes CNC borings engine lathes and heavy and extra-heavy-duty CNC lathes; plastic processing machines including plastic injection blowing and molding machines; and casting and machined parts. It also provides presales and aftersales engineering services technical assistance and spare parts; and exports its products internationally. Its products and services are used by various industries such as automotive components manufacturing consumer goods agricultural machinery and implements education and industrial machinery and equipment. The company was formerly known as Indústrias Romi S.A. Romi S.A. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Santa Bárbara d'Oeste Brazil.

Name: City Lodge Hotels Limited
Description: City Lodge Hotels Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the operation of hotels for business and leisure travelers in South Africa Botswana Mozambique and Namibia. It owns operates and manages hotels under the Courtyard City Lodge Town Lodge and Road Lodge brands. City Lodge Hotels Limited was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Master Drilling Group Limited
Description: Master Drilling Group Limited an investment holding company provides specialized drilling services to blue chip major and mid-tier companies in the mining civil engineering construction and hydroelectric power sectors. It provides rock boring services including horizontal and vertical raise and box hole boring; slot hole reverse circulation piling and directional drilling; shotcreting; paste holes; and LIDAR scanning for mining civil and energy sectors. The company also offers industrial products. In addition it provides exploration drilling services such as blast hole core mud and air rotary percussion sonic diamond slim and reverse circulation drilling services; de-watering; and geotechnical services as well as mining services. The company also developed new technologies for tunneling shaft sinking and production boring. It operates in Africa Central and North America South Africa South America and internationally. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Fochville South Africa.

Name: Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail
Description: Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail provides various financial services in Morocco. The company offers equipment leasing and real estate leasing services. It serves professionals traders SMEs SMIs large groups and multinationals. Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Société Maghrébine de Crédit-bail operates as a subsidiary of Bank of Africa.

Name: Jaiz Bank Plc
Description: Jaiz Bank Plc provides non-interest banking services in Nigeria. It offers savings current domiciliary investment and term deposit accounts. The company also provides auto household appliances consumer home working capital project/construction lease to own equity-based import and export financing services as well as school fee hospital and medical bill rent and other financing services. In addition it offers various cards; investment products; letters of credit bonds guarantees acceptances and trade related contingencies that include documentary credits; point of sale; and automated teller machine services as well as online mobile and SMS banking services. Jaiz Bank Plc was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Abuja Nigeria.

Name: Syn Prop & Tech S.A.
Description: We are SYN and we have a deep understanding of the Brazilian commercial real estate market. Our business is to make our clients' lives easier so they can focus on their own businesses. We serve various market segments including shopping malls commercial buildings and warehouses. Our services encompass leasing management as well as buying and selling commercial properties. Our team consists of experts in management projects engineering security technology and business with experience autonomy and a lot of talent for innovation to deliver the best solutions. Every day we wake up and dedicate ourselves to ensuring that companies and retailers feel at ease achieve their goals and thrive. We work behind the scenes taking care of people's experiences in SYN spaces while they work shop and have fun.

Name: Kuwait Foundry Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Foundry Company K.S.C.P. engages in the manufacturing of iron and other metal products in Kuwait. It operates through two segments: Manufacturing and Investment. The company offers manhole covers gratings and frames and pressure fittings. It is also involved in the investment in securities. Kuwait Foundry Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Al Argan International Real Estate Company - K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Argan International Real Estate Company - K.S.C.P. operates as a real estate development company in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Real Estate Investment Contracting and Hotels and Resorts segments. The company engages in owning buying managing and selling of real estates and lands; conducting real estate studies and consulting activities; performing maintenance work related to buildings and real estates including maintenance work execution of civil mechanical electrical elevators work and air conditioning; organizing real estate exhibitions; and import and export activities. It also establishes real estate auctions; owns and manages commercial shops and housing complexes; trades in construction materials and equipment; constructs civil mechanical electrical sanitary elevators air conditioning aluminum and carpentry contracting projects; imports construction equipment; and owns buys and sells real estate companies' shares and bonds. In addition the company invests owns operates manages and leases hotels clubs motels hospitality houses rest houses parks gardens exhibitions restaurants cafeterias touristic and health resorts entertainment and sports projects; and manages restaurants. Further it establishes and manages investment funds; undertakes infrastructure projects for areas housing commercial and industrial projects; manages real estate facilities under BOT system; invests in portfolios managed by specialized entities; engages in agricultural activities; and offers medical services and heavy equipment as well as project management educational assets management advertising and entertainment services; and operates swimming pools. Al Argan International Real Estate Company - K.S.C.P. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Productive Business Solutions Limited
Description: Productive Business Solutions Limited engages in the distribution of printing equipment business machines handsets and related accessories. The company offers automated teller machines security checkpoints system integration cloud services data analytics communication solutions e-transaction solutions and development of software and other technology solutions. It also provides professional advanced networking and communications and information technology services; and printing security systems and payment methods. It has operations in Barbados Costa Rica Dominican Republic El Salvador Guatemala Honduras Nicaragua Panama the United States Antilles Jamaica Trinidad Guyana Cayman Antigua Colombia Suriname and internationally. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in St Michael Barbados. Productive Business Solutions Limited is a subsidiary of Facey Group Limited.

Name: CSU Digital S.A.
Description: CSU Digital S.A. a technology company for financial services provides digital solutions for payments embedded finance customer experience and loyalty and incentive programs in Brazil. The company operates through two segments: CSU Pays and CSU DX. The CSU Pays segment encompasses solutions in digital payments loyalty and incentives and embedded finance including card processing for issuers and acquirers in the credit debit digital and virtual modalities; the offer of digital wallets instant payments and cryptocurrencies; and others. The CSU DX segment focuses on the development of digital experience solutions with technological and digital density directing efforts to projects with added value and complexity. The company also provides development and operational management relationship and customer acquisition programs; electronic transaction services for companies; information technology outsourcing services; and banking correspondent services to financial institutions. In addition it manages and operates telemarketing and telesales contact centers and credit analysis; captures electronic transactions as means of payment; and develops credit card administration and issuance activities as well as payment account management solutions and activities. The company was formerly known as CSU CardSystem S.A. and changed its name to CSU Digital S.A. in August 2022. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Barueri Brazil. CSU Digital S.A. is a subsidiary of Greeneville Delaware LLC.

Name: Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited
Description: Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited engages in the underwriting of various classes of reinsurance and investments activities in Africa the Middle East and Asia. The company offers life and health reinsurance plans; property and casualty insurance policies for the fire marine hull engineering aviation motor and agriculture industries; and Retakaful support services. It also provides training services in the field of insurance and reinsurance industry. Kenya Reinsurance Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Egypt Gas Company SAE
Description: Egypt Gas Company SAE operates EPC-based natural gas distribution projects in Egypt. The company offers natural gas services including land survey P and A survey and design of natural gas projects; constructs high pressure transmission pipelines in different materials such as carbon steel and HDPE; and constructs pressure reduction stations and pressure reduction units as well as distribution networks. It also provides internal and external installations of gas meters for residential and commercial units; fabricates and installs the flues required for the system; operates and maintains projects; designs fabricates and installs accessories for natural gas project installations; and performs technical control and inspections on steel pipelines. In addition the company offers services for the design engineering procurement and construction of oil and gas projects; undertakes civil works; and mechanical works comprising supply and installation of pipeline projects storage tanks construction and maintenance installation works fire proofing works electromechanical works abrasive blasting and protective coating works scaffolding works and offshore platforms maintenance and rehabilitation. It serves residential commercial and industrial customers. The company was formerly known as natural gas projects company – SAE and changed its name to Egypt Gas Company SAE in August 2008. Egypt Gas Company SAE was founded in 1983 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Osoul Investment Company - K.S.C.P
Description: Osoul Investment Company - K.S.C.P an asset management company engages in the financing and investment activities in Kuwait and Gulf Co-operation council. The company operates through three segments: Finance Investment and Real Estate. It invests in real estate industrial agricultural and economic sectors; acts as an investment portfolio manager; purchases and sells securities and bonds; deals and trades in the foreign exchange market and precious metals market; and owns industrial property rights patents commercial and industrial trademarks commercial designs and literary and intellectual property rights related to programs and writings. The company also invests in Murabaha v and deposit in financial institutions; and offers wealth fund client portfolio and real estate management services. In addition it conducts studies and specializes in analytical research; and engages in the general trading activities. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Constructora Conconcreto S.A.
Description: Constructora Conconcreto S.A. operates as a construction company in Colombia and internationally. It offers construction services including consulting services such as pre-construction project management technical management conceptualization and auditing services for project conceptualization; construction design services which include architectural interior structural network geotechnical geometric and bioclimatic designs as well as integration of designs under BIM methodology; services for infrastructure housing buildings prefabricated components triboard panels and aggregates; and asset management services including specialized and public service management maintenance and multiservices and renovation and building adaptation services. The company also develops and sells housing and commercial units; and concessions and real investment projects. In addition it develops builds designs and manages infrastructure building and housing projects such as airport facilities logistic facilities commercial facilities institutions hotelier health facilities industrial corporate and transport. The company was incorporated in 1961 and is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E)
Description: Tenth of Ramadan for Pharmaceutical Industries and Diagnostic Reagents (Rameda) (S.A.E) together with its subsidiaries produces and sells a range of branded generic pharmaceuticals food supplements veterinary products and nutraceuticals in Egypt. The company manufactures markets sells and stores pharmaceutical reagents for human and veterinary use and diagnostic reagents for individuals laboratories and hospitals; imports pharmaceutical reagents and raw materials; and produces food supplements for human use. It offers a portfolio of products in various therapeutic areas such as anti-biotics cardiovascular diseases and gastro-intestinal tract disorders anti-infectives alimentary tract and metabolism genito-urinary system nervous system blood forming organs weight management and sex hormones. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in 6th of October City Egypt.

Name: National Cleaning Company K.P.S.C.
Description: National Cleaning Company K.P.S.C. provides cleaning services in Kuwait Turkey Iraq and India. Its services include municipal waste management comprising city cleaning and waste collection and disposal services; and solid and liquid refuse removal and cleaning such as clearing of building debris and removal of house wreckages and leftovers in the residential and industrial network. The company offers environmental waste management services consisting of oil lakes profile survey and rehabilitation petroleum sludge management soil treatment boreholes assessment anaerobic thermal desorption electrochemical soil treatment bioremediation soil washing crude oil tanks sludge quantification tanks cleaning API separator maintenance and skimming pumps heat exchanger cleaning spill response and chemical accident hazardous waste landfill construction and operation solid waste reception and treatment refineries/petrochemical plants waste management industrial wastewater treatment domestic sewage waste water treatment plant car wash water recycling oily water treatment and leachate treatment plant. The company is engaged in the marketing and selling of asphalt products; trading of animals and crops; swimming pool cleaning and maintenance; used tires recycling; manufacturing of v goods; investment in trading stocks bonds and other securities; food supplies; road cleaning contracting; and real estate activities. National Cleaning Company K.P.S.C. was founded in 1978 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Loterie Nationale du Bénin Société Anonyme
Description: Loterie Nationale du Bénin Société Anonyme a gaming and lottery company. It offers mobilize national savings to finance investments of a social cultural and sporting nature. The Company was founded in 1967 and is based in Cotonou Benin.

Name: Bonyan for Development and Trade
Description: Bonyan for Development and Trade a real estate investment company acquires operates and leases commercial real estate assets in east and west Cairo. The company is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Iron & Steel for Mines & Quarries
Description: Iron & Steel for Mines & Quarries explores and exploits iron and steel in Egypt. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Caracol Televisión S.A.
Description: Caracol Televisión S.A. engages in the radio broadcasting and television businesses in Columbia and internationally. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Boyacá Colombia. Caracol Televisión S.A. is a subsidiary of Valorem S.A.

Name: Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al-Mazaya Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries operates as a real estate development company in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Oman and Bahrain. It develops villas and residential buildings; commercial spaces comprising office and retail buildings; and health projects such as medical centers and hospitality projects. The company is involved in the marketing and sales management services; project management services; property management services; portfolio management services; medical services; and real estate brokerage and research services. In addition it purchases owns and sells lands; and operates manages invests in leases and rents hotels health clubs recreational parks gardens exhibition grounds restaurants residential and commercial complexes and tourist and health resorts. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A.
Description: Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. operates as a multi-solution company in Brazil. The company offers private healthcare plans markets and manages other insurance or complementary services and provides services for the capture routing authorization and billing of medical and hospital services. It also offers medical audit services processing of medical bills call center operations claims and hospital network management system licensing and other outsourced healthcare support services. Additionally it engages in mass insurance brokerage through retail channels such as life insurance capitalization home insurance extended warranty financial protection insurance and others. The company facilitates client access to accredited networks of service providers and offers specialized care management services. It serves monitors and reviews client portfolios. The company was formerly known as Qualicorp S.A. and changed its name to Qualicorp Consultoria e Corretora de Seguros S.A. in June 2018. It was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: A Capital Holding
Description: A Capital Holding operate as a real estate investment firm. The company is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Gemfields Group Limited
Description: Gemfields Group Limited together with its subsidiaries operates as a mining company. It operates through Kagem Mining Limited Montepuez Ruby Mining Limitada Development Assets Fabergé Corporate and Other segments. The company explores for emerald beryl ruby corundum gold and allied minerals in Zambia Mozambique Ethiopia and Madagascar. It also engages in the wholesale and retail of jewelry and watches through directly operated boutiques international wholesale partners its website and other third-party online marketplaces; sale of cut and polished gemstones; and provision of marketing and technical and administrative services. In addition the company mines platinum group metals including platinum palladium rhodium and gold in South Africa. The company was formerly known as Pallinghurst Resources Limited and changed its name to Gemfields Group Limited in June 2018. Gemfields Group Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in London the United Kingdom.

Name: Société Nationale d'Electrolyse et de Pétrochimie S.A.
Description: Société Nationale d'Electrolyse et de Pétrochimie S.A. produces and sells vinyl and electrolysis products. The company offers liquid chlorine for use in bacteriological treatment; caustic soda used in food textile mining detergent and other industries; bleach for disinfection and detergent; and hydrochloric acid for galvanizing and surface treatment. It also provides PVC resin and PVC compound used for buildings irrigation drinking water supply sanitation energy transfer clothing etc. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Société Nationale d'Electrolyse et de Pétrochimie S.A. is a subsidiary of YNNA Holding SA.

Name: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A.
Description: Priner Serviços Industriais S.A. provides industrial infrastructure integrity engineering and inspection services in the petrochemical pulp and paper steel offshore naval mining and infrastructure sectors in Brazil. The company provides access solutions including scaffolding UpPriner LinkDeck Rope access and Web PrinerDeck; mechanical testing chemical analysis metallographic analysis corrosion testing field solutions procedure and welder qualification and failure analysis; execution of injected piles micro-anchoring anchored retaining walls soil nailing shotcrete soil treatment and load testing; pressurized habitat solutions; non-destructive testing inspection of equipment and facilities welding engineering advanced engineering materials engineering and laboratory services training and consulting inspection software and tank inspection services. Name: Dari Couspate SA
Description: Dari Couspate SA produces and sells couscous and pasta products in Morocco. It also exports its products to approximately 45 countries. In addition the company distributes its products to retail chains and outlets. Dari Couspate SA was founded in 1995 and is based in Salé Morocco.

Name: Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A.
Description: Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A. engages in the development exploration exploitation production and metallurgical treatment and marketing of mining in Peru. The company produces and sells zinc lead and copper concentrates. It also owns mining rights in the Huanzalá and Pallca mines located in the Ancash Region Peru. Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Compañía Minera Santa Luisa S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsui Mining & Smelting Co. Ltd.

Name: Envases Venezolanos S.A.
Description: Envases Venezolanos S.A. engages in the manufacturing and sale of metal and glass containers for various containers for use in industrial and domestic applications in Venezuela. The company provides tin containers for canned fish food and industrial products; lids; and tin crown caps and plastic caps as well as undertakes lithography works. Envases Venezolanos S.A. was founded in 1952 and is based in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Zeda Limited
Description: Zeda Limited provides mobility solutions in South Africa and other countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through Car Rental Business and Leasing Business segments. The Car Rental Business segment provides short term rental and subscription solutions for individuals business travel corporates and government entities under the Avis and Budget brand name. It provides replacement vehicles for its partner insurance companies as well as other complementary products that include the hire of child car seats GPS and bike racks and specialized insurance products. The Leasing Business segment offers services that comprise the leasing of vehicles such as motorcycles and heavy commercial vehicles for corporates small businesses and government entities. It also provides complementary products such as telematics intelligent fuel and accident management roadside assistance insurance and managed maintenance services as well as maintenance plans. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kempton Park South Africa.

Name: Grupo Bvl S.A.A.
Description: Grupo Bvl S.A.A. provides stock market services in Peru. It offers stock market trading clearing and settlement digital and price provisioning services. The company also facilitates the trading of duly registered securities through stock exchange; offers registration transfer and custody services for securities; provides transaction clearing and settlement services; offers platform services for the issuance signature management and custody of electronic documents linked to commercial transactions; and provides consulting services in various areas related to the financial and securities markets. In addition it offers educational services for promoting the development of the securities market as well as invests in financial assets. The company was formerly known as Bolsa de Valores de Lima S.A.A. and changed its name to Grupo Bvl S.A.A. in June 2021. The company was founded in 1860 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Grupo Bvl S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Holding Bursátil Regional S.A.

Name: Pampa Camarones SpA
Description: Pampa Camarones SpA develops and operates copper project in the Arica and Parinacota Region. It produces and sells copper cathodes. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Las Condes Chile.

Name: Mohandes Insurance Company
Description: Mohandes Insurance Company provides life and general insurance products in Egypt. It offers fire and burglary; and engineering insurance products including all-risk installation contractors all-risk machinery malfunction document contractors machinery and equipment electronic equipment document and corruption document contents insurance. The company also provides transport and ship hull insurance; group medical treatment insurance; and compulsory and supplementary cars insurance. In addition it offers miscellaneous accident insurance products comprising personal accident employers liability travel risk document professional liability family protection and housing glass breakage cash transportation and civil liability for elevator and construction work as well as insurance against breach of trust of embezzlement insurance policies. Mohandes Insurance Company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG
Description: Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries markets and distributes petroleum products primarily in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers one-stop-shop service stations that provides on- the-go shopping food and beverages; commercial fuels; fuel cards and lubricants; and digital transformation solutions. The company also provides marine fuel and solutions advertisement and property rental services. In addition it operates retail convenience store car care centers and coffee franchise. Further the company markets and distributes petroleum products and bunker petroleum products. The company was formerly known as BP Oman SAOG and changed its name to Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG in October 2003. Oman Oil Marketing Company SAOG was founded in 1998 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C. engages in the energy and infrastructure business in Qatar and internationally. The company engages in the marketing and sale of products and services related to oil and gas industry; trading and rental of industrial construction equipment; and undertaking water contractor works. It also provides engineering services for geological mining and underground and surface water; and sewage and water draining services. Al Mahhar Holding Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 1989 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: YeboYethu (RF) Limited
Description: YeboYethu (RF) Limited acquires and holds shares in Vodacom Group. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E)
Description: Egyptian Gulf Bank (S.A.E) provides various corporate retail and investment banking services in Egypt. It offers savings current interest bearing and investment accounts; certificates of deposit; and time deposits. The company provides secured personal auto used cars auto durable goods education syndicated and mortgage loans; revolving overdrafts; loans for small and medium sized businesses; working capital and trade financing; project finance; loans for doctors; and pharmacists lending services. In addition it offers Islamic banking cash management foreign exchange treasury bills and bonds payroll fund margin lending e-statement and online banking services as well as debit credit and internet cards. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries provides consumer and commercial lending services in Kuwait. It operates through four segments: Finance Asset Management Investment and Corporate Finance and Financial Brokerage and Online Trading. The Finance segment provides consumer and commercial loans to individuals and corporate entities. The Asset Management segment offers portfolio management and custody services; and manages mutual funds. The Investment and Corporate Finance segment provides investment banking and financial consultancy services; and monitors direct investments. The Financial Brokerage and Online Trading segment offers brokerage and online trading services. The company also leases buys and sells vehicles; provides collection services; manages funds and portfolios on behalf of its clients; and invests in securities and real estate. In addition it offers investment management alternative investment and consulting and advisory services. The company was formerly known as Kuwait Finance and Investment Company K.S.C and changed its name to KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public) in November 2022. (Public). KFIC Invest Company K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Quality Chemical Industries Limited
Description: Quality Chemical Industries Limited manufactures and sells pharmaceutical drugs in Uganda. The company offers lamivudine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate dolutegravir efavirenz and zidovudine tablets for the treatment of HIV infection. It also provides lumartem/lumet tablets for the treatment of malaria; texavir and zentair for the treatment of Hepatitis B; and isoniazid/pyridoxine hydrochloride /sulfamethoxazole trimethoprim tablets for the treatment of tuberculosis. In addition the company offers emeset for the treatment of nausea and vomiting; ciplox and azicip anti-infectives to prevent and treat infections; amlopres to treat hypertension; and erecto for the treatment of reproductive disorders such as erectile dysfunction. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Cipla Quality Chemical Industries Limited and changed its name to Quality Chemical Industries Limited in February 2024. Quality Chemical Industries Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. Quality Chemical Industries Limited is a subsidiary of Cipla Limited.

Name: Contact Financial Holding S.A.E.
Description: Contact Financial Holding S.A.E. operates as a consumer finance company in Egypt. The company offers financing solutions for new and used cars light commercial vehicles heavy transport trucks trailers motorcycles scooters and beach buggies; educational program financing for school university and postgraduate studies; club memberships weddings and events and home interior and furniture financing; mortgage products including home finance and home equity; green finance for agricultural investments; watercraft financing consisting of yachts boats jet skis rafting kayaking kitesurfing gear water skiing parasailing diving gear and many more; shopping finance services for purchasing of consumer products; maintenance financing for home car and property; financial leasing services for passenger vehicles busses vans medical equipment and commercial vehicles that comprises light medium and heavy trucks; and commercial and consumerism direct and reverse recourse and non-recourse and spot or whole ledger factoring services. It also provides insurance brokerage services which include medical life personal accident home electronics machinery key protection car total car loss vehicle transporter business transportation and total transportation insurance products as well as medical discount cards and key replacement coverage products; and marine and cargo transportation engineering solutions fire and burglary fidelity guarantee business interruption cash in transit and non-payment risk insurance products. The company was formerly known as Sarwa Capital Holding for Financial Investments (S.A.E) and changed its name to Contact Financial Holding S.A.E. in March 2021. Contact Financial Holding S.A.E. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Masisa S.A.
Description: Masisa S.A. manufactures and sells wooden boards for furniture solutions and interior spaces in Chile the United States Peru Colombia Ecuador Canada China Vietnam South Korea and internationally. It offers raw and coated panels; medium density fiberboards (MDF); medium density particleboards; one layer boards; particle boards; melamine boards; MDF moldings; sawn timber; finger joint moldings; PVC and ABS edge tapes; melamine ripados veneered and painted interior coverings; and hardware complementary for the development and construction of furniture as well as ECOPLAC and TFL panels. The company also exports its products. It serves the construction industry. The company was formerly known as Terranova SA and changed its name to Masisa S.A. in 2005. Masisa S.A. was founded in 1960 and is based in Santiago Chile. Masisa S.A. is a subsidiary of GN Holding S.A.

Name: Acrow Misr
Description: Acrow Misr designs manufactures sells and rents formwork and scaffolding products in Egypt Africa South-Eastern Europe Algeria Bahrain Kenya Kuwait Saudi Arabia Morocco Nigeria Oman Qatar Romania Tanzania and the United Arab Emirates. The company offers foundation wall and core wall column slab climbing bridge and façade and suspended scaffolding systems as well as safety equipment access staircase. It also provides engineering solutions formwork sale and rent services site support after sale services and logistics services. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Acrow Misr operates as a subsidiary of Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development.

Name: Companhia de Participações Aliança da Bahia
Description: Companhia de Participações Aliança da Bahia through its subsidiaries engages in breeding rearing selecting fattening buying and selling of cattle and other species in Brazil. It also engages in agricultural activities buying and selling real estate; engineering services construction and insurance. The company was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Salvador Brazil.

Name: National International Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: National International Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the financial and real estate investing and industrial activities. It operates through three segments: financial; real estate; and industrial. The company’s Financial Investing segment participates in financial and real estate funds. Its Real Estate Investing segment invests in trades in constructs or develops and sells real estate properties and other related real estate services. The company’s Industrial segment engages in manufacturing and selling chemical products. The company also owns intellectual property rights including patents trademarks or industrial forms franchise rights and other rights. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: UAC of Nigeria PLC
Description: UAC of Nigeria PLC operates in the animal feeds and other edibles packaged food and beverages and quick service restaurant business in Nigeria. It operates through Edibles & Feed Paints Packaged Food & Beverages and Quick Service Restaurants (QSR) segments. The Edibles & Feed segment engages in the manufacture and sale of livestock feeds and edible oil. The Paints segment manufactures and sells paint products and other decoratives. The Packaged Food & Beverages segment manufactures and sells bottled water snacks and ice-cream. The QSR segment is involved in the making and sale of snacks and meals. The company operates and franchises Mr Biggs’ and Debonairs Pizza chain of restaurants. It also engages in property development; building and operation maintenance for commercial and residential properties; operation of hotel and conference rooms; and provision of logistics services such as warehousing short-and medium-haul transportation and haulage services. UAC of Nigeria PLC was founded in 1879 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company BSC
Description: Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company BSC together with its subsidiaries operates as a finance company in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through four segments: Lending Automotive Real Estate and Insurance. The company offers car and personal loans; mortgage loan; cheque discounting facilities; credit cards. It also provides medical motor life home and travel insurance; trades in motor vehicles and spares as well as offers after sales services and car leasing services; and buys sells and rents properties as well as provides property evaluation services. Bahrain Commercial Facilities Company BSC was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Tubli the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Compagnie de Transports au Maroc Société Anonyme
Description: Compagnie de Transports au Maroc Société Anonyme provides transportation services in Morocco. It offers intercity and personnel transportation services as well as travel services. The company was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Soquimich Comercial S.A.
Description: Soquimich Comercial S.A. development production marketing and sale of plant nutrition products primarily in Chile. It offers water-soluble fertilizers; granulated fertilizers; specialty plant nutrition products for foliar application; organic products for use in organic agriculture; custom made soluble and granulated mixes; and other products. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Santiago Chile. Soquimich Comercial S.A. operates as a subsidiary of SQM Industrial S.A.

Name: Sanad Construction Resources PLC
Description: Sanad Construction Resources PLC engages in the manufacture packaging and trading of cement in Palestine. The company offers packed and bulk cement. It also trades in construction materials; imports and supplies cement; provides commercial transportation services; invests in construction companies; and extracts stones and sand. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Al Bireh Palestine.

Name: Honeywell Flour Mills Plc
Description: Honeywell Flour Mills Plc manufactures and markets wheat-based products in Nigeria. It offers flour semolina whole wheat meal noodles and pasta as well as manages free trade zone enterprises. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Honeywell Flour Mills Plc is a subsidiary of Flour Mills of Nigeria PLC.

Name: Novus Holdings Limited
Description: Novus Holdings Limited engages in the printing production and manufacturing operations in South Africa. It operates through Print Education Packing and Other segments. The Print segment engages in printing of books magazines retail inserts and newspapers for fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) sector. The Education segment develops educational content for various institutions including government and private colleges. The Packaging segment produces flexible packaging products and prints flexible labels to beverage petrochemical and FMCG markets. The Other segment engages in the non-print/packaging and non-educational related transaction businesses; and provision of jumbo tissue wadding which is used to produce household and consumer products such as toilet paper facial tissue kitchen towels and serviettes. The company was founded in 1905 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Vittia S.A.
Description: Vittia S.A. provides fertilizers in Brazil and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Foliar Fertilizers and Industrial Products; Soil Micronutrients; Soil Conditioners and Organominerals; and Biological Products. It offers biological organomineral foliar bio and concentrated suspension fertilizers; adjuvants; biological pesticides comprising microbiological and macrobiological control; inoculants; sulfur; acaricides; soil conditioners; vegetable nutrition products consist of chloride CoMo phosphite macro nitrate soluble powders and concentrated suspensions; sulphates; and granulated micronutrients and salts for agriculture and livestock. The company was formerly known as Vittia Fertilizantes e Biológicos S.A. and changed its name to Vittia S.A. in May 2023. Vittia S.A. was founded in 1971 and is based in São Joaquim da Barra Brazil.

Name: Austral Group S.A.A.
Description: Austral Group S.A.A. a fishing company produces and trades in marine based foods and ingredients in Peru and internationally. The company operates in two segments Indirect Human Consumption and Direct Human Consumption. It offers frozen canned fishmeal and fish oil. The company also provides frozen fresh and canned marine products of various species such as horse mackerel mackerel squid bonito parakeet and others. Austral Group S.A.A. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Austral Group S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Laco AS.

Name: Zeder Investments Ltd.
Description: Zeder Investments Ltd. is a private equity arm of PSG Group Ltd. specializing in middle market investments in PIPEs transactions. The firm seeks to invest in unlisted securities of agricultural food beverages grain and related industries with a focus on agribusiness industry. It seeks to make investments in South Africa and neighbouring countries. It invests between ZAR20 million ($2.74 million) and ZAR500 million($49.48 million) in companies with an enterprise value between ZAR50 million ($4.95 million) and ZAR10000 million ($989.55 million) revenues between ZAR500 million ($49.48 million) and ZAR30000 million ($2968.65 million) and EBITDA between ZAR10 million ($0.99 million) and ZAR2000 million ($197.91 million). The firm sources its capital through equity capital raised through the issuing of share to public shareholders. It invests through its personal capital. Zeder Investments Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is based in Stellenbosch South Africa.

Name: Arab Islamic Bank P.L.C.
Description: Arab Islamic Bank P.L.C. provides banking products and services in Palestine. It operates through Retail Banking Corporate Banking and Treasury segments. The company offers current savings and financial inclusion accounts; debit and shopping cards; gold-guaranteed loans; and finance programs including auto commodity education health services travel small enterprise corporate and project as well as Ijara Istisna’a and SunRef Energy. It also provides international trade such as letter of credit and banking guarantees; money transfer; foreign currency buying and selling; and cheque books.
