In addition the company offers e-services including mobile and internet banking; bills electronic and QR payments; SMS video call and pre-booking services; smart soft point-of-sale and point-of-sale; E-SADAD; and digital services center. It operates through a network of branches offices and ATMs as well as a mobile branch. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestine. Arab Islamic Bank P.L.C. is a subsidiary of Bank of Palestine Plc.

Name: Gulf Insurance Group - Jordan
Description: Gulf Insurance Group - Jordan engages in the insurance business in Jordan Middle East and North Africa region. The company offers group individual and international medical insurance products; group and individual life insurance products; motor insurance products; travel insurance products; marine aviation and energy insurance products including marine cargo marine hull yachts and pleasure crafts and freight forwarder legal liability insurance products; and property engineering and other insurance products. It also provides reinsurance products. The company was formerly known as Arab Orient Insurance Company. Gulf Insurance Group - Jordan was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Gulf Insurance Group – Jordan is a subsidiary of Gulf Insurance Group K.S.C.P.

Name: Chobe Holdings Limited
Description: Chobe Holdings Limited through its subsidiaries owns and operates ecotourism lodges and camps on leased lands in northern Botswana and the Caprivi Strip in Namibia. It operates through Camp Lodge and Safari Operations; Transfers and Touring; Aircraft Maintenance Operations; and Other segments. The company operates lodges and camps under the Desert & Delta Safaris Chobe Game Lodge and Ker & Downey Botswana brands. It also provides air road and water transfer services; game viewing services; farming; property rental; bed nights of camps and hotel rooms; suite of aircraft maintenance services; and other miscellaneous operations. In addition the company offers tour and safari services; management services; reservation services; and air charter services. Further it leases farmland and equipment; and exports goods for lodges. Chobe Holdings Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Araxi Limited
Description: Araxi Limited together with its subsidiaries operates as a financial technology company in South Africa the Asia Pacific the United States the United Kingdom Europe the rest of Africa and the Indian Ocean Islands. It operates through three segments: Payments and Payment Infrastructure and Services; Software and Services; and International. The company provides payment infrastructure technical support and payment technology solutions to established financial institutions emerging payment service providers and corporate customers in the retail fuel restaurant hospitality and healthcare sectors. It also designs develops and implements end-to-end solutions such as device fleet management solutions to institutional clients and corporate customers; supplies electronic point-of-sale devices; and offers merchants with a single device for the banking and non-banking products and services. In addition the company provides a multi-product and multi-party transacting platform and value-added services solutions for the facilitation of business-to-business payment-related products in conjunction with an institutional client base. Further it offers software development consulting and integration and technology-based product solutions which enable clients to perform business processing functions meet regulatory requirements integrate with trading platforms and exchanges and secure sensitive information to banking financial services retail telecommunications healthcare and other enterprises. The company was formerly known as Capital Appreciation Limited and changes its name to Araxi Limited in October 2025. Araxi Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Grazziotin S.A.
Description: Grazziotin S.A. engages in the retail and wholesale business in Brazil. The company’s stores offer furniture convenience store merchandise home appliances electronics housewares household clothing and accessories sports articles and perfumery as well as cosmetics foodstuffs decoration camping hygiene and cleaning products. It is also involved in the financial institutions and insurance brokerage as well as manages shopping centers. The company provides its products under Grazziotin Franco Giorgi Pormenos Tottal and GZT brand names. The company was founded in 1950 and is based in Passo Fundo Brazil.

Name: GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E
Description: GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E. engages in production of pharmaceutical chemicals. The company is involved in manufacture of general and specialty medicines and vaccines. GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E. was founded in 1981 and is based in London the United Kingdom. GlaxoSmithKline S.A.E operates as a subsidiary of Glaxo Group Limited.

Name: Egyptian Media Production City
Description: Egyptian Media Production City provides services in the media drama and film production industries. It operates an audio-visual heritage restoration center which offers films physical restoration film scanning and digital restoration services; up skill training and development center that provides training programs; and Dolby Atmos studio that offers audio mixing services. It also operates a five stars hotel channel studios for media production and live transmission technical operation centers administrative offices for shooting different productions and production service centers as well as organizes events and conferences. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Gadwa for Industrial Development
Description: Gadwa for Industrial Development operates as an industrial development and investment company in Egypt and internationally. The company manufactures packing materials and papers electrical wires and cables and cheese including white processed Swiss and Italian varieties. It also manufactures installs and assembles electricity water and gas meters. In addition the company engages in contracting and real estate investment pharmaceuticals and financial advisory businesses. Additionally the company provides dairy products manufactures packaging materials and produces self-adhesive tabs corrugated carton boxes and boards. Further it engages in manufacturing copper and aluminum cables and conductors. Gadwa for Industrial Development was founded in 2021 and is based in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: Tijara & Real Estate Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Tijara & Real Estate Investment Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries purchases sells and exchanges land and real estate properties in Kuwait and internationally. It operates in Real Estate Management and Investment Management segments. The company is also involved in the construction and leases of buildings commercial and residential complexes. It also manages properties; purchases and sells securities of companies; develops and builds real estate properties; and invests in equities and other investments. In addition the company undertakes maintenance works of buildings and real estate properties such as civil mechanical and air-conditioning works. Tijara & Real Estate Investment Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Frontier Transport Holdings Limited
Description: Frontier Transport Holdings Limited an investment holding company operates in the transport sector in South Africa. It operates in two segments Passenger transport services and Vehicle and spares – sales and servicing. The company operates diesel buses electric buses and luxury charter coaches. It also provides public transport school and private tours luxury coaches shuttle services as well as involved in parts and spares sales. The company was formerly known as Hosken Passenger Logistics and Rail Limited and changed its name to Frontier Transport Holdings Limited in September 2021. Frontier Transport Holdings Limited was founded in 1861 and is based in Cape Town South Africa. Frontier Transport Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited.

Name: Orascom Investment Holding S.A.E.
Description: Orascom Investment Holding S.A.E. an investment holding company operates in the telecom sector in Egypt and Africa. It provides mobile telecommunication services; and direct broadband and high-speed connectivity to telecom operators internet services providers and companies through undersea optical fiber cables. The company is also involved in real estate property investments. The company was formerly known as Orascom Telecom Media and Technology Holding S.A.E. and changed its name to Orascom Investment Holding S.A.E. in July 2018. Orascom Investment Holding S.A.E. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Empresas Iansa S.A.
Description: Empresas Iansa S.A. manufactures and markets various food products in Chile and internationally. It offers sugar sweeteners delicacies expanded cereals premium juices and pet foods under Iansa sugar Iansa Zero K Iansa Agro Tanmaya Fellness Cannes and Biomaster brand name; sugar petfood cossette molasses concentrated juices fruit and vegetable pulps tomato paste and food ingredients under Industrial patagoniafresh and Icatom brand name; and beets tomatoes seedlings wheat and other crops under Agricultural Supplies Agricultural Production Animal Nutrition brand name. Empresas Iansa S.A. was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Santiago Chile. Empresas Iansa S.A. is a subsidiary of ED&F Man Holdings Limited.

Name: Zahraa El Maadi Investment and Development Company SAE
Description: Zahraa El Maadi Investment and Development Company SAE develops and sells residential units and lands in Egypt. It engages in the construction real estate development housing investment and tourism businesses. The company is based in New Maadi Egypt.

Name: Mediterranean Tourism Investment Company
Description: Mediterranean Tourism Investment Company operates and manages Four Seasons Hotel in Amman. It provides suites and guest rooms restaurants and lounges rooftop and indoor pools spa fitness amenities and other services. Mediterranean Tourism Investment Company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Zain Bahrain B.S.C.
Description: Zain Bahrain B.S.C. principally engages in the provision of public telecommunications and related products and services in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The company is involved in the provision of data roaming gaming streaming social media and call passes; mobile insurance; entertainment plans; and mobile and broadband plans devices home solutions and gift cards as well as trading of handsets and accessories for personal customers. It also offers mobile fiber and wireless broadband dedicated internet local and global connectivity UCaaS business roaming smart vehicle management bulk messaging landline and PABX Internet of Things smart WiFi SD-WAN ATM co-location Microsoft 365 Huawei Idealhub domain registration value added tax solutions and reference interconnect offer as well as cloud and managed security services for business customers. In addition the company provides local and international credit transfer services. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Zain Bahrain B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Mobile Telecommunications Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Banque Bemo S.A.L.
Description: Banque Bemo S.A.L. provides commercial corporate and private banking services primarily in Lebanon and internationally. The company offers private banking and wealth management services. It also provides corporate banking services comprising commercial facilities such as support in working capital and trade finance facilities; medium- and long-term facilities; project financing; securitization and corporate finance; syndicated loans; treasury services; and other services such as SWIFT notifications and e-statements. In addition the company offers treasury and capital market services including asset management cash and liquidity management foreign exchange and money market services. It serves customers through a network of branches in Lebanon and Limassol Cyprus. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Beirut Lebanon. Banque Bemo S.A.L. is a subsidiary of Sharikat Al Istismarat Al Oropia Lil Shark Al Aousat (Holding) sal.

Name: Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica
Description: Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica engages in the distribution of electricity in Brazil. It supplies electricity in 72 areas of the 497 municipalities covering an area of approximately 87101-kilometer square. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil. Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica is a subsidiary of Equatorial Participações e Investimentos S.A.

Name: Banco Comercial AV Villas S.A.
Description: Banco Comercial AV Villas S.A. provides various banking products and services in Colombia. It offers current savings digital transaction and payroll accounts. The company also provides investment credit portfolio purchase credit revolving credit payroll advance educative credit release credit ordinary credit treasury credit factoring business credit cards foreign trade and rediscount credit products. In addition it offers mortgage credit products; mortgage credit; pre-approved housing credit home acquisition credit pre-approved credit for real estate and mortgage portfolio products; insurance products; payment collection acquisition and currency buying and selling services; and credit and debit cards. The company was formerly known as Corporación de Ahorro y Vivienda AV Villas and changed its name to Banco Comercial AV Villas S.A. in March 2002. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Banco Comercial AV Villas S.A. is a subsidiary of Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A.

Name: SMN Power Holding SAOG
Description: SMN Power Holding SAOG together with its subsidiaries engages in the power generation and water desalination businesses in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates the Al Rusail plant a natural gas-fired power plant with a capacity of 1343 megawatts; and the Barka II plant an independent water and power plant with a water production capacity of 120000 cubic meters per day. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman. SMN Power Holding SAOG is a subsidiary of Oman United Insurance Company SAOG.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development
Description: Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development provides steel related products in Egypt. The company offers steel sheets sandwich panels corrugated sheets accessories steel purlins and guard rails. It also manufactures and sells metal formwork and scaffolding storage shelves sheet metal and prefabricated buildings and caravans. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. Industrial Engineering Company for Construction and Development operates as a subsidiary of AIF Holding Limited.

Name: Coast Investment & Development Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Coast Investment & Development Company K.S.C.P. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides advisory and consulting services. It primarily manages separate client focused portfolios and mutual funds for its clients. The firm invests in the public equity fixed income private equity and real estate markets across the globe. Its real estate investments include investments in properties reconstruction housing operations and all development operations in various fields. The firm seeks to invest in shares and bonds of companies government authorities and semi government authorities. It also invests in mutual funds. The firm employs a combination of quantitative and qualitative analysis to create its investment portfolios. It conducts in-house research to make its investments. Coast Investment & Development Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1975 and is based in Safat Kuwait.

Name: Inovest B.S.C.
Description: Inovest B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the asset management private equity and venture capital specializing in growth capital and real estate investment businesses in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The firm operates in a Shariah-compliant manner. It invests in direct investments and securities; establishes invests in and manages various investment funds; and undertakes contracting activities. The company also develops maintains leases and manages commercial and industrial centers residential buildings and other properties; purchases and sells properties; and constructs and maintains villas as well as offers project management and related advisory services. In addition it deals in financial instruments in the local regional and international markets; offers financial services and investment consultation services; provides information and studies related to various types of investments; and imports exports and sells electronic and electrical equipment and appliances. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: National Consumer Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: National Consumer Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) engages in the management and operation of various entertainment gaming centers in the State of Kuwait and Gulf Cooperation Council countries. It also manufactures and sells various sizes of corrugated cartons cement bags paper egg trays paper party plates and paper products and tissues. In addition the company engages in restaurant management services; and wholesale and retail trading activities. The company was formerly known as National Company for Consumer Industries. National Consumer Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Arab Banking Corporation (Jordan)
Description: Arab Banking Corporation (Jordan) provides various banking products and services in Jordan. The company offers retail banking services comprising prepaid cards credit cards and debit cards; professional loan clinics financing loan personal loan against salary transfer for private and public sector car loan housing and mortgage loan and salary advance; current savings and term deposit accounts; remittance; digital banking ATM SMS and call center services; and tariffs and charges services. It also provides wholesale banking services such as overdrafts revolving loans long term commercial loans syndicated loan and project and structured finance solution; cash management and trade finance services; and small and medium enterprises financing products including renewable energy point of sale financing women-specific and early-stage project financing services as well as industrial and productions loans. In addition the company offers asset liability management money market/placement deposits capital market/fixed income foreign exchange market derivatives and custody services. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Arab Banking Corporation (Jordan) is a subsidiary of Arab Banking Corporation (B.S.C.).

Name: The Securities House K.S.C.P.
Description: The Securities House K.S.C.P. through its subsidiaries engages in the investment portfolio management business. It operates through three segments: Proprietary Investment Management Asset Management and Advisory Services and Commercial Activities. The Proprietary Investment Management segment invests funds in securities and real estate. The Asset Management and Advisory Services segment engages in the discretionary and non-discretionary investment portfolio management; manages local and international investment funds and collective investment schemes; and provides advisory services. The Commercial Activities segment engages in the food business. The Securities House K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Dice For Ready-Made Garments (SAE)
Description: Dice For Ready-Made Garments (SAE) manufactures markets and retails ready-made garments for men women and kids in Egypt. The company offers fabric knitting fabric dyeing fabric finishing all-over fabric printing elastic draw-cord and socks production services. It also provides sleepwear casual wear and accessories through retail stores and wholesale partners. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Kuwait and Middle East Financial Investment Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait and Middle East Financial Investment Company K.S.C.P. operates as an asset management and financial services company. It operates through Asset Management; Brokerage and Online Trading; Credit Operations; Investment Real Estate and Treasury; and Rental and Leasing Activities segments. The company provides third party fund and portfolio management services on a fiduciary basis; online and brokerage services in the Middle East North Africa and the United States; and margin loans to the clients trading in Boursa Kuwait and commercial loans to the clients. It is also involved in the money market placements business; real estate activities; and proprietary trading in equity stocks and funds across gulf cooperation countries GCC and international markets as well as rental and leasing activities in the state of Kuwait. In addition the company engages in financial advisory activities; investment managed fund; and brokerage vehicle leasing businesses. It serves private and institutional clients. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Kuwait and Middle East Financial Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Al Thekair General Trading & Contracting Co.

Name: Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C.
Description: Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C. through its subsidiaries operates in the IT and communication technology; engineering procurement and construction (EPC); consultancy; oil and gas; trading; logistics; and MEP sectors. It offers cyber security unified communication and collaboration software defined networking next generation network structured cabling low voltage cable installation fiber-optic network security wireless and mobility TETRA and AVLS solutions; a range of security and safety services for businesses governments and residences; and audio and visual solutions as well as operates as an EPC contractor for various industries including oil and gas power water and infrastructure. The company also provides centralized alarm monitoring station intrusion and burglary alarm system virtual guarding and CCTV integration central control designing maintenance technical support and alarm monitoring services as well as intrusion alarm for armoured vehicles and development/integration of centralized software. In addition it offers consultancy and human resource management services; a range of services for communications-related areas such as collaboration data centers cloud solutions information management and fully-managed managed services; and undertakes steel structural piping and related support structural and pre engineered building works as well as miscellaneous works comprising fire escape ladders fencing catwalk systems storage space gratings and chequered plates emergency stairs and balustrades gates handrails etc. Mekdam Holding Group - Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2018 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Access Bank Botswana Limited
Description: Access Bank Botswana Limited provides various corporate retail and investment banking services in Botswana. It operates through three segments: Retail Banking Commercial Banking and Global Markets. The company offers savings current payroll fixed and term deposits and call accounts; debit credit and prepaid cards; and personal home and term loans leasing facilities overdrafts vehicle asset financing services and commercial property development loans. In addition it provides letters of credit guarantees cross border payments invoice discounting purchase order financing supply chain finance bonds pre-import finance and bills for collection services as well as insurance products. Further the company offers Internet and mobile banking services. Access Bank Botswana Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Gaborone Botswana. Access Bank Botswana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Access Bank Plc.

Name: Inversiones Siemel S.A.
Description: Inversiones Siemel S.A. operates in the agribusiness and agriculture real estate finance and information technology sectors in Chile. It offers flexible solutions for renting storage spaces and offices for individuals and companies; rents warehouses integrated offices commercial premises mini-warehouses and mini-offices; develops livestock as well as fruit plantations such as cherries dried plums and almonds; and produces and markets meat and wool as well as cheese under the Boladero brand. It manages hotels and car rental business; and is involved in exploitation of agricultural properties plantations and olive production. In addition it develops data center services operation infrastructure management consulting and advice on information technology; and provides advisory and support services for business development. The company was formerly known as Agricultural Investment and Industrial Siemel SA. Inversiones Siemel S.A. was founded in 1980 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Inversiones Siemel S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Angelini Y Compania Limitada.

Name: ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited
Description: ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited manufactures and sells steel products in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Steel Operations and Non-Steel Operations segments. The company offers flat steel products such as hot rolled plate hot rolled coil – pickled and oiled cold rolled coil galvanized coil color coil and electrogalvanized coil; light bay and heavy bay steel castings; long steel products including fencing profiles forgings heavy structural sections hexagon bars hollow bars mining bars rails reinforcing/Y bars round and square bars special profiles window sections wire rods and billets and blooms; and hot rolled and cold drawn seamless tube products. It also produces commercial coke and commercial grade coal. The company serves agricultural armament automotive bolt and nut chains construction engineering furniture and appliance mining packaging piping renewable energy roofing and cladding and tubing industries. It was formerly known as Mittal Steel South Africa Limited and changed its name to ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited in October 2006. The company was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Vanderbijlpark South Africa. ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited is a subsidiary of Arcelormittal Holdings AG.

Name: Castilla Agrícola S.A.
Description: Castilla Agrícola S.A. harvests produces and sells sugarcane. The company engages in the dairy farm business; and provides liquid fertilizers. Castilla Agrícola S.A. was founded in 1945 and is based in Cali Colombia.

Name: PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc
Description: PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures distributes and sells various consumer products and home appliances to wholesalers in Nigeria and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Home and Personal Care Products; and Durable Electrical Appliances. The company offers detergents soaps cosmetics refrigerators freezers air-conditioners televisions generators and washing machines. The company also sells its products under the Morning Fresh Zip Canoe Premier Excel Joy Stella Venus Imperial Leather Cussons Baby Original Source Carex Robb and Haier Thermocool brands. The company was formerly known as Paterson Zochonis Industries Plc and changed its name to PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc in September 2006. The company was founded in 1899 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. PZ Cussons Nigeria Plc is a subsidiary of PZ Cussons (Holdings) Limited.

Name: Financiera Credinka S.A.
Description: Financiera Credinka S.A. operates as a microfinance institution in Peru. The company offers savings accounts CTS deposits and fixed term deposits as well as debit cards. It also provides micro-business consumer and business credits; and bond letters. In addition the company offers life micro insurance and accident protection products; and mutual fund products. The company was formerly known as Financiera Nueva Visión S.A. and changed its name to Financiera Credinka S.A. in December 2014. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Cusco Peru. Financiera Credinka S.A. is a subsidiary of Diviso Grupo Financiero S.A.

Name: Medipower (Overseas) Public Co. Limited
Description: Medipower (Overseas) Public Co. Limited operates as a commercial real estate company in the United States Canada and Bulgaria. It owns and manages retail properties and residential developments as well as shopping centers. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Nicosia Cyprus.

Name: Specialities Group Holding Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Specialities Group Holding Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and imports building materials chemicals and insulation systems. The company manufactures specialized building materials and chemicals such as admixtures for concrete and mortar; grouts and anchoring products; curing compounds and sealers; flooring materials; concrete repair materials; bonding agents; tile fixing and grouting compounds; primers protective coating and membranes; expansion joint sealants; and miscellaneous products. It also engages in the contracting and construction real estate general trading and oil and gas businesses. In addition the company is involved in the trading of petrol devices and equipment; excavation operation and maintenance of oil wells; manufacture of cement and concrete materials; and development of computer systems and software as well as localization systems for computers and peripherals. Further it manufactures and imports waterproofing systems; and provides drilling and work over directional drilling and oil field services. Additionally the company provides port services; and furniture and furnishings. The company was formerly known as Alghanim Specialities Company W.L.L and changed its name to Specialities Group Holding Company K.P.S.C. in 2006. Specialities Group Holding Company K.P.S.C. was founded in 1959 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Zara Investment Holding Company
Description: Zara Investment Holding Company through its subsidiaries owns and operates a network of hotels and resorts in Jordan. The company operates through Hotels and Other segments. It operates gift and antique shops; develops real estate properties; owns tourism projects; maintains agricultural facilities; and generates solar power as well as engages in the general investment activities. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Duncan Fox S.A.
Description: Duncan Fox S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the agro-industrial hotel and real estate businesses in Chile. It produces and markets frozen fruits and vegetables under the Minuto Verde La Cabaña Pura Hoja and Punto Azul brand names; develops and operates a chain of hotels under the Holiday Inn and Holiday Inn Express brand names; and develops housing office and commercial projects. Duncan Fox S.A. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Mercantil Financeira S.A. - Crédito Financiamento e Investimento
Description: Mercantil Financeira S.A. - Crédito Financiamento e Investimento provides financial solutions in Brazil. The company operates through Direct Consumer Credit and Payroll Loans segment. It provides solutions to update bills renegotiate debts and contracts and legal and personal loans. The company was formerly known as Creditaqui Financeira S.A. - Crédito Financiamento e Investimento and changed its name to Mercantil Financeira S.A. - Crédito Financiamento e Investimento. The company was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Nova Lima Brazil. Mercantil Financeira S.A. - Crédito Financiamento e Investimento operates as a subsidiary of Banco Mercantil do Brasil S.A.

Name: Maroc Leasing S.A.
Description: Maroc Leasing S.A. engages in the provision of lease financing services for movable and real estate properties for professionals and businesses in Morocco. It offers leasing finance for movable properties including construction equipment cars light vehicles trucks road tractors handling equipment medical equipment machine tools production lines office and information technology equipment etc. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Maroc Leasing S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banque Centrale Populaire.

Name: AECI Mining Explosives PLC
Description: AECI Mining Explosives PLC manufactures and supplies mining explosives and mining chemicals in Africa Europe Southeast Asia North America South America and Australia. It operates in four segments: AECI Mining AECI Chemicals AECI Managed Businesses and AECI Property Services and Corporate. The AECI Mining segment provides a mine-to-mineral solution for the international mining sector including commercial explosives initiating systems blasting services and surfactants for explosives manufacturers Its AECI Chemicals segment supplies traded industrial and specialty chemicals as well as water treatment chemicals technology equipment and plant and crop protection products and plant nutrients. The AECI Managed Businesses segment engages in agriculture industrial manufacturing road infrastructure food and beverage public water and animal feed businesses as well as the textile sector. Its AECI Property Services and Corporate segment is involved in property leasing and management in the office industrial and retail sectors. It serves the mining sector water treatment market plant and animal health industry food and beverage and the manufacturing and general industrial sectors. The company was formerly known as AEL Zambia Plc and changed its name to AECI Mining Explosives PLC in August 2021. AECI Mining Explosives PLC was incorporated in 1924 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Marisa Lojas S.A.
Description: Marisa Lojas S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the retail of consumer goods in Brazil. The company sells clothing items for men women and children; and perfumery cosmetics and watches through physical stores and e-commerce. It also engages in the management of non-financial intangible assets including trademark management; purchase sale use and licensing of trademarks and patents; receipt of royalties; and authorization for reproduction and use of trademarks and patents in processes and products as well as the retail trade in clothing. Marisa Lojas S.A. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: The CIC Insurance Group Plc
Description: The CIC Insurance Group Plc provides general and life insurance products and services in Kenya South Sudan Uganda and Malawi. It operates through Long-Term Business General Insurance Business Asset Management and Other segments. The company offers life insurance products including term policies endowment whole life unit link pensions and annuities and education policies as well as group life and group credit life for banks and co-operatives; and general insurance products such as engineering fire liability marine motor private motor commercial accident theft workmen’s compensation crop insurance political violence and terrorism sportsmen forestry and aquaculture insurance and medical insurance products covering corporate schemes individuals and SMEs. It also provides asset management products comprising money market equity fund balanced fund fixed income wealth fund dollar fund and pension fund management that includes segregated schemes umbrella retirement schemes discretionary wealth management and income drawdown fund; and advisory services. In addition the company offers microinsurance products including coopcare product livestock biashara salama jikinge group funeral expense and personal accident cover for students on attachment. Further it provides risk assessment and underwriting claims processing and settlement policy management investment management financial planning and retirement solutions insurance education and training programs loss prevention and fraud prevention services. The company was formerly known as The Co-operative Insurance Company of Kenya Limited and changed its name to CIC Insurance Group Plc in September 2010. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. The CIC Insurance Group Plc is a subsidiary of Co-Operative Insurance Society Limited.

Name: Sagicor Real Estate X Fund Limited
Description: Sagicor Real Estate X Fund Limited specializes in real estate investments.

Name: Petra Education Company PLC
Description: Petra Education Company PLC owns and operates the University of Petra in Jordan. Its academics cover information technology architecture and design mass communication arts and sciences engineering pharmacy and medical sciences law administrative and financial sciences and dentistry areas. Petra Education Company PLC was founded in 1991 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Positivo Tecnologia S.A.
Description: Positivo Tecnologia S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops manufactures sells and distributes hardware software and information technology (IT) solutions in Brazil and internationally. It operates through Consumer Public Institutions and Corporate segments. The company offers computers smartphones tablets accessories smart home and environment devices office products electronic security devices servers mobile payment terminals payment machines and IT infrastructure products; education technology solutions including self-service kiosks data collection devices for demographic surveys and electronic voting machines; and medical laboratory and communication equipment. It also engages in the rental of IT and mobility (hardware as a service) equipment; provision of IT technical support and managed IT services; sale of pedagogic application systems and school administration products; technical-pedagogical planning and support; and representation sale implementation training support and technical assistance for equipment as well as for technical technological and scientific teaching systems. It serves end consumers residential condominiums businesses schools and public institutions. The company was formerly known as Positivo Informática S.A. and changed its name to Positivo Tecnologia S.A. in April 2017. Positivo Tecnologia S.A. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Curitiba Brazil.

Name: Renergen Limited
Description: Renergen Limited an investment holding company engages in the alternative and renewable energy businesses in South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through Tetra4 and Cryovation segments. The company explores for develops and sells liquefied natural gas and helium gas. It also develops Cryo-Vacc technology which enables the transportation of vaccines and biologics at low temperature without any electrical power. Renergen Limited was founded in 2005 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Al Omaniya Financial Services SAOG
Description: Al Omaniya Financial Services SAOG engages in the hire purchase and lease finance for motor vehicles and other assets in the Sultanate of Oman. The company provides Life Line an auto finance product for financing saloon cars and commercial vehicles facilitating hire-purchase and leasing options for new used and refinance own vehicles; and asset finance debt factoring bills discounting bridge and working capital loans and project and construction loans. It also offers loans for electronic or household products; and accepts fixed deposits from small medium and large corporate houses. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Seed Co International Limited
Description: Seed Co International Limited engages in the processing of agricultural seed. The company offers maize and soybean seeds as well as other seeds including wheat soya sugar beans groundnuts sorghum cowpeas and rice. It sells its products under the Seed Co brand name. The company operates in Botswana Mozambique South Africa Angola the Democratic Republic of Congo Malawi Zambia Nigeria Ethiopia Kenya Rwanda and Tanzania. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Helbor Empreendimentos S.A.
Description: Helbor Empreendimentos S.A. engages in the real estate development business in Brazil. Its portfolio includes residential and commercial properties. The company was formerly known as Helbor Empreendimentos Imobiliarios Ltda. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Mogi das Cruzes Brazil.

Name: Al-Enma'a Real Estate Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al-Enma'a Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. engages in the contracting management and maintenance of real estate in Kuwait and the Gulf Countries. The company operates through Construction Projects Services Rendered Real Estate and Investments segments. The Construction Projects segment undertakes contracts to construct buildings such as commercial residential industrial and touristic projects. The Services Rendered segment engages in the maintenance of mechanical and electrical spare parts and building materials. This segment also provides security services and manages real estate for others. The Real Estate segment manages its properties and rents properties for others. The Investments segment participates and invests in shares of local and foreign companies and real estate properties. It also engages in the transportation of funds and precious metals; and real estate consulting services. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al-Enma'a Real Estate Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Kuwait Finance House K.S.C.P.

Name: Veste S.A. Estilo
Description: Veste S.A. Estilo manufacture and sells clothing and clothing accessories in Brazil. The company offers dress for women under the Le Lis brand; business clothing for men and women under the Dudalina brand; denim jeans for men and women under the John John brand; leisure and party outfits under the Bo.Bô brand; and men’s wear under the Individual brand. It sells its products through its own stores multi-brand stores outlets and e-commerce. The company was formerly known as Restoque Comércio e Confecções de Roupas S.A. and changed its name to Veste S.A. Estilo in January 2023. Veste S.A. Estilo was incorporated in 1982 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Quemchi S.A.
Description: Quemchi S.A. engages in maritime transport cargo and shipping services and investments businesses. It is involved in the transportation of cargo in containers as well as in the transportation of bulk cargo and cars. The company also provides storage facilities cargo-handling services and port terminal concessions. In addition it engages in various activities related to industries such as forestry fishing mining chemical production construction real estate tourism communication and foreign trade. Quemchi S.A. sells its products in Asia Europe the United States and Africa. The company was formerly known as Compañía Electro Metalúrgica S.A. Quemchi S.A. was founded in 1992 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Riopaila Agrícola S.A.
Description: Riopaila Agrícola S.A. produces and markets agricultural products. It cultivates sugarcane rice and mangoes. The company is also involved in the cattle raising activities. Riopaila Agrícola S.A. was founded in 1918 and is based in Cali Colombia.

Name: Al Manar Financing and Leasing Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Al Manar Financing and Leasing Company K.S.C. (Public) operates as an Islamic financing and investing company in Kuwait. It operates through Finance Investments and Others segments. The company provides new and used vehicle financing; and financing for furniture and electronic appliances medical treatment education computers and accessories and real estate properties as well as marine equipment. It also invests in real estate properties including developing selling and leasing lands buildings housing and commercial complexes; and provides consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Empresas Hites S.A.
Description: Empresas Hites S.A. engages in the retail business in Chile. It is involved in the retail sale of various clothing electronics and home appliances through its multi-stores. The company is also involved in the financial business such as granting direct credits to customers through sales in its multi-stores and internet channel. Empresas Hites S.A. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Cadbury Nigeria Plc
Description: Cadbury Nigeria Plc engages in manufacturing and selling branded fast moving consumer goods in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: Refreshment Beverages Confectionery and Intermediate Cocoa Products. The Refreshment Beverages segment manufactures and sells Cadbury Bournvita and Cadbury 3-in-1 Hot Chocolate. The Confectionary segment manufactures and sells Tom Tom Candy Caramel Buttermint Candy Coffee and Clorets gum products. The Intermediate Cocoa Products segment manufactures and sells cocoa powder cocoa butter cocoa liquor and cocoa cake. It offers its products through a network of distributors key accounts and institutional customers as well as chain of wholesalers and retailers. It exports its products to various countries in Africa and Europe. Cadbury Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Cadbury Nigeria Plc operates as a subsidiary of Cadbury Schweppes Overseas Limited.

Name: Construcciones El Condor S.A.
Description: Construcciones El Condor S.A. engages in the construction and investment businesses. The company provides construction services for the public and private sector including the construction of roads tunnels viaducts bridges dams concrete works mining open cast mining soil and rock excavation and mass transportation systems. It invests in road airport and energy concession projects and companies related to the infrastructure sector as well as manages investments in public service and mining concessions. Construcciones El Condor S.A. was founded in 1979 and is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: National Printing Company S.A.E.
Description: National Printing Company Ltd. operates converting and printing houses for consumer packaging in Egypt. It offers flexible carton or offset and corrugated packages for use in the inbox lamination books and paper cups industries. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Cairo Egypt. National Printing Company Ltd. is a subsidiary of Grandview Investments Holding Corp.

Name: Widam Food Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Widam Food Company Q.P.S.C. imports and trades in livestock meat and feed products in the State of Qatar and the Republic of Tanzania. It offers beef such as tenderloins striploins shoulders legs chilled chops and minced meat; camel meat including cuts minced and special cuts; fresh chicken meat whole and cut; dairy products; frozen vegetables meats seafoods and poultry; fresh fruits; livestock fresh chilled and frozen lamb; fresh offals including liver kidneys and heart; and fresh and pesticide-free homegrown vegetables. The company also involves in the slaughtering of sheep and cattle; supply of fresh meat and related products; and slaughtered beef and lamb cooled beef and other premium cuts. It serves hospitals hotels airlines restaurants catering companies hypermarkets and small butcheries. The company was formerly known as Qatar Company for Meat and Livestock Trading (MAWASHI) Q.S.C. and changed its name to Widam Food Company Q.P.S.C. in March 2013. Widam Food Company Q.P.S.C. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Financiera Confianza S.A.A.
Description: Financiera Confianza S.A.A. operates as a microfinance company in Peru. It offers saving products; personal business liquid guarantee and educative credits; insurance products; and other services such as Bim remittance debit card interbank transfer and collection services. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Lima Peru. Financiera Confianza S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Fundación BBVA para las Microfinanzas.

Name: NEM Insurance Plc
Description: NEM Insurance Plc provides general insurance products and services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria and Europe. The company offers corporate insurance products such as motor marine cargo and hull aviation oil and gas engineering computer and electronics fidelity guarantee and group personal accident insurance; personal insurance products including goods in transit fire and special perils travel motor home protection professional indemnity and enhanced motor third party insurance; and SME products comprising burglary product liability fidelity guarantee motor insurance cash in transit group personal accident and agricultural insurance products. It involved in asset leasing and LPO financing activities. It offers its products to manufacturing industrial commercial enterprises and financial institutions such as banks mortgage and stock broking firms. The company was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Choppies Enterprises Limited
Description: Choppies Enterprises Limited operates a chain of supermarkets in Botswana Zimbabwe Zambia Namibia and internationally. The company’s stores offer food groceries tobacco products beauty products and other general merchandise. It also provides value-added financial services. The company operates all its stores under the Choppies brand name. Choppies Enterprises Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Productos EFE S.A.
Description: Productos EFE S.A. engages in the manufacture marketing and distribution of ice creams in Venezuela. It operates a network of ice cream shops. The company was founded in 1926 and is headquartered in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: AIICO Insurance Plc
Description: AIICO Insurance Plc provides risk underwriting and related financial services in Nigeria. It operates through Life Insurance General Business Health Management and Asset Management segments. The life insurance segment offers whole life term assurance guaranteed pensions endowment pensions mortgage endowment savings and protection products as well as other long-term contracts. The General Business segment provides auto household commercial and business interruption insurance; and general insurance to individuals and businesses. The Health Management segment offers prepaid health plans to cater for the health needs of individuals and corporate organizations. The Asset Management segments offers portfolio management services structured investments and mutual funds for corporate and individual clients. In addition the company offers annuity property marine fire personal accident pure risk home and travel insurance as well as marine manufacturing agricultural and oil and gas insurance; and various risk plans. It markets its products through insurance brokers and agents. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Kuwait and Gulf Link Transport Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Kuwait and Gulf Link Transport Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides integrated supply chain management services in the Middle East. It operates through Transportation services Logistics services Rental and Leasing services and Others segments. The company offers supply chain management services including warehousing and distribution stevedoring project cargo and custom clearance as well as air land and ocean freight services; and passenger and travel services such as multi-model passenger transport services and vehicle renting and leasing services for commercial and government clients. It provides government services which includes heavy lift stevedoring and related terminal distribution logistics transportation car rental ports operation and food services. In addition the company engages in the investment property management general trading and real estate activities; travel and tourism insurance garage and maintenance and advertising activities; and the sale of spare parts and vehicle maintenance. uwait and Gulf Link Transport Company K.P.S.C. was founded in 1956 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Kuwait Resorts Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Kuwait Resorts Company K.P.S.C. engages in the hospitality and real estate businesses in the State of Kuwait. The company operates through Hotels Financial Investment and Real Estate segments. It owns and operates Hilton Kuwait Resort a five-star hotel. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Pyramisa Hotels & Resorts
Description: Pyramisa Hotels & Resorts operates a chain of hotels in Egypt. The company operates the Pyramisa Suites Hotels Cairo Pyramisa Beach Resort Sharm El Sheikh Pyramisa Beach Resort Sahl Hasheesh Pyramisa Isis Hotel Luxor Pyramisa Isis Corniche Aswan Pyramisa Isis Island Aswan and Pyramisa Hotel Apartments Dubai. It also operates real estate properties including Sunset Pearl Apartments Bay View Apartments and Paradise Gardens Apartments Town View and Palm View. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Dar Al-Thuraya Real Estate Co. K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Dar Al-Thuraya Real Estate Co. K.S.C. (Public) engages in the financial investments and properties businesses in Kuwait. It operates through Investment Properties and Investment segments. The company engages in buying selling and increasing capital value of investment properties; and investment activities. It also buys and sells land and real estate; manages and leases owned or leased residential and non-residential properties; owns properties and movables; manages third party properties; and manages and develops land and real estate properties. In addition the company is involved in real estate consulting; managing and organizing exhibitions and conferences; general trading and contracting activities; catering of food stuffs; restaurant and catering services; and wholesale and retail trade services. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Dar Al-Thuraya Real Estate Co. K.S.C. (Public) is a subsidiary of Al Madar Kuwait Holding Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Alijarah Holding (Q.P.S.C.)
Description: Alijarah Holding (Q.P.S.C.) engages in driving school business in Qatar. It is involved in financial leasing property development and transportation businesses. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Puma Energy Zambia Plc
Description: Puma Energy Zambia Plc engages in marketing and distribution of petroleum products in Zambia. The company operates through Retail Business to Business Aviation and Lubricants segments. It offers fuel lubricants and other oil products. The company was formerly known as BP Zambia plc and changed its name to Puma Energy Zambia Plc in June 2011. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. Puma Energy Zambia Plc is a subsidiary of Puma Energy (Ireland) Holdings Limited.

Name: Aluminium Du Maroc SA
Description: Aluminium Du Maroc SA engages in design and manufacture of aluminium alloy profiles for construction and industry in Morocco. Its products include doors strikes roofs facades shutters bodyguards pool barriers and portals. The company is also involved in the production of abrasive papers and aluminum accessories and seals; and manufacture machining and installation of aluminum joinery systems. In addition it offers driving structural general purpose and greenhouse tubes for construction industry and agriculture markets. Further the company is involved in the acquisition operation and rental of movable and immovable properties; and real estate development business. The company distributes its products through its network of commercial agencies and resellers. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Tangier Morocco.

Name: El Shams Pyramids Co. For Hotels & Touristic Projects S.A.E
Description: El Shams Pyramids Co. For Hotels & Touristic Projects S.A.E constructs and owns hotels motels and touristic facilities. It owns and operates Meridian Pyramids Hotel in the Haram area of Giza. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Méliuz S.A.
Description: Méliuz S.A. together with its subsidiaries operate a virtual portal for the placement and dissemination of brands products services and other advertising and publicity materials. It operates through B2C (BusinesstoCustomers)National; and Other segments. The company offers leasing of virtual advertising space for the insertion of texts drawings and other materials as well as rental of space. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Cintac S.A.
Description: Cintac S.A. manufactures and markets steel construction systems in Chile Peru and the Latin America. The company offers tubes profiles sheets such as tubulars pipes open and laminated profiles galvanized profiles and steel sheets; tubest; and road defenses and corrugated products as well as agricultural products such as central vina open cables and galvanized steel fences. It also provides covers and coatings insulated panels uninsulated panels collaborating panels and instapanel collection products; Metalcon CNC products; and Metalcon for structural applications partition walls and ceiling construction. In addition the company offers home solar panel kits and photovoltaic plants. Cintac S.A. was founded in 1956 and is based in Maipú Chile. Cintac S.A. is a subsidiary of Novacero S.A.

Name: Bank of Africa Niger
Description: Bank of Africa Niger provides banking services for individuals and companies primarily in Niger. The company’s products and services include accounts savings plans term deposits and operating and documentary credit services; letters of credit; medium and long term loans; insurance; loans cards and money transfers; and online phone and SMS banking services. It operates in retail corporate and financial markets. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Niamey Niger. Bank of Africa Niger is a subsidiary of BOA West Africa.

Name: Quantum Foods Holdings Ltd
Description: Quantum Foods Holdings Ltd together with its subsidiaries engages in the feed poultry and egg businesses in South Africa and other African markets. It operates through Eggs Farming and Animal Feeds segments. The company produces and distributes eggs; and sells layer parent stock hatching eggs day-old pullets and point-of-lay hens. It also supplies livestock to abattoirs; and produces and sells day-old commercial broiler chicks from hatcheries as well as various feeds including broiler and layer poultry dairy sheep cattle ostrich and pig feeds. The company serves livestock farmers major retailers wholesalers industrial clients informal markets commercial abattoirs and internal customers such as our broiler and layer farms. It sells its products under the Nulaid Nova Feeds Bergvlei Chick and Bellevue Chix brand names. Quantum Foods Holdings Ltd was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Wellington South Africa.

Name: Agroindustrias San Jacinto S.A.A.
Description: Agroindustrias San Jacinto S.A.A. engages in the cultivation transformation and industrialization of sugar cane and its by-products in Peru. The company offers sugar alcohol molasses and bagasse products. Agroindustrias San Jacinto S.A.A. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in San Jacinto Peru. Agroindustrias San Jacinto S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Corporación Azucarera del Perú S.A.

Name: Botswana Telecommunications Corporation Limited
Description: Botswana Telecommunications Corporation Limited provides telecommunications services in Botswana. The company offers fixed and mobile voice telephony data services directory services broadband services internet services fixed landline and tariff services and toll free services as well as smart offices conferences telephone management call recording and value added services. It also provides security as a service managed network services site connectivity and BTC mobile products and services as well as virtual private networks and customer premises equipment. In addition the company offers digital services including data center colocation cloud and Microsoft 365 solutions. It serves large medium and small enterprises; government entities; and individual customers as well as other licensed service providers. Botswana Telecommunications Corporation Limited was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG
Description: Al Anwar Ceramic Tiles Company SAOG manufactures sells and distributes glazed ceramic tiles in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers floor tiles for kitchen balcony bathroom bedroom and living room as well as for residential and commercial spaces; outdoor floor tiles; elevated wall tiles; decorative panels; and porcelain tiles under the Al Shams brand name. It exports its products in approximately 20 countries including GCC the Middle East and Africa. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: General Co. For Silos & Storage
Description: General Co. For Silos & Storage engages in loading and unloading grains from ships at Egyptian ports. It is involved in the import export storage trading distribution maintenance steaming redeeming and transportation of grains to customers and importers in the public and private sectors through contracts as well as creating and managing coastal and inland silos. The company was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Al Jazeira Services Company SAOG
Description: Al Jazeira Services Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries provides contracting services in the Sultanate of Oman the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company operates in two segments Catering and Investment. It offers catering housekeeping laundry equipment supply and allied services as well as non-oil & gas military forces mining and infrastructure sectors. The company is also involved in strategic industrial projects and other trading investments. Al Jazeira Services Company SAOG was founded in 1997 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Conoil Plc
Description: Conoil Plc markets refined petroleum products and manufactures and markets lubricants household and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in Nigeria. It operates through three segments: White Products Lubricants and Liquefied Petroleum Gas. The White Products segment sells premium motor spirit aviation turbine kerosene dual-purpose kerosene low-pour fuel oil and automotive gasoline/grease oil. Its Lubricants segment offers transport and industrial lubricants greases process oil and bitumen. The LPG segment is involved in the trading of bulk and packed LPG cylinders and valves. The company was formerly known as National Oil and Chemical Marketing Plc and changed its name to Conoil Plc in January 2003. Conoil Plc was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Conoil Plc is a subsidiary of Conpetro Limited.

Name: Shuaiba Industrial Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Shuaiba Industrial Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells paper packaging in Kuwait GCC Asia and Africa. It operates through Industrial Packaging Consumer Packaging and Flexible Packaging divisions. The Industrial Packaging division produces and supplies multi-wallpaper sacks for industrial use. Its Consumer Packaging division is involved in the production and supply of bags and wrapping sheets. The Flexible Packaging division produces and supplies multi-ply printed and laminated films as well as aluminum foil lamination. It also engages in commercial agency activities. Shuaiba Industrial Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Taageer Finance Company SAOG
Description: Taageer Finance Company SAOG provides financial services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers corporate deposits and issues non-convertible bonds for funding. It also provides leasing working capital finance factoring receivables new and used auto loans consumer loans and structured finance as well as insurance products to retail SME and corporate customers. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Manazel Holding Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Manazel Holding Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries operates as a real estate development company in Kuwait and Egypt. The company is involved in selling and purchasing land and real estate. Its project portfolio includes palaces and villas and residential projects. The company also holds industrial property rights such as patent industrial trademark industrial royalties and other rights. The company was formerly known as Kuwait and Italy General Contracting K.S.C and changed its name to Manazel Holding Company K.P.S.C. in June 2005. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Automob Participações S.A.
Description: Automob Participações S.A. engages in retailing trucks buses machinery and equipment in Brazil. The company is based in Cuiabá Brazil. Automob Participações S.A. is a subsidiary of Vamos Locação de Caminhões Máquinas e Equipamentos S.A.

Name: Palestine Investment Bank P.L.C.
Description: Palestine Investment Bank P.L.C. provides banking and financial products and services to individuals companies businesses and small and medium-sized enterprises in Palestine and internationally. The company offers current and saving accounts; car commercial and housing loans; export and project financing; and financing for contractors manufacturers and real estate investments as well as personal revolving overdrafts. It also provides letters of credit bank guarantees local and international transfers and bills of collection; treasury and investment services; electronic banking services; ATM and payment services; and safe deposit box and cards. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestine.

Name: Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A.
Description: Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A. provides services and products related to environmental management worldwide. The company operates through the Environment Response and Others segments. The company provides crisis management and emergency response services; industrial cleaning and repair and maintenance services; maritime services such as port support and offshore services; water production and supply and effluent management; energy generation services from waste; and waste management and decarbonization services. Ambipar Participações e Empreendimentos S.A. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Al-Nisr Al-Arabi Insurance Company
Description: Al-Nisr Al-Arabi Insurance Company provides life and general insurance products in Jordan and internationally. The company offers education retirement term life health travel critical illness home and personal accident insurance to individuals and families. It also provides cargo engineering financial lines group life and medical liability life and medical and property insurance to businesses; and vehicle marine aviation fire and other insurance products. Al-Nisr Al-Arabi Insurance Company also provides access to online medical insurance. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Al-Nisr Al-Arabi Insurance Company operates as a subsidiary of Arab Bank plc.

Name: PBG S.A.
Description: PBG S.A. manufactures exports and sells ceramic and porcelain products in Brazil and internationally. The company offers flooring technical and enamelled porcelain pieces decorated and special mosaics products intended for covering internal walls facades in the field of civil construction materials industry. It sells its products through a network of Portobello Shop retail chain home centers Franchise Stores and civil construction companies. The company was formerly known as Portobello S.A. and changed its name to PBG S.A. in December 2015. PBG S.A. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Tijucas Brazil.

Name: Argent Industrial Limited
Description: Argent Industrial Limited manufactures and trades in steel and steel-related products in South Africa Asia the Middle East Australia New Zealand North America South America rest of Africa the United Kingdom rest of Europe and internationally. The company offers security gates burglar bars roller shutters sectional doors and expanding barriers; custom-made adjustable louvre shutters; aircraft refueling vehicles and systems; braai stands and fireplaces; overhead cranes hoists and lifting equipment; fuel storage tanks; speed control retarder systems; underground scrapers and wear parts grizzly frames and segments and other allied mining equipment; metal gates metal fencing and railings timber gates and metal decking fence panels; and handcrafted wooden gates and garden products; materials handling equipment; roll-over protection bars; and modular buildings office mess units and toilet and shower blocks. It is also involved in manufacturing of ladders fibreglass ladders trolleys as well as distributing castors and accessories; supplying of commercial grades of stainless steel and aluminum in sheets plates coils flats angles tubes and pipes; supplying of ready-mix concrete and mortars pumping of concrete and crushed stone products; manufacturing and trading of industrial doors; supplying of raw materials for use in construction and infrastructure industries; and operating of steel service center. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Umhlanga South Africa.

Name: Al Madar Kuwait Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Al Madar Kuwait Holding Company K.S.C.P. engages in the real estate business in Kuwait. It operates through Real Estate Investment and Corporate Finance segments. The company engages in the buying selling capital appreciation and investing in real estate; and providing finance to companies by using the various Islamic financing instruments such as Murabaha Wakala future sales and other contracts as well as invests in equity securities. It also manages the investment portfolios; invests in money on behalf of others; purchases and invests in and leases various types of investment equipment; and conducts real estate investments. In addition the company is involved in the ownership sale and lease of equity rights of utility patent registered brands and franchise rights; and operates as investment consultant. Further it provides general trading contracting and construction services; asset management services for equities and real estate; advisory and consultancy services to conventional financial institutions; research services; real estate development; and investment banking services. The company was formerly known as Al Madar Finance and Investment Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to Al Madar Kuwait Holding Company K.S.C.P. in March 2024. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Al Madar Kuwait Holding Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Al Thekair General Trading and Contracting Company W.L.L.

Name: Kahira Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries Company
Description: Kahira Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries Company engages in the manufacturing and sale of pharmaceuticals medical preparations cosmetics and materials in Egypt. The company is involved in the provision of chemicals extracts veterinary medicines and pesticides; and packaging and distribution activities. It also exports its products to Iraq Yemen Sudan Somalia Jordan Libya Senegal Zimbabwe South Sudan Mali and Kenya. Kahira Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries Company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P. engages in investment and manufacturing and trading activities in Kuwait and internationally. The company invests in various sectors such as industrial utilities services and other related sectors. It manufactures cement blocks; and invests in and develops real estate projects. In addition the company owns shares and equities of Kuwait and foreign shareholdings as well as limited liability companies or participates in the association of these companies. Further it engages in lending activities for companies and owns rights of industrial property such as patents industrial trademarks industrial fees or other rights to lease them to other companies. The company was formerly known as Boubyan International Industries Holding Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P. in January 2019. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Warba Capital Holding Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Boubyan Petrochemical Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Laboratorios Richmond S.A.C.I.F.
Description: Laboratorios Richmond S.A.C.I.F. a pharmaceutical company develops and manufactures pharmaceutical products. It provides antiretroviral products for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV); oncology and oncohematology drugs; cardiometabolic drugs including antihypertensive hypocholesterolemic platelet antiaggregants and hypoglycemic drugs; and neurological and psychiatric drugs comprising analgesic antipsychotic antidepressants anti-dementia antiepileptics and hypnotic drugs as well as drugs for the treatment of multiple sclerosis. The company sells its products in Latin America Africa Asia and the Middle East. Laboratorios Richmond S.A.C.I.F. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Pioneers Properties For Urban Development - PRE Group
Description: Pioneers Properties For Urban Development - PRE Group provides real estate and construction services in Egypt. It provides real estate investment contracting leasing and management services. The company also develops commercial and mixed-use real estate projects; and housing and construction projects. In addition it offers financial leasing services; consultancy services; land reclamation services; and land sale purchase and construction services as well as handles housing and other production-ready patterns. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: The Nigerian Exchange Group Plc
Description: The Nigerian Exchange Group Plc through its subsidiaries operates as a stock exchange in Nigeria. The company operates in three segments: Capital Market & Post trade Services Strategic Investment and Property Management. It is involved in the regulation of various stock broking firms in Nigeria as well as provides them with the facilities for the purchase and sale of bonds stocks and shares; and clearing and settlement of trades on the stock exchange. In addition the company offers property letting and investment property management real estate development financial advisory and consultant capital market infrastructure and regulatory services; and listing and trading securities licensing market data ancillary technology and other services; and acts as a nominee. The company was formerly known as The Nigerian Stock Exchange. The Nigerian Exchange Group Plc was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Sunbird Tourism Plc
Description: Sunbird Tourism Plc engages in the hospitality business in Malawi Africa Europe the United States and internationally. The company owns operates and manages hotel properties. It also provides hotel accommodation catering and related tourist services. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Blantyre Malawi. Sunbird Tourism Plc is a subsidiary of MDC Limited.

Name: Kuwait Emirates Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Emirates Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate and investment businesses in Kuwait. It is involved in the development management and trading of real estate properties; trading of securities and investment activities; and provision of real estate services as well as offers general trading and tourism services. The company was formerly known as Kuwait Syrian Holding and changed its name to Kuwait Emirates Holding Company K.S.C.P. in December 2022. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Alexandria Co. For Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries
Description: Alexandria Co. For Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries manufactures markets and distributes generic forms of human and animal health products in Egypt. It also offers medical appliances. The company is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Grupo Concesionario del Oeste S.A.
Description: Grupo Concesionario del Oeste S.A. engages in the construction improvement repair conservation expansion remodeling maintenance administration and operation of the Western highway in Argentina. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Al - Tajamouat for Touristic Projects plc.
Description: Al - Tajamouat for Touristic Projects plc. owns and operates Taj Lifestyle Center a shopping dining and entertainment destination located in Abdoun area Amman. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Al - Tajamouat for Touristic Projects plc. operates as a subsidiary of Alkhair Holding B.S.C.

Name: Livestock Transport and Trading Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Livestock Transport and Trading Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in purchasing transporting and selling livestock in Kuwait the United Arab Emirates Australia and South Africa. It operates through Commercial Food processing and Investments segments. The company offers livestock frozen and chilled meats fresh cuts fertilizers and carcasses. It also provides meat products such as burger meatball sausage minced meat mortadella pastrami kebab roast beef and frankfurter. In addition the company is involved in purchasing transporting ranching and selling of live and slaughtered sheep and various skins and intestines; purchasing and selling of fodders; and wholesale and retail of chilled and frozen meat products. Further it engages in the trading of livestock and meat products; establishment and management of commercial and industrial projects; and sea transportation of miscellaneous goods. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: UPDC Plc
Description: UPDC Plc together with its subsidiaries develops sells and manages real estate assets in Nigeria. The company operates in two segments Property Development Sales & Management; and Hospitality Services. It acquires develops sells leases and manages commercial and residential accommodation properties and retail spaces as well as offers advisory services. The company also provides facilities management services to residential and commercial properties; and hotel management services such as sale of rooms and conference halls as well as food and beverages.
