The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. UPDC Plc is a subsidiary of Custodian Investment Plc.

Name: eTranzact International Plc
Description: eTranzact International Plc a payment technology provider engages in the processing of various types of electronic payment transactions using its switching platform worldwide. It operates through Mobile; Other Commissions; and Maintenance and Support Services Software Development and Others segments. The company's switching platform processes transactions across various channels such as mobile phones web point of sale automated teller machines other mobile devices and bank branches. It also offers Bankit an omni-channel direct to bank payment gateway; PocketMoni a wallet and payment platform; WebConnect a payment gateway for direct payment with bank accounts; and Payoutlet.net to pay bills send money and top-up mobile phones. In addition the company provides SwitchIt which validates processes and authorizes transactions; CorporatePay an online platform for bulk payments; Payoutlet a collection platform across its member banks’ branches; and Credo a social payment platform for businesses. Further it offers software development and maintenance services. The company serves individuals corporates and institutions. eTranzact International Plc was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Afluente Transmissão de Energia Elétrica S.A.
Description: Afluente Transmissão de Energia Elétrica S.A. engages in the planning projection construction maintenance and operation of electric energy transmission systems lines substations and control centers in Brazil. It operates substations of Tomba Funil Brumado II Itagibai Ford Palo and camacari in the state of Bahia with an installed capacity of 600 MVA and transmission line of 489.1 kilometers. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil. Afluente Transmissão de Energia Elétrica S.A. is a subsidiary of Neoenergia S.A.

Name: Comprehensive Leasing Company
Description: Comprehensive Leasing Company provides financial leasing services in Jordan and Iraq. The company offers vehicles real estate machinery and medical equipment leasing services to individual and corporate sectors as well as small and medium size enterprises. It also provides direct lease/finance program top-up lease/finance program sale and leaseback program operating lease program progressive payments lease program and loyalty lease/finance program services as well as owns and sells properties. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Amman Jordan. Comprehensive Leasing Company is a subsidiary of WHITECHURCH Investments Limited.

Name: Memphis Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries
Description: Memphis Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries a drug holding company produces and sells pharmaceutical products for human and veterinary use in Egypt and internationally. The company offers human health products in various therapeutic areas including anti-infective CNS dermatological cardio vascular system corticosteroid vitamins and minerals musculo-skeletal system analgesic and antipyretic respiratory system genitourinary system alimentary tract and metabolism antihistaminic antiparasites and hormones. It also provides animal health products in powder form as well as in oral and injectable solution forms. The company was founded in 1940 and is based in Cairo Egypt. Memphis Pharmaceuticals & Chemical Industries is a subsidiary of HoldiPharma.

Name: Alfa Holdings S.A.
Description: Alfa Holdings S.A. engages in the provision of financial products in Brazil. It engages in the credit to legal entities and individuals private banking wealth management asset management investment banking and insurance. The company was formerly known as Real S.A. and changed its name to Alfa Holdings S.A. in April 1999. Alfa Holdings S.A. was incorporated in 1959 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. Alfa Holdings S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Banco Safra S.A.

Name: SAB Zenzele Kabili Holdings (RF) Limited
Description: SAB Zenzele Kabili Holdings (RF) Limited produces markets distributes and sells beer. Its beer brands include Corona Stella Artois Flying Fish and Brutal Fruit. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Centum Investment Company Plc
Description: Centum Investment Company Plc is a private equity and secondary investing firm specializing investing in middle market emerging growth growth capital developmental capital industry capitalization recapitalization and buyouts. The firm makes both direct and fund of fund investments. Within private equity it primarily invests in consumer goods & services agriculture business education healthcare energy financial services FMCGs marketable securities information and communication technology cash technology agribusiness real estate financial sector insurance beverage sector carbonated soft drinks alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages food manufacturing power automotive publishing and catering sectors. The firm typically invests in companies that largely serve the needs of the domestic and other markets in East Africa. It seeks to make equity investments minimum of $2 million having minimum target enterprise value of $10 million. The firm have profitable with an EBITDA in excess of $5 million. The firm seeks to have board participation in its portfolio companies. It will make investments in ordinary or preference shares and/or convertible debt. The firm may also invest in green fields and brown fields. It seeks to acquire controlling majority and significant minority stakes in its portfolio companies. The firm have multiple strategic exit routes within the investment horizon. The firm prefers to invest from its balance sheet investments. Centum Investment Company Plc was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Sociedad Agrícola e Industrial San Carlos S.A.
Description: Sociedad Agrícola e Industrial San Carlos S.A. produces and sells sugar and sugar products. The company offers white raw powdered and whole cane sugar products. It also engages in the electricity co-generation business. The company was founded in 1897 and is based in Guayaquil Ecuador.

Name: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc
Description: AXA Mansard Insurance Plc together with its subsidiaries underwrites risk and non-life insurance contracts in Nigeria. It operates through Non Life Business Life Business Insurance Asset Management Property development and Health Maintenance segments. The company offers life and saving products such as whole life term life cash back term life life celebration instant plan bonus life life saving education plan group life insurance; health insurance including group and employee health plans and third party administrator plan; and investments which includes money market fund equity income fund education trust employee investment scheme and customized portfolio. It also provides business insurance plan agric motor home money travel group personal accident marine fire and special peril burglary insurance fidelity liability goods-in-transit and engineering insurance. The company was formerly known as Mansard Insurance Plc and changed its name to AXA Mansard Insurance Plc in July 2015. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. AXA Mansard Insurance Plc operates as a subsidiary of Assur Africa Holdings Limited.

Name: Wigton Energy Limited
Description: Wigton Energy Limited engages in the generation and sale of electricity from wind technology in Jamaica. It owns and operates a 62.7 MW wind energy generating facilities in Rose Hill Manchester. The company was formerly known as Wigton Windfarm Limited and changed its name to Wigton Energy Limited in November 2024. Wigton Energy Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Vitafoam Nigeria Plc
Description: Vitafoam Nigeria Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacture marketing and distribution of flexible and rigid foam fibre products and textile linens in Nigeria and other West African countries. It operates through two segments Foam Products and Furniture/Other Products. The company provides inner core spring mattresses; regular flexible foams; fibre-based and allied products; rigid foam; and visco-elastic foam products. It also offers wood and metal furniture products and oil filters as well as engages in the system house projects. The company serves real estate healthcare hospitality oil and gas automotive and agricultural sectors. Vitafoam Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Esterad Investment Company BSC
Description: Esterad Investment Company BSC is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm invests in the public equity fixed income and alternative investment markets across the globe. Its alternative investments include investment in private equity and real estate markets. Esterad Investment Company BSC was founded in 1973 and is based in Manama Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Al Anwar Investments SAOG
Description: Al Anwar Investments SAOG is a private equity firm specializing in providing in PIPES and in growing sectors and secondary market. The firm also invests in small-to medium-sized businesses. The firm prefers to invest in financial services and insurance with secondary focus on the energy and industrial sectors. The firm typically invests in companies based in Oman Middle East and in the GCC markets United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia Qatar Oman Kuwait and Bahrain. The firm prefers to take a board representation. It prefers to exit its investment through stake sale IPO and swap/merger. Al Anwar Holdings SAOG was founded in 20th December 1994 and is based in MuscatOman.

Name: Agroindustrial Laredo S.A.A.
Description: Agroindustrial Laredo S.A.A. produces and sells sugar and its by products in Peru and internationally. The company offers powdered fine grain and organic sugar; refined sugar for use in the pharmaceutical sector and for producing clear drinks and translucent sweets; and white sugar for companies that produce dark sweets and soft drinks. It also provides byproducts including extra neutral alcohol for the companies which prepare food beverages and perfumery products; molasses that is used as raw material to make alcohol as well as for use in various food purposes; and bagasse for paper companies. In addition the company engages in the real estate promotion execution of rehabilitation projects and urban construction as well as the purchase/sale of real estate. The company was founded in 1813 and is based in Laredo Peru. Agroindustrial Laredo S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Manuelita Internacional S A.

Name: Champion Breweries Plc
Description: Champion Breweries Plc engages in the brewing and marketing of Champion lager beer and Champ Malta in Nigeria. The company also provides contract brewing and packaging services. It offers its products under the Champion Lager Beer Champion Lager Beer with Ginger Extract Champ Malta Champ Malt with Butter Cookies Flavour and Champ Malt with Tiger nut brands. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Uyo Nigeria. Champion Breweries Plc is a subsidiary of Raysun Nigeria Limited.

Name: Global Financial Investments Holding SAOG
Description: Global Financial Investments Holding SAOG provides brokerage and investment consultancy services in the Sultanate of Oman and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through two segments Brokerage and Investments; and Education and Training Services. The company offers investments in securities and properties; logistics; and leasing and financing services. It manufactures and sells aluminum products; produces manufactures and sells industrial gas; and repairs and maintains vehicles. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Umeme Limited
Description: Umeme Limited engages in the distribution and supply of electricity in Uganda. The company also offers distribution infrastructure construction services for electricity distribution including sub stations medium voltage lines and low voltage infrastructure. In addition it provides technical advisory project management and consultancy technical development and training services. Umeme Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kampala Uganda.

Name: Zarka Educational & Investment Co.
Description: Zarka Educational & Investment Co. operates education centers. It engages in the establishing and managing of kindergartens; establishing of schools for various educational levels entitlements and medical claims training in technological skills rehabilitation auditory and verbal training speech therapy and training in the use of computers and computer programs. It is also involved in satellite broadcasting activities. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Az Zarqa Jordan.

Name: Oman Qatar Insurance Company SAOG
Description: Oman Qatar Insurance Company SAOG provides life and general insurance products in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through three segments: Marine and Energy; Property & Casualty; and Medical and Life. The company offers personal insurance products including car and travel insurance; and business insurance products such as energy property and commercial life and medical and corporate travel and fleet insurance as well as marine and aviation insurance. It also provides marine cargo marine hull and machinery fire engineering general accident third party liability workmen compensation motor home health group life and credit life insurance products. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Al Khuwair the Sultanate of Oman. Oman Qatar Insurance Company SAOG is a subsidiary of Qatar Insurance Company Q.S.P.C.

Name: Döhler S.A.
Description: Döhler S.A. manufactures and sells cotton artificial synthetic mixed fiber flat and ready-made fabrics in Brazil and internationally. The company offers bath face floor children hand beach and pool and hooded towels as well as robes; bed products including bedding sets quilt kits blankets and coverlets fitted and about sheets duvets crib games and pillowtops; table products such as tablecloths dishcloths centerpiece table runners and rails placemats and aprons; and translucent blackout and kitchen curtains. It also provides character products; decorative blankets and rugs; football teams-themed products; and kits and combos. In addition the company offers fabrics for the footwear furniture and mattress industries; corporate linens; and solutions for the hotel and hospital sectors. Döhler S.A. was founded in 1881 and is headquartered in Joinville Brazil.

Name: HBR Realty Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A.
Description: HBR Realty Empreendimentos Imobiliários S.A. engages in the developments leasing and management of real estate assets in Brazil. It operates convenience centers corporate buildings shopping centers hotels and parking lots as well as provides self-storage units +Box built to suit rent agreements and sale lease back services. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Mogi das Cruzes Brazil.

Name: Senergy Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Senergy Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries provides oilfield services in Kuwait Bahrain and Pakistan. It operates through two segments Investment Management and Drilling and Maintenance. The company’s solutions include open hole logging including petrophysical formation testers and micro-resistivity formation imagers services and mechanical sidewall coring tool conveyance options and wellbore logging solutions; cased hole logging consisting of internal and external corrosion analysis data acquisition tools saturation monitoring and mechanical services such as through-tubing bridge plugs explosive-free pipe cutters and free point indicators and gyro measurements; and perforations services including wireline and tubing-conveyed perforating systems. It also offers geosciences services such as complete well integrity assessment four phase flow analysis advanced production logging in horizontal well with ICD completions production logging using jet pump in artificial lift wells reservoir flow evaluation in water injection wells and evaluation of water injection profiles in horizontal wells with open hole completions; and surface well testing and slickline services. In addition the company provides drillstem testing solutions and offers various tools such as full-bore test packers tension safety joints hydraulic jars gauge carriers tester valves circulating valves exit valves and expansion joints. Further it offers slickline services including removing unwanted obstructions; removing wax scale sand and fill build-ups; perforating; fishing; swabbing; packer setting; and other mechanical interventions. The company also offers maintenance of oil facilities wells and refineries; and provides general trading and contracting and engineering services as well as well testing services for oil and gas sector; and offers wireline services. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Al Ahmadi Kuwait.

Name: PROVEN Group Limited
Description: Proven Investment Limited is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm invests in public equity and fixed income markets across the globe. The firm primarily invests in small-cap and mid-cap companies. It employs fundamental analysis in identifying investment opportunities that will provide added value and growth to the firm's portfolio over the medium to long-term horizon. It seeks to invest in Jamaica and other countries in the English-speaking Caribbean. Proven Investment Limited is based in Castries Saint Lucia.

Name: First Takaful Insurance Company - KPSC
Description: First Takaful Insurance Company - KPSC provides takaful insurance solutions to individual commercial and industrial sectors in Kuwait. It operates through two segments Takaful Insurance and Investment. The company offers life and medical insurance products including domestic helpers policy; and fire and general accident insurance products such as house holder’s comprehensive fire and allied perils Insurance property all risks loss of profit hotel comprehensive energy terrorism burglary fidelity guarantee money glass workmen’s compensation general public and product liability professional indemnity decennial liability and directors’ and officers’ liability insurance products. It also provides engineering insurance products including contractor’s and erection all risk contractor’s plant and equipment all risks electronic equipment machinery breakdown deterioration of stock boiler and pressure vessel and loss of profit following machinery breakdown insurance products. In addition the company offers marine and aviation insurance products comprising hull aviation marine cargo and freight forwarder’s and ship/liner agent’s liability insurance products; and motor insurance products that consists of comprehensive vehicle third party liability driver’s license personal civil liability and orange card insurance products as well as fleet and vehicle total loss insurance policy products. Further it engages in the real estate business. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. First Takaful Insurance Company – KPSC is a subsidiary of International Financial Advisors Holding – KPSC.

Name: Zurich Chile Seguros Generales S.A.
Description: Zurich Chile Seguros Generales S.A. provides various insurance products in Chile. The company offers life family accident and health insurance products; life insurance with savings products comprising project education investment and retirement; home insurance products which covers damage caused by fire earthquake and other events as well as theft and broken windows and pipes; annuities; and civil liability car and personal accident insurance products. It also provides insurance products for companies that consists of financial protection personal accidents property SME transport civil liability building and commercial vehicles as well as financial leasing such as real estate leasing and leaseback. The company was founded in 1853 and is based in Santiago Chile. Zurich Chile Seguros Generales S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones Suizo Chilena S.A.

Name: Lojas Quero-Quero S.A.
Description: Lojas Quero-Quero S.A. engages in the general retail trade activities in Brazil. It offers construction tools home appliances cell phones decoration organization furniture garden TVs and audio small appliances bed table and bath cleaning household utilities children's fashion and lifestyle air conditioning computing sports beauty automotive musical instruments technology office and stationery agribusiness and health products. The company also provides credit card and financial services. Lojas Quero-Quero S.A. was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Cachoeirinha Brazil.

Name: El-Nasr Clothing & Textiles Co. (KABO)
Description: El-Nasr Clothing & Textiles Co. (KABO) engages in the manufacturing trading and sale of various textiles internal and external ready-made clothing threads haberdashery accessories and related raw materials in Egypt the Middle East and Africa. The company establishes various exhibitions and operates sales outlets. El-Nasr Clothing & Textiles Co. (KABO) was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: MINAPHARM Pharmaceuticals
Description: MINAPHARM Pharmaceuticals produces medicines chemicals medical and dental supplies cosmetics veterinary and herbal medicines and dietary supplements in Egypt and internationally. It operates through Biological Production Drug Production and Other Pharmaceuticals segments. The company provides its products for the treatment of acne alopecia analgesics and anti-inflammation atopic dermatitis autoimmune disease bone health cardiovascular cerebral insufficiency diabetic neuropathy and retinopathy dyslipidemia gastroenterology and hepatology glaucoma hematoma and thrombosis hemorrhoids haemostasis immuno-stimulants and immunomodulatory and infertility as well as for iron deficiency anemia labour induction menopause nausea and vomiting ocular infection and inflammation osteoporosis post operative management pregnancy and lacation probiotic and gut health psoriasis respiratory tract infection rheumatoid arthritis supplements topical antibiotics topical muscle relaxant and venous disease. MINAPHARM Pharmaceuticals was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Bayer S.A. (Peru)
Description: Bayer S.A. (Peru) engages in the pharmaceuticals consumer health and crop science businesses in Peru. It operates through three segments: Crop Science Pharmaceuticals and Consumer Health. The company offers chemical crop protection products to control weeds; seeds and traits for corn cotton soybeans oilseed rape/canola rice wheat and other crops; biological and chemical products to protect crop plants against fungal diseases; biological and chemical products to protect crop plants from harmful insects and their larvae; vegetable seeds; digital applications for agriculture; products for consumer lawn and garden use and forestry golf courses railway tracks and landscape applications; biological and chemical seed treatment products to protect against fungal diseases and pests. It also provides prescription products for cardiology and women’s health oncology hematology ophthalmology medium-term cell and gene therapy diagnostic imaging equipment and contrast agents; and nonprescription OTC products for dermatology nutritional supplements digestive health allergy cough and cold pain and cardiovascular risk prevention. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Lima Peru. Bayer S.A. (Peru) operates as a subsidiary of Bayer Aktiengesellschaft.

Name: CM Hospitalar S/A
Description: CM Hospitalar S/A engages in the distribution of hospital materials medicines and nutrition products in Brazil. The company offers ophthalmic agent adrenergic and thrombopoietin agonist aminoglycosides painkiller anesthetics receptor antagonist anti-hemorrhoidal antihypertensives systemic antihistamine and orthopedic therapy materials; and anti-inflammatories anti-TNF antacid antiandrogen antianemic anti-asthmatic antibiotic anticoagulant anticonvulsant monoclonal antibody anti-growth antidepressant antidiabetic antidiuretic antidote antiemetics and antinauseants anti-migraine antiepileptics antiestrogens antifibrinolytic antiflatulent antifungal antihemorrhagic antimicrobial antineoplastics antiparathyroid drugs antiparkinsonian antipsychotic systemic antipsoriasis antirheumatics anti-varicose and antiviral medicines. It also provides beta blocker carbohydrate cycloplegic contraceptive contrast special control corticosteroid topical debrider diuretic electrolyte pancreatic enzyme erythropoietin uterine and cardiac stimulant growth factor granulocyte colony stimulating factor gastroprokinetic systemic hemostatic heparins hepatoprotector and lipotropic hormone adeno-pituitary and growth hormone immunoglobulin immunosuppressant labor inducer proton pump and phosphodiesterase inhibitor bone resorption inhibitor platelet aggregation inhibitor adenosine diphosphate receptor antagonist proton pump and interleukin inhibitor proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 inhibitor and calcium reabsorption inhibitor medicines. In addition the company distributes orthopedic products compression socks and diapers; and transports medical and hospital cargo. Further it provides support infrastructure and assistance as well as pharmaceutical monitoring to patients at home; and wipes and wet towels. CM Hospitalar S/A was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Ribeirão Preto Brazil.

Name: OSOS Holding Group Company K.P.S.C.
Description: OSOS Holding Group Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate and investment businesses primarily in the State of Kuwait. The company owns purchases develops and sells real estate and bare lands; and offers property management services. It also owns sells and purchases shares and bonds in real estate companies; and offers consultations in real estate in varied forms as well as invests in various portfolios and other companies. The company was formerly known as Al Safat TEC Holding Company K.P.S.C. and changed its name to OSOS Holding Group Company K.P.S.C. in September 2015. OSOS Holding Group Company K.P.S.C. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Inmobiliaria Manquehue S.A.
Description: Inmobiliaria Manquehue S.A. engages in real estate development business in Chile. The company develops homes and apartments in the metropolitan and VI region. It also sells panels for residential development and equipment. The company was formerly known as Inmobiliaria y Urbanizadora and changed its name to Inmobiliaria Manquehue S.A. in 2007. Inmobiliaria Manquehue S.A. was founded in 1978 and is based in Vitacura Chile.

Name: MPM Corpóreos S.A.
Description: MPM Corpóreos S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides laser hair removal services in Brazil Chile Argentina Colombia and Paraguay. It operates through Laser International Operations and Franchising (Royalties) segments. The company offers physiotherapy services in the areas of laser hair removal and facial and body aesthetics under the Espaçolaser Cela and Definit brands. It also franchises its stores. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: National Hotels Company B.S.C.
Description: National Hotels Company B.S.C. owns and operates a hotel in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The company operates through Hotel Business Real Estate Properties and Investments and Corporate segments. It owns the Diplomat Radisson Blu Hotel and Residence & Spa. The company also rents rooms and offices and commercial properties; invests in equity investments; operates serviced apartments; and sells food and beverages as well as provides conferences and events services. National Hotels Company B.S.C. was founded in 1974 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Metal Fabricators of Zambia Plc
Description: Metal Fabricators of Zambia Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells copper rods and copper and aluminum electrical conductors in Zambia. Its products include low voltage cables (600/1000v) building wires bare copper earth wires flexible cables and wires aluminum overhead conductors aerial bundle conductors copper rods medium voltage power cables and copper shapes as well as general insulated wires. The company also sells telecommunications cables. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Luanshya Zambia. Metal Fabricators of Zambia Plc is a subsidiary of Reunert International Investments (Mauritius) Limited.

Name: BMC Bolsa Mercantil de Colombia S.A.
Description: BMC Bolsa Mercantil de Colombia S.A. organizes and maintains public market for agricultural industrial mining-energy products and other commodities. The company offers MCP; MERCOP; energy for natural gas brokerage and clearing and settlement services for the operations; and non-bank financing and investment services. BMC Bolsa Mercantil de Colombia S.A. was founded in 1979 and is based in Bogotá Colombia.

Name: Lasco Distributors Limited
Description: Lasco Distributors Limited engages in the distribution of pharmaceuticals and consumable products in Jamaica. It operates through two segments: Consumer Division and Pharmaceutical Division. The company offers nutrition hygiene and health care products comprising food drinks under the LASCO brand; various plant-based beverages under the LaSoy brand; sanitary napkins under the CURVES brand; packaged water and flavored water and drinks under iCool brand; and a range of generic products under the LASMED brand. It also exports consumable items. Lasco Distributors Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Credit Rating and Collection Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Credit Rating and Collection Company K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries engages in the credit rating collection and investment businesses in Kuwait. It offers invoice management service a pre-collection program designed for clients to hand over their invoices and contracts; direct collection service that directly collects from debtors for new overdue or bad debt accounts; special and executive collection service a program targeting collection of overdue debts from individuals and corporates on behalf of corporate clients; and skip tracing service to determine the location of the debtors. The company also provides legal action services that offers legal advice regarding filing claims before the law courts against civilians travel ban orders arraignment and arrest warrants assets seizure orders foreclosures and other legal aspects; international collection service to collect debt globally; debt remedial and risk management services; and credit rating service which provides investors with critical information to enable them to take informed investment decision based on their risk-return preferences. In addition it engages in the renting and leasing of land and real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Credit Rating and Collection Company K.S.C. (Public) operates as a subsidiary Investment Dar Company K.S.C.

Name: Alisra for Education and Investment Company (PLC)
Description: Alisra for Education and Investment Company (PLC) engages in the establishment and building of private university under the name of Isra University in Jordan. It also provides education services as well as invests in the field of tourism agricultural and commercial sectors. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Real Estate Investments Zambia PLC
Description: Real Estate Investments Zambia PLC together with its subsidiaries invests develops and restructures commercial residential and non-commercial property for commercial letting in Zambia. It operates in two segments Retail and Office and Residential. It owns a portfolio of office retail industrial and residential real estate. The company was formerly known as Farmers House PLC and changed its name to Real Estate Investments Zambia PLC in 2012. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Lusaka Zambia.

Name: Metalúrgica Riosulense S.A.
Description: Metalúrgica Riosulense S.A. operates as a manufacturer of engine components for light vehicles utility vehicles trucks agricultural machinery motorcycles and products for railway and marine transportation in Brazil. It offers spare parts such as camshafts pistons valve guides injector sleeves valve tappets cylinder liners valve seats combustion pre-chambers rocker arms piston rings engine valves reamers piston with ring valve springs and crankshaft rings; specialized tools for railway maintenance; and casting models. The company also exports its products. Metalúrgica Riosulense S.A. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Rio Do Sul Brazil.

Name: MENA Real Estate Company - KSCP
Description: MENA Real Estate Company - KSCP engages in the development and implementation of real estate projects in Kuwait and internationally. It also offers real estate consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Inmobiliaria SIC S.A.
Description: Inmobiliaria Sic S.A. engages in the real estate activities in Peru. The company was founded in 2019 and is based in San Isidro Peru.

Name: Alexandria Spinning & Weaving Co.
Description: Alexandria Spinning & Weaving Co. manufactures and trades in textiles cast cotton felt and accessories in Egypt. The company offers compact gassed final and coarse combed and carded yarns. It also exports its products to European and Arab countries as well as to the United States Canada and the Far East. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Mecure Industries PLC
Description: Mecure Industries PLC manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals in Nigeria. The company develops produces and markets generic drugs as well as specialty pharmaceuticals. It offers tablets capsules and syrups; and multivitamins and dietary supplements. The company was incorporated 2005 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Quimpac S.A.
Description: Quimpac S.A. engages in the production and sale of chemical products for industrial and domestic use in Peru and internationally. The company offers caustic soda chlorine dicalcium phosphate salt and other chemical products. It also provides hydrogen and hydroxide chlorine soda and water treatment chemicals. In addition the company engages in the livestock business; distribution of chemical products to the veterinary and agricultural markets; and heavy cargo transportation by road. The company was formerly known as Química del Pacífico S.A. Quimpac S.A. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Callao Peru. Quimpac S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Quimpac Corp SAC.

Name: Middle & West Delta Flour Mills
Description: Middle & West Delta Flour Mills engages in the manufacture storage trading importing and exporting of grain and its products and alternatives. The company provides bread towels foodstuffs in general yeast ice refrigeration and freezing feed and their components; and pasta. It also offers packaging supplies. In addition the company invests in securities real estate sector logistical areas and hotel and tourist places. Further it provides commercial agency services for others. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Tanta Egypt.

Name: Aqar Real Estate Investments Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Aqar Real Estate Investments Company K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in State of Kuwait the United Arab Emirates and internationally. The company operates through Real Estate Investments and Others segments. It acquires buys develops leases sells and trades in land and properties; manages third party properties; invests in financial portfolios; establishes manages leases and sells buildings and real estate projects residential and commercial complexes and private and public parking lots; offers economic technical and engineering studies and consultations related to real estate business and private and public real estate projects; and acquires buys and sells shares and bonds of real estate companies. The company also provides maintenance work execution of civil mechanical electrical elevators and air conditioning related to buildings and real estate; manages operates invests in rents and leases hotels health clubs motels hospitality houses rest houses parks gardens exhibitions restaurants cafeterias housing complexes touristic and health resorts entertainment and sports projects and shops; and organizes real estate exhibitions and auctions. In addition it establishes and manages real estate investments fund; imports building materials; builds operates and transfers infrastructure of districts residential commercial and environmental industrial projects through system; and manages real estate utilities. Aqar Real Estate Investments Company K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Minupar Participações S.A.
Description: Minupar Participações S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the production and slaughtering of poultry primarily in Brazil. It is also involved in the industrialization and commercialization of processed meat products. Minupar Participações S.A. was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Lajeado Brazil.

Name: Metrofile Holdings Limited
Description: Metrofile Holdings Limited an investment holding company provides records and information management services in South Africa Botswana Kenya Mozambique and the Middle East. It offers records management including offsite records management scan and store secure shredding and electronic data destruction services; cloud solutions; content services; and information advisory services. The company also provides data management services such as cloud backup disaster recovery and specialized hosting in a private cloud as well as business process optimization services. It serves the financial public retail and mining sectors. The company was formerly known as MGX Holdings Limited and changed its name to Metrofile Holdings Limited in February 2005. Metrofile Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Illovo South Africa.

Name: Empresa Constructora Moller y Pérez Cotapos S.A.
Description: Empresa Constructora Moller y Pérez Cotapos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the development and construction businesses in Chile. The company operates through two segments Real Estate and Construction for Third Parties. It develops and sells houses and apartments under the Moller & Pérez-Cotapos brand; and constructs hospitals clinics and centers. The company was founded in 1961 and is based in Santiago Chile. Empresa Constructora Moller y Pérez Cotapos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversiones 957 Spa.

Name: Upper Egypt Mills Company J.S.C
Description: Upper Egypt Mills Company J.S.C produces and sells flour in Egypt. It also imports and manufactures bread; exports grain products; and operates in real estate and trading business. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Sohag Egypt.

Name: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc
Description: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc provides aviation handling services in Nigeria. Its services include aircraft/ramp handling cargo handling passenger handling premium lounge aviation security and baggage reconciliation as well as ground and flight dispatch services. The company also operates SAHCO Training Academy that offers aviation training courses; and provides equipment rental and maintenance services. Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Ikeja Nigeria.

Name: Banco Pichincha S.A.A.
Description: Banco Pichincha S.A.A. provides various banking products and services in Peru. It offers deposits loans guarantees and bonds securities and financial leasing and intermediation services as well as insurance brokerage services. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Miraflores Peru.

Name: Empresa Eléctrica de Magallanes S.A.
Description: Empresa Eléctrica de Magallanes S.A. engages in the generation transmission distribution and supply of electricity in the Magallanes Region and Chilean Antarctica. The company operates thermal generating plants with capacity of 126.6 MW; and total energy of 357.7 GWh. Empresa Eléctrica de Magallanes S.A. was founded in 1897 and is based in Punta Arenas Chile. Empresa Eléctrica de Magallanes S.A. is a subsidiary of CGE Magallanes S.A.

Name: Balwin Properties Limited
Description: Balwin Properties Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the development and sale of residential properties in South Africa. It operates through Sale of Apartments; Provision of Services to Balwin Residential Estates; Bond Commission; Residential and Commercial Property Rental; and Balwin Foundation segments. The company sells sectional title apartments. It also engages in various businesses including fibre infrastructure and related services; mortgage bonds; clean energy and treated water; security and access control supply and services; internet services; and maintenance services to body corporates. In addition the company is involved in the rental of residential properties; investment and management of commercial properties; management of lifestyle amenities within developments; rental of digital advertising and cell tower infrastructure; online sale of sports equipment; and resale of previously owned Balwin apartments. Balwin Properties Limited was founded in 1996 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Agro Industrial Paramonga S.A.
Description: Agro Industrial Paramonga S.A. engages in the planting cultivation harvesting and processing of sugar cane in Peru. The company’s products include blonde and refined sugar brown sugar and molasses; and rectified ethyl alcohol and industrial alcohol. It also generates electricity through thermal plant. Agro Industrial Paramonga S.A. was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Lima Peru. Agro Industrial Paramonga S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Les Forts S.A.C.

Name: Technos S.A.
Description: Technos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacturing and wholesale distribution of wristwatches. It also provides technical assistance services for watches. The company sells watches through retail stores as well as websites under the Technos Mormaii Michael Kors Dumont Touch Allora Fossil Euro Mariner and Condor brands. The company was formerly known as GMT Participações SA and changed its name to Technos S.A. in 2011. Technos S.A. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil.

Name: South Valley Cement Company
Description: South Valley Cement Company produces and sells cement and its associated products in Egypt. The company provides Portland cement clinker Portland ordinary cement and ready-mix concrete. It also owns and manages a portfolio of multi sector direct and indirect investments. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Oman Reinsurance Company SAOG
Description: Oman Reinsurance Company SAOG engages in underwriting reinsurance business. It operates in two segments Facultative and Treaty. The company underwrites fire engineering accident medical motor and aviation classes as well as marine and non-marine business. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Ithmaar Holding B.S.C.
Description: Ithmaar Holding B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides financial services in the Middle East Africa Asia and internationally. It operates through Retail & Corporate Banking; Asset Management/Investment Banking; and Others segments. The company offers retail commercial investment and private banking; wealth asset and fund management; and real estate development services. It serves retail and corporate clients. The company was formerly known as Ithmaar Bank B.S.C. and changed its name to Ithmaar Holding B.S.C. in January 2017. Ithmaar Holding B.S.C. was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Manama Bahrain.

Name: Michell y Cía. S.A.
Description: Michell y Cía. S.A. operates as a textile company in Peru and internationally. It offers tops and yarns for hand and machine knitting and weaving; knitting weaving and production of garments coats and accessories; and rugs and carpets for residential and commercial use. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Arequipa Peru.

Name: Barka Water and Power Company SAOG
Description: Barka Water and Power Company SAOG owns designs develops constructs finances operates maintains and insures power generating stations water desalination plants associated gas interconnection facilities and other related infrastructure facilities in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through two segments Base Plant and Expansion Plants. The company operates a 427 megawatt-hours gas-fired power generation facility; 20 MIGD multi-stage flash distillation (MSF) water facilities; and 10 MIGD and 12.5 MIGD seawater reverse osmosis plants. The company was formerly known as ACWA Power Barka SAOG and changed its name to Barka Water and Power Company SAOG in March 2022. Barka Water and Power Company SAOG was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Barka the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: The Vegetable Oil Industries Co. Ltd.
Description: The Vegetable Oil Industries Co. Ltd. produces sells and imports vegetable ghee and oil products in Palestine. It offers soya oil corn oil and sunflower oil products. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Nablus Palestinian Authority.

Name: Cambuci S.A.
Description: Cambuci S.A. manufactures and sells soccer equipment in Brazil Africa South and Central America Asia and Europe. The company produces balls footwear accessories and apparel. It sells its products under Penalty and Stadium brands. The company operates through stores and e-commerce channels to direct customers and retailers. Cambuci S.A. was founded in 1945 and is based in São Roque Brazil.

Name: Jerusalem Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd.
Description: Jerusalem Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd. develops manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products in Palestine the Middle East North Africa and internationally. It offers range of over-the-counter prescription pharmaceutical and nutritional supplements products. The company produces approximately 300 pharmaceutical products in various dosage forms such as tablets capsules sterile injectables suspensions syrups powders suppositories ovules creams ointments and ear and nose drops as well as solutions. It also produces detergent cosmetic personal hygiene veterinary and agricultural products. The company was founded in 1969 and is based in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: Metair Investments Limited
Description: Metair Investments Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures supplies and distributes motor vehicle components and energy storage solutions in South Africa Romania and the United Kingdom. It operates in two segments Energy Storage and Automotive Components. The company offers energy storage products including automotive and industrial batteries solar systems back-up systems standby systems charging systems battery distribution networks batteries and solar batteries for original equipment manufacturers and the automotive aftermarket. Its energy storage products are used by the telecoms utilities mining retail and materials and product handling industries. The company also provides automotive components such as heating ventilation air-conditioning climate control systems plastic injection moldings and brake pads air cleaners radiators wiper and washer systems compressors engine control units air conditioning pipes and hoses cooling modules radiator fan shrouds and condensers charge air coolers reserve tanks brake discs and shoes hydraulics and other braking components; and front-end modules shock absorbers and struts. In addition it offers automotive parts including coil and leaf springs stabilizer and torsion bars headlights taillights reflectors plastic bins and storage crates chrome plating body color painting and assemblies automotive wires PVC insulated copper wiring harnesses and cables instrument clusters and combination meters and molded parts. The company also exports its products to Africa the Middle East and Europe. Metair Investments Limited was incorporated in 1948 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: MAYBERRY JAMAICAN EQUITIES LIMITED
Description: MAYBERRY JAMAICAN EQUITIES LIMITED an investment holding company holds investments in various companies that are listed on the Junior Market and the Main Market of the Jamaica Stock Exchange. As of December 31 2021 it held 34 stocks in its portfolio. The company was formerly known as Mayberry West Indies Limited and changed its name to MAYBERRY JAMAICAN EQUITIES LIMITED in January 2018. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Castries Saint Lucia. MAYBERRY JAMAICAN EQUITIES LIMITED is a subsidiary of Mayberry Investments Limited.

Name: Grimoldi S.A.
Description: Grimoldi S.A. manufacturing import marketing and distribution of footwear accessories and clothing. It offers footwear such as sneakers sandals shoes clogs tacos boots comfort outdoors running and flip-flops; and accessories including bags backpacks wallets socks toiletry bags fanny packs cleaning and belts. The company also provides services related to logistics storage custody deposit etc. It offers its products under the Hush Puppies Vans Kickers Cat Merrell Walking Arezzo Jansport New Balance Caterpillar The North Face a-pie Stitching and Grims and Dr. Martens brands through its stores third-party stores franchises and online. Grimoldi S.A. was founded in 1895 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Paratus Namibia Holdings Limited
Description: Paratus Namibia Holdings Limited an investment holding company operates in the information and communications technology industry. It offers fiber LTE data centers and cable landing network stations services. The company was formerly known as Nimbus Infrastructure Limited. Paratus Namibia Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Windhoek Namibia.

Name: Agricola Cayalti Sociedad Anonima Abierta (Cayalti S.A.A.)
Description: Agricola Cayalti Sociedad Anonima Abierta (Cayalti S.A.A.) engages in the production of sugarcane in Lambayeque region Peru. The company was formerly known as Empresa Agroindustrial Cayaltí S.A.A. and changed its name to Agricola Cayalti Sociedad Anonima Abierta (Cayalti S.A.A.) in March 2022. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Chiclayo Peru. Agricola Cayalti Sociedad Anonima Abierta (Cayalti S.A.A.) operates as a subsidiary of Intipuquio S.A.

Name: International Meal Company Alimentação S.A.
Description: International Meal Company Alimentação S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates restaurants bars and cafes that offers food and beverages in Brazil Colombia and the United States. The company also for airlines; operates food courts at service stations and restaurant chains along highways; sells fuel for vehicles; provides services to franchisees of the KFC and Pizza Hut brands; and subletting stores and spaces for promotional and commercial purposes in its chain stores as well as provides general services. The company operates its restaurants under the Frango Assado Viena Brunella Margaritaville KFC Pizza Hut Batata Inglesa and RA Catering brand names. International Meal Company Alimentação S.A. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Sociedad Anonima de Deportes Club de Golf Santiago
Description: Sociedad Anonima de Deportes Club de Golf Santiago engages in the practice development promotion and dissemination of sports in Chile. It is also involved in the construction and installation of golf courses. The company is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Fenie Brossette S.A.
Description: Fenie Brossette S.A. engages in the import and distribution of equipment and products to public and private companies in the fields of building public works industry and energy. It offers truck and automotive spare parts industrial machinery and public works spare parts machinery; commercial and automotive vehicles; public works equipment and concrete block making machines; public lightings generators and photovoltaic plants; pumps industrial and water taps and water treatment and desalination; tubes and accessories seamless steel tubes and metal products; and air conditioners and water heaters. The company also provides shelving gratings lifting equipment forklifts and nacelles; scaffolding formwork and event structure products; rolling scaffolding and access structures; and sand washing and wastewater clarification and crushing services as well as after sales services. Fenie Brossette S.A. was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Fenie Brossette S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Zellidja S.A.

Name: Société Arabe Internationale de Banque S.A.E
Description: Société Arabe Internationale de Banque S.A.E provides corporate and retail banking and investment services in Egypt and internationally. The company offers certificates of deposit current and savings accounts and time deposits; auto cash education and syndicated loans; safe boxes; mortgage products; investment products; and credit debit and prepaid cards. It also provides corporate banking products including short-term credit facilities; term facilities; project finance and infrastructure finance; export and trade finance letters of credit letters of guarantee documentary credit etc.; and financial leasing and sale and lease back facilities. In addition the company offers payroll; factoring; governmental payment services; and treasury and capital market services such as foreign exchange fixed income custody mutual fund and margin trading services as well as Islamic mobile and internet banking services. Société Arabe Internationale de Banque S.A.E was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Société Arabe Internationale de Banque S.A.E operates as a subsidiary of  Arab International Bank.

Name: Mitre Realty Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.
Description: Mitre Realty Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops constructs and sells residential and commercial real estate properties for middle-class and upper middle-class customers in Brazil. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Cornerstone Insurance Plc
Description: Cornerstone Insurance Plc together with its subsidiaries offers risk underwriting and related financial services for corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. The company operates through Non-Life Insurance Life Insurance Takaful Insurance Fin Insurance Leasing and Life Deposit Administration/Investment Contracts. It offers property-casualty and life/health insurance products. The company also provides motor vehicle aviation marine engineering all risks asset protection liability to third party oil and gas group life credit life mortgage protection term assurance wealth creation Takaful fire and burglary gadget protection goods in transit home personal accident and travel insurance products. In addition it offers leasing services; and investment products. Cornerstone Insurance Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: ICON Properties plc
Description: ICON Properties plc a property holding company owns leases manages and develops office retail residential and industrial properties in Malawi. It also involved in development of commercial hospitality specialised buildings such as hospitals rental of investment properties services to tenants and interest income business. ICON Properties plc was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Blantyre Malawi.

Name: Fontana Limited
Description: Fontana Limited engages in buying selling and retailing of pharmaceutical and associated products in Jamaica. The company’s product portfolio includes baby and toddler beauty caregiver essentials electronics gifts gift ideas groceries health home party and special occasions personal care school and office supplies seasonal and stationery products as well as digital gift cards and toys. It also offers its products through online. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Mandeville Jamaica. Fontana Limited operates as a subsidiary of Burbank Holdings Limited.

Name: FosRich Company Limited
Description: FosRich Company Limited together with its subsidiary O’N’S Mini Mart & Electrical Supplies Limited distributes lighting electrical and solar energy products to retail and commercial customers in Jamaica. The company distributes boxes panels steel wire armoured cables wires wiring devices bulbs contactors breakers switches and similar apparatus; ceiling and standing lighting outdoor lighting fans and electrical supplies; and hardware supplies and related products. It also manufactures PVC pipes fittings and conduits; refurbishes pole mount transformers; and offers technical advice. In addition the company installs solar energy systems solar water heaters and electrical panel boards. It serves the electrical solar energy industrial and hardware industries. FosRich Company Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Renova Energia S.A.
Description: Renova Energia S.A. operates as a renewable energy generation company in Brazil. It generates electricity through wind and solar plants. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Palestine Poultry Company L.T.D
Description: Palestine Poultry Company L.T.D owns and operates poultry and dairy farms in Palestine. It produces and sells eggs chickens cows sheep and goats as well as grains and milk. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tulkarm Palestinian Authority. Palestine Poultry Company L.T.D is a subsidiary of Palestine Industrial Investment Company.

Name: Ceramica Carabobo S.A.C.A.
Description: Ceramica Carabobo S.A.C.A. manufactures and sells ceramic tiles in Venezuela. It offers a portfolio of floor and wall tiles made through single firing and double firing methods. The company through its subsidiary Pan American Ceramics Inc. also distributes its products in the United States and Canada. Ceramica Carabobo S.A.C.A. was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Valencia Venezuela.

Name: Misr Chemical Industries Co.
Description: Misr Chemical Industries Co. produces and sells in various chemical products in Egypt and the Middle East. The company offers sodium hydroxide solutions and liquid chlorines. It also provides compressed hydrogen gases caustic soda flakes commercial and pure hydrochloric acid sodium hypochlorite and ferric chloride products. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt. Misr Chemical Industries Co. operates as a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company S.A.E.

Name: Oman United Insurance Company SAOG
Description: Oman United Insurance Company SAOG engages in the underwriting of general life and medical insurance business in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers insurance and re-insurance for motor fire general accident marine cargo hull workmen compensation engineering and aviation. The company also provides travel home personal accident jet ski boat/yacht marine transit property project marine group personal accidents machinery breakdowns electronic equipment contractor's plant and machinery professional indemnity money fidelity guarantee business travel package and medical expenses insurance. In addition it is involved in the repair and maintenance of motor vehicles. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Jordan National Shipping Lines Company
Description: Jordan National Shipping Lines Company provides shipping services in Jordan. The company operates through Marine Services Hotel Services and Other segments. It owns dry and wet bulk carriers and container feeders as well as RoRo Pax multipurpose and harbor towage tugs and support vessels. The company also operates various break bulk liner services in the Mediterranean Sea Red Sea Arabian Gulf and Indian Ocean to carry steel pipes containers RoRo and heavy lift cargo; technical management services of vessels; and chartering services to exporters and importers of various bulk and bagged commodities. In addition it acts as tramp and liner ship agent at the port of Aqaba offering port agency brokerage surveying transshipments husbandry bunkering and incomprehension’s marketing and sales services. Further the company provides freight forwarding and specialized services to the oil and gas renewable energy pipeline generator offshore and other projects; and marine services such as harbour towage pilotage and related support services as well as hospitality services. Additionally it operates The Jordan Academy for Maritime Studies which offer various programs in nautical studies and maritime engineering as well as acts as a trusted consultant and advisor to public and private customers. Jordan National Shipping Lines Company was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Credicorp Capital Peru S.A.A.
Description: Credicorp Capital Peru S.A.A. provides financial services in Peru. It offers asset and wealth management services capital market and trust and securities services. The company was formerly known as BCP Capital S.A.A. Credicorp Capital Peru S.A.A. was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Lima Peru. Credicorp Capital Peru S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Credicorp Capital Holding Peru S.A.

Name: S.A. San Miguel A.G.I.C.I. y F.
Description: S.A. San Miguel A.G.I.C.I. y F. engages in cultivation processing producing and commercializing citrus products in Argentina. The company is involved in harvesting packing and grinding activities. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Vicente López Argentina.

Name: The Arab Pesticides & Veterinary Drugs Mfg. Co.
Description: The Arab Pesticides & Veterinary Drugs Mfg. Co. PLC together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells pesticides and veterinary medicines in Jordan and internationally. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Crown Paints Kenya PLC
Description: Crown Paints Kenya PLC together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells paints adhesives decorating sundries PVA emulsions and alkyd resins in Kenya Uganda Tanzania and Rwanda. The company operates in two segments Paints and Adhesives. It offers decorative paint products such as emulsion water-based paints floor paints gloss/oil-based paints roof paints textured finished special effects and wood finishes; and intermediate products including polyfilla primers undercoats and wall care products. The company also provides automotive paints; industrial paints; road marking paints; thinners; and adhesives. In addition it offers brush and beyond painting services. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: EI- Nile Co. for Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries
Description: EI- Nile Co. for Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries develops produces and sells pharmaceutical products in Egypt. The company offers tablets capsules ampoules powders gels and creams syrups suppositories lotions shampoos ointments mouthwashes powder solutions and nasal and midodrine drops. It also exports its products to the countries in the Middle East. The company was founded in 1962 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Amar Finance and Leasing Company - KPSC
Description: Amar Finance and Leasing Company - KPSC engages in the real estate related activities in Kuwait. The company operates through three segments: Islamic Financing Investment and Real Estate. It is involved in the real estate purchase and development activities as well as sale of land. The company provides investment placement services as well as other investment services. In addition it offers working capital solutions. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Enka de Colombia S.A.
Description: Enka de Colombia S.A. manufactures and sells resins and fibers in North America Central America South America and Europe. The company offers nylon tire cord fabrics for reinforcement in automobile tires application; high tenacity yarns and twisted yarns; and products made from recycled PET bottles. It also produces polyester and polyamide (nylon) fibers filaments and yarns polyester and polyamide (nylon) polymers and polyester and polyamide (nylon) and recycling of PET and polyolefins. It serves nets strings narrow wovens sewing threads chemical industries of tires textiles plastics beverages and other industries. Enka de Colombia S.A. was founded in 1964 and is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: Compañía de Inversiones La Española S.A.
Description: Compañía de Inversiones La Española S.A. invests in shares and real estate. It operates in two segments Investments in Shares and Other Investments. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Valparaiso Chile.

Name: Mubarrad Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Mubarrad Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate transportation investment and other businesses in the State of Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Real Estate; Transportation Leasing and Maintenance; and Investment segments. The company buys sells and invests in real estate properties. It also engages in leasing transportation and maintenance of vehicle and equipment to corporate and individual customers and investments with similar or related operations. In addition the company invests in financial assets; leases heavy equipment for construction including tower and mobile cranes dump trucks construction hoists motor graders wheel loaders excavators black hole and skid street loaders power generators rollers air compressors sand rollers trailers and lorry cranes as well as engages in the real estate and general contracting activities. Further it establishes and manages tourist villages; logistics services; and offers specialized services such as warehousing inventory management packaging and freight forwarding. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited
Description: Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited an investment holding company engages in the food healthcare financial services and property and enterprise development businesses in South Africa Australia Europe and internationally. It operates through two segments Food and Investments. The company offers reinsurance and retrocession intermediary services; healthcare solutions to private and public healthcare sectors; and equity growth capital services to small and medium sized enterprises. It also engages in catching processing and procurement of pilchard sardine anchovy redeye herring lobster horse mackerel squid tuna hake and other deep-sea species as well as Cape hake sole monkfish and kingklip; and packaging of its catch into frozen and chilled seafood. In addition the company owns and manages property funds with a portfolio of properties in the retail convenience sector; and holds interests in a chain of franchised fast-food retail outlets as well as an ice cream manufacturing business. Brimstone Investment Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: dfcu Limited
Description: dfcu Limited through its subsidiary dfcu Bank Limited provides commercial banking products and services in Uganda. The company offers current savings and fixed deposit accounts as well as personal and corporate credit equity finance long-term development finance leasing working capital finance trade finance foreign exchange trading money market transfers overdrafts etc. It is also involved in real estate and property rental and management activities. The company serves customers in many main areas of agriculture manufacturing trade and commerce communication and transport building and construction leisure hotels and accommodation home loans real estate education health tourism mining and other sectors. It operates through a network of branches online and mobile banking cash deposit ATMs and agent banking. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Kampala Uganda. dfcu Limited operates as a subsidiary of Arise B.V.

Name: Act Financial
Description: Act Financial is a private equity firm specializing in buyouts turnaround leveraged acquisitions liquid and illiquid investments. The firm seeks to invest in financial services pharmaceutical building materials financial manufacturing industrial and real estate. The firm primarily invests in Egypt. The firm takes majority stakes. Act Financial was founded in April 20 2015 and is based in New Cairo Egypt.

Name: Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries manages real estate projects in Kuwait. It operates through Real Estate Activities Haj and Umrah Services and Investment Activities segments. The Real Estate Activities segment invests in real estate properties for the purchase sale development and renting of residential and commercial properties including land and land development properties in various geographical locations. The Haj and Umrah Services segment provides ticketing travel and logistics services to Haj and Umrah. The Investment Activities segment lends to subsidiaries and associates; and invests excess cash flows in investments managed by specialized financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Awj Holding Company K.S.C.P. and changed its name to Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P. in September 2017. Mashaer Holding Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Fidson Healthcare Plc
Description: Fidson Healthcare Plc manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical products in Nigeria. The company operates in three segments: Over-the-Counter Ethical Products and Consumer Healthcare Product. It offers drugs infusions and injectables. The company also provides products for anti infective and anti malaria central nervous system and cough and cold gastrointestinal medicines; supplements; topical/dermatological medicines; vitamins and minerals; and ophthalmic solutions. Fidson Healthcare Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: The Far Property Company Limited
Description: The Far Property Company Limited engages in the real estate development property rental and asset management businesses. It operates through Residential Properties Commercial Properties Industrial Properties and Other segments. The company owns approximately 206 properties in Botswana South Africa and Zambia which cover primarily warehouses and shopping centers; and offers retail residential commercial and industrial properties for rent. The Far Property Company Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Jordan Insurance Company
Description: Jordan Insurance Company provides various insurance and reinsurance products in Jordan the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. It provides marine insurance products including cargo and hull insurance; engineering insurance products comprising contractors' all-risks insurance contractors' plant and machinery insurance and erection all-risks insurance; and property insurance products such as fire and lightning householder’s policy benefits of homeowners insurance and property all risks policy products as well as other extended coverages. The company also offers motor insurance products; life insurance products including universal plans term life insurance and group life insurance; and medical insurance products. In addition it provides casualty insurance products comprising bankers blanket bond money insurance fidelity guarantee public liability workman’s compensation professional indemnity plate glass and personal accidents as well as supplementary products such as travel insurance and roadside assistance services. Jordan Insurance Company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Go Green For Agricultural Investment And Development
Description: Go Green For Agricultural Investment And Development manufactures and sells agriculture construction and mining machineries in Egypt. The company is based in Heliopolis Egypt.

Name: Salalah Mills Company SAOG
Description: Salalah Mills Company SAOG engages in the production and distribution of wheat flour bran barley and feed products in the Sultanate of Oman. It is involved in the production and sale of macaroni pasta and related food products; operation of testing and analyzing laboratory; trading of grains cereals and legumes; and distribution of wheat products. The company also exports its products to Africa and internationally. Salalah Mills Company was founded in 1995 and is based in Salalah Oman.

Name: Boldt S.A.
Description: Boldt S.A. engages in the administration management exploitation and operation of casinos and electronic gambling machines in Argentina. It operates through five segments Data processing Real estate sales Communications Entertainment and Rentals. The company offers telecommunications services; services linked to supply data processing maintenance development and implementation of software linked to slot machines; and rental of corporate towers and shopping malls. In addition it is involved in the entertainment hotel and related machines; printing of documentation referring to the identification of people and goods; management and conservation of cadastres; gastronomy; cars and vehicle storage; and exploitation and/or marketing of real estate as well as construction and engineering works. Boldt S.A. was incorporated in 1943 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Al Fajar Al Alamia Company SAOG
Description: Al Fajar Al Alamia Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries manufactures sells and trades explosives and related accessories in the Sultanate of Oman and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through three segments: Explosives Manufacturing and Trading Mining and Drilling and Blasting. It also provides drilling digging and landfill and leveling works; drilling and blasting; earth works and rock blasting and related contracting services; exploding operations for civil contract works and demolitions as well as mines and markets gabbro rock and gypsum. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Rigolleau S.A.
Description: Rigolleau S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of glass products in Argentina and internationally. The company offers household products such as cups glasses beer glasses chops coffee jars bowls crockery jugs and salad bowls as well as type 1 borosilicate glass ampoules and vials. It also provides food packaging products for sweet and jams preserves and pickles and capes; bottle packaging products for oils beers juices spirits and hip flasks water and essences; and medicinal packaging products for droppers liquids and solids veterinarians agricultural and antibiotics. In addition the company offers a variety of promotional options for product customization. Rigolleau S.A. was founded in 1882 and is based in Berazategui Argentina.

Name: Orascom Financial Holding S.A.E.
Description: Orascom Financial Holding S.A.E. operates as a technology-driven financial services investment company in Egypt. The company offers consumer and structured finance solutions; and IT solution platform services. Orascom Financial Holding S.A.E. incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Nexa Resources Atacocha S.A.A.
Description: Nexa Resources Atacocha S.A.A. operates as a mining company worldwide. The company’s mining portfolio comprises copper zinc lead silver and gold ores. The company was formerly known as Compañía Minera Atacocha S.A.A. Nexa Resources Atacocha S.A.A. was incorporated in 1936 and is based in Lima Peru. Nexa Resources Atacocha S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Nexa Resources El Porvenir S.A.C.

Name: Tanga Cement Public Limited Company
Description: Tanga Cement Public Limited Company manufactures and sells cement in Tanzania. The company provides portland limestone cement with limestone extenders for construction with high strength application; portland composite for structural and non-structural cast foundations columns beams walls girdles paving slabs kerbs interlocking pavement slabs and bricks; and portland composite cement for road stabilization and enhancing properties of soil. It offers its products under the Simba Cement brand. The company was formerly known as Tanga Cement Company and changed its name to Tanga Cement Public Limited Company in June 2014. Tanga Cement Public Limited Company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Tanga Tanzania. Tanga Cement Public Limited Company operates as a subsidiary of AfriSam Mauritius Investment Holdings Limited

Name: Cavali S.A. I.C.L.V.
Description: Cavali S.A. I.C.L.V. provides registration transfer and custody services for securities in Peru. It is involved in clearing and settlement of operations in centralized negotiation mechanisms. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Cavali S.A. I.C.L.V. is a subsidiary of Grupo Bvl S.A.A.

Name: Zambia Forestry and Forest Industries Corporation Plc
Description: Zambia Forestry and Forest Industries Corporation Plc establishes and manages pine and eucalyptus plantations in Zambia. It also operates a pole treatment plant; offers poles for fencing and construction of farms animal ranches chicken runs residences chalets bridges and other commercial structures such as hotels as well as for trusses to hold the roof of sheds and shelters; and utility poles used to support overhead power lines including cable fibre optic cable and related equipment transformers and street lights. Zambia Forestry and Forest Industries Corporation Plc was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Ndola Zambia.

Name: Kakuzi Plc
Description: Kakuzi Plc engages in growing packing and selling avocados in the United Kingdom Continental Europe Kenya and internationally. It operates through Tea; Avocados; Macadamia; and Forestry Livestock Arable & Blueberries segments. The company offers avocado; macadamia; commercial forestry products such as treated poles treated wooden gate treated and untreated doors and door frames heat treated pallets timber and treated fencing poles; livestock and butchery; blueberry; and tea. It is also involved in growing cracking and selling macadamia nuts; cultivation and sale of tea green leaf; forestry development as well as sale of forestry products; livestock farming; animal feed and sale of beef; and growing packing and selling of blueberries. The company was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Thika Kenya. Kakuzi Plc is a subsidiary of Camellia Plc.

Name: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc
