Description: Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc operates as a securities exchange in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company offers a platform that assists companies in raising capital through the issuance of equities and debt securities; and securities market to investors who intend to invest in the listed companies. Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange Plc was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Carbacid Investments plc
Description: Carbacid Investments plc an investment holding company engages in the mining processing and marketing of carbon dioxide gas in Kenya. The company operates through Trading and Investments segments. It invests in properties shares and bonds and financial assets. Carbacid Investments plc is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Egypt Free Shops Co.
Description: Egypt Free Shops Co. a duty-free company imports and sells foreign and domestic goods through duty free shops in Egypt. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Portuaria Cabo Froward S.A.
Description: Portuaria Cabo Froward S.A. provides port services in Chile. The company operates the Calbuco and Coronel port terminals. It also offers chips and pellet shipment; unloading of coal clinker and bulk-agri food; liquid bulk transfer; hydrocarbons discharge; general cargo services. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Valparaíso Chile. Portuaria Cabo Froward S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Grupo Empresas Navieras S.A.

Name: United Finance Company SAOG
Description: United Finance Company SAOG provides vehicle and equipment financing in the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates through Corporate and Retail segments. It offers vehicle financing products such as car fleet boat used car and motorbike finance; equipment financing products comprising heavy equipment and heavy commercial vehicle finance; and business finance products including term loans working capital finance bill discounting supply chain financing and corporate deposits. The company also provides composite loans bridge loans hire purchase insurance and debt factoring and financing of receivables and leasing as well as letter of credit and guarantees. The company operates its branches in Ibra Ibri Firq Sohar Salalah Barka and Mawelah. United Finance Company SAOG was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Dhofar Insurance Company SAOG
Description: Dhofar Insurance Company SAOG engages in the insurance and reinsurance businesses in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through two segments PAA Insurance Contracts and GMM Insurance Contracts. The PAA Insurance Contracts segment offers insurance and re-insurance of motor; fire and general accident; marine cargo and hull; and group life. The GMM Insurance Contracts segment provides life insurance products for individuals. The company offers medical travel home contents property liability energy industrial engineering borrowers’ life oil and petrochemical personal accident workmen's compensation insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: AfroCentric Investment Corporation Limited
Description: AfroCentric Investment Corporation Limited an investment holding company provides healthcare administration and health risk management solutions to the healthcare sector. The company operates through Healthcare SA Healthcare Retail Healthcare Africa and Information Technology segments. It offers HIV and other healthcare management solutions. The company engages in the retail and wholesale of pharmaceutical products under the Activo Health AfroCentric Technologies AfA Allegra Denis EssentialMED Klinikka Medscheme Pharmacy Direct Scriptpharm Tendahealth Forrester Pharma Pharmacy Direct Curasana Wholesaler The Cheese has Moved and other brand names. AfroCentric Investment Corporation Limited operates in South Africa Botswana Mauritius Namibia and Eswatini. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Roodepoort South Africa. AfroCentric Investment Corporation Limited operates as a subsidiary of Sanlam Limited.

Name: York Timber Holdings Limited
Description: York Timber Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the forestry sawmilling plywood wholesale and farming businesses in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Processing Plants Forestry and Fleet Wholesale and Agriculture. It operates sawmills that produces and sells various structural and industrial sawn timber products; and plywood plant that manufactures and sells plywood timber products. The company owns plantations that grows pine and eucalyptus trees; and provides fleet solutions that owns heavy motor vehicles that are used to transport logs. In addition it is involved in operating distribution centers that sells timber-related products from the sawmills plywood plants and external suppliers; and owns land with avocados and citrus and macadamias orchards as well as fruit packaging facility. The company was incorporated in 1916 and is headquartered in Sabie South Africa.

Name: Arab East Investment Company PLC
Description: Arab East Investment Company PLC through its subsidiaries engages in the development and investment of real estate properties in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. It is also involved in the provision of training and consulting services. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Amman the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan.

Name: Bombril S.A.
Description: Bombril S.A. engages in the research manufacture marketing and distribution of household products in Brazil. It offers steel sponges dishwashing liquids odorizers soaps multipurpose cleaners disinfectants synthetic sponges scented cleaners softeners stain removers fabric softeners and liquid laundry detergents. The company offers its products under Steel Wool the Limpol Mon Bi Sapolio Kalipto Bril Pine and Bom Bril brand names. The company was formerly known as Abrasivos Bombril Ltda and changed its name to Bombril S.A. in 1984. Bombril S.A. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in São Bernardo do Campo Brazil.

Name: Palestine Industrial Investment Company Ltd
Description: Palestine Industrial Investment Company Ltd together with its subsidiaries operates in the industrial and agricultural sectors in Palestine. It engages in the manufacturing of feed raising broiler chickens and producing and selling of hatching eggs as well as fresh and frozen chicken. The company also processes and converts cardboard rolls into carton boxes ready for use and marketing; and produces rolls for wrapping furniture and furniture. In addition it produces various type of pipes and semi-finished plastic containers as well as involved in general trading business. Palestine Industrial Investment Company Ltd was founded in 1995 and is based in Nablus Palestine.

Name: Al Abraaj Restaurants Group B.S.C.
Description: Al Abraaj Restaurants Group B.S.C. operates restaurants in Kingdom of Bahrain. The company provides catering services; operates small laboratories to produce bakery products; and owns and leases real estate properties. It is involved in the selling and trading of food and beverages. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Manama Bahrain.

Name: Andino Investment Holding S.A.A.
Description: Andino Investment Holding S.A.A. provides port infrastructure and airport real estate and logistics services in Peru. The company engages in the design construction operation improvement and maintenance of airports; extension and remodeling of terminals; rehabilitation of runways; and improvement of fences and parking lots. It also offers airport services such as ramp handling cargo storage passenger check-in and fixed base operator (FBO) serves; cargo warehouse services; commercial logistics services; maritime and river services; foreign trade advisory services; financial solutions comprising warrants and certificates of deposits; and authorized customs warehouse and customs storage as well as integral logistics solutions. In addition the company provides financing solutions for working capital with warrants invoices and fixed assets. Andino Investment Holding S.A.A. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Miraflores Peru.

Name: Sahara Hospitality Company SAOG
Description: Sahara Hospitality Company SAOG provides accommodation catering and related services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company builds owns and operates permanent accommodations for staff and contractors of Petroleum Development Oman LLC on a contract basis in Fahud Nimr and Rima. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Corporación de Ferias y Exposiciones S.A. Usuario Operador de Zona Franca
Description: Corporación de Ferias y Exposiciones S.A. Usuario Operador de Zona Franca together with its subsidiaries engages in the industrial social cultural and commercial development in Colombia and internationally. The company organizes fairs exhibitions events and conventions. It is also involved in the operation of restaurants and bars and fairgrounds; cafeteria and fast-food services; and parking lot administration. The company was founded in 1954 and is based in Bogotá Colombia. Corporación de Ferias y Exposiciones S.A. Usuario Operador de Zona Franca operates as a subsidiary of Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá.

Name: Kafr El Zayat For Pesticides & Chemicals Co.(S.A.E)
Description: Kafr El Zayat For Pesticides & Chemicals Co.(S.A.E) operates in the pesticides and chemicals industry in Egypt Africa and the Middle East. The company offers insecticides fungicides herbicides nematicides and mineral oils. It also provides fertilizers bioinsecticides biofungicides and organic fertilizers as well as pest control services. In addition the company offers products for public health and household applications. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Kafr Al-Zaiyat Egypt.

Name: AJWA For Food Industries Co. Egypt
Description: AJWA For Food Industries Co. Egypt engages in the manufacture and production of refined edible oils in Egypt and internationally. It offers refine vegetable oils and derivatives; ghee; margarine which is used as a substitute for butter; and shortening which is used in bakeries and food industries especially biscuits and sweets and some dairy product. The company also owns three marinas. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Transpaco Limited
Description: Transpaco Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the manufacturing recycling and distribution of paper and plastic packaging products in South and Southern Africa. It operates through three segments: Plastics Products; Paper and Board Products; and Property and Group Services. The company offers cores and tubes including carton dividers conical containers heavy and light duty cores paper straws paper bags tape and yarn cores void fillers paper cores/tubes convolute cores postal tubes textile paper cones composite tubes textile yarn carriers box dividing partitions/inserts honeycomb/dufaylite for doors precision slitting and edge protectors/angle boards/corner pieces. It also provides beige bulk clear utility garbie garbie super saver green garden heavy duty orange and house branded refuse bags as well as swing and trolley bin liners; and flexibles plastic packaging and scholastic supplies which includes banana punched boutique and fresh produce bags jiffy paper and plastic stationary loop handle and plastic boutique bags poly book covering rolls school sheets and vest type carrier bags. In addition the company offers general packaging machinery safety cleaning and chemical products; bag papers and plastics; catering cleaning and safety wear; inside carton and box protection; and packaging equipment pallet stability paper/corrugated/board products plastic packaging and scholastic stationary products as well as stationary tape twine and closures. Further it provides pallet stabilization film pallet wrap and pallet wrap operating equipment as well as braille printed carton carton board and window folded boxes dispensers paper instruction inserts and point of sale stands. It serves retail general packaging transport industrial agriculture cosmetics food mining pharmaceutical and veterinary markets. Transpaco Limited was incorporated in 1951 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Inversiones Tricahue S.A.
Description: Inversiones Tricahue S.A. operates as an investment company in Chile. It acquires and sells shares of Empresa Eléctrica Pehuenche SA. The company is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: The Arab Drug Company
Description: The Arab Drug Company engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products. It offers anti-infectives central nervous system drugs dermatological drugs and cardiovascular drugs as well as animal health products in powders and solutions. The company exports its products to approximately 40 countries including China Korea Turkey Kazakhstan Iraq Syria Jordan Lebanon Libya Sudan Somalia Yemen and Morocco. The Arab Drug Company was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: B-Gaming S.A.
Description: B-Gaming S.A. develops technological solutions for capturing communicating validating and processing large volumes of information. The company also installs security computer centers communication networks and equipment VSAT antennas online and mobile lottery terminals printers and other supplies. In addition it develops communication and transaction management software. The company was formerly known as Boldt Gaming S.A. and changed its name to B-Gaming S.A. in February 2018. B-Gaming S.A. was incorporated in 1934 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Sociedad de Inversiones Campos Chilenos S.A.
Description: Sociedad de Inversiones Campos Chilenos S.A. produces and sells sugar and derivatives under the Iansa brand name in Chile. It is also involved in the animal nutrition business; sale agricultural inputs such as urea fertilizers; and production and sale of tomato paste and fruit juices and pulps. Sociedad de Inversiones Campos Chilenos S.A. is based in Santiago Chile. Sociedad de Inversiones Campos Chilenos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of E.D.& F. Man Chile Ltda.

Name: Automated Systems Company - KPSC
Description: Automated Systems Company - KPSC provides IT infrastructure and software solutions in Kuwait and internationally. It operates through Services and Solutions Investments and Training Services segments. The Services and Solutions segment engages in consulting implementing upgrading and managing applications in the areas of enterprise resource planning and customer relationship management; and managing projects and human capital outsourcing as well as sells software. The Investments segment invests in local equity funds and shares as well as funds managed by portfolio managers. The Training Services segment offers training services under the franchise agreement with the franchisor. The company’s IT infrastructure solutions comprise data center infrastructure network infrastructure and cyber security as well as provides professional services including project implementation solution architecture and design on demand support and annual maintenance contract services. It also offers software solutions including infrastructure and engineering software solutions; and student and learning management systems. In addition the company provides healthcare information system solutions such as PANMEDICA a solution for medium and large size hospitals with inpatient facilities; PANLAB a system that handles the issue of maintenance and printing of various lab reports; PANPHARMA a system for pharmacies; and PANCLINICA a system for polyclinics and medical centers as well as trades in automation equipment and secondment of staff. Further it offers services and solutions to government/semi-government oil and gas banking and finance telecommunications education and training healthcare engineering construction retail and logistics and travel industries. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Automated Systems Company - KPSC is a subsidiary of Kuwait Airways Company K.S.C.

Name: Qatar Oman Investment Company Q.S.C.
Description: Qatar Oman Investment Company Q.S.C. is a private equity firm specializing in investments in acquisitions. The firm generally invests in shares loan certificates promissory notes negotiable bonds and any other titles or commercial papers. It seeks to invest in oil and gas real estate and infrastructure health care and financial services in the State of Qatar and in tourism real estate and infrastructure health care and education in the Sultanate of Oman. The firm also seeks to establish industrial commercial agricultural real estate tourist and service projects in the State of Qatar and the Sultanate of Oman. Qatar Oman Investment Company Q.S.C. was founded on July 12 2006 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Dar Al Dawa Development and Investment Co. Ltd.
Description: Dar Al Dawa Development and Investment Co. Ltd. an integrated pharmaceutical company develops manufactures markets and distributes pharmaceutical and consumer healthcare products in Levant Gulf and Yemen the Middle East Africa Europe and Asia. It operates through Medicine; and Infants’ Cereals and Milk Formula segments. The company offers products in the therapeutic areas of anti-infective cardiovascular and diabetes urology respiratory gastrointestinal analgesic and musculoskeletal central nervous system gynecology dermatology ophthalmology and oncology; and cereal and milk formula products for infants. It serves patients and medical communities. Dar Al Dawa Development and Investment Co. Ltd. was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Acerías Paz del Río S. A.
Description: Acerías Paz del Río S. A. produces and sells steel products in Colombia and internationally. It offers wire rods corrugated bars and rolls figured steel electro-welded mesh black annealed wires joint grommet grafiles trusses and bolts; iron ore fines lithified and substituted slags blast furnace slags and carbochemicals; and fertilizers and amendments. The company was formerly known as Empresa Siderúrgica Nacional de Paz de Río. Acerías Paz del Río S. A. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Bogotá Colombia. Acerías Paz del Río S. A. operates as a subsidiary of Trinity Capital SAS.

Name: VFD Group PLC
Description: VFD Group PLC a proprietary investment company provides alternative funding and investment channels accessible to individuals small businesses and operators in Nigeria and Ghana. The company engages in microfinance banking investment and fund management issuing house and investment adviser stock and insurance brokerage auto and financial leasing real estate and hospitality development logistics and haulage lending and technology IT infrastructure development digital product development building construction services comfort-food style restaurant relaxation leisure and homestyle cooking’s activities. It offers its services to the financial services capital market technology security services banking remittance real estate and hospitality leasing media and entertainment infrastructure and energy sectors. VFD Group PLC was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo
Description: Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo engages in publishing business in Brazil and internationally. The company operates through High Performance Fibers Editorial and Real Estate segments. It offers editorial and children's and educational title books. The company engages in developing and managing forests through pines and eucalyptus plantation activities. In addition it is involved in the production of cellulose fibers and other pulps for paper fibers used in the carton tissue specialty papers carpets and packaging. The company is involved in buying developing constructing managing selling and rental as well as sub-division of real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo Ind. de Papel and changed its name to Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo in August 1994. The company was incorporated in 1890 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: The Jordan Worsted Mills Co. Ltd.
Description: The Jordan Worsted Mills Co. Ltd. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells fabrics in Jordan. The company offers woolen blended and synthetic as well as summer winter military and civilian wear. It also exports its products to Arab countries. The company serves Jordanian armed forces public security directorate royal Jordanian air force civil defense directorate and general directorate of the gendarmerie as well as state institutions schools local market and clothing manufacturing industries. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: United Co. for Housing & Development - S.A.E.
Description: United Co. for Housing & Development - S.A.E. operates as a real estate developer in Egypt. The company buys sells and divides land as well as prepares and supplies land with utilities and services. It also invests in infrastructure foods dairy products and water treatment as well as real estate investment. The company was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt. United Co. for Housing & Development - S.A.E. is a subsidiary of Pioneers Holding Company For Financial Investments (S.A.E.)

Name: Bowler Metcalf Limited
Description: Bowler Metcalf Limited manufactures and sells rigid plastic packaging in South Africa. The company operates through the Plastic Packaging and Property Investment segments. It also invests in properties for letting to the manufacturing industry. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Musandam Power Company SAOG
Description: Musandam Power Company SAOG engages in the design construction ownership financing operation and maintenance of a dual fuel power plant in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates a power plant with natural gas as the primary fuel and diesel oil as the alternative fuel with a capacity of 120 Mega Watt. The company sells its electrical energy generated to Oman Power and Water Procurement Company SAOC. Musandam Power Company SAOG was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Qatari German Company for Medical Devices (Q.P.S.C.)
Description: Qatari German Company for Medical Devices (Q.P.S.C.) manufactures and sells single use disposable syringes in Qatar and internationally. It offers Q JectUltra an insulin syringe serving as a tool in diabetic care; Q Flow for infusion therapy; Q Need a single use hypodermic needle; Q Ject a single use syringe for the curative medications; and Q Safe a re-use prevention syringe. The company also trades in medical consumables equipment tools and supplies and furniture. In addition it provides healthcare training. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Offtec Holding Group Company (P.L.C.)
Description: Offtec Holding Group Company (P.L.C.) provides business technology in Jordan and internationally. It offers teller cash recyclers teller safes auto safe deposit lockers check scanners check sorting solutions safe deposit locker vault doors and ATMs as well as banknote counting and detecting banknote sorting and strapping and coin counting and sorting machines. The company provides office technology solutions such document filing and storage document shredder and scanner franking machines inserting folding and mailing solutions manual time recorders and time and attendance; and advanced threat data endpoint network web and email security and security management and analysis. It also offers data storage solutions and servers backup and disaster recovery solutions environmental monitoring system digital signage and uninterruptible power supply systems. In addition the company provides office furniture solutions and seating; furniture for auditorium and public areas and partitions; flooring; and educational and healthcare furniture solutions as well as plastic card technologies and digital transformation solutions. Further it offers physical security solutions comprising access control burglary safes digital surveillance entrance security sire resistance safes and cabinets guard tour security doors windows and frames intrusion alarms intelligent key management and lockers and outdoor perimeter security solutions; banking software connected intelligence platform enterprise content management letter check printing and time and attendance software; and digital copier and multifunctional and printers. Additionally the company invests in stocks bonds and securities; provides loans guarantees and finances; and engages in the ownership of patents trademarks franchise rights and other intangible rights. Offtec Holding Group Company (P.L.C.) was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Santova Limited
Description: Santova Limited provides logistics services in Africa the Asia Pacific Europe North America and the United Kingdom. The company operates through Logistics Services and Financial Services segments. It provides international trade services including supply chain engineering logistics global project management client sourcing and procurement express courier and financial services; and development implementation analysis management and supply chain optimization services through cloud-based technologies and software packages. The company also offers business intelligence solutions that enables digital transformation through cloud-based technologies to unlock data for analysis or predictive analytics; insurance solutions; and value add services that delivers a range of tailor-made services and solutions. Santova Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Durban South Africa.

Name: Corporación Cervesur S.A.A.
Description: Corporación Cervesur S.A.A. operates in the textile agro-industry transportation food production and real estate sectors. The company produces knitted fabrics threads garments and animal feed products; and transports hazardous materials as well as goods of mining and hydrocarbon sectors. It also grows various products including green asparagus organic pecans hybrid seeds corns cottons etc. In addition the company constructs apartment buildings. Corporación Cervesur S.A.A. was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Arequipa Peru.

Name: abc S.A.
Description: abc S.A. operates a chain of department stores in Chile. The company's stores provide clothing footwear beauty sports children's electronics technology and household items under the La Polar name as well as operates online stores. It also offers financial retail services including credit cards such as La Polar Card and La Polar Visa Card as well as insurance products and services. The company was formerly known as Empresas La Polar S.A. and changed its name to abc S.A. in July 2024. abc S.A. was founded in 1920 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Société Maghrébine de Monétique
Description: Société Maghrébine de Monétique engages in the development integration and maintenance of electronic-payment solutions in Morocco and internationally. It offers payment solutions such as merchant solutions payment gateways payment channel management issuing cards risk and fraud management prepaid and loan management as well as payment activity management.; e-wallets and mobile banking and payment services; outsourcing services that includes turnkey service and fraud detection and prevention system. The company also provides card personalization and instant issuing BNPL Islamic payment management tokenization 3D Secure-ACS solution multi-currency card cashback program soft POS solutions instant payment and agency banking. It serves financial institutions mobile network and money transfer operators oil companies aggregators/billers and universities as well as e-gov retail and insurance sectors. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Société Maghrébine de Monétique operates as a subsidiary of SA MEDTECH.

Name: Caribbean Producers (Jamaica) Limited
Description: Caribbean Producers (Jamaica) Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and distribution of food and beverage products in Jamaica and St. Lucia. The company manufactures and distributes fresh juices and meats; and distributes nonfood supplies. It also offers meat products including beef pork lamb and poultry; seafood products such as shrimp mussels crabs and other products; dairy products comprising cheeses milk butter and yogurt; wines; spirits including tequila rum whiskey gin vodka liqueur and cognac; and beverages such as coffee juices non-alcoholic spritzers and fine teas as well as logistics services. In addition the company provides fruit juice concentrates and sodas under the Cariburst Juices and Cariburst Frozen Drinks Mixes brands. Further it operates as the distributor of Certified Angus Beef CAB brand; Island Oasis frozen drink mixes and Kan Pak ice cream mixes; and beverage dispenser systems under the Island Oasis Ice Shaver/Blender Bunn-O-Matic Gourmet Juice Dispensers Bunn-O-Matic Taylor Frozen Drink Machine and Taylor Soft Serve Machines brands. The company distributes groceries in-store and online. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Montego Bay Jamaica. Caribbean Producers (Jamaica) Limited is a subsidiary of A.S. Bryden & Sons Holdings Limited.

Name: Deneb Investments Limited
Description: Deneb Investments Limited an investment company distributes branded products in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through Property; Industrial Product Manufacturing; Branded Product Distribution; and Automotive Parts Manufacturing segments. It owns and manages a portfolio of industrial and commercial properties situated in KwaZulu-Natal the Western Cape Limpopo and Eastern Cape. The company also offers integrated polypropylene products; custom bulk bags; non-woven goods; specialty chemicals; rainwater products; household textiles and stitch bonded fabrics; and environmental solutions. In addition it imports and distributes toys baby and outdoor leisure goods; a range of digital software products; and printers as well as designs publishes and supplies school office and corporate stationery products. Further the company design installs and maintains critical systems for pharmaceutical biotechnology healthcare and manufacturing sectors. Deneb Investments Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Cape Town South Africa. Deneb Investments Limited is a subsidiary of TIH Prefco Proprietary Limited.

Name: United Cable Industries Company PLC
Description: United Cable Industries Company PLC manufactures and trades power cable and wire in Jordan and internationally. The company offers domestic wires for use in internal wiring in buildings and electrical equipment; and low voltage power cables for power distribution in urban networks industrial plants and electrical machines. It also provides control cables for connecting signaling and control units; overhead conductors for use in transmission lines and distribution networks in urban and rural areas carried on support towers and poles; and special cables such as fire resistance and renewable energy cables. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Qatar Electronic Systems Company (Techno Q) Q.P.S.C.
Description: Qatar Electronic Systems Company (Techno Q) Q.P.S.C. a systems integrator provides audiovisual extra low voltage broadcast infrastructure IT business lighting systems architecture and hospitality solutions. The company also sells lighting system equipment and integrated software systems; and offers maintenance of equipment and systems. It undertakes projects across corporate education government healthcare hospitality and leisure financial institutions oil and gas residential retail outlets sports facilities public venues and media sectors. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Doha Qatar.

Name: Mayberry Group Limited
Description: Mayberry Group Limited together with its subsidiaries provides various financial services and products to corporations financial institutions governments and individuals. The company offers strategic financial advisory; mergers and acquisition; debt and equity restructuring; investment management; brokerage; and cambio and research services. It is also involved in the equity and securities trading business; and managing equity portfolio pension funds and foreign exchange cambio as well as invests in unquoted securities. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Castries Saint Lucia.

Name: The Bahrain Ship Repairing and Engineering Company BSC
Description: The Bahrain Ship Repairing and Engineering Company BSC provides repair and maintenance services to vessels. It operates in three segments: Ship Repairing and Investments; Trading; and Pump Repairing. The ship repairing and investment segment engages in ship repairing and investment activities. The trading segment offers sale of mechanical electrical and pumps. The pump repairing segment engages in the pump repairing. The company also engages in the manufacturing modification and maintenance of switchboards motor control centers and control panels. In addition it provides marine and industrial pump services include internal and external surface protective coating spare parts manufacturing industrial gear boxes inspection and overhauling repairs and rewinding dynamic balancing and computer aided drawing services; and container repair services. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. The Bahrain Ship Repairing and Engineering Company BSC is a subsidiary of Yusuf Bin Ahmed Kanoo WLL.

Name: The Jamaica Stock Exchange Limited
Description: The Jamaica Stock Exchange Limited engages in the regulation and operation of a stock exchange and the development of the stock market in Jamaica. The company operates in Exchange operations; JCSD services; Investments; and Trustee custodianship company management and other activities segments. It provides regulation of participants in the stock market; transferring and holding services of securities shares stocks bonds and debentures; registrar services; investing activities; and trustee custodianship company management and other services as well as establishes and maintains Central Securities Depository (CSD). The company’s products and services include advertising API and data subscription depository JSE loyalty rewards program market listing training and education. It also acts as a market observer; offers publications; and engages in market research and stock market competition business. In addition the company offers Caribbean Business Exchange (CBX) a dedicated cable TV channel for broadcasting content from the JSE and its stakeholders; as well as operates JTraderPro an online trading platform; a library; e-Campus that provides professionals for career development training; ISIN issuing agency; and direct access market (DMA). The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Mutual Benefits Assurance Plc
Description: Mutual Benefits Assurance Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in non-life insurance and risk management services to organizations and private individuals in Nigeria Liberia and Niger Republic. It operates through three segments: Assurance Business Real Estate and Microfinance Banking. The company’s general insurance products include fire and special perils burglary/housebreaking householder/house-owner comprehensive marine cargo marine hull motor goods-in-transit all risk insurance contractors all risks erection all risks plant all risks machinery breakdown money professional indemnity fidelity guarantee public liability personal accident bond aviation and oil and gas insurance products. It also offers life insurance products comprising term assurance keyman assurance credit life assurance mortgage protection anticipated endowment assurance and whole life assurance policies; mutual education guarantee assurance; mutual education endowment individual savings and protection personal pension and investment micro personal pension and investment and mutual dignity plans; and mutual school fee guarantee scheme mutual multilife shield and group life assurance products. In addition the company protects customers assets and indemnification of other parties; and provides real estate development as well as retails and microfinance banking services. It serves individual and corporate customers through a network of brokers agencies and direct marketing programs. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Real Estate Development Company PLC
Description: Real Estate Development Company PLC together with its subsidiaries operates in the real estate development industry in Jordan and internationally. The company’s portfolio includes residential commercial touristic and mixed-use properties. It provides housing construction and engineering consultancy services. Real Estate Development Company PLC was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Oman National Engineering & Investment Company SAOG
Description: Oman National Engineering & Investment Company SAOG together with its subsidiaries provides services in the areas of engineering and utility sectors in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC); Operation and Maintenance; Billing; Product and Solution; Investments; Fire and safety; and Training Centre Segments. The company engages in the supply and installation of power generating equipment; and construction of power supply lines and other related projects. It also operates and maintains power generation stations desalination plants hospital equipment air conditioning plants and sewage treatment plants. In addition the company involved in the billing and collection of electricity telecom PASSI and water dues. Further the company engages in the rehabilitation of desalination stations; supply of high-density polyethylene pipes and manhole covers; design supply installation and commissioning of sewage treatment plants; supply of isolators and fuses; and provision of metering systems for distribution networks etc. Additionally it offers training in professional courses for third parties; investment properties investments in equity instruments listed on muscat stock exchange and fixed deposits with banks; and fire prevention systems. fire extinguishers. circuits sensors and extension cords. Furthermore the company provides electronic payment insurance and wallet services to customers. The company was formerly known as Oman National Electric Company SAOG and changed its name to Oman National Engineering & Investment Company SAOG in January 2007. Oman National Engineering & Investment Company SAOG was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Trafco Group B.S.C.
Description: Trafco Group B.S.C. together with its subsidiaries trades in food products primarily in the Kingdom of Bahrain and other Gulf Cooperation Council countries. The company operates through six segments: Wholesale Operations; Investments; Dairy Products and Beverages; Fruits and Vegetables; Storage and Logistics; and Livestock. It engages in the production bottling and marketing of sweet drinking water and beverages under the TYLOS Selsabil MARWA and Cloud9 brands; import and distribution of canned frozen and dry and nonfood products as well as general commodities eggs livestock and chilled and frozen meat; provision of storage and logistics services; and trading of fresh fruits and vegetables and other food products. The company also produces and supplies fruit juice and drinks and fresh milk under the Noor brand; UHT milk under the Awal brand; and ice creams under the Fabion brand. In addition it provides bananas; and produces and supplies tomato paste. Further the company invests in quoted and unquoted securities; trades in potato chips; and operates a chain of supermarkets. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Bayan Investment Holding Company (K.S.C) Public
Description: Bayan Investment Company K.S.C.P. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm also provides consultancy and trading services. It provides its services to individuals and companies. The firm seeks to make direct investment private equity investments joint ventures and business services functions such as business valuation and in-house investment analysis.  It focuses its private equity investments in the GCC region. The firm also manages separate client-focused equity portfolios and mutual funds for its clients. It invests in the public equity markets across the globe with a focus on Kuwait. The firm also invests in money markets of Kuwait. It also invests in financial and real estate portfolios negotiated by specialized companies and agencies. Bayan Investment Company K.S.C.P. was founded in 1997 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: October Pharma S.A.E
Description: October Pharma S.A.E manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in Egypt. The company provides its products in solid forms such as tablets capsules and powders; liquid forms comprising syrups drops solutions and sprays; creams and suppositories; soft gelatin capsules; and ampoules and vials. October Pharma S.A.E was founded in 1987 is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Arab Developers Holding
Description: Arab Developers Holding engages in the planning investment development and operation of real estate properties in Egypt the Middle East and North Africa. It develops mixed-use and family oriented destinations as well as mansions villas and serviced apartments; and operates hotels shopping malls and restaurants as well as Golf courses. The company was formerly known as Porto Group Holding SAE and changed its name to Arab Developers Holding in February 2022. Arab Developers Holding was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Dlala Brokerage and Investment Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Dlala Brokerage and Investment Holding Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the brokerage activities in Qatar. It operates through three segments: Stock Brokerage Real Estate and Others. The company acts a stockbroker and provides financial services in QSE. It also provides property management marketing and sales services for real estate clients. In addition the company is involved in investment activities. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Grand Parade Investments Limited
Description: Grand Parade Investments Limited is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in incubation PIPE's industry consolidation recapitalizations buyouts and growth capital investments. It considers investments in seed and startup middle market mature turnaround and emerging growth stages. The firm typically invests in leisure tourism and gaming sectors and also considers investments in property retail food manufacturing real estate and entertainment. It seeks to invest in Africa with a focus on South Africa and Western Cape. The firm primarily invests between R$10 million ($0.84 million) and R$1000 million ($84.98 million) in companies with enterprise value greater than R$300 million ($25.50 million). The firm prefers to take a board seat in its portfolio companies. It may enter into joint ventures and other similar alliances whereby it forms partnerships with such entities contributing not only capital but also providing strategic managerial input. The firm prefers to take minority or majority stake in its portfolio companies. The firm seeks to take more than 20 per cent stake however a smaller stake is also considered where there is the potential to increase such stake in the future. It seeks to make balance sheet investments. Grand Parade Investments Limited was founded in 1997 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I.
Description: Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. manufactures and sells food products in Argentina. It offers biscuits oils and dressings olives oatmeal frozen products mini cracker cookies flour legumes corn breadcrumbs butter and mashed potatoes. The company was formerly known as Francisco Morixe e Hijos Sociedad Colectiva and changed its name to Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. in 1914. Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. was founded in 1901 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Morixe Hermanos S.A.C.I. operates as a subsidiary of Sociedad Comercial del Plata S.A.

Name: Derrimon Trading Company Limited
Description: Derrimon Trading Company Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the wholesale and bulk distribution and retail of household and food products in Jamaica. It operates through three segments: Distribution Wholesale and Retail and Other Operations. The company is involved in the distribution of household products; Sun Power detergents; chilled and ambient beverages; and meat and other food products. It also manufactures flavors and fragrances; processed meat; and wooden pallets as well as provides management and administration services. In addition the company offers warehouse storage rental cold storage facilities distribution network and online shopping services to supermarkets wholesalers grocery stores pharmacies convenience stores and food service channels. Further the company operates supermarkets; manufacturers ham bacon and sausages. The company markets its products through a chain of outlets and supermarkets under the Sampars Select Grocers and Food Savers NY names as well as Caribbean Flavours & Fragrances Spicy Hill Arosa and Woodcats names. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Nozha International Hospital
Description: Nozha International Hospital provides health and medical care services in Egypt. The company offers children semi-urinary tract diseases fevers bones eyes physical therapy ear and throat unit artificial kidney unit intensive care radiology blood bank internal diseases surgery gynecology and other related medical services. Nozha International Hospital was founded in 1985 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc
Description: Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc provides mortgage and banking services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. It offers savings accounts fixed deposits and current accounts. The company also provides mortgage loans short/medium term loans for property owners mortgage refinancing commercial real estate loans and loans for women-owned real estate companies. In addition it offers financial advisory digital banking services debit cards and prepaid cards. The company was formerly known as Abbey Building Society Plc and changed its name to Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc in January 2014. Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: The Consulting & Investment Co. Group. Ltd.
Description: The Consulting & Investment Co. Group. Ltd. provides medical care services in Jordan. The company operates cardiovascular fertility center pediatrics gastroenterology ICU newborn medicine women’s health respiratory therapy laboratory and imaging and radiology departments. It also sells medicines. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Dhofar Generating Company SAOG
Description: Dhofar Generating Company SAOG develops finances designs constructs operates maintains insures and owns power generating station and other relevant infrastructure in the Sultanate of Oman. The company owns and operates two power generation plants with a combined contracted capacity of 718 MW. Dhofar Generating Company SAOG was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Salalah Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Alphaville S.A.
Description: Alphaville S.A. engages in residential subdivision business under the Alphaville brand in Brazil. The company was formerly known as Private Equity AE Investimentos e Participações S.A. Alphaville S.A. was founded in 1973 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Coronation Insurance Plc
Description: Coronation Insurance Plc through its subsidiaries engages in underwriting of life and non-life insurance for individuals and corporate entities. The company operates in two segments General Business and Life Business. It offers current escrow joint and domiciliary accounts; home personal accident car travel life liability marine business vehicle buildings and contents construction business interruption group welfare and life and bancassurance insurance products; asset management such as fixed income private equity equities trust services mutual funds alternatives and advisory services; and estate planning trustee registrar and data management services. The company also provides treasury management products such as liquidity management treasury bills local and foreign currency term deposits commercial papers and notes trading and global currency; yacht and aviation financing and emergency loans; investment banking products including corporate restructuring project finance mergers and acquisitions and capital raising; and wealth management products such as financial planning retirement planning and managed portfolio. In addition it offers securities trading and brokerage services such as investment advisory repo brokerage accounts equities and margin loans; and venture building and capital under technology services. It was formerly known as Wapic Insurance Plc and changed its name to Coronation Insurance Plc in September 2020. The company was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Blantyre Hotels plc
Description: Blantyre Hotels plc operates in hospitality industry in Malawi. The company operates through Accommodation and Food and Beverage segments. It operates Protea Hotel Ryalls hotel. The company also provides conferencing and catering services. Blantyre Hotels plc was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Blantyre Malawi.

Name: National Insurance Company (Palestine)
Description: National Insurance Company (Palestine) provides various insurance products and services for individual and corporate customers in Palestine. It offers vehicle travel comprehensive house hold personal accident life VIP3 money third party liability product and professional indemnity fidelity guarantee workers compensation land transport marine health fire and burglary and critical illness insurance products. The company also provides insurance for machinery breakdowns erection risks plate glasses and electronic equipment as well as contractors' plant and machinery. In addition it offers online insurance products and services. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: eMedia Holdings Limited
Description: eMedia Holdings Limited an investment holding company operates in media sector in South Africa. It operates e.tv a free-to-air commercial television station; eSat.tv operates eNCA a 24-hour news channel; Platco Digital operates Openview a free-to-air satellite television platform; eVOD a video and demand platform allowing to watch shows and movies on any device. The company was formerly known as Seardel Investment Corporation Limited and changed its name to eMedia Holdings Limited in November 2015. eMedia Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa. eMedia Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Fulela Trade and Invest 81 (Pty) Ltd.

Name: Afaq Holding for Investment & Real Estate Development Co. P.L.C
Description: Afaq Holding for Investment & Real Estate Development P.L.C primarily manufactures and sells ready mix concrete products in Jordan. The company is also involved in the transportation and land shipping activities; provision of spare parts and maintenance services; and manufactures trailers. In addition it invests in shares bonds and securities; owns exploits and leases patents trademarks and franchise and other intangible rights. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Metal and Recycling Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Metal and Recycling Company K.S.C. (Public) provides waste management recycling and industrial solutions to government oil and gas petrochemicals manufacturing and commercial clients in Kuwait. It operates through Waste Management & Recycling Services Department- HVAC Services Department - Cleaning and Others segments. The company offers recycling waste plastic rubbles and environmental waste as well as trades recycled materials; imports machines and materials for shredding sorting cutting and shearing of metals; and selling waste scraps. This segment provides treatment and disposal of metallic plastic and medical waste. It provides maintenance of tools and technical supplies such as electric generator; cleaning services; maintenance of construction ceiling bridge erection cleaning and sanitary contracts; buying and selling cleaning powders; air condition contracts and maintenance; and extinguishing tool works and fire alarm machines. In addition the company offers cleaning of roads and buildings; city cleaning contract; and security services. Further it engages in investment and rental activities. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Metal and Recycling Company K.S.C. (Public) operates as a subsidiary of Agility Public Warehousing Company K.S.C.P.

Name: Pulse Investments Limited
Description: Pulse Investments Limited engages in the development and production of media content model agency representation and live show production businesses in Jamaica and internationally. The company is also involved in the sub-letting of leasehold properties; property development; and hospitality and leisure activities. It owns and operates studio filming and editing facilities as well as shoot locations; and sells its TV shows to cable television stations free-to-air television stations and internet broadcasters. Further the company engages in development of real estate holdings which includes construction of residences. Pulse Investments Limited was founded in 1980 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Bahrain Car Parks Company (Amakin) B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Car Parks Company (Amakin) B.S.C. provides parking solutions in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through Car Park Services; Property Rentals Services; Investment and Related Services; and Sales of Equipment and Related Services segments. The company provides car park management services; parking management systems and solutions including installation and maintenance; and property leasing services. It also engages in the sale and trading of machinery equipment and parts; marketing and promotion activities; electrical installation; real estate activities with its own and leased properties; publicity and advertising; general trade; and valet parking activities. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Marshall Monteagle PLC
Description: Marshall Monteagle PLC an investment holding company engages in the import and distribution and property holding businesses in the United Kingdom South Africa Europe and internationally. It operates through Import and Distribution; Property; and Other Activities segments. The company owns and manages multi-tenanted rent producing properties; and imports exports distributes and trades in non-perishable products such as food food ingredients household consumer products metal and minerals manufacturing inputs hand tools and machinery. It also offers logistics and procurement services; trades in various hard and soft commodities industrial raw materials consumer food and non-food products; and invests in equities. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Saint Helier Jersey.

Name: Cairo for Housing and Development Company (S.A.E)
Description: Cairo for Housing and Development Company (S.A.E) engages in the development sale and lease of real estate properties in Egypt. It is also involved in design and engineering consultancy work and supervising services. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Cairo Egypt. Cairo for Housing and Development Company (S.A.E) is a subsidiary of Pioneers Properties for Urban Development Company (S.A.E.).

Name: Kingston Properties Limited
Description: Kingston Properties Limited together with its subsidiary Carlton Savannah REIT (St. Lucia) Limited engages in the investment and ownership of real estate properties in Jamaica. It holds interests in seven units in the Carlton Savannah Hotel in Trinidad. The company was formerly known as Carlton Savannah REIT (Jamaica) Limited and changed its name to Kingston Properties Limited in October 2009. Kingston Properties Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Alexandria Flour Mills
Description: Alexandria Flour Mills processes manufactures packages imports distributes stores fumigates maintains exports in grain and related products. The company provides flour; bread; pasta such as mind pen tooth spaghetti and sparrow tongue pasta; dough; syrups; halva; biscuits; and other foodstuff as well as feed and its components including yeasts and ice. It is also involved in printing and manufacturing of tin container; produces and supplies packaging - capital equipment spare parts; couscous production; real estate investment services; and provision of freezing storage facility. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt. Alexandria Flour Mills is a subsidiary of Holding Company for Food Industries.

Name: Arab Moltaqa Investments Company
Description: Arab Moltaqa Investments Company is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in startups matured growth capital and follows Sharia Compliance investments. The firm prefers to invest in industrial and agricultural investments land reclamation and cultivation livestock development fisheries real estate investments and tourism poultry pharmaceutical and health care. The firm prefers to invest in Middle East and North African region. Arab Moltaqa Investments Company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: ASEC Company for Mining ASCOM S.A.E
Description: ASEC Company for Mining ASCOM S.A.E. operates as a geology mining and manufacturing company in Egypt. The company offers glass sand gypsum and calcium carbonate. It also provides geological and geotechnical investigation geophysical study survey and drilling work mining planning quarry management and blasting services. In addition the company supplies raw materials such as gypsum glass sand gravel and limestone. Further it engages in the geology and mining and glass and rock wool production activities; and exploration and exploitation of precious metals such as gold silver and copper in East Africa. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Eternit S.A.
Description: Eternit S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in roofing and industrialized construction business in China. The company offers cement concrete and solar tile products as well as other construction materials and accessories. It also provides fiber cement and concrete tiles for roofing; panels for drywall; steel frame systems; and raw materials for the manufacture of cement tiles and panels. In addition the company explores and process chrysotile mineral fiber. Eternit S.A. was founded in 1940 and is based in Manaus Brazil.

Name: Compañía de Empaques S.A.
Description: Compañía de Empaques S.A. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells natural fibers and plastic products in Colombia Ecuador and Mexico. The company offers packaging and packing products comprising polypropylene and fique sacks flexible stowage cartonplast mesh packaging agricultural and advertising bags and bigbags; duramalla products consisting of geomesh veneer bird exclusion anti-insects strainer enclosure square diamond chicken coop protection signage plant support and rockshield; duratela products such as shade fique fabrics enclosure harvester anti-weeds anti-hail windbreaker and geotextiles; and duracordel products including monofilament and fique ropes braids fique and PP yarn fique and PP yarn balls and PP ropes. It also provides Durazuncho a polyproylene clamp tape for securing packages and classifying goods; cartonplast products comprising boxes singleface cartonplast flexible stowage and sheets; concrefuerte products; and short- and long-term erosion control blankets. In addition the company engages in production export and import of synthetic metallic and non-metallic fibers and materials; packaging solutions for paints resins and raw materials; and financial and administrative advisory services. Further it is involved in the acquisition distribution and disposal of raw materials and equipment products surpluses and by-products of the textile and plastic industries. The company serves the packaging agricultural construction and infrastructure and biosolution industries. Compañía de Empaques S.A. was incorporated in 1938 and is headquartered in Itagui Colombia.

Name: Philadelphia Int'l Educational Investment Company (PLC)
Description: Philadelphia Int'l Educational Investment Company (PLC) operates as an academic institution under the Philadelphia University in Jordan. Its faculty of business specializes in accounting banking and finance business administration and hospital management; and faculty of arts and educational sciences specializes in Arabic language and literature English language and literature humanities counseling psychology and Chinese language and literature. The company’s faculty of engineering and technology offers electrical communications and electronics mechatronics mechanical civil renewable energy and alternative energy technology engineering; and faculty of information technology engages in computer science information security and cyber security data science and artificial intelligence and software engineering. In addition it specializes in the faculties of law pharmacy and nursing; faculty of allied medical sciences which includes physiotherapy and clinical nutrition and dietetics; and faculty of science that covers biotechnology and genetic engineering mathematics and scientific basic sciences. Further the company provides deanships in scientific research and graduate studies student affairs and quality assurance and accreditation. Additionally it operates e-learning computer development and training health Jordan innovation Philadelphia cyber security and scientific consultancy centers as well as provides TIES program; and offers centers for water environment and dead sea studies. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Al Faleh Educational Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: Al Faleh Educational Holding Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries provides educational services in Qatar. It operates kindergarten primary preparatory and secondary schools under the Doha Academy and Doha International Kindergarten names as well as a college under the AFG College name that provides university education. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Fertilizantes Heringer S.A.
Description: Fertilizantes Heringer S.A. engages in the industrialization and commercialization of fertilizers in Brazil. It operates storage mixing and distribution units. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Fertilizantes Heringer S.A. operated as a subsidiary of Eurochem Comercio de Produtos Quimicos Ltda.

Name: INMA Holding Company Q.P.S.C.
Description: INMA Holding Company Q.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries invests in shares and bonds; and provides brokerage services in Qatar. It operates through three segments: Brokerage Real Estate and Others. The company offers financial brokerage services to customers. It also provides property management marketing and sales services for real estate. The company was formerly known as Islamic Holding Group (Q.P.S.C). INMA Holding Company Q.P.S.C. was founded in 2003 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Concrete Fashion Group For Commercial and Industrial investments S.A.E
Description: Concrete Fashion Group For Commercial and Industrial investments S.A.E retails and wholesales textile and apparel in Egypt. The company offers fused jackets trousers coats 2 and 3 piece suits casual woven bottom and shirts under the Concrete and Euromed brand names. It also involved in provision of financial and management consultancy and technical and management support services; investing in local and foreign companies; and participating in restructuring activities. It also exports its products in Egypt Italy the United States and other European countries. Concrete Fashion Group For Commercial and Industrial investments S.A.E was founded in 1907 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Bogotá S.A. E.S.P.
Description: Empresa de Telecomunicaciones de Bogotá S.A. E.S.P. operates as a telecommunication network company in Colombia. It is involved in the provision of service local telephone long distance and value added including internet and broadband services; mobile carrier interconnection transport and connectivity public telephony satellite and telephony services; and television services. The company was founded in 1884 and is based in Bogotá Colombia.

Name: TC S.A.
Description: TC S.A. operates an investor community. The company’s platform offers market intelligence including analysis production of news and information for users investment ideas and sell side reports. It also offers financial education and data analysis comprising mathematical statistical and computational models that help investors in the decision-making process as well as provides educational courses workshops books videos competitions and articles to develop the necessary knowledge for those who already invest or want to start investing. In addition the company offers third-party asset management services. The company was formerly known as TC Traders Club S.A. and changed its name to TC S.A. in December 2022. TC S.A. was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Safa Bank
Description: Safa Bank offers various Islamic banking products and services. It provides savings current and custom investment accounts; home car and commodity finance; money transfer and electronic cards services; and other services to individual customers. The company also offers foreign trade; contractual financing for infrastructure projects residential and commercial complexes hospitals facilities and public utilities and other projects; bank guarantee; and other products and services for corporate clients. In addition it offers online and electronic banking services. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Ramallah Palestinian Authority. Safa Bank is a subsidiary of Cairo Amman Bank.

Name: Aeris Indústria e Comércio de Equipamentos para Geração de Energia S.A.
Description: Aeris Indústria e Comércio de Equipamentos para Geração de Energia S.A. manufactures wind blades in Brazil. It also repairs paintings cleaning preventive and corrective maintenance engineering and inspections of all blade models and other wind components photographic inspection services for wind turbines fiber components and towers. In addition it provides blade life extension. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Caucaia Brazil.

Name: Oman Chlorine S.A.O.G.
Description: Oman Chlorine S.A.O.G. together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells industrial chemicals in the Sultanate of Oman. It provides hydrochloric acid for activation of petroleum process water treatment food processing manufacture of chlorine dioxide catalyst in organic process removal of heavy metals from carbon black and activated carbon leaching alumina from crystalline zeolites hydrolyzing agent and pickling in metal industries. The company also offers caustic soda flakes and lye products for use in pulp and paper textile soap and detergent aluminum metal chemical process water treatment and bleach manufacturing industries as well as in petroleum products. In addition it provides sodium hypochlorite which is used in bleaching stain removal disinfection/sanitation deodorizing and water treatment industries; and calcium chloride anhydrous granules that is used in petroleum drilling and extraction as well as a raw material for chemical industries and a deicing agent. Further the company manufactures chlorine; and engages in the investment activities. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Future Kid Entertainment and Real Estate Company K.P.S.C.
Description: Future Kid Entertainment and Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the entertainment business in Kuwait and Gulf Cooperation Council Countries. It is also involved in real estate business; and operates gaming centers. The company was formerly known as Unique Kid Entertainment Company K.S.C.C. Future Kid Entertainment and Real Estate Company K.P.S.C. was founded in 1987 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Future Energy Source Company Limited
Description: Future Energy Source Company Limited engages in the retail and wholesale trading of petroleum and automotive products in Jamaica. It operates in two segments Wholesale and Retail Distribution of Fuel; and Distribution of Liquefied Petroleum Gas. The company offers petroleum products including gasoline diesel ultralow sulfur asphalt and heavy fuel oil; mineral synthetic gear and two cycle land and marine oil; transmission fluid; oil-based coolant coolant windshield wash fluid and deionized water; and E10 87 octane E10 90 octane automotive diesel oil ultra-low sulphur diesel and lubricants. It also operates LPG plants; and owns operates and leases service station as well as leases fuel equipment. The company distributes its products to commercial customers including manufacturing construction and transportation industries; and retail customers through its network of service stations. Future Energy Source Company Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Bindar for Islamic Finance Company
Description: Bindar for Islamic Finance Company together with its subsidiaries engages in financing vehicles real estate consumer durables medium and small projects and medical and industrial equipment in Jordan. The company offers personal loans; business loans; invoice financing; and finances consumer durables such as cars vehicles furniture electrical appliances and kitchen products. It also engages in financing lands buildings constructions and contractors as well as selling land and real estate properties; and offers vehicle murabaha. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Amman Jordan. The company was formerly known as Bindar Trading and Investment Company and changed its name to Bindar for Islamic Finance Company in June 2025. Bindar for Islamic Finance Company is a subsidiary of Tamkeen Leasing Company.

Name: Stefanutti Stocks Holdings Limited
Description: Stefanutti Stocks Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries operates as a construction company in South Africa and sub-Saharan Africa. It engages in the building; civils and geotechnical; roads earthworks mining infrastructure and renewable energy infrastructure; materials handling and tailings management; mechanical electrical piping; and oil and gas works as well as general contracting services. The company was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Kempton Park South Africa.

Name: Bosques Amazónicos S.A.
Description: Bosques Amazónicos S.A. a forestry company that engages in afforestation or reforestation activities in Peru. Its activities include the provision of financing for the conservation of Amazonian ecosystems and restoration of degraded lands through investment in commercial forestry plantations; maintenance of plantations in contiguous titled lands and residual forests; and sale of carbon credits. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Pucallpa Peru. Bosques Amazónicos S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Bosques Amazónicos SFM S.A.

Name: Palms Agro Production Company K.S.C.P
Description: Palms Agro Production Company K.S.C.P engages in import and export business of agricultural supplies in Kuwait. It operates through Commercial Projects and Investment segments. The commercial segment offers production and sale of nurseries and ornamental plants. The projects segment engages in gardening and maintenance services. The investments segment provides investment in an associate equity securities term deposit and shot-term deposit. It engages in establishment and management of various nurseries and farms reclamation and development of agricultural land landscape gardening and ornamentation of public places and cities. It also provides import and circulation of veterinary medicines; operates veterinary clinics and centres; and breeds and trades in chicken and eggs as well as undertakes agricultural and construction contracts works. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Palms Agro Production Company K.S.C.P is a subsidiary of Bayan Holding Company K.S.C.

Name: Sygnus Credit Investments Limited
Description: Sygnus Credit Investments Limited a specialty credit investment company provides non-traditional debt financing to medium-sized firms in the Caribbean region. The company invests in private credit instruments including bilateral notes and bonds preference shares asset-backed debt mezzanine debt convertible debt and other forms of structured private credit instruments. It also provides finance raising and alternative investment platform services. The company serves manufacturing distribution financial services energy real estate transportation and infrastructure sectors in Puerto Rico Jamaica Bahamas Barbados Aruba and internationally. Sygnus Credit Investments Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Castries Saint Lucia.

Name: Infracommerce CXaaS S.A.
Description: Infracommerce CXaaS S.A. provides digital solutions for various brands and industries in Brazil Mexico Colombia Peru Chile Argentina Uruguay and Latin America. It offers e-commerce platforms for B2C and B2B e-commerce operation services and customer relationship management. The company operates infra.digital infra.shop infra.data infra.pay and infra.log. It provides omnichannel technology used in artificial and data intelligence payment and credit solutions and logistics. Infracommerce CXaaS S.A. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Agrometal S.A.I.
Description: Agrometal S.A.I. engages in the production and sale of agricultural machinery in Argentina and internationally. The company provides coarse grain planters comprising TX MEGA GEN 3 TX PIVOT 2 and APX SEED PRO; ADX and FX fine grain planters; and ADX Magna and MX Max multipurpose planters as well as DX Pro multi-seed meters TWIN FORCE double chamber actuator and monitors for planting security of crops. It operates through a network of dealers. The company was formerly known as Agrometal S.R.L and changed its name to Agrometal S.A.I. in 1957. Agrometal S.A.I. was founded in 1950 and is based in Monte Maíz Argentina.

Name: Hulamin Limited
Description: Hulamin Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of rolled and extruded aluminum products in South Africa North America Europe Asia the Middle East Australasia South America and rest of Africa. The company operates through two segments Hulamin Rolled Products and Hulamin Extrusions. The Hulamin Rolled Products segment offers aluminum sheets plates and foil products. This segment also manufactures and supplies fabricated and rolled semi-finished aluminum products as well as aluminum foil containers and related products. The Hulamin Extrusions segment manufactures and supplies extruded aluminum products. It serves automotive building electrical general engineering packaging renewable energy and transport industries. The company was formerly known as Hulett Aluminium (Pty) Limited and changed its name to Hulamin Limited in 2007. Hulamin Limited was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Pietermaritzburg South Africa.

Name: Lecico Egypt (S.A.E.)
Description: Lecico Egypt (S.A.E.) produces and sells sanitary ware products and various tiles in Egypt and Lebanon. The company’s products include bathroom suites toilets washbasins and bidets and urinals; and squatting pan shower trays kitchen sink and taps as well as other complementary products. It also provides financial leasing services. It also exports its products. It sells its products to residential water serving hospitality hospitals/healthcare ageing/less-abled schools public spaces and space living sectors. Lecico Egypt (S.A.E.) was founded in 1959 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A.
Description: d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A. engages in the retail sale of pharmaceutical and perfumery products in Brazil. It also sells generic drugs and hygiene and beauty products. The company was formerly known as Cancun RJ Participações S/A and changed its name to d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A. in March 2016. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Rio De Janeiro Brazil. d1000 Varejo Farma Participações S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos S.A.

Name: Naeem Holding Company For Investments (S.A.E - Free Zone)
Description: Naeem Holding Company For Investments (S.A.E - Free Zone) provides various financial services in the Middle East and North Africa region. It offers asset management services to institutions high net-worth individuals and retail clients; and brokerage services that include margin trading online trading and DMA custody and book-keeping services equity analysis macroeconomic analysis and technical analysis. The company also provides investment banking services such as initial public offering private placement mergers and acquisitions debt placements and Islamic finance advisory services; and trades in gold. In addition it offers fundamental and technical research; real estate investment financing and asset management; and consulting services. Further the company is involved in manufacturing tourism investment investment fund financial securities investment and commodities trading activities. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Trust International Insurance Co. P.L.C
Description: Trust International Insurance Co. P.L.C engages in providing insurance and re-insurance products worldwide. The company offers motor health and life insurance products and services.
