It also provides general insurance including fire and allied perils workmen’s compensation employer’s liability householder’s comprehensive public liability contractors all risks marine money fidelity guarantee travel personal accident contractors plant and machinery machinery breakdown erection all risks professional indemnity loss of profits caused by fire product liability electronic equipment deterioration of stock bankers blanket bond glass breakage and medical malpractice insurance. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: Raysut Cement Company SAOG
Description: Raysut Cement Company SAOG engages in the production and sale of cement in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers ordinary Portland cement for plain and reinforced cement concrete works brick and stone masonry plastering and flooring; sulfate resistant cement for concrete applications such as general purpose ready-mix and pre-cast concrete plaster mortars for use in brick and block-works screeds concrete blocks etc.; and oil well cement for cementing work in the drilling of oil wells. It also provides ground granulated blast furnace slag and Pozzolana well cement for cementing shallow oil wells. In addition the company is involved in the transport shipping and limestone quarry; wholesale of cement and plastic; and other trading activities. It also exports its products to Yemen Maldives and Eastern Africa. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Salalah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Al Kamil Power Company SAOG
Description: Al Kamil Power Company SAOG operates as an independent power generation company in the Sultanate of Oman. It builds and operates an electricity generating station at Al Kamil in the Sharqiya region. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: United Financial Investments Company
Description: United Financial Investments Company provides financial services in Jordan. The company offers administrative and consultation services on investment portfolios; and agency or financial consultancy services. It also invests in securities and performs feasibility studies. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. United Financial Investments Company operates as a subsidiary of Jordan Kuwait Bank.

Name: Perubar SA
Description: Perubar SA provides storage and shipping services of mineral concentrates in Peru. The company is involved in the rental of warehouses related business. Perubar SA was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Lima Peru. The company operates as a subsidiary of Glencore Minera A.G.

Name: Stroc Industrie S.A.
Description: Stroc Industrie S.A. operates as an engineering and construction company in Morocco. The company constructs storage and processing units for liquid or gaseous products; bulk product handling and processing facilities; and industrial logistics and tertiary buildings as well as designs and manufactures boiler equipment including belt conveyors hoppers and silos storage and retrieval machines screening stations grinding stations slag heap machines flat bottom bins high pressure storage sphere and other sheet metal elements and piping works. It also provides basic and detailed engineering project management coordination and subcontracting management supply management site installation civil engineering maintenance and improvements startup operator training roofing and building envelope work and electricity plumbing air conditioning high and low current fire detection services. The company serves various customers in the oil gas and petrochemicals mining cement and chemicals infrastructure and buildings and works sectors. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Stroc Industrie S.A. is a subsidiary of AL Istimrar Holding SA.

Name: Mustek Limited
Description: Mustek Limited engages in the procurement assembly distribution and servicing of computers computer components peripherals and related products in South Africa East Africa and Taiwan. It operates through Mustek Rectron and Mecer Inter-Ed segments. The company offers cloud and software solutions; managed cybersecurity and compliance services; accredited training programs; and networking and infrastructure products. It also engages in investments in associates and other investments and loans. Mustek Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Macro Group Pharmaceuticals (Macro Capital) S.A.E
Description: Macro Group Pharmaceuticals (Macro Capital) S.A.E operates as a cosmeceuticals manufacturing company in Egypt and internationally. It engages in the production of pharmaceutical and cosmetic products such as skin care hair care oral care female intimate care anti-scar antiseptics and topical muscle relaxants as well as flavors colors and scents. The company also manufactures solid and liquid soap herbal medicines products and extracts nutritional supplements baby food and special food products. It also offers its products online. In addition the company operates printing press and produces advertising and packing materials as well as sells nutraceutical products. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: São Paulo Turismo S.A.
Description: São Paulo Turismo S.A. operates as a tourism and events company in Latin America. The company operates exhibitions fairs small medium and large-scale events carnival and congresses. It is also involved in business structuring activity. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: G2D Investments Ltd.
Description: G2D Investments Ltd. an investment company invests in technology companies in Brazil the United States and Europe. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Hamilton Bermuda. G2D Investments Ltd. is a subsidiary of GP Investments Ltd.

Name: Arabia Cotton Ginning Company
Description: Arabia Cotton Ginning Company operates in the textiles and clothing industry in Egypt. It is also involved in the real estate activities. The company was founded in 1963 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Creditex S.A.A.
Description: Creditex S.A.A. operates as a textile company in Peru. It offers combed and carded pima tangüis and upland cotton as well as organic yarns. The company also produces fine cotton fabrics for shirts sport clothing trousers and decorations as well as manufactures woven apparels. In addition it operates various retail points of sale outlets under the M.bö Norman & Taylor and Marc Boehler names. The company also exports its products. Creditex S.A.A. is based in Lima Peru. Creditex S.A.A. is a subsidiary of Corporación Cervesur S.A.A.

Name: Carlos Casado S.A.
Description: Carlos Casado S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates as an agricultural company in Latin America. The company is involved in the real estate construction and development; development and operation of land; production of soybean and corn; and livestock and breeding activities. The company was founded in 1883 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Al TAS-Heelat Jordan Specialized Financing
Description: Al TAS-Heelat Jordan Specialized Financing provides lending services to consumers and small and medium enterprises. The company offers personal loans; private vehicle and public transportation vehicle loans; commercial loans; and housing and land mortgage loans. It also provides real estate financing; project financing and financial leasing using the Murabaha method in accordance with the provisions of Islamic Sharia; issues debit and credit cards as well as personal cards; and obtains guarantees and bank credits. The company was formerly known as Jordan Trade Facilities Company and changed its name to Al TAS-Heelat Jordan Specialized Financing in March 2025. Al TAS-Heelat Jordan Specialized Financing was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Al TAS-Heelat Jordan Specialized Financing operates as a subsidiary of Tamkeen Leasing Company.

Name: Adcorp Holdings Limited
Description: Adcorp Holdings Limited provides workforce solutions in South Africa and Australia. The company operates through Contingent Staffing Professional Services Staffing Solutions and Business Support segments. The Contingent Staffing segment offers industrial contingent staffing solutions to the blue-collar and healthcare personnel. The Staffing Solutions segment offers productivity and process efficiencies services to FMCG warehousing telecommunications and logistics sectors as well as offers niche industrial and office cleaning services. The Professional Services segment provides ICT personnel resourcing project management temporary and permanent placement services. The Business Support segment offers finance human resources payroll IT legal risk compliance and marketing services. Adcorp Holdings Limited was founded in 1968 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Energía Latina S.A.
Description: Energía Latina S.A. engages in the generation and sale of electricity in Chile. It operates energy storage solutions and supplies solar energy; asset management services including real-time monitoring data analysis reporting and active management; and distribution and generation of renewable energy. Energía Latina S.A. was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Vitacura Chile.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Compania de Electricidad de Tulua S.A. E.S.P.
Description: Compania de Electricidad de Tulua S.A. E.S.P. engages in the generation transmission distribution and sale of electric power in Colombia Panama Costa Rica and Honduras. The company owns and operates hydroelectric thermal solar and wind power plants with an installed capacity of approximately 1810 MW. It serves residential customers. The company was incorporated in 1920 and is headquartered in Tuluá Colombia. Compania de Electricidad de Tulua S.A. E.S.P. is a subsidiary of Celsia Colombia S.A. E.S.P.

Name: The Islamic Insurance Company
Description: The Islamic Insurance Company provides general and life insurance products and services in Jordan. It offers fire and perils medical expense motor marine life personal accident workers compensation liability comprehensive householder engineering contractors’ plant and machineries electronic equipment travel and plate glass insurance products as well as bankers blanket bond insurance program. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: East Delta Flour Mills
Description: East Delta Flour Mills engages in the manufacture trade import storage fumigation maintenance packaging processing transportation and distribution of grains and its related products and substitutes. It provides various baked goods pasta pasta foodstuffs fodder and its components yeasts ice and cooling and freezing products. East Delta Flour Mills is based in Zagazig Egypt.

Name: Société Immobilière Balima
Description: Société Immobilière Balima engages in activities related to acquisition sale resale rental management exchange of urban buildings and construction of buildings in Morocco. The company was founded in 1928 and is based in Rabat Morocco.

Name: Liberty Kenya Holdings Plc
Description: Liberty Kenya Holdings Plc an investment holding company engages in the provision of insurance and wealth management services to the retail and corporate markets in Kenya and Tanzania. The company provides life insurance annuities medical fire motor liability and personal accident as well as engineering workmen’s compensation marine and aviation theft agriculture bonds goods in transit and glass insurance products. It offers administration and asset management services; and investment retirement life and education solutions to individuals and businesses. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. Liberty Kenya Holdings Plc is a subsidiary of Liberty Holdings Limited.

Name: Bicicletas Monark S.A.
Description: Bicicletas Monark S.A. manufactures and sells bicycles in Brazil. The company offers steel aluminum transport line ride line and a children's line BMX BRISA and KIDS models. Bicicletas Monark S.A. was formerly known as Monark Indústria e Comércio Ltda. The company was founded in 1948 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. Bicicletas Monark S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Monark Participações Ltda.

Name: REAG Investimentos S.A.
Description: REAG Investimentos S.A. operates an online platform that connects professionals with seeking quotes and hire services in Brazil. The company engages in the provision of services for the development and creation of electronic pages; maintenance of portals and content providers; and provision of other information technology services related to the internet. It also provides advertisement of pages and services on the internet; enables the return of positive search results for web pages; and develops search selection and filtering algorithms. REAG Investimentos S.A. is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Gas Natural del Oriente S.A. ESP
Description: Gas Natural del Oriente S.A. ESP commercializes transports and distributes fuel gas in Colombia. It also engages in the exploration exploitation storage use transport refining purchase sale and distribution of hydrocarbons and their derivatives. In addition the company provides engineering advisory construction auditing manufacturing and consulting work related services to hydrocarbons. Further it constructs operates and maintains gas pipelines for public and private use. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Bucaramanga Colombia. Gas Natural del Oriente S.A. ESP is a subsidiary of Vanti S.A. ESP.

Name: Caja Rural de Ahorro y Crédito Los Andes S.A.
Description: Caja Rural de Ahorro y Crédito Los Andes S.A. provides banking products and services. The company offers fixed term and normal savings products. It also offers credits for water personal group construction agriculture and SME. In addition the company provides SOAT insurance products. Caja Rural de Ahorro y Crédito Los Andes S.A. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Puno Peru. Caja Rural de Ahorro y Crédito Los Andes S.A. is a subsidiary of Creation Investments Andes LLC.

Name: The Energy House Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: The Energy House Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries operates as an energy investment holding company in the Middle East and North Africa. It operates through two segments Energy and Others. The company engages in the exploration drilling development and production of oil and gas and alternate and renewable sources of energy; and licensing and other activities related to the energy sector as well as investment and other related services. It also provides financial services. The company was formerly known as AREF Energy Holding Company KSCC. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. The Energy House Holding Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Development Enterprises Holding Company K.S.C.

Name: Compañía Anónima Nacional Teléfonos de Venezuela
Description: Compañía Anónima Nacional Teléfonos de Venezuela provides telecommunications services to the communities sectors and institutions in Venezuela. It offers integrated telecommunications solutions to meet the needs of its customers in fixed telephone mobile telephony satellite television data and Internet access services as well as IT services including webhosting data networks database hosting dedicated hosting data center and on demand storage services. The company was founded in 1930 and is based in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Neogrid Participações S.A.
Description: Neogrid Participações S.A. together with its subsidiaries develops licenses sells and implements customized software for supply chain management and synchronization worldwide. The company also provides related technical advisory and training services. In addition it offers software and databases installation configuration and maintenance services as well as technical IT support services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Joinville Brazil.

Name: Skyline Investments Inc.
Description: Skyline Investments Inc. develops and operates real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Skyline International Development Inc. Skyline Investments Inc. was founded in 1998 and is based in Toronto Canada with an additional office in Israel.

Name: Nutun Limited
Description: Nutun Limited through its subsidiary Nutun Holdings Proprietary Limited provides business process outsourcing solutions (BPO) in South Africa Australia the United Kingdom and the United States. The company offers customer experience and credit lifecycle BPO solutions; and inbound and outbound call center services. The company was formerly known as Transaction Capital Limited and changed its name to Nutun Limited in March 2025. Nutun Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Sandton South Africa.

Name: enX Group Limited
Description: enX Group Limited engages in the diverse businesses in the general industrial sector in South Africa. The company operates through enX Lubricants enX Chemicals and enX Power segment. The enX Lubricants segment produces and markets oil lubricants and greases as well as distributes lubricants under the ExxonMobil brand name and fluids solutions and services. The enX Chemicals segment imports warehouses and distributes a range of virgin polyolefins and styrenics synthetic rubber natural rubber fillers engineered carbons rubber chemicals phenolic resins conveyor belting steel cord conveyor belting fabric desiccants and dunnage bags. The enX Power segment designs manufacturers installs rents and maintains diesel generators; and distributes industrial engines. It offers power through solar hybrid and grid alternatives; renewable energy solutions preventative maintenance refuelling and remote monitoring as well as supplies and rents parts. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Jordan Decapolis Properties
Description: Jordan Dubai Properties is a real estate investment firm. The firm specializes in investments in real estate and tourism sectors. It focuses on real estate asset management land development and investments in real estate as well as in program project property and facility management. The firm also operates as commercial property developer and asset manager. It primarily concentrates on all activities within the Kingdom of Jordan. Jordan Dubai Properties was founded in 1982 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Nass Corporation BSC
Description: Nass Corporation BSC engages in the civil engineering business in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates in two divisions Construction and Allied Activities; and Trading Activities. The company constructs industrial structures infrastructure development projects pipelines roads villas office blocks warehouses and other commercial buildings; and bridges jetties and quay walls and dredging as well as undertakes land reclamation and shore protection works. It also engages in shutdown and maintenance projects EPC of packaged units general plant construction and heavy engineering and process equipment manufacturing as well as refractory and insulation and industrial painting projects. In addition the company undertakes electrical and instrumentation contracts; offers services in the field of landscape construction maintenance and horticulture; and provides ready-mixed concrete and precast products. Further it provides scaffolding and formwork services; supplies ice and sweet water and washed building sand; imports and sells frozen food products; and operates as a dealer for international brands offering sales distribution spare parts and after-sales services. Additionally the company is involved in the provision of landscaping asphalting and plumbing services; rental of heavy equipment; and supply of manpower to related contracting activities. It also engages in sand mining dredging reclamation seabed safeguarding and marine construction and transportation activities; and mechanical fabrication and maintenance business. The company was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: East African Portland Cement PLC
Description: East African Portland Cement PLC manufactures and sells cement in East Africa. It provides ordinary Portland cement and Pozzolanic Portland cement products; and paving blocks. The company offers its products under the Blue Triangle Cement and Green Triangle Cement brands. The company was incorporated in 1933 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Kuwait Hotels Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Kuwait Hotels Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries owns operates and manages hotels in Kuwait Oman Qatar Syria and Egypt. It operates through Hotel Management; and Manpower Supply segments. The company offers buys and sells resorts land and real estate; manages and owns owned and rented properties; develops and manages land and properties; hotel; restaurant; and resort services. It also provides catering services; manages restaurant public facilities and food services; general cleaning services for buildings; and invests in properties. Kuwait Hotels Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Development & Engineering Consultants
Description: Development & Engineering Consultants plans designs and researches and implements construction projects. The company undertakes contracting works; and provides site management services as well as invests in real estate properties. Development & Engineering Consultants was founded in 1954 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Hayat Pharmaceutical Industries Co. PLC
Description: Hayat Pharmaceutical Industries Co. PLC engages in the manufacture and marketing of generic pharmaceutical products in Jordan. It offers products in various therapeutic areas such as allergies; cardiovascular system; dermatology; gastrointestinal system; infectious disease; inner ear and balance; neurology; pain and inflammation; respiratory system; and vitamins and supplements as well as men’s and women’s health products. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Gulf Franchising Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Gulf Franchising Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) together with its subsidiaries provides food catering services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It operates through Investment Trading and Food Catering segments. The company provides computer programming and operations general trading consultancy and food catering services as well as engages in the utilization of franchising and property ownership and investment activities. Gulf Franchising Holding Company - K.S.C. (Public) was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: General Accident Insurance Company Jamaica Limited
Description: General Accident Insurance Company Jamaica Limited a general insurance company provides underwriting services for commercial personal property and casualty insurance products in Jamaica Trinidad and Tobago and Barbados. It operates through Motor; Fire and Allied Perils; Marine; Liability; Engineering and Machinery Breakdown; and Miscellaneous Accidents segments. The company covers loss of motor vehicles including liabilities to third parties; loss damage and destruction of residential and commercial properties due to fire and allied perils burglary theft and accidental damage; loss or damage of goods from sea and other perils while in transit by sea air or land and from warehouse to warehouse; accidental bodily injury and death due to liability; and loss or damage of equipment by fire burglary theft accidental damage and electrical and mechanical breakdown. It also offers miscellaneous accident insurance comprising fidelity guarantee goods in transit loss of money plate glass personal accident and burglary. In addition the company provides car seat coverage; home-owners commercial all risks and consequential loss/business interruption; travel; public products and employers liability; director and officers liability; equipment contractors and computer all risk; tender/bid performance and mobilization bond; and marine cargo insurance. General Accident Insurance Company Jamaica Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. General Accident Insurance Company Jamaica Limited is a subsidiary of Musson (Jamaica) Limited.

Name: Qatar Cinema and Film Distribution Co. (Q.P.S.C)
Description: Qatar Cinema and Film Distribution Co. (Q.P.S.C) engages in the distribution of cinema films and videos in Qatar. The company operates through Real Estate Cinema and Other Investments segments. It also trades in television films and programs commercial advertisement and tools for the operation of cinema and projectors. In addition the company operates movie theaters and cafeterias for cinemas; and invests in shares bonds funds and real estate investments. Qatar Cinema and Film Distribution Co. (Q.P.S.C) was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Doha Qatar.

Name: Bahrain Cinema Company B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Cinema Company B.S.C. together its subsidiaries engages in screening films in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through Theatre Operations Restaurants and Concession Counters and Rental and Others segments. The company also engages in the restaurant operations and go-karting business; advertisement activities; real estate activities with own/leased properties; sale and trade of furniture and various household articles; and sale/trade in other machinery equipment and parts. In addition it provides leisure and amusement related services. The company was formerly known as Bahrain Cinema and Films Distribution Company and changed its name to Bahrain Cinema Company B.S.C. in 1976. Bahrain Cinema Company B.S.C. was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc
Description: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc operates as a derivatives exchange of Kenya. The company operates through two segments Cash Equities and Interest Rate Market and Derivatives Market. It offers equities bonds exchange traded funds real estate investment trusts derivatives data and training services as well as operates a digital academy. The company also provides a platform for the issuance holding trading and settlement of securities of unquoted companies under the Unquoted Securities Platform name; and Ibuka an incubation and acceleration program to support companies to reach their next stage of growth. In addition it offers clearing and settlement services for transactions in derivative securities whether carried out on or off a securities exchange as well as engages in mobile and online trading. The company was incorporated in 1921 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Chemical and Allied Products Plc
Description: Chemical and Allied Products Plc manufactures and sells paints and coatings in Nigeria. The company offers decorative and industrial coatings; indoor outdoor specialty and protective coatings; primers; and other products. It sells its products under the Dulux Regular Dulux Trade Caplux Sandtex and Hempel brands. The company distributes its products through Dulux colour stores Dulux colour shops and Sandtex stores. The company was founded in 1957 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. Chemical and Allied Products Plc is a subsidiary of UAC of Nigeria PLC.

Name: Al Maha Ceramics SAOG
Description: Al Maha Ceramics SAOG manufactures and sells wall and flooring ceramic tiles in the Sultanate of Oman GCC countries and internationally. It offers glazed wall floor and border and highlighter tiles in various designs and shades under the Digiplus Diamond Edge Barid iProtect and Antislip brands. The company also exports its products to the United Arab Emirates Saudi Arabia Qatar Bahrain Jordan Syria Lebanon Africa Somalia Ethiopia and South Asia. Al Maha Ceramics SAOG was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Sohar Oman.

Name: Trust Bank Limited
Description: Trust Bank Limited together with its subsidiaries provides commercial banking products and services in the Gambia. It offers current savings and corporate and foreign currency accounts; and time/fixed deposits. The company also provides building loans/mortgage car loan personal loan and overdraft; real time gross settlement; automated clearing house; trust alerts and exchange rates as well as cheque discounting banker’s indemnity and bank guarantees; and ATM online and mobile banking. In addition it offers foreign currency purchase and sale currency notes shipments documentary letters of credit and collections and SWIFT transfers. Further the company is involved in the dealing of financial instruments of the money market in the Gambia; management of clients’ receivables and securities on clients’ accounts including consulting services; banking information; and mortgage activities. Trust Bank Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Banjul the Gambia.

Name: Raya Customer Experience
Description: Raya Customer Experience operates as a business process outsourcing (BPO) and contact center outsourcing company. It offers CX management solutions including customer services technical support collections cross selling and upselling customer acquisition customer retention back office and CX advisory services. The company also provides digital solutions such as robotic process automation data analytics omnichannel and Al- chatbots; call central seat rental solutions; and human resources outsourcing services. The company serves retail and ecommerce automotive banking services FMCG games healthcare travel and leisure white goods media and communication and government service industries. The company was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Raya Customer Experience is a subsidiary of Raya Holding Company for Financial Investments (S.A.E).

Name: Jordan Loan Guarantee Corp.
Description: Jordan Loan Guarantee Corp. provides loan guarantees and credit insurance service in Jordan. The company offers small and medium-sized enterprises financing micro loan guarantees industrial finance guarantees and lease guarantees as well as Islamic financing and entrepreneurial project financing program; and small start-ups guarantee program renewable energy program loan guarantee for Covid-19 pandemic central bank program to guarantee micro and small corporate. It also provides real-estate land purchase and housing loan guarantees as well as export credit guarantee and domestic sales program. Jordan Loan Guarantee Corp. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Wesizwe Platinum Limited
Description: Wesizwe Platinum Limited through its subsidiaries operates as a platinum group metals mining company in South Africa. The company primarily explores for platinum palladium rhodium and gold as well as nickel cobalt and copper deposits. Its flagship project is the Bakubung platinum mine located on the Bushveld Igneous Complex in the North West province of South Africa. Wesizwe Platinum Limited was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Rustenburg South Africa.

Name: Dalqan Real Estate Company K.S.C. (Public)
Description: Dalqan Real Estate Company K.S.C. (Public) engages in the real estate activities in Kuwait and internationally. It invests in and develops real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait. Dalqan Real Estate Company K.S.C. (Public) is a subsidiary of Dalqan Holding Group Company K.S.C.

Name: Grupo IMSA S.A.
Description: Grupo IMSA S.A. engages in the composite materials massive consume pipes and poles and food additives businesses in Columbia and internationally. It manufactures and sells composite materials for use in the civil construction infrastructure wind energy transportation and recreation sectors; personal care home vehicle and industrial products; fiberglass-reinforced polyester piping and pole systems; property management and food additives. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Medellín Colombia.

Name: Molinos Juan Semino S.A.
Description: Molinos Juan Semino S.A. engages in the production and sale of grains and byproducts in Argentina. It offers flours gluten native and modified starches dextrins proteins and pre-mixes. The company’s products are used in the food refrigeration textile paper and other industries. It also exports its products to Brazil Chile Bolivia Uruguay Paraguay Ecuador Peru the United States Japan China Malaysia Taiwan Thailand Hong Kong Saudi Arabia Turkey and Russia. Molinos Juan Semino S.A. was founded in 1865 and is based in Carcarañá Argentina.

Name: Eppley Limited
Description: Eppley Limited is a publicly owned investment manager. It also invests in mutual funds. The firm invests in various credit mezzanine and real estate. The company was formerly known as Orrett and Musson Investment Company Limited. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Knutsford Express Services Limited
Description: Knutsford Express Services Limited together with its subsidiaries provides transportation and courier services in Jamaica. The company offers services comprising local and overseas courier schedule charter coach parish to parish courier online shipping travel points airport shuttle locker and pickup services as well as Courier Plus an online shipment management solution. It also involved in the rental of investment properties; property development and other investment activities; and provision of connections to the international airports. Knutsford Express Services Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Montego Bay Jamaica.

Name: Samad Misr EGYFERT.S.A.E
Description: Samad Misr EGYFERT.S.A.E engages in manufacturing and packaging solid and liquid fertilizers in Egypt. It also trades in fertilizers agricultural chemicals agricultural crops and related raw materials; and manufactures and trades fodder and related raw materials seeds agricultural seeds and compound fertilizers. Samad Misr EGYFERT.S.A.E was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Disty Technologies SA
Description: Disty Technologies SA engages distribution of information technology (IT) products and solutions in Morocco. The company offers desktop and all-in-one personal computers laptops workstations screens and computer accessories. It also offers printers scanners copiers and related accessories as well as provides consumable products such as toners cartridges and other consumables. In addition the company offers servers storage devices switches routers and server and network options; cameras video devices televisions dynamic displays and image and sound accessories; software products comprising Microsoft OEM BOX and Cloud and Autodesk and security related software. Further it provides inverters barcode readers mobile terminals thermal printers video surveillance solutions access control products anti-intrusion devices and other products. Disty Technologies SA was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Dolla Financial Services Limited
Description: Dolla Financial Services Limited offers short-term loans. It operates through Loan operations in Dolla Jamaica; Loan Operations in Dolla Guyana; and Loan Operations from Ultra Financier Limited segments. The company offers business and personal loans. It serves small and medium-sized enterprises employees micro-enterprises entrepreneurs taxi operators bar owners and parents with children or employed students. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Africa Prudential Plc
Description: Africa Prudential Plc provides technology and share registration services to public and private companies in Nigeria. It offers premium share registration services including robust data validation system daily transaction update secured cloud-based operating software clean legacy data robust share portal system and omnichannels for investors' engagement; electronic transmission of annual report and notice of AGM E-accreditation service virtual attendance real time voting and regulatory report generation services; and investor relations services. It also provides private placement stock market listing bonus issuances rights issues and public offers and advisory services; and probate and transmission services such as letters of administration grant of probate transmission of shares amendment of grant and certificate of additional assets. Further the company offers Invearn digital solutions that combines services of capital market operators to meet investors’ needs; Greenpole an enterprise registrar operating solution that caters to the data management and end-to-end operations of registrars; and e-Agm an event management solution used in organizing physical and virtual corporate events. The company was formerly known as Africa Prudential Registrars Plc and changed its name to Africa Prudential Plc in March 2017. Africa Prudential Plc was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: F.V.I. Fondo de Valores Inmobiliarios S.A.C.A.
Description: F.V.I. Fondo de Valores Inmobiliarios S.A.C.A. invests in promotes and manages the rental of spaces in commercial centers and offices in Venezuela. It is also involved in the development marketing and operation of shopping centers; issuances of securities; operation of parking lots; and development of various residential projects. The company has strategic alliance with JW Marriott International to operate JW Marriott Santo Domingo. F.V.I. Fondo de Valores Inmobiliarios S.A.C.A. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Muscat Finance SAOG
Description: Muscat Finance SAOG operates as a non-banking financial company that provides financial services to small and medium businesses and individuals in the Sultanate of Oman. The company engages in the instalment financing and leasing of vehicles and other assets debt factoring working capital and receivable financing activities. It also offers car and home improvement loans for individuals; corporate leasing and deposits; trade financing; and business loans. Muscat Finance SAOG was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Al Shams Housing and Urbanization SAE
Description: Al Shams Housing and Urbanization SAE engages in the leasing of real estate properties in Egypt. The company invests in housing and construction fields as well as in hotel properties. It also provides technical advice services. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Al Madina Insurance Company SAOG
Description: Al Madina Insurance Company SAOG provides insurance products and services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers personal insurance including motor travel domestic helper pleasure craft home life individual critical illness individual credit life and livestock insurance products; and corporate insurance such as property and commercial engineering liability marine general accident group credit life employee benefits and motor fleet insurance products. It also provides takaful an Islamic co-operative insurance; retakaful; and reinsurance products. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: General Investment Co. Ltd.
Description: General Investment Co. Ltd. manufactures and sells alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks in Jordan and internationally. The company invests in financial assets and real estate buildings. It is also involved in the rental of real estate properties. The company offers its products through off-trade on-trade and duty-free outlets as well as e-commerce platform. It exports its products to Iraq Palestine and Syria. General Investment Co. Ltd. was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Wethaq Takaful Insurance Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Wethaq Takaful Insurance Company K.S.C.P. engages in takaful insurance investment and car rental businesses in Kuwait. The company’s products portfolio comprises motor vehicle insurance products including comprehensive geographical extension driving license private personal accidents/orange card/road assistance/replacement vehicle warranties and TPL- all-terrain vehicle insurance; fire and property insurance products such as fire and allied perils/property all risk house holders comprehensive burglary and plate glass insurance; and liability insurance products consist of general third-party liability employer’s liability hauliers TPL-motor and TPL-boat policies. It also provides construction and engineering insurance products such as contractors all risks/rigs erection all-risks construction plant and machinery machinery breakdown electronic equipment and workmen compensation insurance; and group takaful and group medical insurance products comprising group takaful group medical workmen compensation and personal accidents/domestic helpers as well as travel assistance including schengen cover policies. In addition the company offers financial insurance products such as professional indemnity/medical malpractice credit life bankers blanket bond/investment management insurance/purchase protection and secure wallet programs/computer crimes/directors and officers business interruptions money in transit and fidelity guarantee/money in safe; marine and aviation insurance products for marine cargo hull aircrafts and helicopters; and reinsurance services. Further the company involved in purchase sale and lease of land; real estate investment and marketing activities; and trading of cars and spare parts. Wethaq Takaful Insurance Company K.S.C.P. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait. Wethaq Takaful Insurance Company K.S.C.P. is a subsidiary of Investment Dar Company K.S.C.

Name: Inversiones Unión Española S.A.
Description: Inversiones Unión Española S.A. engages in investment activities. The company invests in furniture and properties; tangible and intangible assets; and shares corporate rights and securities. Inversiones Unión Española S.A. is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Kuwait Real Estate Holding Company K.P.S.C (Holding)
Description: Kuwait Real Estate Holding Company K.P.S.C (Holding) together with its subsidiaries engages in real estate business in Kuwait and internationally. The company operates through Real Estate and Financial Investment segments. It is also involved in investment and development of real estate and lands; and provision of project management and maintenance as well as management consulting services. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Methaq Real Estate Investment Company P.S.C.
Description: Methaq Real Estate Investment Company P.S.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in real estate business in Jordan. It buys sells and expropriates real estates and lands for residential commercial industrial investment and other purposes. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: C.A. Fábrica Nacional de Cementos S.A.C.A.
Description: C.A. Fábrica Nacional de Cementos S.A.C.A. manufactures cement and concrete. It offers Portland cement products; and premix concrete under the Compactmex Mortermex Normex Pavimex and Imperemex names.C.A. Fábrica Nacional de Cementos S.A.C.A. was founded in 1907 and is based in Caracas Venezuela. The company operates as a subsidiary of Lafarge Venezuela.

Name: South Cairo and Giza Flour Mills and Bakeries Company
Description: South Cairo and Giza Flour Mills and Bakeries Company engages in the manufacturing trading importing exporting storing fumigation maintaining packing transport and distribution of grains and their products. The company offers flour bread and bran products as well as alternatives; bakery products; pasta; general food stuff; and fodder and constituents. The company was founded in 1965 and is based in Giza Egypt. South Cairo and Giza Flour Mills and Bakeries Company operates as a subsidiary of Holding Company for Food Industries SAE.

Name: LOM Financial Limited
Description: LOM Financial Limited a holding company provides private investment services and products in Bermuda Bahamas the United Kingdom and the Philippines. The company offers investment and financial advice brokerage and discretionary investment management services; principal transactions agency transactions and investment advisory services; custody settlement information technology and execution services; finance human resources and administrative services; nominee services; IT marketing and administration services; sources values documents and close capital investments in growing companies; and acts as an investment consultant manager and advisor as well as holds properties. It also provides bespoke discretionary account management; fixed mandate managed accounts; mutual funds; trading and investment brokerage; and deals in precious metals and commodities gold coins commodity futures and options. In addition the company offers trade desk services that executes stocks and bonds options derivatives currency foreign exchange transactions gold and other precious metals that are held in custody. It serves individuals and families; business owners and entrepreneurs; and institutions and corporates. LOM Financial Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Hamilton Bermuda.

Name: Microdata S.A.
Description: Microdata S.A. provides IT infrastructure integration solutions in Morocco. Its portfolio of IT solutions includes PC equipment and peripherals for imaging and printing; VDI; server infrastructure; virtualization; cloud-based services; storage; backup; and networking as well as software for productivity mobility and collaboration. The company also provides virtualization networks and security data protection cloud application modernization and local services. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Premium Healthcare Group
Description: Premium Healthcare Group provides healthcare services in the Middle East and North Africa. The company offers blood tests unne analysis imaging services and home lab services as well as diagnostic support to clinicians and hospitals. It also provides advanced diagnostics services in genetic testing molecular diagnostics and pathology which allows for the early detection of diseases. The company operates through diagnostic and laboratory networks. It operates in Egypt Saudi Arabia and Jordan. The company was formerly known as City Lab and changed its name to Premium Healthcare Group in September 2024. Premium Healthcare Group is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Schwager S.A.
Description: Schwager S.A. engages in the mining and renewable energy businesses in Chile. It offers maintenance services assembly operational support and electrical solutions for mining plants; and warehouse and logistics services as well as dairy products. The company is also involved in the development construction operation and maintenance of energy projects. The company was formerly known as Schwager Energy S.A. The company was founded in 1847 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Alpha Namibia Industries Renewable Power Limited
Description: Alpha Namibia Industries Renewable Power Limited together with its subsidiaries invests in infrastructural renewable energy in Namibia and Sub-Sahara Africa. The company engages in importing exporting producing and distributing solar products; planning constructing running and servicing solar power plants and related activities; and developing financing building and operating photovoltaic power plants. It is also involved in manufacturing distributing producing constructing trading importing and exporting consumer products and capital goods to render services; and investing in property shares securities and equities. In addition the company focuses on generation transmission and distribution of renewable energy that includes biomass geothermal solar hydro wind and wave resources. Alpha Namibia Industries Renewable Power Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Windhoek Namibia.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Sharqiyah Desalination Company SAOG
Description: Sharqiyah Desalination Company SAOG acquires operates and maintains a water desalination plant at Sur in the Sharqiyah region the Sultanate of Oman. It also builds operates and maintains 17.66 MIGD capacity water desalination plant. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Mailpac Group Limited
Description: Mailpac Group Limited provides courier and mail order services in Jamaica and internationally. It is also involved in the sale of food products beverages and household supplies from its online platform. Mailpac Group Limited was founded in 1998 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Middle East Holding Company PLC
Description: Middle East Holding Company PLC operates in insurance and reinsurance business. The company offers vehicle marine aviation fire liability medical life engineering and other insurance and reinsurance products. Middle East Holding Company PLC was founded in 2020 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Mansoura Poultry co.S.A.E
Description: Mansoura Poultry co.S.A.E engages in poultry related activities in Egypt. The company operates poultry farm veterinary pharmacy vegetable-based farms and other feed mills. Mansoura Poultry co.S.A.E was founded in 1983 and is based in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Name: TPS Eastern Africa Plc
Description: TPS Eastern Africa Plc owns and operates hotel and lodge facilities for the business and tourist markets in Kenya Uganda and Tanzania. It operates a collection of hotels resorts safari lodges camps palaces and forts. The company is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Ready Mix Concrete and Construction Supplies
Description: Ready Mix Concrete and Construction Supplies together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and supply of concrete in Jordan. The company offers normal sulphate resisting low permeability waterproofing lightweight heavyweight permeable flowable fill screed fiber troweling post tensioning early strength foam stamped exposed aggregate architectural/fair faced polished and color pigmented concrete products; shotcrete; self-compacting; CO2 optimized fly ash and microscilica and ready plaster mixes; and steel-fiber reinforced concrete. Its products are used in commercial and residential buildings infrastructure healthcare industrial private public education governmental and other projects. The company also engages in the trade of construction equipment spare parts and oils; trade of heavy equipment such as spare parts renting equipment cranes and weights; and purchasing of lands and construction of residential apartments. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Oman Chromite Company SAOG
Description: Oman Chromite Company SAOG engages in mining and marketing of chromite ores in the Sultanate of Oman East Asia South Africa and internationally. It offers metallurgical and refractory chrome ores. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Sohar the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: IEB Construcciones S.A.
Description: IEB Construcciones S.A. operates as a construction and services company in Argentina and internationally. It undertakes roadworks; port works; architectural works; hospital educational cultural and sport complexes; underground works; commercial and industrial construction works; water and sanitation works; works for nuclear power plants; and mining works. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. As of October 31 2024 IEB Construcciones S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Inversora Mercedes.

Name: The Arab Dairy Products Co.
Description: The Arab Dairy Products Co. produces and sells cheese in Egypt. The company provides white processed cheddar and Swiss cheese products under the Panda Dairy and Panda Gourmet brand names. It is also involved in private label activities. The company also exports its products. The Arab Dairy Products Co. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Al Ezz Ceramics & Porcelain Co.
Description: Al Ezz Ceramics & Porcelain Co. engages in manufacturing and selling ceramic and porcelain tiles for homes and businesses in Egypt. The company provides sanitary wares floor wall tiles bathtubs water mixers taps and related contracting work. It also engages in the importation of raw materials machinery and equipment and spare parts. In addition it operates GEMMA showrooms. It markets its products through a distribution network in the Middle East Europe and North America. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Cairo Egypt. Al Ezz Ceramics & Porcelain Co. operates as a subsidiary of El Ezz Group Holding for Industry and Investment.

Name: Enjoei S.A.
Description: Enjoei S.A. operates a marketplace platform for the purchase and sale of used products in Brazil. The company provides products for girls boys and children including accessories clothes beauty products footwear toys hygiene and well-being and scholarship products. It also offers home and décor electronics home appliances pet products books and stationery music and tv antiques other products etc. The company was formerly known as Enjoei.com.br Atividades de Internet S.A. and changed its name to Enjoei S.A. in May 2021. Enjoei S.A. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Electro Sur Este S.A.A.
Description: Electro Sur Este S.A.A. engages in the distribution of electricity in Peru. The company has operations in the regions of Cusco Apurimac and Madre de Dios as well as Sucre province in the Ayacucho and the province of Cayarani in the Arequipa region. Electro Sur Este S.A.A. was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Cusco Peru.

Name: The National Detergent Company SAOG
Description: The National Detergent Company SAOG manufactures markets and distributes detergents liquid soaps and home care products in the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates through Consumer and Other Business segments. It offers detergent powders liquid detergents power gels sanitizer sprays cleaners antiseptics matic gels disinfectants hand sanitizers bleach dish wash liquid hand wash liquids shampoo soaps window cleaner fabric softener and other industrial and household cleaning products. The company sells its products through distributors under the Bahar brand. It also manufactures and trades specialty chemicals for oil and gas construction and water treatment industries. The National Detergent Company SAOG was founded in 1981 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Companias CIC S.A.
Description: Companias CIC S.A. designs produces and markets furniture and decoration products in Chile. It offers beds and mattresses; pillows; linens such as bed sheets blankets and accessories and cover beds and quilts; pillows; bases; sofas; dining room furniture; and bedroom living room and other furniture. The company was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: AL - Sharq Investment Projects Co. PLC.
Description: AL - Sharq Investment Projects Co. PLC. engages in the establishment and management of hotels and tourist resorts in Jordan. The company operates and manages Mövenpick Hotels & Resorts. AL - Sharq Investment Projects Co. PLC. was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Regency Petroleum Company Limited
Description: Regency Petroleum Company Limited a petroleum marketing company distributes and sells petroleum products in Jamaica. The company offers propane gas to bulk customers such as hotels restaurants bakeries and other industries of business; cooking gas; commercial bulk tanks; automotive fuel; liquefied petroleum gas; and butane gas in packed cylinders for household uses. It also distributes automotive diesel 90 octane fuel 87 octane fuel and ultra low sulphur diesel; and operates petrol stations. The company distributes its products through dealers. Regency Petroleum Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Savanna-la-Mar Jamaica.

Name: Livetech da Bahia Indústria e Comércio S.A.
Description: Livetech da Bahia Indústria e Comércio S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides technology-as-a-service solutions and services in Brazil and internationally. It operates through Telecom Solar and Enterprise segments. The company offers telecommunication products and services including operators and internet service providers; fixed broadband solutions such as fiber to the home gigabit passive optical network/ethernet passive optical network access networks active/passive dense wavelength division multiplexing transmission fiber-optic cables optical distribution and fusion and optical measurement tools and equipment; data center services comprising network infrastructure energy and climatization intrusion alarm access control and fire detection and alarm; network and Wi-Fi solutions which includes routers and data security and wireless network equipment; and critical and solar energy systems. It also distributes solar energy systems such as managers power and fixation structures photovoltaic modules inverters string boxes structures cables and connectors and batteries and off-grid inverter systems. In addition the company provides corporate solutions for data network information security energy systems and critical infrastructure telephony and collaboration building automation and electronic security; LED panels; professional audio and video solutions; smart home and home cinema products; and other solar energy-related systems. Further it offers TaaS solutions comprising datacenter infrastructure events audio visual corporate wi-fi network information security LED panels GPON access control office automation unified telephony system DWDM building automation and electronic security. The company serves education entertainment industry health telecommunications transportation and retail industries. Livetech da Bahia Indústria e Comércio S.A. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Ilhéus Brazil.

Name: Arabia Falcon Insurance SAOG
Description: Arabia Falcon Insurance SAOG engages in underwriting general and life insurance business in the Sultanate of Oman. It offers motor medical group and individual life property general accident liability engineering travel marine and personal accident insurance. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Muscat Oman. Arabia Falcon Insurance SAOG operates as a subsidiary of Arabia Insurance Company S.A.L.

Name: Car & General (Kenya) Plc
Description: Car & General (Kenya) Plc supplies power generation automotive construction and engineering products in Kenya Uganda Tanzania and Rwanda. It operates through Trade and Workshop Investment Properties Poultry ICT Training and Talent Development and Manufacturing segments. The company engages in the sale and services of power equipment household goods agricultural tractors and implements marine engines motorcycles three-wheeler vehicles commercial laundry equipment commercial engines and general goods; and manufacture of helmets plastic components and motorcycle safety accessories. It also provides day-old chick farming services; and involved in the rental of properties. In addition the company develops and acquires technology solutions for resale internally and to third parties. Car & General (Kenya) Plc was founded in 1936 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Dhofar Food & Investment SAOG
Description: Dhofar Food & Investment SAOG together with its subsidiaries primarily engages in the production and packaging of dairy products in the Sultanate of Oman and internationally. It offers fresh and long-life dairy juices mineral water products soft drinks energy drinks and food products. The company is also involved in the rearing cattle for beef meat; milling and sale of animal feed from various raw materials; growing of grass; sale of plastic products; and poultry livestock hatching growing processing and selling activities. In addition it trades in equity investments and invests in private equity; and manufactures and sells vegetable oils. The company was formerly known as Dhofar Cattle Feed Company SAOG and changed its name to Dhofar Food & Investment SAOG in October 2022. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Salalah the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Ekttitab Holding Company K.S.C Public
Description: Ekttitab Holding Company K.S.C Public together with its subsidiaries engages in the investment activities in Kuwait. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Middle East Insurance Co.
Description: Middle East Insurance Co. provides various insurance products and services in Jordan and internationally. It provides life and health insurance such as term life personal accident medical and travel insurance; and general accident insurance including public and product liability professional indemnity and workmen's compensation insurance as well as insurance for money fidelity medical malpractice bankers blanket bonds jewelers blocks and contingency/ cancellation of event insurance. The company also offers motor insurance that comprise comprehensive vehicle personal and luggage assistance; and property insurance comprises fire and allied perils property all risks and household insurance. In addition it provides insurance policies to cover engineering risks such as contractors all risks erection all risks contractors plant and machinery and machinery breakdown as well as loss of profit electronic equipment and deterioration of stock machinery breakdown. Further the company offers marine insurance for cargo and hull and machinery; and aviation insurance including aircraft hull and liabilities aircraft spares airport liability personal accident loss of license deductible insurance and loss of use. Middle East Insurance Co. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Middle East Insurance Co. is a subsidiary of Middle East Holding Company PLC.

Name: Middle Egypt Flour Mills
Description: Middle Egypt Flour Mills manufactures stores fumigates maintains packages prepares distributes transports trades in and exports grains in Israel. The company also offers bakery products slurries food products feeds and yeast; packaging and packing supplies; and capital equipment and spare parts. The company was founded in 1966 and is based in Minya Egypt. Middle Egypt Flour Mills is a subsidiary of Food Industries Holding Company SAE.

Name: Maghreb Oxygène S.A.
Description: Maghreb Oxygène S.A. engages in the production packaging and marketing of industrial medical food and special gases in Morocco. It operates through three segments: Gas Welding and Production Unit. The company offers oxygen acetylene and carbon dioxide; flame equipment and small welding stations; medicinal gases and devices; medical fluid distribution systems; and medical equipment comprising operating theaters resuscitation and emergency equipment hospitalization equipment instrumentation laboratory fluids and sterilization and hygiene equipment. It also distributes welding products and related techniques; and medical equipment and consumables. Its products are used in health industry metallurgy agri-food and aviation industries. Maghreb Oxygène S.A. was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. Maghreb Oxygène S.A. is a subsidiary of Akwa Group SA.

Name: National Investment Company Limited
Description: National Investment Company Limited engages in the investment in shares of listed and unlisted companies government securities corporate bonds and other financial instruments. It also establishes and manages business enterprises in manufacturing financial services real estate telecommunications agriculture mining and other service sectors. In addition the company is involved in real estate investment including the acquisition development and management of commercial properties student hostels and shopping malls. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Jerusalem Insurance Co. (L.T.D)
Description: Jerusalem Insurance Co. (L.T.D) provides life and non-life insurance products in Jordan. The company offers property and fire insurance including fire and allied perils property all risks and business interruption insurance; engineering insurance products comprising contractors all risks erection all risks machinery breakdown and electronic equipment insurance; and liability insurance products consisting of third party liability commercial general liability professional indemnity products liability employer’s liability and workmen compensation. It also provides general accident insurance such as cash in transit/cash in safe fidelity guarantee and plate glass insurance; political violence insurance sabotage and terrorism cyber bankers blanket bond and jewelers block insurance; marine and aviation insurance products including cargo yacht freight aircraft inland freight liabilities hull and machinery insurance; and fleet motor insurance products; and group life and medical insurance products. In addition the company offers personal insurance products including health car home personal accident life and retirement and travel insurance services. It serves industrial and commercial enterprises as well as individuals and families. Jerusalem Insurance Co. (L.T.D) was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Financiera ProEmpresa S.A.
Description: Financiera ProEmpresa S.A. provides various financial products and services to micro and small enterprises in Peru. The company offers simple scheduled children’s women’s and salary savings account; CTS accounts; direct consumption quickie payroll deduction loan and pro build credits; and fixed term deposits. It also provides exchange rate national money transfers collection remittances and insurance services. The company serves individuals and businesses. Financiera ProEmpresa S.A. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in San Borja Peru.

Name: Amer Group Holding Company S.A.E.
Description: Amer Group Holding Company S.A.E. operates as a real estate development company primarily in Egypt. It offers mixed-use and family-oriented destinations which include primary and secondary homes as well as hotels shopping malls restaurants and sporting clubs. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Arab International Hotels PLC.
Description: Arab International Hotels PLC. owns and operates the Amman Marriott Hotel in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: PBT Group Limited
Description: PBT Group Limited together with its subsidiaries provides consulting services to finance insurance medical healthcare retail telecommunication and other sectors in South Africa Europe Australia and the United Kingdom. The company offers strategic and advisory services including data strategy modernization readiness program blueprint architecture business analysis and project management; data visualization services comprising business intelligence self-service analytics data science storytelling and analytics; data engineering services such as data lake data streaming ETL / ELT data warehouse data wrangling and cloud infrastructure; artificial intelligence services including scheduling optimization natural language processing robotics and machine learning; managed services comprising outsourcing support maintenance managed and technical services; and application development services. It also provides healthcare management solutions and services including real time claims processing query capabilities electronic data interchange document management and membership and contribution management as well as medical savings account management to medical aid and managed care sectors. In addition the company offers software development digital web and mobile application development software testing and cloud computing solutions. PBT Group Limited was founded in 1998 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Ad-Dulayl Industrial Park & Real Estate Company P.L.C
Description: Ad-Dulayl Industrial Park & Real Estate Company P.L.C develops and manages industrial estates/zones in the Kingdom of Jordan. The company builds factories warehouses and dormitories. It also leases and sells various plots. In addition the company offers infrastructure and utilities support services. Ad-Dulayl Industrial Park & Real Estate Company P.L.C was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Arab Company For Land Reclamation
Description: Arab Company For Land Reclamation provides works and land reclamation services in Egypt. The company was founded in 1964 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Takaful Oman Insurance SAOG
Description: Takaful Oman Insurance SAOG provides general and family takaful services in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates through four segments: Motor Non-Motor Medical and Family. The company provides group life group medical group creditor motor insurance property all risk erection all risk contractor’s plant and equipment contractor’s all risk personal accident workmen’s compensation marine cargo domestic helper travel fire and perils money public liability and hotel plans as well as offers fidelity guarantee services. It offers its products through agents and branches. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Gulf Mushroom Products Co. SAOG
Description: Gulf Mushroom Products Co. SAOG engages in the cultivation processing and marketing of mushrooms under the Mushroom Oman brand in Oman. It offers white button baby giant brown portabella vitamin-D oyster and shitake mushrooms as well as mushroom and waste composts. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Barka the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Aveng Limited
Description: Aveng Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in construction engineering building and contract mining activities in South Africa Australia New Zealand and Pacific Islands Southeast Asia and internationally. It operates through the Infrastructure Building and Mining segments. The company offers civil and structural mechanical and electrical marine pipelines rail and tunneling and underground construction services to transport water and wastewater ports and coastal energy and resources markets. It also provides design consultation and management construction and fit out services to the sport health and science defense education residential commercial retail industrial and infrastructure sectors. In addition the company engages in contract mining operations that include open cut mining shaft sinking and access development and underground mining projects. Aveng Limited was founded in 1889 and is based in Boksburg South Africa.

Name: Palestine Real Estate Investment Limited
Description: Palestine Real Estate Investment Limited engages in real estate development and investment sector in Palestine. The company is involved in the development contracting operation trading and maintenance of infrastructure projects. It also develops five-star hotels and industrial cities as well as commercial and government buildings and residential projects. In addition the company engages in the management operation and maintenance of solar and renewable energy projects. Palestine Real Estate Investment Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Rawabi Palestine.

Name: RMB Holdings Limited
Description: RMB Holdings Limited an investment holding company provides diversified financial services in South Africa. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Midrand South Africa.

Name: Club de Polo y Equitación San Cristóbal S.A.
Description: Club de Polo y Equitación San Cristóbal S.A. operates a sports club in Chile. The company’s facilities include polo horse riding golf tennis tennis courts and other as well as restaurants. Club de Polo y Equitación San Cristóbal S.A. was incorporated in 1943 and is based in Vitacura Chile.

Name: Al Tawfeek Leasing Company
Description: Al Tawfeek Leasing Company provides leasing and factoring solutions in Egypt. It offers financial leasing sale and lease back step-up and step-down lease and structured lease services as well as classical/domestic factoring and reverse factoring services. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt. Al Tawfeek Leasing Company is a subsidiary of Arab Moltaqa Investments Company.

Name: Muscat City Desalination Company SAOG
Description: Muscat City Desalination Company SAOG engages in selling desalinated water in the Sultanate of Oman. The company develops owns and operates the Al Ghubrah independent water plant a seawater reverse osmosis desalination plant with a contracted capacity of 191000 cubic meters per day located in North Ghubrah Muscat Governorate Sultanate of Oman. Muscat City Desalination Company SAOG was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Sasini PLC
Description: Sasini PLC together with its subsidiaries engages in growing processing packing marketing and selling of tea coffee macadamia nuts and avocado in Kenya and internationally. It operates through five divisions: Tea Coffee Macadamia Avocado and Others. The company is involved in the dairy operations and livestock; commercial milling and marketing of coffee; forestry; value additions of related products; renting of growing land; and the leasing of plant and machinery activities. Sasini PLC was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Valores Simesa S.A.
Description: Valores Simesa S.A. invests in real estate and securities and shares. The company engages in the commercial and industrial activities. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Medellin Colombia.

Name: Finbond Group Limited
Description: Finbond Group Limited operates as a financial services institution. It operates through Deposit and Debt Finance Products Lending Property Investment and Transactional Banking segments. The company offers short-term consumer lending services; transactional banking products; personal banking; overdraft facility; business banking products such as commercial business and small enterprise accounts; business credit services; savings and investment products; online and mobile banking; and secured lending as well as insurance products. It operates through branches in North America and South Africa. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Pretoria the Republic of South Africa.

Name: M2M Group SA
Description: M2M Group SA provides electronic payment and e-Gov solutions in Africa Europe Asia Oceania the Americas and internationally. The company’s products include MX PAYMENT a multi-channel electronic payment platform that issues acquires authorizes secures and switches electronic payments; MX Plus Paas a cloud payment service platform covering the entire value chain of multi-channel electronic payment; MX E-Gov which offers solutions related to biometric identification and e-procedures; and MX Campus a multi service student card issuance platform that provides management of university services. It also offers MX Move which provides ticketing solutions for urban long distance and international transport operators; MX Health a platform for issuing and managing health cards; and MX Enterprise which offers integrated solutions for human resource management. The company serves financial institution transport government education health and telecommunication sectors as well as retailers and fuel distributors. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco. M2M Group SA operates as a subsidiary of RMK Sarl.

Name: Access Financial Services Limited
Description: Access Financial Services Limited provides retail lending services to the micro enterprise sector for personal and business purposes in Jamaica and the United States. The company offers personal loan products to private and public sector employees for school expenses home improvement medical expenses payment of utility bills and motor vehicle purchases and repairs. It also provides business loans to micro small and medium sized businesses operating in the agriculture manufacturing trading and service sectors for working capital support or to facilitate the purchase of fixed assets. In addition the company operates a money services division that offers bill payment services. Access Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Triunfo Participações e Investimentos S.A.
Description: Triunfo Participações e Investimentos S.A. engages in the infrastructure business in Brazil. It operates through Toll Energy Logistics and Other segments. The company is involved in recovery reinforcement monitoring improvement maintenance conservation and operation of the toll road; operation of highways; and airport management. It engages in the operation and maintenance of hydro power plants. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil. Triunfo Participações e Investimentos S.A. is a subsidiary of THP - Triunfo Holding de Participações S.A.

Name: First Insurance Company
Description: First Insurance Company together with its subsidiary provides insurance products and services to individuals and businesses in Jordan and internationally. It offers fire natural hazard accident medical and marine vehicles cargo during transportation other damage of properties liability of land based vehicles general liability ships ships liability aircraft aircraft liability and life insurance products and services. The company also provides motor home family and critical income protection travel engineering cash workmen’s compensation public and product liability and bankers blanket bond insurance products. First Insurance Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Feria de Osorno S.A.
Description: Feria de Osorno S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in the production distribution import export and sale of food products to farmers in Chile. The company operates in two segments Agricultural and Investment. It engages in the intermediation of livestock and brokerages; and markets meat and dairy products as well as agricultural goods vehicles fuels and other products. The company is involved in the real estate business. Feria de Osorno S.A. was founded in 1945 and is based in Osorno Chile.

Name: Ascendis Health Limited
Description: Ascendis Health Limited a health and wellness company provides health and wellness products and clinical and diagnostic medical devices in South Africa. It operates in Consumer Health and Medical Devices segments. The company offers multivitamins and minerals micronutrients and nutraceutical supplements; vitamins and homeopathic and herbal products; and over-the-counter complementary alternative consumer skin and scripted compounding products under the Solal Solal Skincare Chela-Preg Bettaway Chela-fer Jungle-Vites Vitaforce and Menacal7 brands. It also distributes and sells medical devices and diagnostic laboratory equipment and consumables under the Ortho-Xact Surgical Innovations and The Scientific Group brands. The company also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Wynberg South Africa.
