Name: Compañía Introductora de Buenos Aires S.A.
Description: Compañía Introductora de Buenos Aires S.A. manufactures and markets table salt condiments spices vinegars and olive oil for households in Argentina and internationally. The company also offers ready meals ketchup soy sauce liquid dressings sweet sauces pastry sugar cinnamon powder baking soda grated coconut pastry flavorings and salts for industry. The company was founded in 1901 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Compañía Introductora de Buenos Aires S.A. is a subsidiary of F V Sociedad Anonima.

Name: Ismailia national company for food industries
Description: Ismailia national company for food industries produces and markets food products in Egypt. It offers frozen vegetables including green peas and beans okra taro grape leaves artichoke cauliflower minced molokhia spinach leaves broccoli broad beans mixed vegetables and strawberries as well as peas with carrots. The company also provides natural fruit juices; tomato paste and concentrates; and fruit concentrates and pulp comprising strawberry orange guava and mango pulp. It also engages in preserving freezing canning and drying vegetables fruits legumes etc. In addition it addition it engages in manufacturing producing preparing packaging cooling sterilizing drying and storing mats concentrates nectar etc. The company also exports its products to Europe the United States Canada Australia and the Arab countries. Ismailia national company for food industries was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: LPS Brasil - Consultoria de Imóveis S.A.
Description: LPS Brasil - Consultoria de Imóveis S.A. provides real estate brokerage services in Brazil. It operates through Brokerage Franchises and Financing Promotion segments. The company provides brokerage services for the sale and purchase of third-party and land subdivision properties; and consulting technical real estate advisory franchises correspondent bank and other related services. It also engages in promoting and offering financial products and services in the real estate market. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Mundial S.A. - Produtos de Consumo
Description: Mundial S.A. - Produtos de Consumo engages in the manufacture and sale of personal care products worldwide. The company operates through Personal Care and Cosmetics Metal Fasteners Food Service Crafts and Pump Solutions segments. It offers cuticles and nails scissors and tweezers; buttons and eyelets leather and plastic footwear metallic articles adornments metal and plastic articles and components; professional knives for refrigerators and butchers cutlery pans knives and household utensils; traditional cutting and sewing scissors to school and craft scissors; and pumps. The company sells its products under the Impala Mundial Personal Care Mundial Hercules Mundial Crafts Eberle and Syllent brands. Mundial S.A. was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Eppley Caribbean Property Fund Limited SCC- Value Fund
Wadi Kom Ombo For Land Reclamation Co.
Description: Wadi Kom Ombo For Land Reclamation Co. engages in the infrastructure business in Egypt. It also undertakes land reclamation road station and housing works. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Compañía Agropecuaria Copeval S.A.
Description: Compañía Agropecuaria Copeval S.A. distributes and markets agricultural machinery and products. It offers food products such as alfalfa cereals corn soya flour and mineral salts and additives as well as pet and horse food and substitutes; veterinary products; environmental health products; and hardware products such as of wires and accessories bags ties and cord cleaning and disinfectant harvest and pruning implements crop and fruit trees protection and safety and hygiene products as well as electric fences soaps disinfectants and papers. The company also provides spare parts consisting of lubricants tires batteries fuel ponds original and alternative spare parts implement motorized spare part and tractor accessories; irrigation products such as pumps fittings pipelines valves issuers system controllers sprinkler irrigation equipment filters and accessories; phosphates mixtures potassium muriate soluble urea nitrates and specialties fertilizers; and phytosanitary products. In addition it offers oats onions grass and legume forages Solanaceae Cucurbitaceae rootstock legume and brassic vegetables seeds as well as meadow inoculants and peat forage mixtures wheat bulbs and roots and corn seeds; fruit and crop implements and tractors; home and garden tools including garden irrigation pets toys and merchandise and construction tools; and fuel products. The company was formerly known as Cooperativa Agrícola Lechera Valle Central Limitada. and changed its name to Compañía Agropecuaria Copeval S.A. in 2003. Compañía Agropecuaria Copeval S.A. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in San Fernando Chile.

Name: Eterna Plc
Description: Eterna Plc an integrated energy company manufactures and sells lubricating oils and petrochemicals in Nigeria. The company operates through Retail and Industrial and Lubricants and Chemicals segments. The Retail and Industrial segment is involved in the sale and distribution of petroleum products including white products in retail outlets small units and to industrial customers. The Lubricants and Chemicals segment distributes manufactured and imported lubricants and chemicals to marine and energy customers. The company also imports and sells bulk petroleum products such as premium motor spirit automotive gas oil low pour fuel oil base oils and bitumen. In addition it provides bunkering; gas distribution; liquefied petroleum gas and natural gas marketing; offshore and onshore oil; and gas processing services as well as trade in crude oil and other refined petroleum products. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Eterna Plc operates as a subsidiary of Preline Limited.

Name: Sameer Africa PLC
Description: Sameer Africa PLC together with its subsidiaries engages in letting of investment properties in Kenya. The company operates through four segments: Property Rentals Sourcing and Distribution Regional Operations and Yana Tyre Centre. It is involved in the sourcing buying retailing importing distribution and sale of tires tubes and flaps. The company was incorporated in 1969 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. Sameer Africa PLC is a subsidiary of Sameer Investments Limited.

Name: Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc
Description: Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc through its subsidiaries primarily provides insurance products and services in Nigeria. It operates in two segments Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc (CHH Plc); and Consolidated Hallmark Insurance Limited (CHI Group) Hallmark Finance Company Limited (HFC) and Hallmark Health Services Limited (HHSL). The company offers travel marine oil and gas motor comprehensive machinery breakdown contractors-all-risk motor 3rd party fire and theft money plant-all-risk home bonds burglary consequential loss personal accident fire and special perils professional indemnity aviation combined fire and burglary enhanced motor third party and goods-in-transit insurance products. It also engages in the general insurance finance company and health management organization (HMO) businesses. In addition the company offers loans and finance to individual SMEs and corporate entities. Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Dhofar Tourism Company SAOG
Description: Dhofar Tourism Company SAOG provides hospitality and tourism services in the Sultanate of Oman. It owns and operates the Garden Mirbat resort located at Mirbat beach. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Salalah Oman.

Name: Al-Takaful Palestinian Insurance Company
Description: Al-Takaful Palestinian Insurance Company provides Islamic insurance services to individuals families and businesses in Palestine. The company offers medical and motor insurance as well as family insurance products such as natural and accidental death disability and critical illness coverage. It also provides general insurance products including marine fire and allied perils household CAR and EAR machinery breakdown money fidelity guarantee personal accident plate glass work compensation third party liability travel and contractor plant and machinery. Al-Takaful Palestinian Insurance Company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: Sharkia National Company for Food Security
Description: Sharkia National Company for Food Security engages in the manufacturing and sale of poultry and animal feed in Egypt. It also engages in livestock breeding. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Zagazig Egypt.

Name: Equipment Holding Company K.S.C.P.
Description: Equipment Holding Company K.S.C.P. together with its subsidiaries engages in the construction and trading business in Kuwait. It is involved in construction of ministry and oil sector project contracts; building leasing; investment business; electro mechanical installation; and trading of construction equipment and machinery equipment and tools; as well as provides spare parts and maintenance and onsite assistance and services. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Kuwait City Kuwait.

Name: Empresa Agrícola San Juan S.A.
Description: Empresa Agrícola San Juan S.A. engages in the cultivation harvesting and export of table grapes primarily in Peru. It also cultivates avocado and others. In addition the company provides red globe crimson thompson sweet globe and sweet sapphire. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Lambayeque Peru. Empresa Agrícola San Juan S.A. is a subsidiary of Corporacion Perhusa S.A.

Name: Egyptian Transport and Commercial Services Company S.A.E.
Description: Egyptian Transport and Commercial Services Company S.A.E. provides transportation and logistics services in Egypt. It offers sea freight services including consolidation chartering vessels for large shipments direct import and export and other supply chain solutions; land transport; and air freight services comprising direct import and export consolidation and hanging garment containers. The company also provides warehousing services such as packing container stuffing lashing and securing as well as domestic and bonded storage and free zone warehousing; and chartering services for bulk or general cargo in the areas of agricultural commodities fertilizers chemicals and mining products. In addition it offers packing customs clearance insurance services; and logistical solutions for the transport of sensitive equipment and packages of various weights or dimensions in the fields of power plant cement mills steel mills transformer sub-stations water and wastewater plants and large-scale infrastructure projects as well as oil gas and petrochemical plants. Further the company transports cargo and materials for exhibitions; and engages in the handling and storage of containerized and general cargo including oversized and heavy lift packages. It serves power and renewable energy; oil and gas and petrochemicals; pharmaceuticals; electronics and appliances; and automotive industries. Egyptian Transport and Commercial Services Company S.A.E. was founded in 1939 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Ellah Lakes Plc
Description: Ellah Lakes Plc operates as an agricultural producer in Nigeria. The company engages in the cultivation and production of oil palm; and cassava soybean maize and rice plantation. It also engages in piggery business. Ellah Lakes Plc was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Benin City Nigeria.

Name: Inversiones Nutravalor S.A.
Description: Inversiones Nutravalor S.A. an investment company engages in the production and sale of fishmeal and fish oil in Chile. The company also offers protein food products; and canned and frozen horse mackerel and hake and reineta as well as sells tuna fillets and shredded tuna. The company was formerly known as Empresa Pesquera Eperva S.A. and changed its name to Inversiones Nutravalor S.A. in August 2021. Inversiones Nutravalor S.A. was founded in 1956 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Nu-World Holdings Limited
Description: Nu-World Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures imports distributes and exports various consumer electronics electrical appliances and consumer durables in Africa Asia Australasia Europe and South America. Nu-World Holdings Limited was founded in 1946 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Sociedad Hipodromo Chile S.A.
Description: Sociedad Hipodromo Chile S.A. engages in the horse race betting business in Chile. It engages in the breeding importation and sale of blooded racing horses; development of horse breed; and training of suitable centers for the training of horses as well as organize diffuses and realizes shows and sports meeting races exhibition and contests. The company was incorporated in 1904 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Gulf Hotels (Oman) Company Limited SAOG
Description: Gulf Hotels (Oman) Company Limited SAOG operates in the hospitality and tourism industry in the Sultanate of Oman. It owns and operates the Crowne Plaza Hotel in Muscat. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman. Gulf Hotels (Oman) Company Limited SAOG is a subsidiary of Golden Sands Hotel Company LLC.

Name: Express Catering Limited
Description: Express Catering Limited engages in the operation of branded sports bars and restaurants at Sangster International Airport in Montego Bay. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Montego Bay Jamaica. Express Catering Limited is a subsidiary of Margaritaville St. Lucia.

Name: Ismailia Development and Real Estate Co
Description: Ismailia Development and Real Estate Co plans and establishes urban areas with various facilities and services. Its infrastructure works include drinking water sanitation electricity roads communication parking meters and multi-story garages. The company also establishes specialized integrated and general hospitals; and establishes operates and manages commercial and entertainment centers and conference halls as well as schools and educational institutes. In addition it is also involved real estate investment activities; refrigerated transport of goods and refrigerators for preserving agricultural crops industrial products and foodstuffs; and operation of container terminals and grain silos. Further the company engages in management operation and maintenance of industrial service and real estate projects; establishing managing and operating logistical centers and areas for light and complementary industries; establishing equipping managing and renting warehouses; storing and shipping goods; and establishing managing and operating dry ports as well as renting storage spaces administrative offices and shops. Additionally it engages in the reclamation and cultivation of barren or desert lands; and raising of poultry and birds. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Ismaïlia Egypt.

Name: Cargo Handlers Limited
Description: Cargo Handlers Limited provides stevedoring equipment leasing and management services in Jamaica. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Montego Bay Jamaica.

Name: First Jordan Investment Company PLC
Description: First Jordan Investment Company PLC invests in various sectors in Jordan and the Middle East. It engages in the construction of real estate; and management and development of real estate. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Takaful International Company B.S.C.
Description: Takaful International Company B.S.C. operates as an Islamic insurance company in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through Marine and General Motor Medical and Family segments. The company offers insurance products such as property engineering general accident liability marine cargo marine hull aviation medical group life motor travel assurance products and family takaful; insurance for private homes and dwellings; and takaful policies to cover individual life and unit linked savings products. It serves individuals and corporations. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Manama Bahrain. Takaful International Company B.S.C. operates as a subsidiary of Bahrain Kuwait Insurance Company B.S.C.

Name: Arab Phoenix Holding Company
Description: Arab Phoenix Holding Company primarily engages in the real estate development business in Jordan. The company operates through Manufacturing Real Estate and Contracting Business segments. It purchases and develops lands; and constructs resells and rents housing projects. The company is also involved in constructing trading complexes; renting buying and selling real estates and lands; implementing construction contracts; manufacturing and forming timber to manufacture doors and furniture; manufacturing and pulling aluminum and plastic windows. In addition it engages in the construction management and ownership of hotels and resorts; and preparation and processing of concrete molds and prefabricated concrete products as well as in the electro mechanic business. The company was formerly known as Taameer Jordan Holdings and changed its name to Arab Phoenix Holding Company in April 2017. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Compañía Eléctrica del Litoral S.A.
Description: Compañía Eléctrica del Litoral S.A. engages in the distribution and sale of electricity in Chile. It is also involved in the provision of other services associated with the supply. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Algarrobo Chile. Compañía Eléctrica del Litoral S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Chilquinta Energia S.A.

Name: Delta Insurance Company
Description: Delta Insurance Company engages in the insurance business in Egypt. The company offers fire engineering accident cargo transport car medical oil and energy land transport aviation and ship hull insurance services. Delta Insurance Company was founded in 1980 and is based in Giza Egypt. As of November 2 2025 Delta Insurance Company operates as a subsidiary of Al-Wafaa Life Insurance Company.

Name: Jamaican Teas Limited
Description: Jamaican Teas Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and distributes of various tea and other consumer products in Jamaica. It operates through four segments: Manufacturing Retailing Real Estate and Investments. It manufactures and sells teas under the Tetley and Caribbean Dreams brand names. The company also operates a chain of Shoppers Delite supermarkets; and develops rents and sells housing and commercial properties as well as engages in the investment business. It exports its products to North and South America and the United Kingdom. The company was formerly known as Tetley Tea Company (Jamaica) Limited and changed its name to Jamaican Teas Limited in November 2009. Jamaican Teas Limited was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Zambeef Products PLC
Description: Zambeef Products PLC together with its subsidiaries engages in the agri-businesses in Zambia Nigeria and Ghana. The company engages in the production processing distribution and retailing of beef chicken meat pork fish milk dairy eggs edible oil flour day-old chick and stockfeed products. It is also involved in the row cropping operations primarily maize soya beans and wheat. In addition the company operates distribution and retail outlets directly to end-consumers in Zambia and West Africa. Additionally it operates transport and trucking fleets. Further the company processes and sells leather shoe and poultry products as well as chicken breeding. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Lusaka Zambia.

Name: Stanley Motta Limited
Description: Stanley Motta Limited engages in the rental of properties to BPO sector in Jamaica. Stanley Motta Limited was incorporated in 1948 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: National Company for Housing Professional Syndicates SAE
Description: National Company for Housing Professional Syndicates SAE engages in housing construction and tourism activities in Egypt. The company is involved in the construction and reconstruction of residential communities and towers in the areas of Cairo Giza and Alexandria. It also operates Le Meridien Heliopolis a five star hotel. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Heliopolis Egypt.

Name: Nasr Company for Civil Works
Description: Nasr Company for Civil Works engages in the construction business in Egypt. The company undertakes irrigation bridge utility electricity road and railway land reclamation tunnel port and marine construction projects. It also constructs public and residential buildings; executes and equips hospitals and hotels; and is involved in the real estate and tourism investment activities. The company was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Dolphin Cove Limited
Description: Dolphin Cove Limited together with its subsidiaries operates tourist attractions in Jamaica. The company offers dolphin programmes as well as other ancillary operations such as restaurants and gift and video shops. The company was formerly known as Gabarone Limited and changed its name to Dolphin Cove Limited in March 1999. Dolphin Cove Limited was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Ocho Rios Jamaica. Dolphin Cove Limited is a subsidiary of World of Dolphins Inc.

Name: Egyptians for Housing & Development Co.
Description: Egyptians for Housing & Development Co. is involved in the real estate business in Egypt. The company engages in the buying dividing and selling of lands or constructing buildings; and establishing urban expansion projects new cities buildings housing and their services from commercial markets administrative places and garages to rent or sell. Egyptians for Housing & Development Co. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Jordan Investment Trust P.L.C
Description: Jordan Investment Trust P.L.C together with its subsidiaries engages in investment real estate venture capital capital market and investment banking services in Jordan and internationally. It operates in two segments Financial Investments and Investment Properties. The company offers investment banking services including asset management corporate finance advisory nominee and custodian accounts and brokerage services as well as consulting and capital market operations services. It also invests in early-stage and other companies across various sectors; trades in equities and bonds; and trades and leases properties and land. Jordan Investment Trust P.L.C was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Valparaíso Sporting Club S.A.
Description: Valparaíso Sporting Club S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the horse racing activities in Chile. It leases its halls free spaces and facilities for sports and social events and show. The company was founded in 1882 and is based in Viña Del Mar Chile.

Name: MTN Zakhele Futhi (RF) Limited
Description: MTN Zakhele Futhi (RF) Limited an investment company operates as the special purpose investment vehicle to effect MTN Group’s Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment transaction. It acquires and holds shares in MTN Group on behalf of the participating black public. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Hidrostal S.A.
Description: Hidrostal S.A. manufactures of centrifugal pumps for various applications in Peru. The company offers general purpose pumps including monoblock centrifugal electric pump series A B and C; hydropneumatic equipment with pressurized tank; centrifugal motor pump; self-priming motor pump; monoblock self-priming electric pump; self-priming bare shaft pump; self-priming pump with clutch; bare shaft pump with threaded connections; monoblock electric pump; irrigation pump; and double suction pumps. It provides vertical turbine type pumps with hallow shaft motor solid shaft motor HMSS solid shaft motor double suction-double discharge vertical submersible turbine pump and submersible pump in 304 stainless steel; and special pumps for solids comprising A02 sump submersible electric and bare shaft pumps type K  Q S DA and F as well as sells horizontal and vertical electric motors. In addition the company offers after-sales services such as installation commissioning maintenance and overhaul services. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Lima Peru. Hidrostal S.A. is a subsidiary of Hidrostal Holding AG.

Name: Al-Daman for Investments (P.L.C)
Description: Al-Daman for Investments (P.L.C) owns investments in the tourism sector in Jordan. It owns various shops in the Aqaba city; and interest in the Movenpick hotel. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Ferrocarril del Pacífico S.A.
Description: Ferrocarril del Pacífico S.A. operates as a multimodal freight transportation solutions company in Chile. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Estación Central Chile. Ferrocarril del Pacífico S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Puerto Ventanas S.A.

Name: North Cairo Flour Mills
Description: North Cairo Flour Mills engages in the flour milling business in Egypt and other Arabian and African countries. The company’s products include bakers’ biscuit ghariba pizza pies cheese patty Kaiser shorek croissants cake house hold and fertificated flours; and pasta as well as wheat germ shorts and bran. The company offers pasta under the Mina AI Kawthar Pronto and Molino brands. It also exports its products. The company also transports distributes and stores the products. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt. North Cairo Flour Mills is a subsidiary of Food Industries Holding Company SAE.

Name: Beit Jala Pharmaceutical Company
Description: Beit Jala Pharmaceutical Company engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical products in the Palestinian Authority. It provides its products in various forms such as tablets capsules powders oral drops solutions suspensions syrups sprays creams gels lotions ampoules and suppositories. The company also offers medicated shampoos; and sterile products including eye ear and nose drops as well as ear and nose ointments. In addition it exports its products to the Middle East and North Africa region Europe Central Africa and South East Asia. The company was formerly known as Jordan Chemical Laboratory. Beit Jala Pharmaceutical Company was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Beit Jala the Palestinian Authority.

Name: CWG Plc
Description: CWG Plc engages in the supply installation integration maintenance and support of computer equipment e-payment hardware and ancillary equipment in Nigeria Ghana Uganda and Cameroon. It operates through IT Infrastructure Communication and Integrated Services Managed Support Services Software and Platform segments. The IT Infrastructure segment supplies installs and supports computer hardware; and operates middleware systems and automated teller machines. The Communication and Integrated Services segment offers VSAT and fiber connectivity metropolitan area networks wide area networks local area networks and systems integration as well as network communications support services. The Managed Support Services segment provides internal and external clients managed/outsourcing services and related accessories for equipment and service maintenance. The Software segment offers services in software deployment implementation and support systems analysis design and implementation and smartcard applications as well as training to clients on the systems and other off-the-shelf packages. The Platform segment provides products and solutions as the foundation for growth and progress in ecommerce and society such as BillsNPay SMERP UCP and Finedge. The company was formerly known as Computer Warehouse Group Plc. CWG Plc was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Majan College (University College) SAOG
Description: Majan College (University College) SAOG engages in the fields of management sciences scientific research and education to students in the Sultanate of Oman. It also offers programs at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. The company provides its undergraduate programs in the areas of business information technology and English language; and postgraduate programs in the areas of master programs in business administration computer sciences international human resources management and applied linguistics as well as other professional courses. In addition it offers e-learning services under the MOVE Masader and turnitin names. The company was formerly known as College of Administrative Sciences. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman. Majan College (University College) SAOG is a subsidiary of Human Investment LLC.

Name: Watlington Waterworks Limited
Description: Watlington Waterworks Limited through its subsidiary Bermuda Waterworks Limited engages in the production and distribution of water in Bermuda. The company operates through Utility Bottled Water and Others divisions. It manufactures and sells bottled water under the Pure Water brand through grocery stores and directly to customers as well as offers piped drinking water for homes businesses hotels cruise ships occasional ships and residents requiring water for specialized equipment; and purifies drinking water. The company also distributes drinking water through a network of underground pipelines to the central and western parishes of Bermuda. In addition it operates retail store for plumbing supplies such as PVC and CPVC pipe and fittings as well as well pumps and accessories water treatment equipment pressure tanks water heaters in- ground covers for supporting heavy wheel loading larger size pipes pipe repair clamps mechanical couplings deep and shallow wells submersible well pumps sump pumps and others; and sells and rents water coolers as well as provides water services. The company was incorporated in 1932 and is based in Hamilton Bermuda.

Name: Calgro M3 Holdings Limited
Description: Calgro M3 Holdings Limited develops and manages integrated residential properties in South Africa. It operates in two segments Residential Property Development and Memorial Parks. The Residential Property Development segment engages in mid to high income housing and integrated housing developments. The Memorial Parks segment develops and manages memorial parks as well as provides burial rights and associated burial and maintenance services. It also invests in real estate properties. Calgro M3 Holdings Limited was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Bryanston South Africa.

Name: Al Dawliyah For Hotels And Malls P.L.C.
Description: Al Dawliyah For Hotels And Malls P.L.C. develops constructs purchases sells rents and leases hotels restaurants theaters swimming pools and malls in Jordan. The company owns Amman Sheraton Hotel that has 267 rooms and suites. Al Dawliyah For Hotels And Malls P.L.C. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Barka Desalination Company SAOG
Description: Barka Desalination Company SAOG owns designs develops finances constructs operates and maintains a reverse osmosis desalination plant at Barka in the Sultanate of Oman. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Sovereign Trust Insurance Plc
Description: Sovereign Trust Insurance Plc provides non-life and special risk insurance in Nigeria. It offers motor family wellbeing marine cargo and hull travel all risk aviation burglary house breaking consequential loss contractors and erection all risk electronic equipment fidelity guarantee fire and extraneous perils goods in transit healthcare indemnity house holder house owner machinery breakdown money oil and gas personal/group accident plant all risk professional indemnity and workmen’s compensation insurance products as well as builder’s public product and occupiers liability insurance. The company was formerly known as Grand Union Assurances Limited and changed its name to Sovereign Trust Insurance Plc in January 1995. Sovereign Trust Insurance Plc was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Jordan Express Tourist Transport Co. Ltd
Description: Jordan Express Tourist Transport Co. Ltd provides public transportation and tourism bus services in Jordan. It operates through Tourist Transportation Passengers Transportation Fuel and JTT segments. The company offers loyalty cards; mail delivery services such as carrying parcels letters and postal packages; and various tourism programs. It also operates 2 fuel stations. Jordan Express Tourist Transport Co. Ltd was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: United Insurance Company
Description: United Insurance Company operates as an insurance company in Jordan and internationally. It offers life fire and general travel marine liability and cargo hull and machinery motor engineering aviation medical insurance products and services as well as pet insurance products and services. The company was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Copper 360 Limited
Description: Copper 360 Limited engages in the mining and exploration of copper in South Africa. The company produces copper concentrate from ore. It also holds 70% interest in the Namaqua Copper Belt project covering an area of 19000 hectares located in the O'okiep Copper District South Africa. The company was formerly known as Big Tree Copper Limited and changed its name to Copper 360 Limited in November 2022. Copper 360 Limited is based in Stellenbosch South Africa.

Name: General Company For Land Reclamation Development & Reconstruction
Description: General Company For Land Reclamation Development & Reconstruction builds and sells desert plots in Egypt. It also engages in construction of sanitation works gardens and fences. In addition the company involved in commercial agency work; real estate; and sale of agricultural land. Further it engages in electricity network related business. Company For Land Reclamation Development & Reconstruction was founded in 1959 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Domínguez & Cía. S.A.
Description: Domínguez & Cía. S.A. manufactures and markets tin aluminum and plastic packaging products in Venezuela and internationally. The company offers containers for fizzy drinks food aerosol sprays paintings tapas and industrial products. It serves food and beverage industrial and pharmaceutical sectors. The company was founded in 1930 and is based in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Empresa Editora El Comercio S.A.
Description: Empresa Editora El Comercio S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in publishing and distribution of newspapers in Peru. The company produces and markets cardboard folding packages self-adhesive labels; printing of magazines catalogs and books. It also engages in multimedia flexographic and video related services. In addition the company is involved in radio broadcasting and telecommunications services including advertising space through various channels. Empresa Editora El Comercio S.A. was founded in 1839 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Deera Investment & Real Estate Development Co.
Description: Deera Investment & Real Estate Development Co. engages in trading and renting properties in Jordan. The company is involved in the property acquisition and selling land development commercial and residential buildings construction and other related activities. It also engages in the tourism and industrial investment businesses. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Palestine Insurance Company
Description: Palestine Insurance Company engages in the insurance and reinsurance activities in the Palestinian Authority. The company offers ACT and third party liability insurance for all private commercial public transports buses and tourist vehicles; and complementary insurance products. It also provides banker's blanket bond legal or public liability deterioration of stock plate glass electronic equipment product liability workers' compensation engineering marine money fidelity guarantee professional indemnity travel household comprehensive personal accident and fire and natural perils insurance products; and health insurance products. Palestine Insurance Company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Ingenio Azucarero del Norte Compañía de Economía Mixta Iancem
Envases del Pacifico S.A.
Description: Envases del Pacifico S.A. engages in the production and sale of flexible packaging products in Chile. Its products include preformed packaging structures labels and covers and specialty products. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Continental Tire Andina S.A.
Description: Continental Tire Andina S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of tires in Ecuador. It offers tires for car and vans motorcycle bicycle truck and bus agricultural machinery and earth moving and material handling machineries. The company was formerly known as Compania Ecuatoriana del Caucho S.A. and changed its name to Continental Tire Andina S.A. in June 2010. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Quito Ecuador. Continental Tire Andina S.A. is a subsidiary of Continental Tire the Americas LLC.

Name: Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc
Description: Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc provides banking and related services in Tanzania. The company offers savings and current accounts; and credit products comprising microfinance business mortgage working capital consumer and insurance loans. It also provides treasury services such as money and foreign exchange market; ATM and mobile banking services; insurance services including fire motor travel homeowners credit life and assets all risk cover ; and digital agency mobile internet banking and debit card services. The company serves small and medium sized entrepreneurs companies SACCOS institutions such as schools universities hospitals and corporations. Mkombozi Commercial Bank Plc was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Jordanian Real Estate Company for Development
Description: Jordanian Real Estate Company for Development engages in the development and sale of lands and apartments in Jordan. It also offers financial leasing services. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Al-Mashreq Insurance Public Shareholding Company
Description: Al-Mashreq Insurance Public Shareholding Company provides insurance solutions and services in Palestine. The company offers travel personal accident vehicle home fire insurance and associated hazards and other insurance services to individuals; health treason work injury and business trip insurance to employees; and vehicle bank coverage electronic equipment engineering property against all damages money glass fire insurance and associated hazards cargo jewelry store professional liability civil and production liability to businesses. It also engages in investment in trading securities; invests and develops real estate properties and develops land; marine insurance; and manages medical expenses. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: The Arab Ceramic Co.
Description: The Arab Ceramic Co. designs produces and sells sanitary ware faience tiles and other subsidiary products in Egypt. It offers sanitary ware such as water closets and bidets; baby furniture and wall hung washbasins; and laundry products as well as ceramic floor and wall tiles. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Azul Azul S.A.
Description: Azul Azul S.A. engages in organizing producing marketing and participating in professional entertainment and leisure activities of a sporting and recreational nature. It is involved in training activities with sports content. The company also provides equipment and consultancy services of an organizational administrative and event management. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in La Cisterna Chile.

Name: Metalurgica Peruana S.A.
Description: Metalurgica Peruana S.A. engages in the real estate activities in Peru. The company rents movable and immovable properties comprising machinery land and industrial plant. Metalurgica Peruana S.A. was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Refinaria de Petróleos de Manguinhos S.A.
Description: Refinaria de Petróleos de Manguinhos S.A. refines petroleum products in Brazil. The company also offers gasoline A Diesel A S10 and Marine Diesel. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro Brazil. Refinaria de Petróleos de Manguinhos S.A. is a subsidiary of XOROQUE Participações S.A.

Name: Ramallah Summer Resorts Company Ltd.
Description: Ramallah Summer Resorts Company Ltd. owns establishes constructs rents manages operates and maintains hotels houses furnished apartments commercial places shops restaurants cafes cinemas and other properties in Palestinian Authority. The company operates through Hotel Services Rented real estate and Investments in corporate shares segments. It also invests in shares. Ramallah Summer Resorts Company Ltd. was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian Authority.

Name: Ikeja Hotel Plc
Description: Ikeja Hotel Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the operation of hotels and restaurants. It operates through three segments: Rooms Food and Beverage and Other Services. The company is involved in the sale of rooms and rent of office space; and sale of food and beverages through restaurants and bar. It also operates Sheraton Lagos Hotel and Federal Palace Hotels and Casino. In addition the company provides catering and advisory and consultancy services; develops hotel leisure facilities; apartment letting activities; recreational facilities; and operates night clubs and business centre services. The company was formerly known as Properties Development Limited. Ikeja Hotel Plc was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Hipermarc S.A.
Description: Hipermarc S.A. distributes and commercializes light and medium vehicles and motorcycles in Chile and Argentina. The company operates through Real Investments and Leases; Real Estate Leases; Agro-Industry; and Automotive segments. It also produces and markets frozen fruits and vegetables; invests and leases real estate properties; and offers transportation services. The company was formerly known as Supermercados Unimarc S.A. and changed its name to Hipermarc S.A. in 2008. Hipermarc S.A. was founded in 1961 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Mena for Touristic & Real Estate Investment
Description: Mena for Touristic & Real Estate Investment engages in the construction real estate investment project management and urban development businesses in Egypt and internationally. Its portfolio includes residential commercial and resort projects. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Maadi Egypt.

Name: MPICO plc
Description: MPICO plc engages in the development rental and management of commercial residential retail and industrial properties in Malawi. It has investment properties primarily in Lilongwe and Blantyre. The company rents its properties to the government and the private sector. MPICO plc was incorporated in 1972 and is based in Lilongwe Malawi.

Name: Almehanya for Real Estate Investments & Housing Co. P.L.C.
Description: Almehanya for Real Estate Investments & Housing Co. P.L.C. together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate investment development and management activities in Jordan. It develops and sells residential commercial industrial and tourist projects; and provides real estate management services such as buying selling leasing maintenance and improvement of properties as well as supervision of buildings. The company also invests in securities and banks deposits; trades in financial assets; and provides other services including importing exporting and re-exporting devices equipment machinery and materials for construction work and real estate projects. Almehanya for Real Estate Investments & Housing Co. P.L.C. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Arab Co.for asset management and development
Description: Arab Co.for asset management and development operates as a real estate development company. The company purchases sells leases and acquires land for the purpose of dividing planning and providing infrastructure to the land under management. It is also involved in the development and management of buildings including residential and commercial units malls hypermarkets office spaces and recreational areas as well as builds and manages tourist villages hotels motels and related activities including entertainment sports commercial and cultural activities. In addition it offers advisory services for the preparation of designs and engineering consultancy and supervision of project execution. The company holds as land bank of approximately 588 thousand square meters in Egypt. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Tamkeen Insurance Company
Description: Tamkeen Insurance Company together with its subsidiaries provides insurance products and services to individuals and institutions in Palestine. The company offers medical care for COVID-19 infection motor group life health lift loss of profit and business interruption erection all risks contractors plants and machinery travel personal accidents medical malpractices marine cargo household comprehensive fire and allied perils contractor all risk workmen compensation product liability money insurance plate glass fidelity guarantee professional indemnity and third party liability insurance. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Ramallah the Palestinian Authority.

Name: Atlas for Investment & Food Industries
Description: Atlas for Investment & Food Industries engages in the agricultural processing real estate and farm development businesses in Egypt. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Giza Egypt.

Name: Kapchorua Tea Kenya Plc
Description: Kapchorua Tea Kenya Plc engages in the cultivation manufacture and sale of tea in Kenya. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Kapchorua Tea Company Limited and changed its name to Kapchorua Tea Kenya Plc in August 2017. Kapchorua Tea Kenya Plc was founded in 1869 and is based in Nandi Hills Kenya.

Name: Salam International Transport and Trading Company
Description: Salam International Transport and Trading Company provides solutions and services to the shipping logistics and transportation oil and gas logistics and construction catering and life support services and construction and real estate industries in Jordan. It owns and operates a fleet of vessels including barges RoRo's passenger ships multipurpose vessels and Panamaxes; manages vessels comprising high speed crafts container ships bulk carriers and livestock carriers and oil tankers; and operates Jordan Academy for Maritime Studies a private institution located in Abu Nusair. The company also provides canvassing and cargo booking solutions for third party shippers and ship-owners; and marine vessel traffic management and ship way services as well as hydrographic surveys to various vessels visiting the Port of Aqaba. In addition it offers land transportation services such as multi-modal transportation warehousing and storage sea and land ports cargo handling custom clearance and inland haulage services for various types sizes and weights of cargoes; and freight forwarding storage and handling heavy lifts and support services. Further the company is involved in the handling and storage of petro products and chemicals oil and gas transportation and logistics and supply activities; the provision of catering services to specialized projects maritime companies industrial institutions container terminals corporate firms and commercial audiences; hospitality support services; general trading services; and real estate investment and development activities. Additionally it undertakes construction and civil works/projects. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Compañía Chilena de Fósforos S.A.
Description: Compañía Chilena de Fósforos S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the production and marketing of matches in Chile. The company also provides safety matches splints popsicle sticks traps paint palettes ice cream sticks and ties coffee stir sticks closet doors stairs security doors blinds moldings paint palettes and wooden rules as well as wooden cutlery products such as spoons forks and knifes. In addition it engages in the development and exploitation of forestry agricultural and fruit plantations. The company also exports its products to the United States Peru Brazil Fiji and Japan. The company was incorporated in 1913 and is based in Santiago Chile. Compañía Chilena de Fósforos S.A. is a subsidiary of Inversiones San Martin S.A.

Name: Oman & Emirates Investment Holding Company SAOG
Description: Oman & Emirates Investment Holding Company SAOG is a principal investment firm. It is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Swissport Tanzania Plc
Description: Swissport Tanzania Plc provides airport ground and cargo handling and airport lounge services in the United Republic of Tanzania. The company operates through three segments: Ground Handling Services Cargo Handling Services and Lounge business. It offers passenger services such as passenger check-in and gate passenger mobility security services lost and found and lounge hospitality services; and ramp handling services including baggage central load control aircraft cleaning moving of aircraft and turnaround coordination services. The company also provides air cargo handling services that consist of general and special cargo handling hub handling forwarder handling and temperature-controlled handling as well as express service; and executive aviation services comprising executive terminals access customs and immigration assistance passenger and crew assistance vip and crew lounges personalized service delivery car rental hotel and restaurant reservations. In addition it offers lounges services such as unlimited complementary food and drinks and refreshments and snacks free WiFi flight information display kids playing area and printing and workstation as well as rest rooms and shower locker disabled toilet and baby changing facility services. Swissport Tanzania Plc was founded in 1984 and is based in Dar es Salaam the United Republic of Tanzania. Swissport Tanzania Plc is a subsidiary of Swissport International Ltd.

Name: Azevedo & Travassos Energia S.A.
Description: Azevedo & Travassos Energia S.A. engages in the exploration production and marketing of oil and natural gas in Brazil. It holds concession contracts in exploratory fields and blocks as well as partnerships that focuses on the development of onshore oil and gas production in the Potiguar Basin with focus on the Mossoró/RN region. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: SHARM DREAMS Co. for Touristic Investment S.A.E
Description: Sharm Dreams Co. for Touristic Investment S.A.E. engages in the development of tourist entertainment and mixed-use real estate projects. The company’s property portfolio comprises hotels boutique hotels resorts vacation clubs water parks downtown areas a spa Island real estate units villas and townhouses. It also owns and manages medical tourism centers and hospitals. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: First Finance Company
Description: First Finance Company provides various financial products and services for individuals and companies in Jordan. The company provides direct financing of consumer and durable goods; real estate financing including financing of lands housing buildings and constructions; and financing the establishment of private and public projects. It also offers audit and assurance services such as external and internal audit services; tax consultation and other services; and advisory services. In addition the company serves travel and aviation business financial services and energy and environment consulting sectors as well as consumer product and transport logistic industries. First Finance Company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Bahrain Flour Mills Company B.S.C.
Description: Bahrain Flour Mills Company B.S.C. engages in the production and sale of flour and related products in the Kingdom of Bahrain and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It offers all purpose pizza whole meal and self-raising flours as well as dumpling mixes; and grains such as hab harees jereesh and semolina. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is based in Manama the Kingdom of Bahrain. Bahrain Flour Mills Company B.S.C. is a subsidiary of Bahrain Food Holding Company W.L.L.

Name: Trevisa Investimentos S.A.
Description: Trevisa Investimentos S.A. through its subsidiaries engages in transportation services for bulk and general cargo by waterways in Brazil and internationally. The company offers transportation services for cellulose container military soybean meals wheat corn fertilizers clink mineral coal and wooden logs. It also leases commercial rooms. The company operates a fleet of approximately 27 vessels. Trevisa Investimentos S.A. was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre Brazil.

Name: Jordan Hotels and Tourism Company
Description: Jordan Hotels and Tourism Company owns operates and manages Intercontinental Hotel Jordan in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1955 and is based in Amman Jordan. Jordan Hotels and Tourism Company is a subsidiary of Zara Investment Holding Company.

Name: Ismailia / Misr Poultry Company S.A.E
Description: Ismailia / Misr Poultry Company S.A.E engages in the poultry business in Egypt. It is involved in the raising of poultry broiler broodstock and table egg broodstock as well as day-old broiler chicks producing chicks and broiler chickens; manufacturing of feed such as poultry and fish feed; establishing and managing of automated poultry slaughterhouses; marketing of animal protein and oils; production of whole frozen and chilled chicken; sale and marketing of poultry and its products municipal fertilizer and the output of poultry farms; and attaching units Water treatment and waste treatment cooker. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Ismaïlia Egypt. Ismailia / Misr Poultry Company S.A.E is a subsidiary of Al Ismaelia for Real Estate Investment S.A.E.

Name: Murray & Roberts Holdings Limited
Description: Murray & Roberts Holdings Limited operates as a multinational engineering and construction company in South Africa rest of Africa Australasia and South East Asia North America and internationally. The company provides development engineering procurement construction commissioning operations and maintenance solutions to the metals minerals and renewable energy sectors. It also offers services for mining platforms including feasibility studies specialist engineering vertical and decline shaft construction mine development and specialist mining services such as raise boring and grouting underground construction and material handling solutions as well as contract mining for projects. In addition the company provides materials handling design consulting design/supply sourcing and general contracting to the mining and minerals processing phosphate waste coal aggregate cement and other bulk materials industries; and project and construction management services. Murray & Roberts Holdings Limited was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Bedfordview South Africa.

Name: AlKhair River for Development Agricultural Investment and Environmental Services
Futura Consorcio Inmobiliario S.A.
Description: Futura Consorcio Inmobiliario S.A. engages in real estate development activities. It is also involved in the managing real estate investments. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in San Isidro Peru. Futura Consorcio Inmobiliario S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Breca Inmobiliaria S.A.C.

Name: Indies Pharma Jamaica Limited
Description: Indies Pharma Jamaica Limited engages in the distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and auxiliary products in Jamaica. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Montego Bay Jamaica. Indies Pharma Jamaica Limited is a subsidiary of Bioprist Holdings Inc.

Name: Jerusalem Cigarette Co. Ltd.
Description: Jerusalem Cigarette Co. Ltd. produces markets and sells cigarettes. It also manages leased and not leased properties. In addition the company exports its products. Jerusalem Cigarette Co. Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Al Eizariya Palestinian Authority.

Name: Agra Limited
Description: Agra Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the agricultural retail and wholesale business in Namibia. It operates in four segments: Retail and Wholesale Auctions Rental and ProVision. The company offers hardware paint and accessories building materials tools and electrical products; convenience stores which include fast food bread coffee groceries beverages snacks ice and braai essentials such as charcoal and wood; water equipment pesticides and fertilizers animal health products hardware and gardening supplies and equestrian accessories; veterinary pharmaceuticals veterinary medicines and over-the-counter products; hunting camping fishing and safari equipment; firearms ammunition and telescopes as well as expert advice; sports rifles; and agricultural supplies animal feed veterinary supplies fencing materials seed fertilizer tools hardware farming infrastructure personal protective equipment building materials home improvement items automotive products and everyday household essentials. It also provides mentorship programs training courses consultancy services and technological advice for business development farming and production management; and education and training with e-learning platform. In addition the company organizes and facilitates auction and liaison services of livestock and agricultural products; measures the performance of various commercial and residential rental properties; and markets and auctions movable goods and agricultural industrial commercial and residential properties online as well as invests in upgrades and renovates residential and commercial properties. Further it operates Auas shopping mall with retail outlets offering fast-moving consumables outdoor products restaurants personal grooming services medical practitioners pharmacy and DIY and farming essentials; and operates fuel stations. Agra Limited was founded in 1946 and is based in Windhoek Namibia.

Name: Gasco Inversiones S.A.
Description: Gasco Inversiones S.A. develops and sells real estate properties in Chile. It invests in properties as well as leases real estate properties. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile.

Name: Clínica de Marly S.A.
Description: Clínica de Marly S.A. provides health services in Colombia. The company offers services in the areas of anesthesia bronchoscopy cardiology bariatric surgery column surgery hand surgery general surgery maxillofacial surgery plastic and reconstructive surgery other surgery pain clinic coloproctology palliative care dermatology endocrinology physiatry gastroenterology gynecology hematology diagnostic imaging infectology and neurodiagnostic and pathology laboratory. It also provides vascular laboratory non-invasive method internal medicine nephrology neonatology and pediatrics pneumology functional and restorative neurosurgery neurology ophthalmology clinical oncology orthopedics and traumatology otorhinolaryngology psychiatry rheumatology bone marrow transplant intermediate and intensive care unit outpatient chemotherapy clinical laboratory maternal fetal medicine unit emergency and urology as well as digestive physiology laboratory services. In addition the company offers supporting services including blood bank wound and ostomy scan or CT hemodialysis or renal therapies digital mammography physical medicine and rehabilitation; minor surgical procedure services such as simple sutures resection of skin lesions and blocks and other services; diagnostic aid and medical directory services; and vaccinations for polio hepatitis A hepatitis B human papilloma virus herpes zoster influenza pneumonia diphtheria tetanus and pertussis tetanus measles mumps and rubella meningitis and yellow fever chickenpox as well as paramedic consultation services for nutrition psychology optometry neuropsychology occupational therapy speech therapy and phonoaudiology respiratory therapy and pelvic floor therapy. Clínica de Marly S.A. was founded in 1903 and is based in Bogotá Colombia.

Name: Global United Insurance Company
Description: Global United Insurance Company engages in the insurance business in the Palestinian Authority. It offers motor general accident engineering workers' compensation civil liability fire life marine shop clinic and investment insurance. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Nablus Palestinian Authority.

Name: Credifamilia Compañía de Financiamiento S.A.
Description: Credifamilia Compañía de Financiamiento S.A. a financing company specializes in providing credit and savings solutions in Colombia. It offers mortgage loans for acquiring or remodeling new or used houses; investment services; insurance products; and savings accounts. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Bogotá Colombia.

Name: Paranapanema S.A.
Description: Paranapanema S.A. produces and sells copper and its byproducts in Brazil and internationally. Its products include cathodes rebar drawn wire sulfuric acid oleum iron silicate and anode sludge from which precious metals are extracted; and copper and bronze connections for hot and cold water and pipes for industrial and residential gas and fire-fighting systems. The company also offers semi-finished products of copper and copper alloys; and laminates wires bars and profiles that are used for manufacturing parts and components in automotive electronics apparel hardware bathroom fixture stamping and machining industries. In addition it provides copper tubes for used in domestic and industrial air conditioning systems compressors components and other refrigeration systems as well as civil construction. Further the company offers its products under the Caraíba Eluma and Paranapanema brands. Paranapanema S.A. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Santo André Brazil.

Name: Grupo Zuliano C.A.
Description: Grupo Zuliano C.A. an investment fund company engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical or petrochemical products. It produces and sells polymer grade propylene; polypropylene homopolymer and copolymer grades; and polyethylene low-density polyethylene and linear resins as well as polyethylene blends. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Maracaibo Venezuela.

Name: Misr Oils & Soap
Description: Misr Oils & Soap manufactures and trades in oils detergents and soaps in Egypt and internationally. The company offers sunflower corn mixture cotton seed and soybean oils; other packaging products; and toilet medical laundry kitchen and other special soaps as well as liquid detergents. The company also produces animal/fish/poultry feeds and other protein products; and distilled glycerin and cotton products. In addition it rents and leases factories; and manufactures tin containers. Misr Oils & Soap was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Stationery and Office Supplies Limited
Description: Stationery and Office Supplies Limited sells office furniture fixtures stationery and other office supplies in Jamaica. It operates through three segments: Books Furniture and Stationery and Other Supplies. The company offers big and tall folding guest and reception high-back leather task student and medium-back chairs as well as stools sofa and chair accessories; desks and accessories; folding occasional conference and collaborative tables; industrial heavy duty and standard shelving products and warehousing accessories; lateral filing products storage cupboards lockers filing and fireproof cabinets metal pedestal mobile storage unit and cabinet accessories; and partitions. It also provides books notebooks and pads badges batteries binders binding machines combs and covers wastepaper bins boards and easels book and catalogue stands cable ties/tie straps calculators carbon papers cards card holders cash pans chair mats clips and fasteners clocks computer accessories correction fluids and tapes desk organizers and accessories dairies envelops erasers folders and filings glue file guides key cabinets labels label makers and tapes chalk highlighter marker miscellaneous office supplies papers pencils pens sharpeners ladders laminators and supplies office accessories lamps paper trimmers post-it notes and flags punches push pins printers ribbons rubber bands rulers rolls scissors seek branded products sheet protectors stamps stamp pads and inks staplers and staples storage and organizer products surge protectors tags tape and tape dispensers telephone accessories thumb drives and tacks toilet paper/hand towel trays as well as shredders and safes. The company was incorporated in 1965 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Stationery and Office Supplies Limited is a subsidiary of Outlook Limited.

Name: Quilicura S.A.
Description: Quilicura S.A. manufactures and sells metal cylinders to store liquefied petroleum gas in Chile. The company also offers reinspection and repair services; and LPG cylinder maintenance service for liquefied gas distribution companies. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Palestine Securities Exchange Company P.L.C.
Description: Palestine Securities Exchange Company P.L.C. operates a security exchange market. Its trading system includes listed companies operating in the banking and financial service insurance investment industrial and service sectors. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Nablus Palestine.

Name: National Drilling Company
Description: National Drilling Company engages in the oil drilling activities in Egypt. It provides oil and gas drilling services including land drilling and workover activities and related services; technical support detection equipment and subsistence services; and maintenance of oil wells for operator companies. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Medical Packaging Company
Description: Medical Packaging Company produces and sells glass packaging products for pharmaceutical and medical purposes in Egypt and internationally. It offers a range of ampoules vials and aluminum caps for use in the packaging of various pharmaceutical liquid products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Sociedad Agrícola La Rosa Sofruco S.A.
Description: Sociedad Agrícola La Rosa Sofruco S.A. engages in the production and sale of agricultural products in Chile. It offers fresh fruits dehydrated fruits nuts plums and honey and natural juices. The company also sells its products online. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1824 and is based in Santiago Chile. Sociedad Agrícola La Rosa Sofruco S.A. is a subsidiary of Compania de Inversiones Mobiliaria e Inmobiliaria Mar del Plata S.A.

Name: Euro Arab Insurance Group Plc.
Description: Euro Arab Insurance Group Plc. provides various insurance products in Jordan and internationally. It offers life motor marine transport fire and other damages to property theft liability and medical insurance products. The company was formerly known as Amman Insurance Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Euro Arab Insurance Group Plc. in 2002. Euro Arab Insurance Group Plc. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Euro Arab Insurance Group Plc. operates as a subsidiary of Comsal Ltd.

Name: Grupo Toky S.A.
Description: Grupo Toky S.A. operates in the electronic commerce business. It retails various articles in the furniture decorative items housewares children garden and leisure remodeling and garage electro and other sectors which focuses on direct sales to consumers and indirect sales through partnering companies. The company engages in the activities related to the logistics of furniture to third parties. In addition it sells its products through www.mobly.com.br website. Grupo Toky S.A. was formerly known as Mobly S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Toky S.A. in May 2025. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in São Paulo Brazil. Grupo Toky S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Home24 Holding Gmbh & Co. Kg.

Name: Linkage Assurance Plc
Description: Linkage Assurance Plc engages in the non-life insurance business in Nigeria. The company offers motor insurance; property insurance including fire and allied peril theft and burglary all-risk business interruption house owner and householder comprehensive and industrial all risk products; group personal accident fidelity guarantee money and goods in transit insurance products; liability group insurance; and builders’ liability occupier’s liability healthcare professional indemnity and travel insurance products. It also provides marine cargo and hull and aviation insurance; agriculture insurance products comprising poultry livestock fish farm farm property and produce multi-perils crop and area yield index-based insurance as well as insurance related to oil and gas; and contractors’ all risks erection all risks plant all risks machinery breakdown electronics and telco equipment construction turnkey project and boiler and pressure vessel insurance products. In addition the company offers third party motor shop and small and medium sized organizations insurance products. Further it provides risk management advisory services. Linkage Assurance Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Alimentos Derivados de la Caña S. A.
Description: Alimentos Derivados de la Caña S. A. engages in the production and sale of sugar cane. The company was formerly known as Industria de Alimentos Pontevedra S.A. and changed its name to Alimentos Derivados de la Caña S. A. in January 2003. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Cali Colombia. Alimentos Derivados de la Caña S. A. is a subsidiary of Ingenio La Cabaña S.A.

Name: Inmobiliaria San Patricio S.A.
Description: Inmobiliaria San Patricio S.A. engages in the real estate business in Chile. The company acquires manages exploits markets leases subleases buys and sell real estate properties for residential commercial industrial agricultural and forestry. It also involved in production processing industrialization and marketing of forest goods and related wood products. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Las Condes Chile. Inmobiliaria San Patricio S.A. is a subaisiary of Inversiones Cordillera Inmobiliaria Spa.

Name: National Real Estate Development and Investments Company SAOG
Description: National Real Estate Development and Investments Company SAOG engages in renting and managing self-owned or leased real estate properties. The company was formerly known as National Real Estate Development Company SAOG and changed its name to National Real Estate Development and Investments Company SAOG in 2016. National Real Estate Development Company SAOG was founded in 1974 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Al-Wataniah towers Co.
Description: Al-Wataniah towers Co. buys sells and invests in land and real estate properties. It also mortgages lands; furnishes apartments and real estate; and develops and manages investments in various economic commercial industrial service and other fields. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Al Bireh Palestinian Authority. Al-Wataniah towers Co. operates as a subsidiary of National Insurance Company (Palestine).

Name: Muscat Insurance Company SAOG
Description: Muscat Insurance Company SAOG provides general and life insurance products to corporate SME and individual customers in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers individual general insurance products including home safe motor and householders comprehensive motor third party liability domestic and accident safe travel and pleasure craft insurance products; and individual life and health insurance products such as individual term insurance family floater medical insurance and child annuity products. It also provides corporate general insurance products that includes property all risk business interruption/loss of profit and sabotage and terrorism insurance; contractors all risks and third party insurance erection all risks and third-party liability machinery breakdown machinery breakdown loss of profit electronic equipment and contractors plant and machinery insurance policies; comprehensive general liability professional indemnity directors and officers liability medical malpractice employers liability motor fleet comprehensive and third party and deterioration of stocks insurance products; and money fidelity guarantee group personal accident group travel marine and inland transit and marine hull insurance products. In addition the company offers corporate life and health insurance products including group medical group life with workmen compensation and group credit life insurance policies. The company was formerly known as Muscat National Holding Company SAOG and changed its name to Muscat Insurance Company SAOG in August 2017. Muscat Insurance Company SAOG was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Arabian Steel Pipes Manufacturing Co.
Description: Arabian Steel Pipes Manufacturing Co. manufactures and sells various pipes and tubes in Jordan. The company offers black and galvanized seam welded steel pipes for use in water lines gas lines firefighting HVAC lines and electric poles; and coated pipes. It also provides round tubes and pipes; square and rectangular tubes; riser pipes for water well pumps oil and water lubricated vertical turbines and submersible pumps; and telecom towers for cellular communications as well as fabricates steel accessories for telecom sites such as tower/poles and wall antenna brackets special roof top solutions steel beams steel fences steel ladders AC steel cages cable tray supports and special steel structures. In addition the company provides tubular poles for low voltage electric power transmission; and lattice poles for medium and high voltage electrical power transmission as well as lattice steel towers for overhead electrical power transmission lines. Further it provides hot-dip galvanizing for various steel structures. The company also exports its products to Iraq Syria Palestine Lebanon Egypt Libya and Yemen as well as North America. Arabian Steel Pipes Manufacturing Co. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: ODIN Investments (S.A.E)
Description: ODIN Investments (S.A.E) engages in the financing and investment business in Egypt. The company’s services include investment banking services including mergers and acquisitions deals initial public offering (IPO) transactions private placement offerings and other financial services; private equity services; asset management services for institutional or individual investors; and venture capital services comprising financial managerial and technical services. It also invests in industrial services real estate and financial sectors. The company was formerly known as Egyptians Abroad Investment & Development Co. and changed its name to ODIN Investments (S.A.E) in August 2019. ODIN Investments (S.A.E) was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Giza Egypt.

Name: Radio Jamaica Limited
Description: Radio Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiaries operates free-to-air television cable television and radio stations primarily in Jamaica. The company operates through Audio Visual; Audio; and Print and Other segments. It is also involved in the publication of news in print and digital media as well as multi-media business. The company operates its platforms under the Television Jamaica Limited The Gleaner RJR 94FM The Star Power 106FM FAME 95FM HITZ 92FM Music 99FM 1spotmedia Real Jamaican Television Jamaica News Network and TVJ Sports Network brand names. The company is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Williamson Tea Kenya Plc
Description: Williamson Tea Kenya Plc together with its subsidiaries engages in the cultivation manufacture and sale of tea in Kenya and internationally. It operates tea farms in the areas of Changoi Kaimosi Kapchorua and Tinderet. The company also invests in properties. Williamson Tea Kenya Plc was founded in 1869 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. Williamson Tea Kenya Plc is a subsidiary of Ngong Tea Holdings Limited.

Name: Fiplasto S.A.
Description: Fiplasto S.A. produces and sells hardboard and furniture. It offers a range of products for industry construction and home purpose including chapadur and blackboards; and furniture for bedroom living bathroom and offices. The company offers its products in Germany Belize Bolivia Canada Chile China Costa Rica Ecuador El Salvador Scotland Spain the United States the Philippines Guatemala England Jamaica Panama Paraguay Puerto Rico Republic Dominican and Uruguay. Fiplasto S.A. was founded in 1945 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Cartier Saada SA
Description: Cartier Saada SA together with its subsidiaries engages in processing of preserved fruits and vegetables in Morocco. Its products include olives apricots artichokes capers preserved lemons pickles harissa and white onions as well as citrus fruits. The company is also involved in the import and export and distribution of various consumer food products. It exports its products to approximately 30 countries across 5 continents. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Marrakech Morocco.

Name: Golden Wheat Mills P.L.C
Description: Golden Wheat Mills P.L.C produces and sells flour and its derivative products in Palestine. The company offers semolina wheat flour bran and other food products. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Ramallah Palestine.

Name: Amad investment and real estate development company
Description: Amad investment and real estate development company operates in construction contracts and real estate business in Jordan. The company was formerly known as Amad & Hamdi Housing Company Plc and changed its name to Amad investment and real estate development company in 2006. Amad investment and real estate development company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Zambia Bata Shoe Company plc
Description: Zambia Bata Shoe Company plc engages in the manufacture and sale of footwear products primarily in Zambia. It offers men’s women’s and children’s shoes as well as back to school and sports shoes. The company was founded in 1937 and is based in Lusaka Zambia.

Name: CIABRASF - Cia. Brasileira de Serviços Financeiros S/A
