Description: CIABRASF - Cia. Brasileira de Serviços Financeiros S/A provides fund management and fiduciary services solutions in Brazil. It offers services such as trustee public offerings controller custody bookkeeping and legal tax and custody representation for non-resident investors. The company was formerly known as Cia. Brasileira de Serviços Financeiros S/A. CIABRASF - Cia. Brasileira de Serviços Financeiros S/A was incorporated in 2023 and is based in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: 4Sight Holdings Limited
Description: 4Sight Holdings Limited provides technology solutions in South Africa rest of Africa Europe the Middle East and Australasia and the Americas. The company offers asset automation solutions including intelligent motor control process automation system digital energy cyber security and IIoT; asset optimization solutions comprising manufacturing execution system process control asset performance management and simulation; asset simulation solutions; and enterprise resource planning HR and payroll business intelligence and reporting fixed asset and customer relationship management solutions. It also provides digital enterprise cybersecurity software and application development adoption and change management data enablement and intelligent automation solutions; and distributes and supports artificial intelligence solutions on behalf of software vendors such as Microsoft and Sage as well as a range of vertical and horizontal ISV applications. The company serves agriculture car rentals education engineering export financial services healthcare hospitality importing and clearing agents logistics manufacturing mining oil and gas power and utilities professional services property management retail software supply and consulting telcos and infrastructure transport and warehousing and distribution industries as well as government and public sectors regulatory bodies project based companies and non-profit organizations. 4Sight Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Four Ways South Africa.

Name: Jordan Vegetable Oil Industries Co. Ltd.
Description: Jordan Vegetable Oil Industries Co. Ltd. produces and sells vegetable oils and ghee under the Al-Ghazal brand name in the Middle East. It offers corn soya and sunflower oil as well as palm olein. The company was incorporated in 1953 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Precision Air Services Plc
Description: Precision Air Services Plc provides regional and domestic air carriage of passengers and cargo. The company flies to 14 destinations within and outside Tanzania including Arusha Kilimanjaro Mwanza Bukoba Mtwara Dodoma Tabora Seronera- Serengeti Zanzibar Mbeya and Kahama as well as Nairobi Hahaya and Anjoun. It also provides ground handling services. Its fleet consists of five ATR 72-500 two ATR 42-600 and one ATR 42-500. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: Crookes Brothers Limited
Description: Crookes Brothers Limited an investment holding company engages in the agricultural business in South Africa Eswatini Zambia and Mozambique. The company grows sugar cane bananas and macadamia nuts. It is also involved in the development and sale of industrial commercial and residential property as well as leases building. In addition the company engages in tourism business as well as provision of utility services related to the property development. The company was founded in 1860 and is headquartered in Umhlanga South Africa.

Name: Extracted Oil & Derivatives Co.
Description: Extracted Oil & Derivatives Co. manufactures and sells edible oils in Egypt. The company offers sunflower oil under the Mira name; soyabean oil under the Al Fayrouz name; corn oil under the AL Safa name; and cotton seed oil under the Faransawy name as well as blended oils under the Mixola AL Marwa and Marmoura names. It also offers ghee under the Hawanem Hania Fine el Nakhil and Hanya names; and shortening and margarines under the Margrine Golden Shortening and Lecithin names. In addition the company provides toilet soaps under the Canary Soap Pensée Oliva Rosa and Astra names; laundry soaps under the Domino and Diana names; and crude and distilled glycerol for medical and pharmaceutical applications. Further it offers sulphonic acid and liquid sodium silicate; low and high foam detergent powders under the Hattric and Croc names; liquid detergent under the Pensee name; and animal feed including soyabean meal cattle fodder and cotton seed meal. The company was founded in 1959 and is headquartered in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: TOL Gases Limited
Description: TOL Gases Limited produces and distributes industrial gases medical gases and related accessories in Tanzania. The company offers gas products such as ammonia dry ice nitrogen compressed carbon dioxide industrial oxygen helium medical/compressed air medical oxygen acetylene argon nitrous oxide and argo shield. It also provides gas welding and cutting products including acetylene regulators flashback arrestor acetylene and oxygen with brand flash back arrestor oxygen blue hose pipes copper coated mild steel OK 98.7 gas rods coupling nuts and nipple RHS cutting attachments and nozzles cutting torches double stage oxygen regulators flip front helmets nozzle cleaners oxygen regulators shanks red hose pipe-acetylenes spark lighters and spindle keys. It serves mining food and beverage healthcare chemicals glass and minerals manufacturing energy water and waste construction and paints and coatings industries. The company was formerly known as Tanzania Oxygen Limited. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania. TOL Gases Limited is a subsidiary of SAAMI Holdings Ltd.

Name: Unirab Polvara Spinning & Weaving Co.
Description: Unirab Polvara Spinning & Weaving Co. manufactures markets and trades in spinning and weaving cotton wool silk linen fiber industrial and raw textiles sewing threads and related raw materials in Egypt. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: May & Baker Nigeria plc
Description: May & Baker Nigeria Plc together with its subsidiaries manufactures sells and distributes human pharmaceuticals human vaccines and consumer products in Nigeria. It operates through Pharmaceuticals and Beverage segments. The company offers pharmaceuticals including anti-diabetic anti-hypersensitive anti-infective anti-malaria analgesic cough and cold and anxiolytics; and nature care products. It also provides beverage drinks including bottled water under the Lily Water name; and hand and surface sanitizers under the Smartans name. In addition the company engages in contract manufacturing of pharmaceutical products; and in healthcare and industrial packaging. May & Baker Nigeria Plc was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Construtora Adolpho Lindenberg S.A.
Description: Construtora Adolpho Lindenberg S.A. operates as a construction company in Brazil. The company engages in the execution and administration of civil construction works as well as incorporation of real estate developments. It also provides contracting services. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Japaul Gold & Ventures Plc
Description: Japaul Gold & Ventures Plc provides oil and maritime services in Nigeria. The company operates through Dredging Services Quarry Services Offshore Services and Construction Services segments. It is also involved in swamp reclamation sand stock pilling and artificial island creation as well as engages in channelization and maintenance of river channel services. In addition the company is involved in mining leases for gold lead zinc lithium and copper. Further it engages in platform support vessels anchor handling tug supply vessels offshore support vessels and oil tankers related businesses. Additionally the company offers quarry crushing and haulage activities as well as rents equipment. The company was formerly known as Japaul Oil & Maritime Services Plc. Japaul Gold & Ventures Plc was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ikeja Nigeria.

Name: Naeem Real Estate Holding Group
Description: Naeem Real Estate Holding Group operates as a real estate investment vehicle. Its investments include land plots for business parks and touristic projects in Giza and Marsa Alam; and office parks in Egypt and the Middle East. Description: Ubar Hotels & Resorts SAOG owns and operates hotels in the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates through Ubar Hotels and Resorts SAOG; and Al Ahlam Hotel Management LLC segments. It owns operates and manages the Golden Tulip hotels in Nizwa and Muscat. The company was formerly known as Interior Hotels Company SAOG and changed its name to Ubar Hotels & Resorts SAOG in March 2013. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Nizwa the Sultanate of Oman. Ubar Hotels & Resorts SAOG is a subsidiary of Mohammed Al Barwani Investment L.L.C.

Name: Lumber Depot Limited
Description: Lumber Depot Limited sells lumber hardware supplies and related products in Jamaica. The company offers range of hardware electrical plumbing and construction supplies. It serves building contractors tradesmen public and private institutions as well as homeowners doing construction projects renovations and repairs. Lumber Depot Limited was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Philadelphia Pharmaceuticals Company
Description: Philadelphia Pharmaceuticals Company develops manufactures and markets human pharmaceutical products cosmetics and medical devices of various therapeutic categories in Jordan. The company provides products for skin related disorders including anti-lice and scabicides preparations antiseptics and disinfectants bleaching and hyperpigmentation disorders preparations emollients and protectives keratolytics/topical psoriasis treatment preparations and skin healing agents as well as agents for dermatitis; and topical acne preparation anti-pruritic anti-viral plain antifungal and anti-infective plain steroid steroids with antifungal/anti-infective combination and skin recoloring products. It also offers products for women health such as vaginal antifungals alkalinizing and cleansing agents antimicrobials germicidal fungicidal antiseptics and hemostatic and vaginal progesterone; and products in the areas of alimentary gastrointestinal system anti-inflammatory analgesic antipyretic dental-oropharyngeal hair care local anesthetics and respiratory system as well as supplements and health care-OTC products. The company also exports its products in the Middle East and North Africa region. Philadelphia Pharmaceuticals Company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Alfin Banco S.A.
Description: Alfin Banco S.A. provides various banking and financial products and services. It offers savings and fixed deposits; home equity loans loan with vehicle guarantee and motorcycle loan; debit cards; and money transfer interbank transfer fee payment immediate transfers programmed payments and currencies buying and selling services. It also provides protected debt and family multiprotection life plus credit and easy life insurance; credit insurance plus; tax credit insurance with return; debt plus insurance with refund; secured armored card+; and safe walk easy protection solutions. The company is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Bahema Educação S.A.
Description: Bahema Educação S.A. together with its subsidiaries provides education services in Brazil. The company operates schools and training centers. It also offers basic and continuing education services; early childhood education courses; entrance exam preparation courses; and elementary secondary and related services. The company was formerly known as Bahema S.A. and changed its name to Bahema Educação S.A. in August 2019. Bahema Educação S.A. was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Future Arab Investment Company
Description: Future Arab Investment Company operates as an investment company. The company engages in the import export sale and distribution of raw materials for the food industry as well as equipment for restaurants hotels and supermarkets; filling and packaging of foodstuffs; manufacturing of ready mixes and flavors for food industries; importing exporting trading installing and maintaining surveillance and protection systems alarms and cameras; real estate; agricultural products trading; buying owning renting sorting developing and organizing lands; provision of parcel receiving and distribution services; and production of raw materials and foodstuffs. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Delmon Poultry Company B.S.C.
Description: Delmon Poultry Company B.S.C. engages in the process and sale of chicken in the Kingdom of Bahrain. It operates through four segments: Chicken Feed Chicks and Investment. The company is also involved in the feedmill and chick hatchery businesses. Delmon Poultry Company B.S.C. was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Al Hamalah the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Name: Cutix Plc
Description: Cutix Plc manufactures markets and sells electrical automobile and telecommunication wires cables and related products in Nigeria. The company offers polyvinyl chloride (PVC) single flexible flat and power cables; PVC insulated and sheathed house wiring cables; industrial power cables such as armored and non-armored cables; solar cables; and flexible and automotive cables for transmission manufacturing and house-hold electrical appliances. It also provides aluminum drop wires aluminum conductors 4-core twist cables and aluminum conductors steel reinforced cables. In addition the company offers bare copper conductors for energy transmission installations; and bare stranded aluminum cables conductors such as overhead line conductors. Cutix Plc was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Otolo Nigeria.

Name: Cruzados SADP
Description: Cruzados SADP organizes produces markets and participates in professional sports activities related to soccer matches in Chile. It operates through two segments Collection and Commercial. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Cresta Marakanelo Limited
Description: Cresta Marakanelo Limited operates hotels and related services in Botswana. It operates through Cresta Urban Oasis Cresta Urban Heartbeat Cresta African Roots and Cresta African fingerprint segments. The Cresta Urban Oasis segment operates hotels including Cresta Lodge Gaborone and Cresta Marang Gardens which provide meeting and conference rooms wireless internet access and restaurant services primarily to business travelers. The Cresta Urban Heartbeat segment operates hotels under the Cresta President Hotel and Cresta Thapama Hotel brands which offer rooms and restaurants primarily to business travelers. The Cresta African Roots segment operates hotels under the Cresta Riley’s Hotel Cresta Bosele Hotel Cresta Jwaneng Hotel Cresta Mahalpye Hotel and Cresta Botsalo Hotel brands. The Cresta African Fingerprint segment operates two hotels under the Mowana Resort and Spa and Cresta Maun Resort brands which provide rooms restaurants and safaris. Cresta Marakanelo Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: The General Company for Ceramic and Porcelain Products
Description: The General Company for Ceramic and Porcelain Products produces and sells ceramic and porcelain products in Egypt and internationally. The company offers sanitary ware products ceramic walls and floors houseware vases hotel dishes and ceramic decoration as well as tableware products. The General Company for Ceramic and Porcelain Products was founded in 1955 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Continental Urbana Sociedad Anónima Inversora
Description: Continental Urbana Sociedad Anónima Inversora engages in the operation of a shopping mall and related activities in Argentina. The company also involved in the project development maintenance and rental of stores. Continental Urbana Sociedad Anónima Inversora was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina. Continental Urbana Sociedad Anónima Inversora is a subsidiary of Dypsa Desarrollos y Proyectos SA.

Name: Nairobi Business Ventures PLC
Description: Nairobi Business Ventures PLC trades in hardware materials and sodium silicate in Kenya and East Africa. The company trades in cement and steel. It also engages in air direct connect and aviation management solutions maintenance of tires and leasing of hangar as well as repair and maintenance of heavy trucks. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Manufacturas de Papel C.A.
Description: Manufacturas de Papel C.A. engages in the manufacture and conversion of paper for industrial commercial domestic school and office applications. The company produces toilet papers paper napkins interleaved sheets and other paper products. It also produces sacks bags notebooks reams and resmillas. The company was founded in 1912 and is based in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Med Paper S.A.
Description: Med Paper S.A. manufactures and sells printing writing and packaging paper. The company offers paper products in various presentations including reels rolls formats reams folders notebooks and registers notepad envelops and cube block. It also provides kraft paper for use in the production of bags sachets and containers for the food industry as well as for distribution and packaging sector. In addition it offers kraft paper envelop and bleached kraft paper. Med Paper S.A. was founded in 1948 and is headquartered in Tangier Morocco.

Name: Padtec Holding S.A.
Description: Padtec Holding S.A. provides equipment/DWDM and services and software and platforms. It offers network maintenance and management; characterization; SPaaS; fiber monitoring; and training services. The company also provides transceivers lightpads switches and routers standalone and DCI generation products as well as digital solutions. It offers its products and services to regional operators internet and telecommunications providers datacenters network operators IT and multimedia government utilities and integrators finance and research networks. The company was formerly known as Ideiasnet S.A. Padtec Holding S.A. was founded in 2001 and is based in Campinas Brazil.

Name: Unicasa Indústria de Móveis S.A.
Description: Unicasa Indústria de Móveis S.A. manufacture sell import and export furniture in Brazil. It offers furniture made from wood iron steel and aluminum as well as other products related to domestic and commercial furniture. The company sells its products under the Dell Anno New Casa Brasileira and Unicasa brands. Unicasa Indústria de Móveis S.A. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Bento Gonçalves Brazil.

Name: Arab Aluminum Company (S.A.E)
Description: Arab Aluminum Company (S.A.E) engages in the extrusion of aluminum profiles in Egypt. It also offers anodizing extrusion and painting services as well as operates a shop that engages in the design manufacture service and maintenance of dies and accessories. The company was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc
Description: Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc manufactures and markets pharmaceutical and animal health products in Nigeria and Ghana. It provides health care ethical and veterinary related products; and poultry and animal range of anthelmintic products as well as production enhancing medicaments. The company was formerly known as Pfizer Inc. and changed its name to Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc. In 1997. Neimeth International Pharmaceuticals Plc was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Livestock Feeds Plc
Description: Livestock Feeds Plc manufactures and sells animal feeds and concentrates in Nigeria. The company operates through four segments: Aba Ikeja Onitsha Operations and Northern Operations. It offers finished and concentrated feeds. The company was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Livestock Feeds Plc is a subsidiary of UAC of Nigeria Plc.

Name: Rakta Paper Manufacturing Company
Description: Rakta Paper Manufacturing Company produces and sells writing and printing papers in Egypt. It offers white and color writing and printing paper fluting and test liner paper kraft wrapping paper kraft liner and duplex cardboards. The company was founded in 1958 and is based in Alexandria Egypt. Rakta Paper Manufacturing Company is a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company. Rakta Paper Manufacturing Company operates as a subsidiary of Chemical Industries Holding Company S.A.E.

Name: Trustco Group Holdings Limited
Description: Trustco Group Holdings Limited together with its subsidiaries provides banking financial and education related products and services. The company provides short- and long-term insurance products to individuals and small and medium enterprises as well as invests primarily in mixed use land development. It also offers construction and management services. In addition the company offers commercial banking services to individuals and businesses; financial assistance services for educational and training purposes; and long-term property advances. Further it primarily conducts mining operations with focus on diamond industry. The company has operations in Namibia South Africa Mauritius and Sierra Leone. Trustco Group Holdings Limited was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Windhoek Namibia.

Name: Universal Modern Industries Co. For Edible Oil
Description: Universal Modern Industries Co. For Edible Oil produces and sells edible oils and specialty fats in Jordan and internationally. It offers corn soybean sunflower and palm olein oil; vegetable ghee; and specialized products such as shortening and margarine. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Minasmáquinas S/A
Description: Minasmáquinas S/A engages in the vehicle dealership activities in Brazil. The company sells trucks sprinters bus and vans under the Mercedes-Benz brand. It also offers belt kit inverters tensioner pulley sock absorber clutch brake disc filter kit oil intercooler engine kit alliance parts pre filter radiator reservoir overhaul kit engine engine wiring harness and turbocharger. In addition the company provides tires under the Michelin brand; online courses and training services; and after-sales service for parts and services. Minasmáquinas S/A was founded in 1961 and is headquartered in Contagem Brazil.

Name: Insimbi Industrial Holdings Limited
Description: Insimbi Industrial Holdings Limited provides ferrous and non-ferrous alloys and refractory materials in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Non-Ferrous Ferrous and Refractory segments. The Non-Ferrous segment supplies non-ferrous recycled metals for the foundry non-ferrous automotive heavy aluminum and powder coating industries. The Refractory segment provides refractory requirements of steel and cement industries; and supplies industrial heat-resistant textiles. The Ferrous segment offers steel and polypropylene fibers to the welding and optical industries as well as various ferrous-based recycled metals. The company serves steel aluminum cement foundry and paper and pulp industries. It also exports its products. Insimbi Industrial Holdings Limited was founded in 1970 and is based in Germiston South Africa.

Name: Specialized Investment Compounds Company
Description: Specialized Investment Compounds Company (P.L.C) engages in the investment development and sale of industrial buildings and specialized craft warehouses. The company serves investors in tourism agriculture trading and industrial sectors. Specialized Investment Compounds Company (P.L.C) was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Union Construction and Investment
Description: Union Construction and Investment operates as a real estate development company in Palestine. It develops commercial centers residential complexes hotels and touristic resorts; and plans designs constructs and runs industrial and tourist parks. The company is also involved in the general trading activities. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Ramallah Palestinian.

Name: Comprehensive Multiple Transportations Company
Description: Comprehensive Multiple Transportations Company provides public transportation services in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. It offers services on public transport lines for passengers within Amman municipality the Capital Governorate and other lines within the Kingdom of Jordan. The company operates through a fleet of 600 buses. Comprehensive Multiple Transportations Company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Lasco Financial Services Limited
Description: Lasco Financial Services Limited provides a range of financial services to customers in Jamaica. The company operates as a Cambio dealer and remittance services provider; and as an agent of MoneyGram International money transfer BOSS revolution money transfer Ria Money Transfer and Skip Di Line Application. It also offers consumer loans to salaried borrowers; business loans and support to micro and small businesses; distribution of Visa prepaid cards; and e-payment solutions. In addition the company provides value added services including bill payment. Lasco Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Sagicor Select Funds Limited
Description: Sagicor Select Funds Limited operates listed equity funds that track various indexes established by the Jamaica Stock Exchange. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Sagicor Select Funds Limited is a subsidiary of Sagicor Investments Jamaica Limited.

Name: Quálitas Compañía de Seguros S.A.
Description: Quálitas Compañía de Seguros S.A. offers contracting of vehicle insurance in Peru. The company was founded in 2013 and is based in Lima Peru. Quálitas Compañía de Seguros S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Quálitas Controladora S.A.B. de C.V.

Name: Sabaa International Company for Pharmaceutical and Chemical Industry
Description: Sabaa International Company for Pharmaceutical and Chemical Industry engages in the manufacture and sale of generic medicines in Egypt. It provides hard gelatin capsules such as Acitretin; film coated tablets including Saboctic Topiramate and Tolterodine; and tablets such as Claudol and Flamogen E.C.T. The company also offers OTCs food supplements and veterinary products as well as medicine trials services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Trematon Capital Investments Limited
Description: Trematon Capital Investments Limited is a private equity firm. The firm seeks to invest in property gaming leisure and construction. It seeks to invest in South Africa with a focus on Western Cape and Gauteng. The firm also engages in investment and trading in listed and unlisted shares which are not specific to any industry and potential investments are not necessarily limited by industry or geography. Trematon Capital Investments Limited is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Nablus Surgical Center Company PLC
Description: Nablus Surgical Center Company PLC provides health and therapeutic services in Palestinian Authority. The company offers catheterization cardiac and vascular surgery intensive care intermediate care critical cardiac care internal medicine general and day surgery obstetrics and gynecology emergency department laboratory and radiology pharmacy and outpatient clinic. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Nablus Palestinian Authority.

Name: Arabia Insurance Company - Jordan
Description: Arabia Insurance Company - Jordan engages in the provision of insurance services in Jordan. The company offers various insurance and reinsurance products which include marine and aviation fire and allied perils health life motor travel education and engineering insurance as well as general insurance products such as money fidelity bankers blanket plate glass personal and workmen’s accident third party liability professional indemnity employers liability and jewelry insurance. The company was incorporated in 1975 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Arabia Insurance Company - Jordan is a subsidiary of Jerusalem Insurance Co. (L.T.D).

Name: Tanmiya For Real Estate Investment (S.A.E)
Description: Tanmiya For Real Estate Investment (S.A.E) engages in the construction business. The company is based in Helwan Egypt.

Name: Osool ESB Securities Brokerage
Description: Osool ESB Securities Brokerage operates as a securities brokerage company in Egypt. The company was formerly known as Al-Iman Securities Brokerage Company. Osool ESB Securities Brokerage was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Livingtrust Mortgage Bank PLC
Description: Livingtrust Mortgage Bank PLC provides residential and commercial mortgage financing services in Nigeria. It offers national housing fund home improvement personal government employee estate development and MSME retail loans. The company also provides savings kiddies gold personal and corporate and access accounts as well as term and fixed deposits. In addition it offers construction finance and other financial services. The company was formerly known as Omoluabi Mortgage Bank Plc and changed its name to Livingtrust Mortgage Bank PLC in October 2020. Livingtrust Mortgage Bank PLC was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Osogbo Nigeria.

Name: The Egyptian Modern Education Systems S.A.E.
Description: The Egyptian Modern Education Systems S.A.E. establishes manages and leases millennium language schools in Egypt. It operates kindergarten and secondary schools The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Unga Group Plc
Description: Unga Group Plc through its subsidiaries engages in manufacture of human and animal nutrition products and distribution of animal health products in Kenya. It operates in two segments Human Nutrition and Animal Nutrition and Health. The Human Nutrition segment produces products for human consumption. The Animal Nutrition and Health segment offers animal feed and mineral supplement products. It also offers wheat flour rice and pulses porridge and maize meal. In addition the company manufactures and sells cakes roles breads and pastries. Unga Group Plc was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Sygnus Real Estate Finance Limited
Description: Sygnus Real Estate Finance Limited operates as a real estate investment company in the Caribbean region. The company provides flexible financing to real estate markets such as industrial residential commercial and hospitality. It also offers investment banking wealth management wealth advisory and alternative investment platform services including private equity and credit. The company was formerly known as Sygnus Real Estate Investments Limited and changed its name to Sygnus Real Estate Finance Limited in January 2019. Sygnus Real Estate Finance Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Castries Saint Lucia.

Name: Ipal S.A.
Description: Ipal S.A. through its subsidiaries produces and sells food products in Chile. It produces breakfasts lunches and snacks for schools under the Hendaya brand; and cereals cereal bars snacks powdered milk dehydrated products dairy mixes and functional foods under the Proalsa brand. The company also provides prepared meals and customized gastronomic solutions for its clients including casinos restaurants dealerships airlines hospitals etc. as well as frozen products under the Innovalim brand. In addition it engages in the development and construction of real estate projects; tourism and agricultural businesses; and development of products for third parties and dealers as well as food for the institutional market and concessionaires. The company was incorporated in 1952 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Al-Sanabel International For Islamic Investment (Holding) Plc
Description: Al-Sanabel International For Islamic Investment (Holding) Plc through its subsidiaries provides investment and investment banking services in Jordan. It offers various financial services such as corporate direct investments and financial advisory. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Arab Company for Paints Products
Description: Arab Company for Paints Products produces and markets internal external and decoration paint products in the West Bank and Gaza Strip. The company offers various types of paints such as water oil or decorative pastes insulation materials protection system and epoxy materials. It also provides primers including P.U. S acrylic oil orange and sport; FDT and super guard 2K; grafitta stoveto multi crystal and effitto classic; water bronze and dezeray antike terre; aipo classic and D-diomond; metallic texture/sandy road sun pannel and aluminium paints; and antirust 8 and colored varnish galvo steal aramat LAC 2001 and red oxide products. In addition the company offers galvacryl under coat bendrol turpentine wood stain sport presurfacing and coat; arasid 101 and 2001; newtex ceramic fix aratex fiber roof and araroof; thick glue flex and cold putty; vinylic matt under coat water base soft vinyl silicone stone coat water laqour and bendrol stone care fungi cryl and emulsion 2001 and 101; and aracryl 2001 2000 and 101 products. Further it provides antique velvet pearl terra concentrated golden medium golden silver multi decor and metal paint; and APC hammer seal crystal sahara 2 bond latex fill grafio flex protect seal and eggshell products. Arab Company for Paints Products was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Nablus Palestinian Authority.

Name: Minergy Limited
Description: Minergy Limited an investment holding company engages in the exploration development mining and trading of thermal coal. The company develops the Masama coal mine located on the southern edge of Mmamabula coalfield in Botswana. It supplies coal to industrial customers and power utilities. The company is based in Gaborone Botswana.

Name: Huge Group Limited
Description: Huge Group Limited an investment holding company provides mobile connectivity services in South Africa and Sub-Saharan Africa. It operates through Corporate Office Grouping Cloud and Connectivity Grouping Software and xTech Grouping and Distribution Grouping segments. The company offers satellite fibre and fixed wireless connectivity enterprise MVNO enablement voice communication and secure transmission services as well as cyber security products services and solutions; voice WAN management aggregation PBX and cloud and hosting services; and houses SMS and messaging technology platforms. It also provides internet access and secure connectivity for payment systems including customer SIM card bulk messaging 2G/3G/4G mobile data connectivity fixed mobile voice and hosted PBX solutions; and imports and distributes alternative energy products and solutions including solar panels inverters and lithium batteries. In addition the company develops implements maintains and supports enterprise resource planning and accounting software for manufacturing engineering wholesale distribution and professional services industries; and offers platform-as-a-service outsourced operations-as-a-service advisory services and technical enablement services. Further it operates as a mobile virtual network enabler that provides a cloud-native turnkey virtual network operator (VNO) enablement service to large enterprises and smaller SMME consumer brands; and develops payment solution applications for individuals small merchants and retailers. Huge Group Limited was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Johannesburg South Africa.

Name: Al Ahly for Development & Investment
Description: Al Ahly for Development & Investment engages in the formation and management of securities portfolios in Egypt. It provides non-banking services; corporate finance services including capital raising private placement merger and acquisition/financial advisory and project finance; and investment banking research and analysis capital market and asset management services. The company is also involved in the venture capital activities; promotes and covers the subscription of securities; and provides direct investment services for fund management. Al Ahly for Development & Investment was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Oman Fisheries Company SAOG
Description: Oman Fisheries Company SAOG engages in the procurement processing and sale of fresh frozen and coated fish in the Sultanate of Oman. Its products portfolio comprises fish nuggets fish burgers fish fingers breaded fish biscuits breaded fish fillets breaded prawns popcorn shrimps breaded squid rings breaded shrimp burger cuttlefish cubes and peeled and de-veined cooking shrimps under the Taqa Sadaf and Fun Fish brands. The company also offers various seafood products including demersal and pelagic fish tuna cephalopods crustaceans and breaded and battered seafood products. In addition it engages in the operation of retail outlets; and fishing and sale of fishing rights. The company also exports its products. Oman Fisheries Company SAOG was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: GCDI S.A.
Description: GCDI S.A. operates as a construction company in Argentina. It operates in Construction and Services and Real Estate Development segments. The company develops and constructs projects in Buenos Aires and Rosario as well as in Montevideo Uruguay. It also constructs office buildings residential towers shopping malls and art centers as well as undertakes industrial warehouses and other projects. In addition it offers urban hygiene and waste management services. The company was formerly known as TGLT S.A. and changed its name to GCDI S.A. in June 2022. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Prestige Assurance Plc
Description: Prestige Assurance Plc a general insurance company provides non-life insurance products in Nigeria. The company offers insurance products in the areas of motor marine bond engineering fire aviation oil and energy general accident workers' compensation and terrorism. Its products include health salary protection shield personal accident agricultural money burglary householder Mediclaim health all risk prestige device fidelity guarantee overseas and group Mediclaim SME blanket and group personal accident insurance products; and marine cargo and hull insurance products. The company also provides machinery breakdown fire and allied perils electronics equipment consequential loss contractors all risk marine cum erection or storage cum erection and plant all risk insurance products; and public and products liability professional indemnity directors and officers liability and employers' liability policies. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Prestige Assurance Plc is a subsidiary of The New India Assurance Company Limited.

Name: Fictor Alimentos S.A.
Description: Fictor Alimentos S.A. operates in the financial market sector in Brazil. It provides trading educational courses and trainings for traders; produces and markets animal protein and processed foods such as raising chickens and poultry for slaughter Day-old chicks eggs deboning of cattle and pigs meat products animal feed pasta cheese bread ready-made meals and fish and seafood; and provision of cleaning drying and other services; management of service centers; classification disinfection and processing of agricultural products; and shared resources and support for industrial and commercial operations. The company was formerly known as Atom Empreendimentos e Participações S.A. Fictor Alimentos S.A. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Arab Real Estate Investment Co.
Description: Arab Real Estate Investment Co. engages in the real estate business in Egypt. The company owns and develops housing theatres cinemas hospitals schools sports and entertainment buildings markets and garages. It also establishes factories workshops tourist villages and housing as well as engages in resorting city businesses. In addition the company export and import materials for industrial projects. Arab Real Estate Investment Co. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: 138 Student Living Jamaica Limited
Description: 138 Student Living Jamaica Limited together with its subsidiary engages in the construction and rental of living facilities at the University of the West Indies (UWI). The company is also involved in restoration and reconstruction of traditional halls. 138 Student Living Jamaica Limited was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Zellidja S.A.
Description: Zellidja S.A. operates as a lead smelter in Morocco. The company offers soft lead fine silver copper matte antimonial lead oxide and triple concentrate alloys. It exports its products to Europe the United States the Middle East and North Africa. The company was founded in 1946 and is based in Casablanca Morocco. Zellidja S.A. is a subsidiary of SOMED.

Name: Filamentos Industriales S.A.
Description: Filamentos Industriales S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of polyester and nylon threads. The company also offers viscose cotton polycotton shiny threads and dyed polyester products. In addition it provides dyeing of yarn technical and laboratory services. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: El-Ebour Co. for Real Estate Investment S.A.E.
Description: El-Ebour Co. for Real Estate Investment S.A.E. operates as a real estate investment company in Egypt. It provides contract services in the fields of housing construction and public buildings projects. The company also purchases divides and sells lands as well as utility and infrastructure services. In addition it establishes sells and rents residential projects. El-Ebour Co. for Real Estate Investment S.A.E. was founded in 1994 and is based in Nasr City Egypt.

Name: Gafisa S.A.
Description: Gafisa S.A. operates as a development and construction company under the Gafisa brand name in Brazil. The company is involved in residential commercial projects. It also provides technical consultancy services real estate management and construction services and development and implementation of marketing strategies for real estate projects. Gafisa S.A. was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in São Paulo Brazil.

Name: Golden Textiles & Clothes Wool
Description: Golden Textiles & Clothes Wool engages in the manufacture and sale of worsted wool textiles in Egypt. It offers suits jackets vests or coats as well as other casual and formal men and womenswear collections. The company also exports its products primarily to Europe and North America. Golden Textiles & Clothes Wool was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Omani Packaging Company SAOG
Description: Omani Packaging Company SAOG manufactures and sells paper corrugated packaging products in the Sultanate of Oman the United Arab Emirates and Qatar. The company provides paper corrugated packaging products and corrugated cartons including slotted carton die cut wrap around and trays and telescopic top and bottom boxes; and assembled partitions and single face corrugated rolls for cushioning and protection and wax lined cartons for frozen products. It also offers 3 ply in B or C flute and 5 ply in B and C flutes. The company serves local markets industrial household foodstuff detergent mineral water beverages fisheries ceramic agriculture and other sectors. It also exports its products to GCC and Asian countries. Omani Packaging Company SAOG was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Rusayl the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: FTN Cocoa Processors Plc
Description: FTN Cocoa Processors Plc engages in the processing and sale of cocoa beans and palm kernel seeds in Nigeria. The company provides cocoa cake cocoa liquor cocoa butter cocoa powder palm kernel oil and palm kernel cake products. It serves manufacturing companies. The company also exports its products. FTN Cocoa Processors Plc was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Rubex International for Plastic and Acrylic Manufacturing
Description: Rubex International for Plastic and Acrylic Manufacturing engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic and acrylic products in Egypt and internationally. It offers plastic products including rubitan sofas crates chairs and tables and pallet products; bathtubs and foot baths; shower cabinets; acrylic sheets; polyester units; and solid surface products as well as miscellaneous products. The company also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Rubex For Plastic Manufacturing Co. and changed its name to Rubex International for Plastic and Acrylic Manufacturing in August 2015. Rubex International for Plastic and Acrylic Manufacturing was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: National Biscuit Industries Limited SAOG
Description: National Biscuit Industries Limited SAOG manufactures and markets biscuits wafers and snacks in the Sultanate of Oman. The company offers sweet caramelized semi-sweet marie digestive and cream biscuits; nankhatai; and shortbreads savouries cookies wafers choco chips date filled cookies and pellet and extruded snacks under the NABIL ORYX and TRENTS brands. It also exports its products to Australia New Zealand Singapore South Africa rest of Asia rest of Africa Levant and MENA and GCC countries. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman. National Biscuit Industries Limited SAOG is a subsidiary of Amfis Holding Limited.

Name: Protinal C.A.
Description: Protinal C.A. manufactures and markets animal foods and agricultural products in Venezuela. It offers chickens sausages and frozen food products such as nuggets milanese tenders chicken wings and chicken burgers. It also provides broiler chickens and eggs. The company offers its products under the Del Corral Protinal and Protican brand names. Protinal C.A. was founded in 1942 and is based in Valencia Venezuela. Protinal C.A. is a subsidiary of Ag Processing Inc a cooperative.

Name: Cilo Cybin Holdings Limited
Description: Cilo Cybin Holdings Limited cultivates manufactures and sells medical cannabis products worldwide. The company offers CBD THC and THCV distillates; THC and CBD crude; CBD CBG and CBN isolates; CBD Nano Oil; oil in bottles cannabis flower and cannabis vapes; and topicals capsules and device products. It also provides flower sourcing formulation manufacturing and primary and secondary packaging services. In addition the company operates an online shop for its products under the Brand Shop name. Name: El Kahera El Watania Investment
Description: El Kahera El Watania Investment engages in the underwriting of securities business in Egypt. Name: Nutridar Company
Description: Nutridar Company produces and markets infant and baby milk formulae infant cereals infant soothing teas dietary supplements and kids’ multivitamin gummies under the Sahha Prima BebeLait and Formelac brands in Jordan and internationally. It imports raw materials; manufactures sells and markets food supplements and pharmaceuticals; and retails and wholesales baby food and supplies. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan. Nutridar Company is a subsidiary of Dar Al-Dawa Development and Investment PSC.

Name: Arab Aluminium Industry Co. Ltd.
Description: Arab Aluminium Industry Co. Ltd. manufactures and sells aluminum products in Jordan. The company’s products portfolio includes standard profiles sliding and hinges systems curtain walls kitchens shutters and curtains industrial sections advertisement profiles expansion sections special series accessories balustrades furniture and panels as well as aluminum products for decorations and partitions and air conditioning and refrigeration. Name: Jordanian Expatriates Investment Holding Company
Description: Jordanian Expatriates Investment Holding Company together with its subsidiaries engages in investment in financial assets industrial commercial agricultural tourism and real estate in Jordan and internationally. It also provides brokerage services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Main Event Entertainment Group Limited
Description: Main Event Entertainment Group Limited provides entertainment promotion agency and management services in Jamaica. It also engages in planning coordinating and delivering diverse entertainment and event related experiences as well as provision of advertising marketing digital signage audio film and corporate communications services to clients. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Main Event Entertainment Group Limited is a subsidiary of MEEG Holdings Ltd.

Name: GR Holding S.A.
Description: GR Holding S.A. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm manages equity and mutual Funds for its clients. It invests in equity markets. GR Holding S.A. is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Industrial and Medical Gases Nigeria Plc
Description: Industrial and Medical Gases Nigeria Plc manufactures and sells industrial medical and special gases in Nigeria. The company offers oxygen nitrogen carbon dioxide and dissolved acetylene gases used in healthcare industrial processes environmental applications food and beverage industry aerospace and aviation energy sector laboratory and research glass and ceramics manufacturing pulp and paper industry water treatment electronics manufacturing chemical and pharmaceutical industry oil and gas industry automotive fire suppression agriculture metal production mining and quarrying and other industries. Name: Compañía Minera San Ignacio de Morococha S.A.A.
Description: Compañía Minera San Ignacio de Morococha S.A.A. engages in the prospecting exploration exploitation concentration and marketing of mineral properties in Peru. It explores for zinc lead and dolomite deposits. The company holds an interest in the San Vicente Mining Unit located in the province of Chanchamayo department of Junín; and the Monobamba Hydroelectric Plant located in the district of Monobamba province of Jauja. Compañía Minera San Ignacio de Morococha S.A.A. was incorporated in 1942 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: NPF Microfinance Bank Plc
Description: NPF Microfinance Bank Plc a microfinance bank provides banking and other financial services in Nigeria. The company offers retail banking loans and advances and other allied services. It provides its services to poor and low-income households and micro enterprises such as members of the police community. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Lagos Nigeria. NPF Microfinance Bank Plc is a subsidiary of Nigerian Police Co-Operative Society Limited.

Name: Unity Bank Plc
Description: Unity Bank Plc provides banking and other financial services to corporate and individual customers in Nigeria. The company accepts current savings and fixed deposit accounts; grants loans and advances; and offers consumer and trade finance international banking cash management mobile and electronic banking services and money market services. It also provides asset acquisition finance salary advance and salary backed loans; bills payment funds transfer domiciliary transfer airtime purchase money transfer foreign exchange treasury bills and bonds and cards. In addition the company offers business banking services including inventory finance letter of credit and overdraft facility; unity farmers co-operative leasing and finance scheme and unity industrial input farmers schemes; and fixed income bankers’ acceptance and commercial papers products. Unity Bank Plc was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Arab Valves Company
Description: Arab Valves Company manufactures assembles and sells valves faucets mixers and fittings in Egypt. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Nasr City Egypt.

Name: Pioneers Holding Company For Financial Investments (S.A.E.)
Description: Pioneers Holding Company For Financial Investments (S.A.E.) invests in real estate and construction industrial and financial services sectors. It also provides securities brokerage and asset management services as well as same day trading margin lending online trading and custody services. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Delta Co. For Printing & Packaging S.A.E
Description: Delta Co. For Printing & Packaging S.A.E converts and prints flexible packaging materials in Egypt. It offers packaging materials for the automobile pesticide beverage cheese and dairy cone sleeve fresh food home and medical care and protein food industries; and pouches for food bags. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Alexandria Egypt.

Name: Regency Alliance Insurance Plc
Description: Regency Alliance Insurance Plc provides general insurance products to institutional and individual clients in Nigeria and the West African sub-region. The company offers motor travel personal accident employer’s and director liability professional indemnity good in transit compulsory aviation bond money plant and industrial all risk marine oil and energy contractor and erection all risk fidelity guaranty public liability machinery breakdown and business interruption insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Description: Compañía Universal Textil S.A. manufactures and sells fabrics in Peru. The company offers polyester viscose and spandex fabrics. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Sociedad Anónima Inmobiliaria Sport Francais
Description: Sociedad Anónima Inmobiliaria Sport Francais operates real estate property to build and install sports fields and educational establishments in Chile. The company was incorporated in 1957 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc
Description: Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc provides marine and aviation logistics services to the oil and gas industry in Nigeria and Sub-Sahara Africa. The company also offers charter shuttle and maintenance services for helicopters and airplanes; and harbor and general marine services. In addition it provides marine services such as agency service boat building boat maintenance and boat operations services; and training services including training to pilots and engineers of contracting organisations. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria. Caverton Offshore Support Group Plc is a subsidiary of Tasmania Investments Ltd.

Name: Embpar Participacoes S.A.
Description: Embpar Participacoes S.A. together with its subsidiaries engages in the wood and real estate business in Brazil. The company operates through Forestry and Property Management segments. It engages in the industrialization and trade of wood and its derivatives; and the management and administration of real estate property. The company was formerly known as Battistella Administração e Participações S/A – APABA and it changed its name to Embpar Participacoes S.A. in April 2008. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Rio Negrinho Brazil. Embpar Participacoes S.A. is a subsidiary of Aliança Battistella Agro Pastoril e Administradora de Bens S.A.

Name: Blue Power Group Limited
Description: Blue Power Group Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and sells soaps in Jamaica. It offers bath and laundry bar soaps. The company was formerly known as Lumber Depot Limited and changed its name to Blue Power Group Limited in April 2010. Blue Power Group Limited was founded in 2001 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Blue Power Group Limited is a subsidiary of Antibes Holdings Limited.

Name: Westwing Comércio Varejista S.A.
Description: Westwing Comércio Varejista S.A. operates as an online furniture store in Brazil. The company offers furniture for living and dining rooms other rooms garden and balcony and desks as well as children furniture; bed and bath products beach towels and children’s bed and bath linens; and decorative and lighting items including cushions lighting decorative accessories organizers frames and plates mirrors candles and scents and vases and cachepots. In addition the company offers lifestyle products which include food and beverages fashion items children’s products beauty and care accessories and pet products; and seasonal items. Name: Universal For Paper and Packaging Materials
Description: Universal For Paper and Packaging Materials manufactures and supplies packaging products in Egypt and internationally. It offers corrugated carton boxes PSA self-adhesive tapes cardboard cores and paper and self-adhesive jumbo rolls. The company was incorporated in 1981 and is based in 10th of Ramadan City Egypt.

Description: Speed Medical Co a healthcare company that operates medical lab chain in Egypt under the Speed Lab brand. The company also operates polyclinics under the Speed Clinic brand; and a 140-bed hospital in East Cairo. Speed Medical Co was founded in 2015 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Description: Injaz for Development and Projects Company P.L.C engages in the purchase and development of lands and real-estate trading in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan. Description: Eunisell Interlinked Plc develops manufactures and markets various polymeric porcelain and metallic products in Nigeria. Name: Egyptians for investment & Urban development

Description: Royal Exchange Plc provides financing asset management and trusteeship services in Nigeria.
