Name: African and Overseas Enterprises Limited
Description: African and Overseas Enterprises Limited through its subsidiaries engages in the fashion retail property media and broadcasting and water infrastructure businesses in South Africa Rest of Africa Asia Europe North America and Australia. The company involved in the retail sale of ladies’ and men’s clothing shoes costume jewellery cosmetics and related fashion accessories through Queenspark outlets in South Africa. It also owns and manages a property portfolio investment and owner-occupied properties; provides media and satellite equipment and services; and offers private water and wastewater utility services. In addition the company engages in the installation of satellite transmission equipment; radio and television signal distribution; supply of microwave and satellite news gathering services including broadcasting studio recording and other ancillary services; and providing of communication services and connectivity solutions in the broadcasting and telecommunications industry. African and Overseas Enterprises Limited was founded in 1947 and is based in Cape Town South Africa.

Name: Amlak Real Estate Investment and Trade Company
Description: Amlak Real Estate Investment and Trade Company engages in the real estate business. It buys and sells land and real estate properties; rents residential and non-residential buildings; and manages real estate and properties as well as engages in real estate activities based on a contract or a fee. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Al Bireh the State of Palestinian Authority. Amlak Real Estate Investment and Trade Company operates as a subsidiary of Global United Insurance Company.

Name: Sweets of Oman SAOG
Description: Sweets of Oman SAOG manufactures distributes trades in and sells chocolates and sugar confectionery products in the Sultanate of Oman rest of GCC countries and internationally. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Rusayl Oman.

Name: Longvie S.A.
Description: Longvie S.A. produces and sells household appliances in Argentina. It offers washing machines car washers kitchens ovens stoves water heaters hot water tanks and heaters. The company also exports its products to South America the United States Europe and Asia. Longvie S.A. was founded in 1918 and is based in Villa Martelli Argentina.

Name: Spur Tree Spices Jamaica Limited
Description: Spur Tree Spices Jamaica Limited engages in the manufacture and distribution of seasonings sauces spices canned ackee and callaloo primarily for the export market. It operates in two segments Species & Other and Canned Products. The company serves its products to food service markets. Spur Tree Spices Jamaica Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Arabia Investments Holding
Description: Arabia Investments Holding engages in the non-banking financial engineering contracting and manufacturing businesses in Egypt. The company offers bricks and tiles as well as involved in hardscape paving solutions. Arabia Investments Holding was founded in 1985 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Mantengu Limited
Description: Mantengu Limited together with its subsidiaries operates as a resource investment company. It focuses on the mining mining services and energy sectors. The company is also involved in the mining and processing of chrome ore to produce chrome concentrate with platinum group metals (PGMs) as a by-product. The company was formerly known as Mantengu Mining Limited and changed its name to Mantengu Limited in September 2025. Mantengu Limited is based in Sandton South Africa.

Name: Sanlam Kenya Plc
Description: Sanlam Kenya Plc a non-banking financial institution through its subsidiaries engages in underwriting life and non-life insurance risks in Kenya. It operates through Life Risk Life Savings Participating Non-Life and Investments segments. The company underwrites life and non-life insurance risks such as death disability credit protection mortgage protection and property protection. It also provides motor home burglary all-risk group personal accident product liability public liability marine construction all risks electronic equipment directors and officers and commercial motor general insurance products. In addition the company offers education cover financial planning investments Flexi Educator Plus FADHILI Funeral Cover personal accident insurance and motor comprehensive private insurance solutions as well as Flexi Hela that offers flexible savings with life cover. Further it provides investment management services. The company was formerly known as Pan Africa Insurance Holdings Limited and changed its name to Sanlam Kenya Plc in August 2016. Sanlam Kenya Plc was incorporated in 1946 and is based in Nairobi Kenya. Sanlam Kenya Plc is a subsidiary of Hubris Holdings Limited.

Name: Blanco y Negro S.A.
Description: Blanco y Negro S.A. focuses on organizing producing marketing and participating in professional entertainment and leisure activities and shows of sports and recreational. It also provides advisory support management and consultancy services as well as engages in the educational activities. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Macul Chile.

Name: Bermuda Aviation Services Limited
Description: Bermuda Aviation Services Limited together with its subsidiaries provides facilities management and automotive solutions in Bermuda. It operates in three segments: Administrative Services Automotive Garages and Facilities Management. The company offers elevator installation modernization and maintenance; property management and maintenance; commercial and residential cleaning; and customized electrical generator and fire detection solutions. It also distributes automotive parts and services. The company serves commercial and residential markets. Bermuda Aviation Services Limited was incorporated in 1947 and is based in Pembroke Bermuda.

Name: Jordan Masaken for Land and Industrial Development Group
Description: Jordan Masaken for Land and Industrial Development Group together with its subsidiaries engages in the real estate business in the Kingdom of Jordan. It is engaged in land acquisition and development of plot for real estate and industrial project. Jordan Masaken for Land and Industrial Development Group was founded in 2008 and is based in Amman the Kingdom of Jordan.

Name: TransCentury PLC
Description: TransCentury PLC an investment holding company invests in power infrastructure transport infrastructure and engineering industries in East Central and Southern Africa. It operates through two segments Power and Engineering. The company offers aluminum and copper cables; transformers and switchgears; house wires valves metering equipment and road preservation technologies; and metering units gauges generators low-loss distribution products and transmission cables. It also provides civil and mechanical engineering services; cranage erection and logistic services as well as installation of weigh bridges generators bearings and sub-stations; gensets; bridge rehabilitation; and road maintenance using patching technology. In addition the company offers aluminum conductors electrical accessories submersible cables industrial control cables and booster cables; ACSR bare conductors aerial bundled conductors and concentric neutral cables; and armoured and unarmoured power cables control cables domestic wire winding wire and flexible cables. Further it provides small and medium oil-filled distribution transformers power transformers low and medium voltage switch gear transformer repair and servicing transformer installation commissioning services in-house factory transformer service and refurbishment turnkey electrical power projects. Additionally the company offers on-load tap changer services off-load tap changer services motor repair services overhead line construction substation construction and mini substation manufacturing; and energy software after sale service agriculture and industrial solutions quality management projects resources leasing and rental services. TransCentury PLC was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Nairobi Kenya.

Name: Rowad Tourism Company
Description: Rowad Tourism Company through its subsidiaries engages in the tourism urbanization and development activities in Egypt. It owns leases and manages hotels and tourist resorts as well as offers tourist transportation and commercial agency services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Sohar Power Company SAOG
Description: Sohar Power Company SAOG builds owns and operates electricity generation station and water desalination plant in the Sultanate of Oman. It operates a 585 megawatt electricity generation station; and 33 million imperial gallons per day of water desalination plant at Sohar. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.
Industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

Name: Hotels Management Company International SAOG
Description: Hotels Management Company International SAOG owns and operates the Chedi Muscat Hotel in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman. It operates in three segments: Rooms Food and Beverage (F&B) and Others. The Rooms segment offers suites deluxe rooms and club rooms executive junior suites and Chedi club suites. Its Food and Beverage segment provides the main restaurant and bar beach restaurant Chedi pool bar Serai pool bar banquettes library bar shisha courtyard long pool bar and room and tobacco selling services. The Others segment offers spa boutique guest telephone guest transport guest laundry and other miscellaneous services. Hotels Management Company International SAOG was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Muscat the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Construction Materials Industries SAOG
Description: Construction Materials Industries SAOG manufactures and sells lime and limestone products in the Sultanate of Oman other GCC countries and internationally. The company offers quick lime ground quick lime and dololime as well as commercial and food grade hydrated lime. It serves the construction sugar glass masonry and mortars steel water treatment chemical paper pulp agricultural food ceramic environmental and mining manufacturing industries. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Sohar the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Litoral Transmision S.A.
Description: Litoral Transmision S.A. engages in the production and transmission of electrical energy. The company is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: INVOLYS S.A.
Description: INVOLYS S.A. engages in the consulting publishing and integration of management software and technological solutions based on AI and IoT in Morocco. The company offers Praxis a comprehensive asset management solution that covers inventory fixed asset management integrated workspace management and fleet management; and Vectis a solution for budget and purchasing management. It also provides Operis a solution for real estate project management; Stream a collaborative system that allows to manage the performance of programs and projects; Gehmonis a solution for human capital management; and P-Sapio a predictive analytics tool. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Casablanca Morocco.

Name: Paramount Trading (Jamaica) Limited
Description: Paramount Trading (Jamaica) Limited engages in importation distribution and manufacturing of chemicals lubricants and other related products in Jamaica. The company operates through Chemicals Construction and Adhesive Manufacturing Transportation and Lubricants segments. It also distributes chemicals and chemical products for food pharmaceutical additives and ingredients. In addition the company distributes SIKA branded products and adhesive and hardware supplies such as concrete admixtures waterproofing/moisture protection sealants floor and protective coating and other products. Further it engages in manufacturing of food-grade technical and industrial-grade chemicals for direct use or as raw materials; and provision of solvents disinfectants germicides household laundry and cleaning products paint resin and other products. Additionally the company offers island-wide delivery solutions; and manufactures and distributes oils and lubricants engine oils and fluids industrial oils and greases hydraulic transmission and other fluids. Paramount Trading (Jamaica) Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Trellidor Holdings Limited
Description: Trellidor Holdings Limited an investment holding company engages in the manufacture sale and installation of custom-made security barrier products in South Africa the United Kingdom and Ghana. It sells its products through a network of franchises. The company was formerly known as Trellicor Holding Proprietary Limited and changed its name to Trellidor Holdings Limited in September 2015. Trellidor Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Durban South Africa.

Name: Enjoy S.A.
Description: Enjoy S.A. operates gaming casinos hotels discos restaurants event halls and shows in Chile and internationally. The company operates through Gaming Non-Gaming and Real Estate segments. It also engages in the marketing leasing importing and exporting of slot machines and their accessories; real estate business; investment and business agencies; and operation of restaurants nightclubs event and show rooms. Enjoy S.A. was founded in 1975 and is based in Santiago Chile. Enjoy S.A. is in reorganization.

Name: Atom Educação E Editora S.A.
Description: Atom Educação E Editora S.A. focuses on publishing and editing of books magazines and educational contents in the financial market. It also provides training services for professional development and equity management; and publishes and develops educational materials for financial education and markets investments and stock exchange operations as well as professional development such as entrepreneurship; and preparation of public examinations. In addition the company offers investment services in public and private debt securities; and day trading operation services. It distributes education courses through franchises. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Sorocaba Brazil. Atom Educação E Editora S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Atom Empreendimentos e Participações S.A.

Name: Manufacturas de Cemento S.A.
Description: Manufacturas de Cemento S.A. engages in the production and marketing of various precast concrete products in Colombia. It offers pipelines such as reinforced and unreinforced pipes tubing external coated pipes highway tubes and piling pipes as well as pipes with internal polyethylene coating; box culverts; sinks including pedestrian grid vehicle grille and drains; and inspection pits and cameras. The company also provides platforms; tiles; barriers; cobblestones and blocks; poles; and other public space products. In addition it offers buildings and piles; alveolar plates and walls; glass fiber reinforced concrete and facade panels; and other infrastructure products. Further the company provides transport facility and technical advice services. Its products are used in infrastructure buildings public space and sewerage applications. The company was founded in 1916 and is based in Cota Colombia.

Name: Peru Holding de Turismo SAA
Description: Peru Holding de Turismo SAA engages in the development of tourism sector in Peru. It is involved in the acquisition of properties and development of hotel projects. The company was formerly known as Peru Real Estate SA and changed its name to Peru Holding de Turismo SAA in July 2000. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC
Description: Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC engages in the provision of personal and business banking services in Tanzania. It offers personal current foreign currency current and savings semi fixed child saving and career accounts for individual customers; and business banking accounts including corporate current call deposit and club/NGO current accounts. The company also provides loan products comprising personal insurance premium financing global education and MSME business loans as well as salary advances; and business overdrafts and bank guarantees. In addition it offers insurance products such as fire and allied perils; and liability motor marine engineering agricultural and life insurance products. Further the company engages in the foreign exchange activities. Mwalimu Commercial Bank PLC was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Dar es Salaam Tanzania.

Name: National Aluminium Industrial Co.
Description: National Aluminium Industrial Co. engages in the manufacturing and forming of aluminum in Jordan and internationally. National Aluminium Industrial Co. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Polaris Holding Company Ltd.
Description: Polaris Holding Company Ltd. through its subsidiaries provides stevedoring services in Bermuda. The company is also involved in purchasing and leasing heavy operating machinery and equipment that range from small propane operated forklifts to large mobile harbor cranes used to service container ships calling on the port; and logistics and container management. In addition it engages in the asphalt manufacturing and paving decorative paving and aggregate supply activities. The company was founded in 1966 and is based in Hamilton Bermuda.

Name: ASO Savings and Loans Plc
Description: ASO Savings and Loans Plc provides mortgage banking products and services for individuals and businesses in Nigeria. The company offers current and savings accounts and fixed deposits; mortgage personal and business loans as well as line of credit and home finance; national housing fund; and e-banking solutions such as mobile phone web/internet ATM and point of sale banking services. It also provides real estate investment banking products financial advisory services loan syndication structuring integrated financing building buy and sell commercial and residential models. ASO Savings and Loans Plc was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Abuja Nigeria.

Name: WPP Scangroup Plc
Description: WPP Scangroup Plc engages in the provision of marketing and communication services in Kenya and internationally. The company provides consumer research media investment management public relations shopper marketing brand communication and technology as well as advertising and consulting services. The company was formerly known as Scangroup Limited and changed its name to WPP Scangroup Limited in June 2015. WPP Scangroup Plc was founded in 1999 is based in Nairobi Kenya. WPP Scangroup Plc is a subsidiary of WPP plc.

Name: Arab Engineering Industries
Description: Arab Engineering Industries provides wire-on-tube condensers for use in household refrigerators chest and up-right freezers and other refrigeration equipment in Egypt. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Muscat Gases Company SAOG
Description: Muscat Gases Company SAOG manufactures markets and sells cooking gases in the Sultanate of Oman Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Brazil and the United Arab Emirates. It also provides liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) bottles or cylinders; and installation and maintenance services for gas systems. In addition the company promotes and markets goods and e-commerce. Muscat Gases Company SAOG was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Muscat Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Fondo Petrolia C.A.
Description: Fondo Petrolia C.A. engages in the exploration extraction production storage transportation distribution and marketing of oil gas and its derivatives. The company is based in Caracas Venezuela.

Name: Muscat Thread Mills SAOG
Description: Muscat Thread Mills SAOG manufactures and markets sewing threads in Oman South Asia the Middle East countries and internationally. The company offers recycled sewing thread used for fashion apparel home textile jeans wear lingerie jackets blouses shirts and knitwear; cotton poly corespun thread; poly poly core spun thread; and spun polyester for outdoor and work wear fashion garments dress shirts blouses jackets workwear casual twills lingerie leather goods jeans denim shirts and suits children wear dresses knitwear shirts undergarments and home textiles as well as textured thread. It also provides apex quilt polyester thread for mattress and bedding manufacturing industries; supreme bag closing thread used for flour rice and sugar mills cattle feed agro salt processing and tea packing. In addition the company offers domestic sewing threads under the Boat and ATC brand names; and CF polyester thread. Further it provides rayon embroidery thread zipper and accessories. The company serves large international enterprises local manufacturing companies local retail shops and small start-up businesses. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Rusayl the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Ferrum S.A. de Cerámica y Metalurgia
Description: Ferrum S.A. de Cerámica y Metalurgia manufactures and sells sanitary ware products in Argentina and internationally. The company provides toilets bidets deposits touchless deposits bidet and toilet covers active lids bathtubs island bathtubs support underpost sink counter semi-recessed pedestal superimpose shower boxes screens receptacles hydromassages bathroom accessories whirlpool accessories accessories for partitions barrales and others first aid kits mirrors vanities laundry kitchen sink urinals special lavatories and specific use toilets. Ferrum S.A. de Cerámica y Metalurgia was founded in 1911 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Marbella Country Club S.A.
Description: Marbella Country Club S.A. together with its subsidiaries operates in the real estate and sports sectors in Chile. It offers various sports facilities including golf courses tennis courts swimming pools padel courts and soccer fields. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Puchuncavi Chile. Marbella Country Club S.A. is a subsidiary of Marbella Chile S.A. para Fondo de Inversiones Privado.

Name: Caribbean Flavours and Fragrances Limited
Description: Caribbean Flavours and Fragrances Limited engages in the manufacturing and distribution of flavours for beverage ice cream baking and confectionery industries. The company also manufactures fragrances including laundry detergents fabric softeners dishwashing liquids and cleaners for household and general cleaning and sanitation purposes. It has operations in Jamaica Dominica Republic Trinidad & Tobago Barbados Guyana Suriname Dominica St Kitts Nassau Puerto Rico United Kingdom and Canada. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Caribbean Flavours and Fragrances Limited is a subsidiary of Derrimon Trading Company Limited.

Name: Consukorra for Trade Agencies & Tech. Consultations
Description: Consukorra for Trade Agencies & Tech. Consultations operates in the contracting and construction engineering sectors. The company also produces and sells electricity; grows and exports fruits; and produces strawberry. It is also involved in the pesticide and fertilizer and trading businesses. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: ASSAS FOR CONCRETE PRODUCTS Ltd.
Description: ASSAS FOR CONCRETE PRODUCTS Ltd. engages in the production and sale of concrete based products in Jordan. The company offers concrete masonry products including hollow/solid and insulated blocks ribs kerbstones and interlocking tiles as well as plain and patterned concrete tiles retaining wall and industrial building blocks single and double flowerpots and wheel stoppers. It also provides hollow core slabs precast elements pre-stressed/post tensioned concrete ceilings and bridges and glass fiber reinforced concrete products. The company offers its products for government and private projects. ASSAS FOR CONCRETE PRODUCTS Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Al Qastal Jordan.

Name: Al Madina Investment Holding Co. SAOG
Description: Al Madina Investment Holding Co. SAOG engages in the investment activities and brokerage services in the Sultanate of Oman and in the Gulf Cooperation Council countries. It is involved in renting offices for companies and individuals; managing showrooms; and renting and operates self-owned or leased residential and commercial real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Transgulf Investment Holding Company SAOG and changed its name to Al Madina Investment Holding Co. SAOG in July 2022. Al Madina Investment Holding Co. SAOG was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Shougang Generación Eléctrica S.A.A.
Description: Shougang Generación Eléctrica S.A.A. engages in the generation transmission and distribution of electrical energy in Peru. It operates the San Nicolas thermal power plant comprising three turbogenerators including TV1 with a capacity of 18708 MW TV2 with a capacity of 17082 MW and TV3 with a capacity of 25924 MW that are located in the district of San Juan de Marcona Province of Nasca as well as a generating set with a capacity of 1241 MW. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Lima Peru. Shougang Generación Eléctrica S.A.A. operates as a subsidiary of Shougang Group Co.Ltd.

Name: Jordan Investment & Tourism Transport Co.
Description: Jordan Investment & Tourism Transport Co. provides passenger transportation services in Jordan and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Inversiones Covadonga S.A.
Description: Inversiones Covadonga S.A. invests in shares in Chile. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Shira Real Estate Development and Investments Company(P.L.C)
Description: Shira Real Estate Development and Investments Company(P.L.C) engages in building and selling housing projects. It also purchases lands; trades in real estate properties; invests in tourism and agricultural projects; builds commercial residential and industrial complexes; and owns manages rents and leases commercial complexes. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: National Breweries Plc
Description: National Breweries Plc engages in the production and sale of traditional African beer in Zambia. It offers beers under the Chibuku Shake Shake Chibuku Super Chibuku 1.5l Bottle and Chibuku Super Extra Malt brand names. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is based in Lusaka Zambia. National Breweries Plc is a subsidiary of Chibuku Breweries Limited.

Name: Al Quds Readymix PLC
Description: Al Quds Readymix PLC engages in the manufacture and sale of ready mix concrete and other concrete related products in Jordan. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Fabricato S.A.
Description: Fabricato S.A. engages in the manufacture and sale of textile products in Colombia. The company produces denim drills and poplins and knit products as well as institutional line products such as workwear and military wear. It also engages in the real estate development business. In addition the company offers its products through online. Fabricato S.A. was founded in 1920 and is based in Bello Colombia.

Name: Al Aqariya Trading Investment Company
Description: Al Aqariya Trading Investment Company owns and leases real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ramallah Palestine. Al Aqariya Trading Investment Company is a subsidiary of Al-Mashreq Insurance Public Shareholding Company.

Name: ISP Finance Services Limited
Description: ISP Finance Services Limited grants commercial and personal short-term loans in Jamaica. It provides payday advances debt consolidation auto insurance motor vehicle repairs back to school or tuition solutions and emergency bill expenses as well as personal and business loans. ISP Finance Services Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Sequoia Logística e Transportes S.A.
Description: Sequoia Logística e Transportes S.A. provides logistics warehouse transportation supply chain and operation management services. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Embu Das Artes Brazil.

Name: Sansuy S.A.
Description: Sansuy S.A. engages in the trading of flexible PVC plastics in Brazil. The company offers its products for agribusiness aqua business visual communication transportation architecture and decoration coverings offshore construction and industrialization. It also exports its products. Sansuy S.A. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Embu Das Artes Brazil.

Name: Andacor S.A.
Description: Andacor S.A. through its subsidiaries operates as a tourism and ski lift services group in Chile. It offers the practice of the sport of skiing in public slopes as well as lifts equipment rental and ski classes for adults and children; restaurants sales office and restroom services; tubing canopy chair ride views sledding and skating rink activities through ticket office internet sale tour operator and institution sales channels. The company was formerly known as Andariveles de Cordillera S.A. and changed its name to Andacor S.A. in 1995. Andacor S.A. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Lo Barnechea Chile.

Name: RH Bophelo Limited
Description: RH Bophelo Limited together with its subsdidiaries invests in the healthcare and financial sector in South Africa. It is involved in investment of equity quasi-equity and equity related investments in healthcare and financial services primarily in operational infrastructure health insurance private hospital infrastructure pharmaceuticals retail and distribution and healthcare technology. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Johannesburg South Africa. RH Bophelo Limited operates as a subsidiary of Public Investment Corporation SOC Limited.

Name: Sterling Investments Limited
Description: Sterling Investments Limited an investment holding company primarily invests in fixed income securities. It holds and trades in securities and other investments. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Castries Saint Lucia.

Name: Inversiones Venecia S.A.
Description: Inversiones Venecia S.A. engages in cultivation and sale of sugarcane in Colombia. The company was founded in 1980 and is based in Palmira Colombia.

Name: Transport & Investment Barter Company
Description: Transport & Investment Barter Company engages in the logistics and land transportation business in Jordan. It offers car carriers; land container and crude oil transportation; diesel transportation service; and transportation of heavy loads goods and vegetable oils as well as operates tippers and skeleton trailers. The company also provides land transportation to flatbeds vegetable oil tanks heavy duty tankers-lowboys fuel-diesel tanks crude oil tanks livestock and sheep carriers and foodstuffs and container transport decks. Transport & Investment Barter Company was founded in 1979 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Inversiones Unespa S.A.
Description: Inversiones Unespa S.A. invests in personal and real properties. It also invests in tangible and intangible assets shares rights in companies and other securities. The company was founded in 1918 and is based in Santiago Chile.

Name: Chellarams Plc
Description: Chellarams Plc engages in the trading and distribution of consumer goods durables ingredients and industrial chemicals in Nigeria. The company offers industrial raw materials including propylene glycol isopropanol stearic acid toluene sodium laureth sulfate or sodium lauryl ether sulfate caustic soda ethyl acetate mineral oil petroleum jelly and paraffin wax. Its foam chemicals products comprises TDI polyols silicone surfactants amine and stannous colour pastes methylene chloride kraft papers and nylon mattress and pillow covers. The company supplies its chemicals for sectors such as food processing pharmaceuticals and manufacturing. Chellarams Plc was founded in 1923 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: International Co. For Investment & Development
Description: International Co. For Investment & Development engages in the investment business in Egypt. The company is involved in investing money in housing and urban expansion projects; leasing real estate properties; and producing and selling animal poultry and fish products. It also engages in the contracting works for housing projects; reclamation and cultivation of lands; division and sale of lands; sale of residential projects; import and commercial agency business; and financial leasing activities. International Co. For Investment & Development was founded in 1981 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Al Buraimi Hotel SAOG
Description: Al Buraimi Hotel SAOG engages in the hospitality business in the Sultanate of Oman. The company owns and manages the Al-Buraimi Hotel. Al Buraimi Hotel SAOG is based in Al Buraimi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Financial Services Company SAOG
Description: Financial Services Company SAOG provides brokerage services in the Sultanate of Oman. The company operates through three segments: Brokerage Activities Equity Investment and Investment Properties. It deals in shares at the Muscat Securities Exchange and overseas market on its account and on behalf of customers. The company also offers issue management margin financing portfolio management investment advice and financial research services and asset management financial brokerage corporate financing and advisory and wealth management services as well as invests in properties. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Ruwi the Sultanate of Oman.

Name: Mangels Industrial S.A.
Description: Mangels Industrial S.A. produces and sells aluminum wheels for the automotive industry in worldwide. The company offers liquefied petroleum gas cylinders air vessels and rear axles as well as provides exchange of containers for gas companies. It offers its products to companies in the automotive motorcycle truck bus home appliance and gas sectors. The company was formerly known as Mangels & Kreutzberg Ltda. and changed its name to Mangels Industrial S.A. in 1963. Mangels Industrial S.A. was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Campos Gerais Brazil.

Name: Jordan French Insurance Co. (P.L.C.)
Description: Jordan French Insurance Co. (P.L.C.) provides various insurance products and services in Jordan. It offers motor insurance products including comprehensive cover Takmili cover and road side assistant insurance products; and medical insurance products. The company also provides life insurance products comprising term life educational universal life personal accident and group critical illness insurance products as well as AMAL programs. In addition it offers fire and allied perils property and casualty and clinics pharmacies and labs insurance products; and general accidents insurance products which comprise workmen’s compensation liability fidelity guarantee money breaking glass political violence bankers blanket bond and cyber risks insurance products. Further the company provides cargo hull liability and freight insurance products; and construction and engineering insurance products including contractor’s all risks contractor’s plant and machinery machinery breakdown loss of profit following machinery breakdown erection all risks electronic equipment deterioration of stock boilers and pressure vessel and decennial liability insurance products. Additionally it offers airline hull insurance products such as hull and spares all risks hull war risks and hull deductible risks insurance products; airline liability insurance products consisting of aircraft third party passenger legal baggage cargo mail airport owner’s and operator’s premises and hanger keepers and products liability insurance products as well as excess war third party liability risk and aircraft repair and maintenance insurance products; crew personal accident and pilot’s loss of license insurance products; and travel and credit insurance products. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Fabrica Nacional de Acumuladores ETNA S.A.
Description: Fabrica Nacional de Acumuladores ETNA S.A. manufactures and distributes electric accumulators and batteries in Peru. The company also exports its products. Fabrica Nacional de Acumuladores ETNA S.A. was founded in 1933 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Bolsa de Valores de Guayaquil S.A.
Description: Bolsa de Valores de Guayaquil S.A. operates in the securities stock market in Ecuador. It also provides training programs. The company is based in Guayaquil Ecuador.

Name: Brikor Limited
Description: Brikor Limited together with its subsidiaries manufactures and supplies building and construction materials in the Republic of South Africa. It operates through Bricks and Coal segments. The company offers clay bricks clay minerals and related ancillary products that include bricks pallets and wrapping for housing residential commercial industrial civil engineering and infrastructure projects. It also provides coal minerals and related transportation services. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Nigel South Africa. Brikor Limited operates as a subsidiary of Nikkel Trading 392 (Proprietary) Limited.

Name: Agroguachal S.A.
Description: Agroguachal S.A. cultivates maintains purchases and sells of sugar cane in Colombia. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Palmira Colombia.

Name: Berger Paints Jamaica Limited
Description: Berger Paints Jamaica Limited manufactures and distributes industrial and decorative paints and paint-related processed materials in Jamaica and internationally. The company provides decorative architectural industrial and automotive products. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Lewis Berger West Indies Limited and changed its name to Berger Paints Jamaica Limited in 1972. The company was founded in 1953 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. Berger Paints Jamaica Limited is a subsidiary of ANSA Coatings International Limited.

Name: Manufactura de Metales y Aluminio Record S.A.
Description: Manufactura de Metales y Aluminio Record S.A. manufactures and sells enameled iron aluminum and steel products in Peru and internationally. The company offers household utensils; laundries; and home appliances. It also offers aluminum and steel products such as pots sinks pans and others. In addition the company is involved in development of durable resistant material enamel and metal structures. Further it engages in industrial pressing related business. Manufactura de Metales y Aluminio Record S.A. was incorporated in 1934 and is based in Lima Peru.

Name: MPC Caribbean Clean Energy Limited

Name: Minera IRL Limited
Description: Minera IRL Limited together with its subsidiaries engages in the exploration development and operation of mines in Peru. The company primarily explores for and produces gold. Its flagship project is the Ollachea Gold project located in the Puno Region of Southern Peru; and holds 100% interest in the Corihuarmi gold mine located in the Peruvian Andes. The company was formerly known as Goldmin Holdings and changed its name to Minera IRL Limited in October 2006. Minera IRL Limited was founded in 2002 is based in Lima Peru.

Name: Rio Grande Forestal (RIVERFOREST) S.A.
Description: Rio Grande Forestal (RIVERFOREST) S.A. engages in the planting and cultivation of teak. The company is based in Guayaquil Ecuador.

Name: Omani Euro Food Industries S.A.O.G.
Description: Omani Euro Food Industries S.A.O.G. engages in the manufacture and sale of baby food and related products in Oman. The company offers baby cereals rusks and biscuits; nutritional drinks; slimming food products; and calcium-fortified drink powder under the Mother’s Choice Heinz and Zydus Complan brand names. It is also involved in the contract manufacturing of food products. The company also sells its products in GCC countries Ethiopia Palestine Yemen Iraq Jordan Cameroon Somalia and internationally. Omani Euro Food Industries S.A.O.G. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Muscat Oman.

Name: Zambia Reinsurance PLC
Description: Zambia Reinsurance PLC engages in the reinsurance business primarily in Zambia. It provides fire accident motor engineering marine and life reinsurance services. The company was formerly known as Prima Reinsurance Plc and changed its name to Zambia Reinsurance PLC in February 2021. Zambia Reinsurance PLC was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Lusaka Zambia.

Name: Ronchess Global Resources PLC
Description: Ronchess Global Resources PLC together with its subsidiaries provides traffic construction and procurement services in Nigeria the United States and internationally. It offers traffic solutions including mechanized road marking road signs traffic lights solar and non solar streetlights and intelligent traffic systems; and airport solutions such as runway and taxiway marking runway signs and runway lights. The company also provides road and building construction services; and procurement services for public and private sector clients. In addition it develops and invests in real estate projects; and provides terrace and estate development services as well as urban design and regional and transportation planning services; and engages in private equity and venture capital funding activities. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: Daar Communications Plc
Description: Daar Communications Plc operates as a media and entertainment company in Nigeria and internationally. It operates through Raypower FM AIT / Television and DAAR News segments. The company broadcasts television channels comprising news channels such as AIT News AIT News Hour World News AIT Reports and The Week in Review; current affairs including Kaakaki Focus Nigeria Inside The Parliament Democracy Today Global Views Africa and Security Watch; public enlightenment such as AIT Infotech Network and Policy on Trac; business comprising Money Line Global Business and Business Africa; musicals such as One Mic Shakatawa Gbedu on the Move Prime Time Africa Musical Concerts – specials and AIT Music Plus; sports including Sports Extra Sports Today and Sports File; Magazine/Talk Shows comprising The Amazons and Bisi Olatilo Show (BOS); cultural such as Mini Jojo & Oro to no – Yoruba Language Yakpotuba – Igbo Language Ido – Hausa Language and Enjoyment Yafun Yafun – Pidgin English; and Tourism including Goge Africa. It also operates AIT INT’L an English language general entertainment channel showing predominantly news sports current affairs movies drama and soap programmes of African origin; and AIT Sport that provides national sports coverage for AIT Television radio and online. In addition the company Raypower 100.5 FM a radio station that promotes news current affairs politics business sports health gender matters youths and children environment culture religion and lifestyle. Daar Communications Plc was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Abuja Nigeria. Daar Communications Plc is a subsidiary of DAAR Investment & Holding Co. Ltd.

Name: Akary for Industries and Real Estate Investments Co. P.L.C.
Description: Akary for Industries and Real Estate Investments Co. P.L.C. engages in purchasing and selling of shares bonds and securities. The company engages in buying setting up and selling of residential apartments. It is also involved in land development selling and investment activities; and provision of leasing finance for movable and immovable assets. In addition the company invests in commercial real estate economics and industrial fields. Akary for Industries and Real Estate Investments Co. P.L.C. was founded in 1964 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Eaagads Limited
Description: Eaagads Limited engages in growing and selling of coffee beans in Kenya. The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Ruiru Kenya. Eaagads Limited is a subsidiary of Kofinaf Company Limited.

Name: Empresa Agroindustrial Tuman S.A.A.
Description: Empresa Agroindustrial Tuman S.A.A. engages in the cultivation agro-industrial transformation and commercialization of sugar cane and other agricultural products in Peru. It offers white sugar refined sugar and other by-products such as sugar cane pulp. The company was formerly known as Cooperativa Agraria Azucarera Tumán. and changed its name to Empresa Agroindustrial Tuman S.A.A. in 1996. Empresa Agroindustrial Tuman S.A.A. is based in Pueblo Libre Peru.

Name: Invernova S.A.
Description: Invernova S.A. engages in the investment purchase sale disposal and marketing of movable and immovable property commercial papers shares bonds and other securities. The company invests in develops builds and sells real estate projects. It also invests in associated companies. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Santiago Chile. Invernova S.A. operates as a subsidiary of P Y S S.A.

Name: Golden Guinea Breweries Plc
Description: Golden Guinea Breweries Plc is involved in the brewing packaging marketing and distribution of lager beer malta and stout primarily in Nigeria. The company was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Umuahia Nigeria. Golden Guinea Breweries Plc is a subsidiary of Pan Marine Investments Limited.

Name: The Palace Amusement Company (1921) Limited
Description: The Palace Amusement Company (1921) Limited together with its subsidiaries is involved in the operation of cinema theatres primarily in Jamaica. It operates in three segments: Cinema Activities Film Activities and Screen Advertising Activities. The Cinema Activities segment is involved in the theater operations and sale of confectionery items. The Film Activities segment engages in the purchase and rental of films from distributors and rental of films to cinema operators. The Screen Advertising Activities segment provides screen advertising services. The company was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica. The Palace Amusement Company (1921) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Russgram Investments Limited.

Name: Nibsa S.A.
Description: Nibsa S.A. develops manufactures and sells plumbing bathroom fitting and other products and solutions in Chile. It offers bathroom products including lavatory taps tub showers shower receptacle bidet taps bars and showers aerators and water regulators and accessories; kitchen products such as dishwasher faucets water aerators water hoses and stopcocks; and water treatment products comprising water purifiers and softeners antifouling and filters. The company also provides electronic sensor faucets timed taps reduced mobility taps flushometers and urinals and institutional accessories; and plumbing products including water connections drains and siphons flexible water and gas products gate and garden valves gas taps and connects spare parts and valves and pressure reducers. It serves retail companies healthcare companies and specialist distributors. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Maipú Chile.

Name: Gharbia Islamic Housing Development Company
Description: Gharbia Islamic Housing Development Company purchases and divides land in Egypt. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Garden City Egypt.

Name: Creast Mark For Contracting And Real Estate Development
Description: Creast Mark For Contracting And Real Estate Development operates in the construction business in Egypt and the Middle East. The company engages in establishing operating and managing of desalination plants refining drinking water distribution networks and transmission lines; and sewage industrial and purification plants. It also establishes builds and rents real estate of all levels and types as well as villages tourist facilities and shops residential cities and administrative camps. In addition the company is involved in the buying dividing supplying and selling of lands and building; and buying reclamation partition management and sale of agricultural and desert land. Further the company offers hydraulic propulsion forces in raising ceilings sliding formwork heavy lifting and lowering executing tunnels and pipe runners and other engineering solutions; and infrastructures related to drinking water sewage electricity and roads. Creast Mark For Contracting And Real Estate Development was formerly known as Creast Mark For Contracting And Real Estate Development. Creast Mark For Contracting And Real Estate Development was founded in 1978 and is based in Heliopolis Egypt.

Name: Instituto Rosenbusch S.A.
Description: Instituto Rosenbusch S.A. manufactures and sells veterinary products in Argentina. The company offers biological products including products for reproductive-respiratory complex IBR BVD brucelosis carbuncle and other diseases; clostridial vaccines; vaccines for cattle sheep goats horses and dogs; and products for the prevention of pneumonia and calve diarrhea and cattle infectious keratoconjunctivitis. It also provides pharmaceutical products such as external and internal antiparasitics endectocides antimicotics-bacteriostatics injectable antibiotics antimastitics and other chemotherapics as well as vitamins and minerals. The company was founded in 1917 and is based in Buenos Aires Argentina.

Name: Jordan International Trading Center Co.Ltd.
Description: Jordan International Trading Center Co.Ltd. engages in the trading of electrical products and appliances. The company offers electronic and smart things such as computers mobiles tablets video game consoles and cameras as well as accessories including headphones Bluetooth headsets hard disks and microphones; furniture and home appliances comprising screens and acoustics washing machines clothes dryers refrigirators freezers air conditioning systems and fans gas ovens and hoods dishwashers microwave water coolers vacuum cleaners and kitchen tools; and health and beauty products which include hair care and removal devices and men’s shavers as well as car tires. It also provides paper and cardboards photo copy papers and printing services. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Valle Grande Forestal (Valleyforest) S.A.
Description: Valle Grande Forestal (Valleyforest) S.A. primarily engages in the extraction and the cultivation of wood for fuel. The company is based in Guayaquil Ecuador.

Name: Caribbean Cream Limited
Description: Caribbean Cream Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of ice creams and frozen novelties in Jamaica. The company offers ice cream cakes and icicle as well as imports and distributes various types of frozen novelties under the Kremi brand. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Kingston Jamaica. Caribbean Cream Limited is a subsidiary of Scoops Unlimited Limited.

Name: Academy Press Plc
Description: Academy Press Plc together with its subsidiaries provides printing services in Nigeria. It operates through Books Annual Reports Calendar Diary and Label segments. The company prints novels and fiction books educational materials research papers and journals diaries and planners and company reports and publications; commercial products such as brochures and flyers business cards catalogs and product guides posters and banners promotional items labels and packaging inserts point-of-sale materials presentation folders direct mail campaigns and event materials; and periodicals including magazines newsletters and industry reports. It also offers light packaging printing services for product sleeves and wraps labels and stickers gift boxes retail and food packaging product inserts and instruction manuals branded envelopes and mailers hand tags and header cards cosmetic and beauty packaging and promotional packaging. The company serves industries individuals corporate organizations and governments. Academy Press Plc was incorporated in 1964 and is based in Lagos Nigeria.

Name: IronRock Insurance Company Limited
Description: IronRock Insurance Company Limited engages in the underwriting of general insurance business in Jamaica. The company operates through Liability Property Motor and Other segments. It underwrites car home renter’s cargo property and motor insurance products; and reinsurance products. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Kingston Jamaica. IronRock Insurance Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Granite Group Ltd.

Name: Amoun International for Investments Company
Description: Amoun International for Investments Company together with its subsidiary engages in the investment activities in Jordan. The company manages a portfolio of investments in real estate agricultural industrial therapeutic tourism service and financial market sectors. It also purchases lands; and builds apartments residential complexes and others. Amoun International for Investments Company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Invertec Foods S.A.
Description: Invertec Foods S.A. grows and processes fruits and vegetables in Chile. It offers dehydrated vegetables juices and purees and frozen fruits and vegetables. The company also provides apple chips and crunch coins and apple instant purees to the retail industry. It also exports its products to approximately 40 countries. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Santiago Chile. Invertec Foods S.A. is a subsidiary of Invertec Ltda.

Name: High Performance Real Estate Investments Co.P.L.C.
Description: High Performance Real Estate Investments Co.P.L.C. engages in the real estate business in Jordan. It purchases sells and leases real estate properties. The company is also involved in purchasing land mainly for the construction sale and rental of residential and commercial complexes. High Performance Real Estate Investments Co.P.L.C. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Amman Jordan.

Name: Shareco Brokerage Company
Description: Shareco Brokerage Company engages in the commission brokerage business. It also purchases and sells shares bonds and securities. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: Al-Arabiya for Investment Projects Company
Description: Al-Arabiya for Investment Projects Company operates as an investment company in Jordan. It invests in industrial commercial agricultural tourism real estate and other fields. It engages in establishing investment projects and participating in their establishment ownership or contribution and investing in stocks bonds and securities traded in global market. In addition it engages in purchasing developing and sorting lands and then selling them. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: R.A. Williams Distributors Limited
Description: R.A. Williams Distributors Limited engages in the sale and distribution of pharmaceutical products in Jamaica. The company sells a range of over the counter and prescription drug products in the therapeutic areas of eye ear nose drops ointments gels and creams tablet and liquid medications. R.A. Williams Distributors Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Spanish Town Jamaica.

Name: La Vanguardia Forestal (Vanguarforest) S.A.
Description: La Vanguardia Forestal (Vanguarforest) S.A. engages in the sowing of teak for harvesting and commercialization in Ecuador. The company was formerly known as Sepagua S.A. and changed its name to La Vanguardia Forestal (Vanguarforest) S.A. in January 2013. La Vanguardia Forestal (Vanguarforest) S.A. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Guayaquil Ecuador.

Name: El Wadi for International and Investment Development SAE
Description: El Wadi for International and Investment Development SAE operates hotels in Egypt. The company operates hotels motels and hotel apartments including gymnasium sauna sports fields billiards halls swimming pools bowling alleys and restaurants. It also establishes manages and operates hospital which provides medical and therapeutic services. The company was incorporated in 1998 and is based in Cairo Egypt.

Name: Construcciones Civiles S.A.
Description: Construcciones Civiles S.A. engages in the design and construction of all types of infrastructure works in Colombia. The company offers road and electrical infrastructure services; hydraulic works industrial and plant services; and buildings and mining infrastructure and services. It also engages in construction of bridges viaducts hydro electrical plants railways underground excavation urban planning and residential and commercial building services. Construcciones Civiles S.A. was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Cali Colombia.

Name: JFP Limited
Description: JFP Limited designs manufactures and distributes custom-built commercial furnishings in Jamaica. It offers restaurant decor packages such as tables chairs planters garbage bins counters and divider walls; office furniture comprising desks workstations chairs file cabinets and computer desks; and hotel furnishing products including bed bases with headboards nightstands luggage racks TV units desks tables chest of drawers closets sofa chairs moldings and valances. The company also provides retrofits of buses and ambulances such as desks booths benches and partition systems; point of sale items such as display units and charging stations; and after-sales services. Further it exports its products to the Caribbean and Latin America. The company was formerly known as Jamaica Fibreglass Products Limited and changed its name to JFP Limited in December 2021. JFP Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: One Great Studio Company Limited
Description: One Great Studio Company Limited provides digital marketing services in Jamaica and the United States. The company offers website design and development; search engine optimization; mobile application design and development; software development; digital strategy; eCommerce design and development solutions; google business profile set-up; and brand identity and design services. One Great Studio Company Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Kingston Jamaica.

Name: Latent Energies For Investments
Description: Latent Energies For Investments engages in buying and selling real estate and investment company activities. The company was formerly known as Jordan Ceramic Industries Company Ltd. The company was founded in 1966 and is based in Amman Jordan.

Name: La Sabana Forestal (Plainforest) S.A.
Description: La Sabana Forestal (Plainforest) S.A. engages in the sowing harvesting and sale of teak. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Guayaquil Ecuador. La Sabana Forestal (Plainforest) S.A. is a subsidiary of Superintendencia de Compañía del Ecuador.
